SIGN_AQUARIUS.one_liner: The sign that dreams up new ways of doing things outside the usual box.
SIGN_AQUARIUS.term_note: Aquarius stands for thinking differently and reaching toward a better future. It protects personal freedom while also thinking about how everyone can live well together.

SIGN_ARIES.one_liner: The sign that lights the first spark and clears a path by diving right in.
SIGN_ARIES.term_note: Aries is the first of the twelve signs and stands for the energy of starting something new. It's the power to move first instead of hesitating, and to learn by doing.

SIGN_CANCER.one_liner: The sign that warmly protects its people and its place.
SIGN_CANCER.term_note: Cancer stands for the energy of holding and caring, and for the home your heart returns to. With a soft heart inside a sturdy shell, it is at its most tender wherever it feels safe.

SIGN_CAPRICORN.one_liner: The sign that takes its time and climbs to the summit one step at a time.
SIGN_CAPRICORN.term_note: Capricorn is the energy of setting goals and building toward them step by step. It values lasting structures and reliable results over quick wins.

SIGN_GEMINI.one_liner: The sign that widens its world by asking questions, linking ideas, and passing them on.
SIGN_GEMINI.term_note: Gemini stands for the quick back-and-forth of thoughts, words, and information. It comes alive when it moves lightly, connecting many stories instead of staying with just one.

SIGN_LEO.one_liner: The sign that lets its own light shine and warms everyone around it.
SIGN_LEO.term_note: Leo stands for the urge to express yourself and shine freely. Its strength isn't only confidence on stage; it's also the generosity of giving wholeheartedly to the people you love.

SIGN_LIBRA.one_liner: The sign that keeps things in balance so neither side's heart tips too far.
SIGN_LIBRA.term_note: Libra stands for balance between you and others, and for harmonious relationships. It values fairness and beauty, and it's the energy that finds better answers together.

SIGN_PISCES.one_liner: The sign that flows past boundaries and feels what others feel.
SIGN_PISCES.term_note: Pisces is the last of the twelve signs, the energy of letting boundaries soften and melting into a greater whole. It stands for empathy, imagination, and a kind of sensing that words can't fully explain.

SIGN_SAGITTARIUS.one_liner: The sign that aims its arrow toward a wider world and deeper meaning.
SIGN_SAGITTARIUS.term_note: Sagittarius stands for the drive to travel far, keep learning, and find a belief of your own. It comes alive when it crosses familiar borders with an optimistic eye.

SIGN_SCORPIO.one_liner: The sign that never stays on the surface and digs all the way down.
SIGN_SCORPIO.term_note: Scorpio is the energy that looks past the surface to what's inside, choosing depth over breadth. Once it gives its heart, it bonds deeply, and it stands for the strength to rise again after things fall apart.

SIGN_TAURUS.one_liner: A slow-moving sign, but once it puts down roots, it stays for the long haul.
SIGN_TAURUS.term_note: Taurus is the energy that treasures solid, tangible security and the pleasures of the body. It draws strength from a good meal, a familiar space, and the things it has built up steadily over time.

SIGN_VIRGO.one_liner: The sign that notices the small things and refines them to make them better.
SIGN_VIRGO.term_note: Virgo is the energy that sorts, fixes, and polishes what's scattered. It stands for a quiet diligence that finds usefulness in the everyday details most people overlook.

RX_MARS_H01.action: Trim each day's to-do list down to just three things.
RX_MARS_H01.careful_cell: Go easy on yourself when your motivation dips
RX_MARS_H01.text: Mars is retrograde in your self area. Your usual push goes missing, and little things get under your skin more easily. Slow down and decide again what truly deserves your energy.
RX_MARS_H01.why_line: Mars, the planet of drive and action, is retrograde in your self area, dialing down the pace of your get-up-and-go.

RX_MARS_H02.action: Pick one overdue bill, reimbursement, or piece of paperwork and get it done this week.
RX_MARS_H02.careful_cell: Hold off on rushed money decisions
RX_MARS_H02.text: While Mars, the planet of drive and action, is retrograde in your money & possessions area, you're hungry to earn more, but things move slower than you'd like. Use the time to settle accounts and put your finances in order.
RX_MARS_H02.why_line: With the planet of drive and action retrograde in your money & possessions area, you notice where you've been impatient about money.

RX_MARS_H03.action: Save angry messages as drafts and reread them an hour later.
RX_MARS_H03.careful_cell: Don't fire back right away if an argument starts
RX_MARS_H03.text: Mars is retrograde in your area of words and nearby connections. Your tone comes out sharper than you mean, and impatience flares on the go. Rethink past conversations and say what you mean calmly.
RX_MARS_H03.why_line: The planet of drive and action goes retrograde in your learning & communication area, helping you keep sharp words in check.

RX_MARS_H04.action: Choose one tidying job you've put off forever and finish it this weekend.
RX_MARS_H04.careful_cell: Don't rush big decisions about moving or your home
RX_MARS_H04.text: With Mars retrograde in your home & roots area, you feel more irritable at home or butt heads with family. Rather than shaking things up, work through the chores you've been putting off.
RX_MARS_H04.why_line: Mars, the planet of drive and action, turns retrograde in your home & roots area, so notice what's been getting on your nerves at home.

RX_MARS_H05.action: Instead of taking up a new hobby, pick up where you left off on a paused project.
RX_MARS_H05.careful_cell: Don't get carried away by your competitive streak, even in games and hobbies
RX_MARS_H05.text: Mars goes retrograde in your joy & creativity area. Things you were excited to do stall, or you just can't get into them. Let this be a season of second chances for what you set aside.
RX_MARS_H05.why_line: With the planet of drive and action retrograde in your joy & creativity area, stalled projects get a second chance.

RX_MARS_H06.action: Turn the intensity of your workouts or workload down a notch, and keep it steady.
RX_MARS_H06.careful_cell: When your body is worn out, don't force yourself to push through
RX_MARS_H06.text: Mars, the planet of drive and action, is retrograde in your daily routines area, covering everyday work and caring for your body. Your work pace slows and fatigue builds. Reorder your tasks and protect your rest.
RX_MARS_H06.why_line: The planet of drive and action is retrograde in your daily routines area, asking you to pace your work and manage your energy.

RX_MARS_H07.action: If an argument flares up, step away for a bit and come back to it once you've both cooled off.
RX_MARS_H07.careful_cell: Don't push to win in a conflict with someone close
RX_MARS_H07.text: While Mars is retrograde in your one-on-one relationships area, old conflicts you'd swept under the rug resurface, or arguments drag on. Instead of trying to win, get clear again on what you each want.
RX_MARS_H07.why_line: Mars, the planet of drive and action, goes retrograde in your one-on-one relationships area, bringing buried conflicts back into view.

RX_MARS_H08.action: For any messy situation, list just the facts, not the feelings.
RX_MARS_H08.careful_cell: Don't make decisions about shared money while emotions run high
RX_MARS_H08.text: Mars is retrograde in your deep bonds area, which also covers shared resources. Tangled money matters or deep emotional issues come back up. Don't rush: slowly start on what you've long put off.
RX_MARS_H08.why_line: With the planet of drive and action retrograde in your shared resources area, knotty issues are best untangled slowly.

RX_MARS_H09.action: If your studies have stalled, set a tiny daily goal and start again.
RX_MARS_H09.careful_cell: Scale back overpacked travel or study plans
RX_MARS_H09.text: Mars goes retrograde in your higher learning & travel area. Planned trips or courses run late, and you clash with people who see things differently. Rather than setting new goals, return to the studies you'd started.
RX_MARS_H09.why_line: The planet of drive and action turns retrograde in your higher learning & travel area, slowing your big plans down.

RX_MARS_H10.action: If you feel like quitting, write down why and reread it once the retrograde is over.
RX_MARS_H10.careful_cell: Don't force things at work or quit on impulse
RX_MARS_H10.text: With Mars retrograde in your career area, work moves slower than you'd like, and you clash with your boss more easily. Channel that frustration into refining stalled projects and sharpening your skills.
RX_MARS_H10.why_line: Mars, the planet of drive and action, is retrograde in your career area, helping you rethink how hard you push at work.

RX_MARS_H11.action: In group work, spell out your share clearly and don't take on more than that.
RX_MARS_H11.careful_cell: Don't waste energy on group power struggles
RX_MARS_H11.text: Mars is retrograde in your community & future area. Group projects slow down, or disagreements widen. Revisit shelved plans with people you used to team up with.
RX_MARS_H11.why_line: With the planet of drive and action retrograde in your community & future area, you learn to match your pace with the group.

RX_MARS_H12.action: When you feel stuck, take a short walk or stretch it out to release that pent-up energy.
RX_MARS_H12.careful_cell: Don't just swallow your frustration; find a way to let it out
RX_MARS_H12.text: While Mars is retrograde in your rest & inner life area, you feel drained for no clear reason, or anger quietly piles up inside. Move your body to clear your head, and rest deeply.
RX_MARS_H12.why_line: The planet of drive and action goes retrograde in your rest & inner life area, so tend to the energy that's been building up inside.

RX_MERCURY_H01.action: Before you post a new profile or bio, let it sit for a day and read it again.
RX_MERCURY_H01.careful_cell: Fine-tune how you introduce yourself and the first impression you make
RX_MERCURY_H01.text: Mercury, the planet of thought and words, appears to move backward through your self area. Your meaning doesn't always land the way you intend, and you catch yourself second-guessing your own decisions.
RX_MERCURY_H01.why_line: Mercury, the planet of thought and words, is retrograde in your self area, asking you to rethink how you describe yourself.

RX_MERCURY_H02.action: Skim this month's charges and cancel any subscriptions you forgot you had.
RX_MERCURY_H02.text: Mercury is retrograde in your money & possessions area. Typos in amounts and slow refunds or reimbursements crop up more often now. On the bright side, you get a great chance to review what you've been spending.
RX_MERCURY_H02.why_line: With the planet of thought and words retrograde in your money & possessions area, the math and the settling-up deserve a second look.

RX_MERCURY_H03.action: Sleep on important messages before sending them.
RX_MERCURY_H03.careful_cell: Reread texts and emails before you hit send
RX_MERCURY_H03.text: The planet that rules words and messages is retrograde on its own home turf. Replies slow down, wires get crossed, and plans shift while you're out and about. Use the time to dust off studying or writing you'd shelved and polish it up.
RX_MERCURY_H03.why_line: The planet of thought and words is retrograde in your learning & communication area, so it pays to double-check every message.

RX_MERCURY_H04.action: For leases, contracts, or repair appointments, confirm the dates and terms one more time.
RX_MERCURY_H04.careful_cell: Double-check home and family plans and appointments
RX_MERCURY_H04.text: While Mercury is retrograde in your home & roots area, family members talk past each other more easily, and home paperwork or repairs run behind schedule.
RX_MERCURY_H04.why_line: Mercury, the planet of thought and words, turns retrograde in your home & roots area, bringing household conversations and paperwork back up for review.

RX_MERCURY_H05.action: Pull out one project you'd put on hold and see it through to the end.
RX_MERCURY_H05.careful_cell: Take a second look at anything you said or promised in the heat of excitement
RX_MERCURY_H05.text: Mercury is retrograde in your joy & creativity area, and you feel the urge to pick up an old hobby or project again. Instead of starting something new, revise and finish what you already began.
RX_MERCURY_H05.why_line: The planet of thought and words goes retrograde in your joy & creativity area, pulling old projects back out of the drawer.

RX_MERCURY_H06.action: At the end of each day, jot down tomorrow's schedule and any instructions you were given.
RX_MERCURY_H06.careful_cell: Double-check work emails, schedules, and instructions
RX_MERCURY_H06.text: While the planet of thought and words is retrograde in your daily routines area, instructions at work get muddled, and devices or schedules glitch. Use the moment to take stock of how you work.
RX_MERCURY_H06.why_line: With the planet of thought and words retrograde in your daily routines area, work communication needs an extra check.

RX_MERCURY_H07.action: After an important conversation, write a quick summary of what you agreed on and check it with each other.
RX_MERCURY_H07.careful_cell: Reconfirm plans and agreements with the people closest to you
RX_MERCURY_H07.text: Mercury goes retrograde in your one-on-one relationships area. You and someone close hear the same words in completely different ways, or contract terms go back and forth again. Calmly clear up old misunderstandings while you can.
RX_MERCURY_H07.why_line: Mercury, the planet of thought and words, is retrograde in your one-on-one relationships area, so confirm agreements and promises twice.

RX_MERCURY_H08.action: Before you sign anything, read the terms out loud, line by line.
RX_MERCURY_H08.careful_cell: Double-check the terms on shared money and paperwork
RX_MERCURY_H08.text: With Mercury retrograde in your deep bonds area, which also covers shared resources, paperwork like loans, insurance, or reimbursements runs late or needs another look. Conversations you buried long ago find their way back to the surface, too.
RX_MERCURY_H08.why_line: The planet of thought and words is retrograde in your shared resources area, sending you back to the documents and the fine print.

RX_MERCURY_H09.action: The day before you leave, recheck your reservations and travel times.
RX_MERCURY_H09.careful_cell: Double-check travel plans, work trips, and bookings
RX_MERCURY_H09.text: Mercury is retrograde in your higher learning & travel area. Bookings change and trips run late. Rather than starting a new course, review what you've already been studying.
RX_MERCURY_H09.why_line: Mercury, the planet of thought and words, turns retrograde in your higher learning & travel area, so reconfirm your plans and reservations.

RX_MERCURY_H10.action: For decisions like switching jobs or signing a contract, write your thoughts down now and reread them after the retrograde ends.
RX_MERCURY_H10.careful_cell: Give reports, presentations, and work decisions one more review
RX_MERCURY_H10.text: While Mercury is retrograde in your career area, where your public role lives, communication with your boss gets crossed, and projects already underway come back for another review. Save any big change of direction for after this period.
RX_MERCURY_H10.why_line: The planet of thought and words is retrograde in your career area, a cue to revisit decisions at work.

RX_MERCURY_H11.action: Before locking in group plans, share the date and place one more time.
RX_MERCURY_H11.careful_cell: Recheck announcements and plans in group chats
RX_MERCURY_H11.text: Mercury is retrograde in your community & future area. Group announcements get mixed up, and replies are slow in coming. Someone you'd lost touch with might suddenly reach out, too.
RX_MERCURY_H11.why_line: Mercury, the planet of thought and words, goes retrograde in your community & future area, so keep a closer eye on group messages.

RX_MERCURY_H12.action: Before bed, write what's on your mind in three lines, then close the notebook.
RX_MERCURY_H12.careful_cell: Put the thoughts you keep mulling over down on paper
RX_MERCURY_H12.text: The planet of thought and words is retrograde in your rest & inner life area. The past replays in your mind, and your thoughts go in circles. Sort things out on the inside before you say anything out loud.
RX_MERCURY_H12.why_line: With the planet of thought and words retrograde in your rest & inner life area, old thoughts tend to come back around.

RX_VENUS_H01.action: Save photos of the look you want to try, and revisit them after the retrograde ends.
RX_VENUS_H01.careful_cell: Hold off on any dramatic makeover for now
RX_VENUS_H01.text: Venus is retrograde in your self area. Your sense of your own looks or appeal wobbles, and you feel like changing everything at once. Instead of reinventing yourself, rediscover what you already love about you.
RX_VENUS_H01.why_line: Venus, the planet of love and relationships, is retrograde in your self area, making you question how you see yourself.

RX_VENUS_H02.action: For anything sitting in your cart, see if you still want it three days from now.
RX_VENUS_H02.careful_cell: Put big purchases and impulse buys on pause
RX_VENUS_H02.text: Venus, the planet of love and your sense of money, goes retrograde in your money & possessions area, and the line between wants and needs blurs. Ask yourself what you truly value.
RX_VENUS_H02.why_line: The planet of love and relationships turns retrograde in your money & possessions area, inviting you to reflect on your spending habits.

RX_VENUS_H03.action: Send a quick hello to someone you've been grateful for.
RX_VENUS_H03.careful_cell: Wait a beat before saying anything emotionally charged
RX_VENUS_H03.text: While Venus is retrograde in your area of words and nearby connections, a hint of hurt creeps into conversations with people close to you. Look back on past conversations, and say thank you again.
RX_VENUS_H03.why_line: With the planet of love and relationships retrograde in your learning & communication area, you notice the feelings behind your words with the people close to you.

RX_VENUS_H04.action: Before buying anything new, dig out something you already own and put it back to use.
RX_VENUS_H04.careful_cell: Hold off on big buys like home decor or furniture
RX_VENUS_H04.text: Venus is retrograde in your home & roots area. Old family memories resurface, or home feels a little unfamiliar. Rather than redoing everything, fall back in love with the space you already have.
RX_VENUS_H04.why_line: Venus, the planet of love and relationships, goes retrograde in your home & roots area, bringing your feelings about home and family back into focus.

RX_VENUS_H05.action: Write down whatever feelings come up, and give it a day before you decide whether to reach out.
RX_VENUS_H05.careful_cell: If an old flame comes to mind, don't act on it right away
RX_VENUS_H05.text: With Venus retrograde in your area of joy and romance, an ex or an old passion drifts back into your thoughts. Ask what that memory is trying to tell you now.
RX_VENUS_H05.why_line: The planet of love and relationships is retrograde in your joy & creativity area, stirring up old flames and past pleasures.

RX_VENUS_H06.action: On your commute or lunch break, revive one small pleasure you used to enjoy.
RX_VENUS_H06.careful_cell: Take a fresh look at small everyday spending and habits
RX_VENUS_H06.text: Venus goes retrograde in your daily routines area. Things with coworkers, or the joy you get from your work, don't feel quite the same. Bring back the small routines that used to brighten your day.
RX_VENUS_H06.why_line: With the planet of love and relationships retrograde in your daily routines area, you look again at the little pleasures in your day.

RX_VENUS_H07.action: Before you voice a hurt, boil it down to one thing you'd like from them.
RX_VENUS_H07.careful_cell: Don't rush any big relationship decisions
RX_VENUS_H07.text: Venus is retrograde in your one-on-one relationships area, and you find yourself weighing what you want from the other person against what you give. Instead of reaching a verdict, take time to truly hear each other out.
RX_VENUS_H07.why_line: Venus, the planet of love and relationships, is retrograde in your one-on-one relationships area, prompting you to weigh the give-and-take between you.

RX_VENUS_H08.action: If you split costs with someone, take this chance to write down how you divide them.
RX_VENUS_H08.careful_cell: Recheck the terms before sharing money or lending it out
RX_VENUS_H08.text: Venus, the planet of love and your sense of money, is retrograde in your deep bonds area, which also covers shared resources. You ask yourself who you share what with, and whether it feels balanced. Get clear on what you want from your closest relationships.
RX_VENUS_H08.why_line: The planet of love and relationships goes retrograde in your shared resources area, prompting another look at the balance of what you share.

RX_VENUS_H09.action: Flip through old travel photos and write down one thing you really want to do next time.
RX_VENUS_H09.careful_cell: Think twice before paying for a pricey trip or class
RX_VENUS_H09.text: While Venus is retrograde in your higher learning & travel area, a place you've visited before or a subject you gave up on draws you back again. Rather than making new plans, savor what you loved about past experiences.
RX_VENUS_H09.why_line: With the planet of love and relationships retrograde in your higher learning & travel area, subjects you once loved come back to mind.

RX_VENUS_H10.action: List three great moments at work and look for what they share.
RX_VENUS_H10.careful_cell: Tend to work relationships and your reputation without rushing
RX_VENUS_H10.text: Venus is retrograde in your career area. You wonder whether you truly love your work, or whether things are okay with the people you work with. Rather than changing course, write down what you value most in your work.
RX_VENUS_H10.why_line: Venus, the planet of love and relationships, turns retrograde in your career area, asking why you love what you do.

RX_VENUS_H11.action: Check in with a friend you haven't seen in a long time.
RX_VENUS_H11.careful_cell: Cut back on group spending and stop overcommitting
RX_VENUS_H11.text: Venus goes retrograde in your community & future area. Old friends or groups come to mind, and you compare them with your current circle. Notice who you feel most at ease around.
RX_VENUS_H11.why_line: The planet of love and relationships is retrograde in your community & future area, showing you who you really feel at ease with.

RX_VENUS_H12.action: Write down what you're feeling as if it were a letter, then keep it instead of sending it.
RX_VENUS_H12.careful_cell: Don't let bottled-up hurt spill out all at once
RX_VENUS_H12.text: While Venus is retrograde in your rest & inner life area, memories of past relationships and feelings you never voiced quietly surface. Before you open up to someone else, be kind to yourself first.
RX_VENUS_H12.why_line: With the planet of love and relationships retrograde in your rest & inner life area, feelings you never got to say come back up.

RXPOST_MERCURY_H01.action: Choose the smallest thing you can do today and do it.
RXPOST_MERCURY_H01.careful_cell: Put your revised plans into action one at a time
RXPOST_MERCURY_H01.text: Now you can act on the plans you revised while looking back, one by one. Instead of starting everything at once, beginning with the easiest one gets things flowing.
RXPOST_MERCURY_H01.why_line: It's a time when plans you put off begin to move.

RXPOST_MERCURY_H02.action: Jot down this month's spending simply on one page.
RXPOST_MERCURY_H02.careful_cell: Gather the spending records you checked in one place
RXPOST_MERCURY_H02.text: If you've checked missed payments or receipts to sort out, it's a good moment to keep them in one place. Once they're organized, your year-end money flow is easy to see at a glance.
RXPOST_MERCURY_H02.why_line: It's a time when money matters become clear.

RXPOST_MERCURY_H03.action: Pick one conversation that needs settling and say it again in a single sentence.
RXPOST_MERCURY_H03.careful_cell: Settle a crossed conversation with clear words
RXPOST_MERCURY_H03.text: Try wrapping up a conversation that led to a misunderstanding with short, clear words. Saying what you meant one more time often untangles things.
RXPOST_MERCURY_H03.why_line: It's a time when words and messages flow smoothly.

RXPOST_MERCURY_H04.action: Check your year-end schedule together with your family once.
RXPOST_MERCURY_H04.careful_cell: Line up chores and family schedules
RXPOST_MERCURY_H04.text: You can match up the chores you put off and the plans you made with family. Checking year-end schedules together ahead of time brings peace of mind.
RXPOST_MERCURY_H04.why_line: It's a time when plans at home fall into place.

RXPOST_MERCURY_H05.action: Choose one half-finished project and complete it this week.
RXPOST_MERCURY_H05.careful_cell: Finish the work that's back in your hands
RXPOST_MERCURY_H05.text: It's a good moment to take out a hobby or project you paused and finish it. The experience of seeing something through leads to your next joy.
RXPOST_MERCURY_H05.why_line: It's a time when things that stalled pick up again.

RXPOST_MERCURY_H06.action: Write down just three tasks and finish one today.
RXPOST_MERCURY_H06.careful_cell: List what's piled up and finish it one by one
RXPOST_MERCURY_H06.text: Try putting the tasks and plans that piled up into a list. Crossing them off one by one makes your mind much lighter.
RXPOST_MERCURY_H06.why_line: It's a time when backed-up tasks untangle in order.

RXPOST_MERCURY_H07.action: Send a short message confirming what you decided together.
RXPOST_MERCURY_H07.careful_cell: Turn what you talked about into a clear agreement
RXPOST_MERCURY_H07.text: You can turn what you and the other person talked about into a clear agreement. You may remember things differently, so a quick check helps.
RXPOST_MERCURY_H07.why_line: It's a time when crossed conversations untangle.

RXPOST_MERCURY_H08.action: Go over one promise you made together once more.
RXPOST_MERCURY_H08.careful_cell: Double-check the details of what you share with someone
RXPOST_MERCURY_H08.text: It's a good moment to check on the money, tasks, or promises you share. Checking ahead of time means fewer misunderstandings.
RXPOST_MERCURY_H08.why_line: It's a time when agreements with people close to you become clear.

RXPOST_MERCURY_H09.action: Write down the first step of the study or plan you're picking back up.
RXPOST_MERCURY_H09.careful_cell: Reset the dates for study or plans you put off
RXPOST_MERCURY_H09.text: Try setting dates for the study or travel plans you put off. Getting what you need ready in advance makes starting out lighter.
RXPOST_MERCURY_H09.why_line: It's a time when study and plans begin.

RXPOST_MERCURY_H10.action: Choose one task to move forward this week and write down the steps.
RXPOST_MERCURY_H10.careful_cell: Move forward step by step in the work direction you've sorted out
RXPOST_MERCURY_H10.text: You can steadily move forward with the work plans you revised while looking back. Just check the important details once more before you act.
RXPOST_MERCURY_H10.why_line: It's a time when work that stalled picks up speed.

RXPOST_MERCURY_H11.action: Set a date for one plan you put off.
RXPOST_MERCURY_H11.careful_cell: Set a date for the get-together you put off
RXPOST_MERCURY_H11.text: It's a good moment to set up plans with a group or friend you kept missing. Settling the date and place clearly makes things easier.
RXPOST_MERCURY_H11.why_line: It's a time when connecting with people gets livelier.

RXPOST_MERCURY_H12.action: Jot down, briefly, the thoughts that have become clear lately.
RXPOST_MERCURY_H12.careful_cell: Write down the thoughts you've sorted out
RXPOST_MERCURY_H12.text: Try writing down the thoughts you quietly looked back on. Having them on paper helps you close out the year and begin the next.
RXPOST_MERCURY_H12.why_line: It's a time when your thoughts become clear.

RXPOST_VENUS_H01.action: In front of the mirror, pick one thing that suits who you are these days and try it this week.
RXPOST_VENUS_H01.careful_cell: Slowly show the new self you've chosen
RXPOST_VENUS_H01.text: Bring the changes you wanted while looking back, like your clothes, the way you speak, or how you treat yourself, into daily life one at a time. You don't need to change everything at once; starting with one thing you like is enough.
RXPOST_VENUS_H01.why_line: It's a time when the way you show yourself becomes new.

RXPOST_VENUS_H02.action: Write down, in one line, a spending rule to keep this month.
RXPOST_VENUS_H02.careful_cell: Turn what you learned about your spending into one small rule
RXPOST_VENUS_H02.text: Based on what you noticed about what drew you to spend, you can decide on a way of spending that fits you. Changing small habits feels lighter than making big decisions.
RXPOST_VENUS_H02.why_line: It's a time when your feelings about spending money settle down.

RXPOST_VENUS_H03.action: Send a check-in message to one person who comes to mind.
RXPOST_VENUS_H03.careful_cell: Send a kind word to someone you've been meaning to reach
RXPOST_VENUS_H03.text: It's a good moment to check in lightly with someone you had a misunderstanding with or haven't talked to in a while. A short, warm word often carries your heart better than a long explanation.
RXPOST_VENUS_H03.why_line: It's a time when words and messages grow warmer.

RXPOST_VENUS_H04.action: Tidy up the one spot at home where you spend the most time.
RXPOST_VENUS_H04.careful_cell: Show the feelings you've sorted out about home and family in a small way
RXPOST_VENUS_H04.text: If you've sorted out how you feel about home or family, try expressing it through a small action. Changing one corner of your home into something you love can help too.
RXPOST_VENUS_H04.why_line: It's a time when closeness with the people near you feels easier.

RXPOST_VENUS_H05.action: Set aside a short time once a week for something you love.
RXPOST_VENUS_H05.careful_cell: Give a little time to a hobby you've come to love again
RXPOST_VENUS_H05.text: A hobby or creative work you drifted away from may feel easy to pick up again. Setting aside time to enjoy it, rather than to be good at it, helps it last.
RXPOST_VENUS_H05.why_line: It's a time when your sense of joy comes back to life.

RXPOST_VENUS_H06.action: Turn one of your morning or evening routines into time for yourself.
RXPOST_VENUS_H06.careful_cell: Change just one daily routine you've looked back on
RXPOST_VENUS_H06.text: If you've looked back at the parts of your days that felt heavy, you can choose one routine that wears you out less and change it. A small change can shift the mood of your whole day.
RXPOST_VENUS_H06.why_line: It's a time when your days feel a little lighter.

RXPOST_VENUS_H07.action: Start by telling them one thing you were grateful for.
RXPOST_VENUS_H07.careful_cell: Calmly share the feelings you've sorted out about a relationship
RXPOST_VENUS_H07.text: If you've looked back at what you hope for from the other person and what you give, it's a good moment to share those feelings calmly. Instead of rushing to a conclusion, take time to hear each other out.
RXPOST_VENUS_H07.why_line: It's a time when a relationship finds steadier ground.

RXPOST_VENUS_H08.action: Talk about one promise it would be good to make together.
RXPOST_VENUS_H08.careful_cell: Line up your expectations again in a close relationship
RXPOST_VENUS_H08.text: Gently bring up what you've been thinking about the things you share with someone close. A conversation about what you each expect can make the bond much steadier.
RXPOST_VENUS_H08.why_line: It's a time when trust between people close to you grows stronger.

RXPOST_VENUS_H09.action: Write down one thing you'd like to learn or one trip you'd like to take next year.
RXPOST_VENUS_H09.careful_cell: Write down the learning or travel plans that draw you
RXPOST_VENUS_H09.text: Things you've wanted to learn or places you've wanted to go may come to mind. Writing them down, rather than leaving right away, helps you set a direction for next year.
RXPOST_VENUS_H09.why_line: It's a time when your heart starts reaching toward the wider world.

RXPOST_VENUS_H10.action: Write down one value you want to keep at work and place it near your desk.
RXPOST_VENUS_H10.careful_cell: Put a value you want to keep at work into practice in a small way
RXPOST_VENUS_H10.text: If you've looked back at what feels meaningful to you at work, try putting that value into small tasks. It's also a good time to smooth out your relationships with the people you work with.
RXPOST_VENUS_H10.why_line: It's a time when the way you approach your work grows stronger.

RXPOST_VENUS_H11.action: Suggest a short get-together to someone you feel at ease with.
RXPOST_VENUS_H11.careful_cell: Reach out to a group or person your heart leans toward
RXPOST_VENUS_H11.text: Time with people you're comfortable with, or a gathering, may feel especially welcome. Rather than pushing to widen your circle, make time for a few people you feel drawn to.
RXPOST_VENUS_H11.why_line: It's a time when there are more people you want to see.

RXPOST_VENUS_H12.action: Set aside quiet time just for yourself once a week.
RXPOST_VENUS_H12.careful_cell: Carry the feelings you've sorted out alone into time that cares for you
RXPOST_VENUS_H12.text: Now let the feelings you quietly looked back on lead into time spent caring for yourself. You don't have to feel guilty about resting.
RXPOST_VENUS_H12.why_line: It's a time when resting alone fills you back up.

RXPRE_MARS_H01.action: Choose just one thing you really want to do in the new year and write it down.
RXPRE_MARS_H01.careful_cell: Ease the pace of what you've been rushing before the new year
RXPRE_MARS_H01.text: Even if there's a lot you want to do in the new year, prepare by easing your pace instead of pushing everything at once. Saving your physical and emotional energy helps you go the distance.
RXPRE_MARS_H01.why_line: It's a period for slowing down a pace you've been rushing.

RXPRE_MARS_H02.action: Write down one big expense you're planning for the new year.
RXPRE_MARS_H02.careful_cell: Leave plenty of room in your new-year plans
RXPRE_MARS_H02.text: Rather than deciding in a hurry, it's a good moment to build some slack into your plans. Deciding ahead of time keeps you steadier in the new year.
RXPRE_MARS_H02.why_line: It's a period for planning big expenses ahead of time.

RXPRE_MARS_H03.action: When you feel like answering quickly, take one breath and then speak.
RXPRE_MARS_H03.careful_cell: Practice pausing for a beat when your words speed up
RXPRE_MARS_H03.text: In a busy year-end, words tend to come out fast. Practicing a brief pause in conversation makes your talks in the new year much gentler.
RXPRE_MARS_H03.why_line: It's a period that calls for practice in speaking slowly.

RXPRE_MARS_H04.action: Pick one spot at home that needs attention and sort it out this month.
RXPRE_MARS_H04.careful_cell: Calmly sort out the things you put off at home
RXPRE_MARS_H04.text: Before the new year, you can calmly sort out things at home you've been putting off. Fixing them one at a time, instead of changing everything in a rush, keeps your mind less busy.
RXPRE_MARS_H04.why_line: It's a period for getting things at home in order ahead of time.

RXPRE_MARS_H05.action: Set the time you'll spend on what you enjoy, week by week.
RXPRE_MARS_H05.careful_cell: Set a pace that keeps what you love fun
RXPRE_MARS_H05.text: The more you want to do, the more it helps to set a pace that keeps it fun. A plan that doesn't overdo it lasts longer.
RXPRE_MARS_H05.why_line: It's a period for taking breaks even from the things you enjoy.

RXPRE_MARS_H06.action: Choose one routine to keep in the new year and one time to rest.
RXPRE_MARS_H06.careful_cell: Prepare new-year routines at a size you can manage
RXPRE_MARS_H06.text: Rather than setting big new-year routines, it's a good moment to prepare ones you can actually keep. Include rest in your routine, too.
RXPRE_MARS_H06.why_line: It's a period for trimming plans that ask too much.

RXPRE_MARS_H07.action: If something hurts, share it briefly that same day.
RXPRE_MARS_H07.careful_cell: Share your feelings before things clash in a relationship
RXPRE_MARS_H07.text: In busy times, small things can easily lead to friction. Practicing calmly sharing hurt feelings before they grow helps a lot.
RXPRE_MARS_H07.why_line: It's a period for sharing feelings before clashing.

RXPRE_MARS_H08.action: Bring up one thing you'll decide together and talk about it early.
RXPRE_MARS_H08.careful_cell: Take your time talking through decisions you'll make together
RXPRE_MARS_H08.text: If there's something you need to decide together, don't rush; take time to talk it over. Talking ahead of time means less friction in the new year.
RXPRE_MARS_H08.why_line: It's a period for calmly preparing decisions with people close to you.

RXPRE_MARS_H09.action: Give your new-year plans a roomier schedule once more.
RXPRE_MARS_H09.careful_cell: Make roomy plans for new-year learning or travel
RXPRE_MARS_H09.text: If you plan to learn something or travel in the new year, you can give your schedule plenty of room. Having some slack keeps it enjoyable.
RXPRE_MARS_H09.why_line: It's a period for planning new challenges with plenty of room.

RXPRE_MARS_H10.action: Decide on one thing to prepare for your work in the new year.
RXPRE_MARS_H10.careful_cell: Build your preparation at work instead of pushing hard
RXPRE_MARS_H10.text: Before the new year, it's a good moment to firm up your preparation at work rather than pushing things in a hurry. Skills you build now become strength when the time comes.
RXPRE_MARS_H10.why_line: It's a period for building your preparation at work.

RXPRE_MARS_H11.action: From this month's plans, choose only the ones you really want to go to.
RXPRE_MARS_H11.careful_cell: Choose gatherings and plans without overdoing it
RXPRE_MARS_H11.text: The more year-end gatherings there are, the more it helps to practice choosing only as many as suit you. Not overdoing it keeps meetings joyful.
RXPRE_MARS_H11.why_line: It's a period for making fewer plans and saving your energy.

RXPRE_MARS_H12.action: Set aside some time this week to do nothing at all.
RXPRE_MARS_H12.careful_cell: Make time to rest your tired heart first
RXPRE_MARS_H12.text: Before the new year, let your tired heart rest first. Resting well is what gives you strength in the new year.
RXPRE_MARS_H12.why_line: It's a period for getting plenty of rest.

SKY_01.common_line: Late fall asks you to take a second look at your relationships, your finances, and the way you communicate. Before any big decision, double-check the details, then move with confidence.
SKY_01.meaning_line: Venus, the planet of love and relationships, and Mercury, the planet of thought and words, both turn retrograde (appear to move backward) during this stretch.

SKY_02.common_line: Early in the new year, your drive runs slower than usual. Skip the grand launch and return to what you set aside: polish it until it shines.
SKY_02.meaning_line: For nearly three months, the planet of drive and action appears to travel backward across the sky.

SKY_03.common_line: Jupiter supports every move you make to express yourself and rediscover your joy. Let your true self show, and people answer with warmth.
SKY_03.meaning_line: Jupiter, the planet of expansion, moves through Leo, the sign of radiant self-expression.

SKY_04.common_line: Putting your days and your way of working in order gets a boost from Jupiter. Small habits and careful finishing touches pay off far more than you expect.
SKY_04.meaning_line: Jupiter, the planet of expansion, tours Virgo, the sign of order and care.

SKY_05.common_line: Everyone feels the call to build new beginnings with steadfast commitment. Across the board, people turn long-held dreams into something real and solid.
SKY_05.meaning_line: Saturn, the planet of responsibility, and Neptune, the planet of dreams, share Aries, the sign of beginnings.

SKY_06.common_line: The way we learn, talk, and connect is shifting fast. Say yes to unfamiliar tools and new ways of communicating: they open unexpected doors.
SKY_06.meaning_line: Uranus, the planet of change, settles into Gemini, the sign of communication and information, for a long stay.

SKY_07.common_line: You slowly shore up the foundations of your life and your relationship with money. Trust the long game: what you build to last shines brighter than any quick win.
SKY_07.meaning_line: Saturn, the planet of responsibility, makes its way through Taurus, the sign of stability and possessions.

SKY_08.common_line: Saturn gives your words and studies new weight, while Jupiter fuels your curiosity about the wider world. Keep learning and gathering experiences, one steady step at a time.
SKY_08.meaning_line: Saturn sits in Gemini, the sign of communication, while Jupiter sits in Sagittarius, the sign of exploration, the two facing each other across the sky in opposition.

SKY_09.common_line: A long cycle transforms people, technology, and communities from the ground up. Work alongside others rather than going it alone, and new paths open for you.
SKY_09.meaning_line: Pluto, the planet of rebirth, settles in for a long stay in Aquarius, the sign of community and the future.

SKY_10.common_line: This year, you find a new balance between shining on your own and showing up as part of the group. Watch closely: notice what begins and what draws to a close.
SKY_10.meaning_line: All year long, eclipses (moments when the Sun or Moon is briefly hidden) land on the Leo–Aquarius axis.

Q2_01.closing: The time you spent enduring never vanishes; it becomes the strength that carries you into next year. Tonight, give yourself some credit: you made it through this year.
Q2_01.intro_differ: If this year asked so much of you that you chose ‘Endurance,’ your own sense of it counts most. The sky adds one more note: there were openings to pause and catch your breath.
Q2_01.intro_match: You chose ‘Endurance.’ The sky agrees: it maps this as a year of growing stronger simply by standing firm.

Q2_02.closing: Choose one thing you learned this year and carry it forward. The learning that lasts is the kind you keep up in small, steady ways.
Q2_02.intro_differ: Choosing ‘Learning’ means you came away from this year with real insight. Beside that, the sky has one more story to tell.
Q2_02.intro_match: ‘Learning’ is your word, and the sky shows exactly that: a year of discovery and wider horizons.

Q2_03.closing: Change shakes things up, but it also clears room for something new. Write down one thing that changed this year; it helps you find your bearings for next year.
Q2_03.intro_differ: If this year felt like ‘Change’ to you, trust that feeling. The sky also reveals a steady current that kept running quietly beneath it all.
Q2_03.intro_match: You picked ‘Change,’ and the sky is saying the very same thing.

Q2_04.closing: A pause isn't falling behind; it's your chance to choose your direction again. When you're ready to move, set your own pace first.
Q2_04.intro_differ: If every step felt heavy enough this year that you chose ‘Pause,’ trust that feeling completely. The sky also shows things moving quietly beneath the stillness.
Q2_04.intro_match: So your word is ‘Pause.’ The sky sees it the same way: a year to stand still and catch your breath.

Q2_05.closing: Before you race to the next goal, pause and let what you've achieved sink in. Knowing what carried you this far gives your next step solid ground.
Q2_05.intro_differ: Choosing ‘Achievement’ means you truly pulled something off this year. Alongside that success, the sky has another story to tell.
Q2_05.intro_match: ‘Achievement’ it is. The sky backs you up, showing a year when everything you've built takes shape.

Q2_06.care_note: If the weight of a goodbye still lingers, you don't have to carry it alone. Talk it through with Sowella AI whenever you like, and if you need more support, please reach out to a therapist or counselor too.
Q2_06.closing: If you've let something go, you don't need to rush to fill the space. Take your time now and listen for what you truly need.
Q2_06.intro_differ: When ‘Farewell’ is the word that comes to mind, your feelings deserve to be honored exactly as they are. The sky also speaks of tending to yourself.
Q2_06.intro_match: You chose ‘Farewell.’ The sky shows the same: a year of letting something go and clearing space.

Q2_07.care_note: If you feel worn out in body and mind, you don't have to push through alone. Share what's weighing on you with Sowella AI, a little at a time, and if you need it, reach out to a therapist or counselor without hesitation.
Q2_07.closing: Hard times also reveal how much you can handle. As the year winds down, give yourself one more moment of rest instead of one more accomplishment.
Q2_07.intro_differ: If ‘Hardship’ was the first word that came to mind, you're right: you worked hard this year. The sky also shows your strength quietly building, bit by bit, through it all.
Q2_07.intro_match: You went with ‘Hardship,’ and the sky confirms it: this year asked you to carry an especially heavy load.

Q2_08.care_note: If this exhaustion keeps dragging on, you don't have to reach a conclusion alone. Tell Sowella AI how you're feeling, at your own pace, and when you need it, we encourage you to get support from a therapist or counselor as well.
Q2_08.closing: Wanting to stop isn't weakness; it's a sign you've been trying hard for a long time. There's no rush to decide what to let go of. Rest fully first, then choose.
Q2_08.intro_differ: How worn out you feel comes first, worn out enough to choose ‘Letting go.’ The sky adds a reminder: you can rest now and decide again later.
Q2_08.intro_match: This year wore you out so much that you chose ‘Letting go.’ The sky shows the same pull: a time when you long to set down what you've held on to for so long.

Q2_09.closing: The days that follow shape a beginning more than day one ever does. Choose one small way to carry what you started this year into the next.
Q2_09.intro_differ: Choosing ‘Beginning’ means you took a first step toward something this year. The sky also speaks of wrapping up what came before.
Q2_09.intro_match: ‘Beginning’ is your pick, and the sky points the same way: this year draws a fresh starting line.

Q2_10.closing: Write down, in one line, where those butterflies came from. Wherever that feeling pointed, you'll often find what you truly hope for.
Q2_10.intro_differ: If your heart stirred enough this year for you to choose ‘Butterflies,’ that flutter is the most precious record of your year. The sky also speaks of calmly building a foundation beneath it.
Q2_10.intro_match: You chose ‘Butterflies.’ The sky glowed this year too, with fresh possibilities sparkling all around you.

Q2_11.closing: Tidying up leaves open space for something new. You might close out the year by thinking of one thing you let go of this year and one thing you chose to keep.
Q2_11.intro_differ: If this was a year of letting go of so much and refining what remained, enough that you chose ‘Tidying up,’ that feeling is the truest guide. Alongside it, the sky was showing another scene as well.
Q2_11.intro_match: You chose ‘Tidying up.’ The sky, too, was picturing this as a year for clearing out what had piled up over time and rearranging your space.

Q2_12.closing: Gratitude tends to last longer when it's put into words. You might close out the year by sending a short note to one person you felt grateful for this year.
Q2_12.intro_differ: If this was a year with so much to be thankful for that you chose ‘Gratitude,’ that feeling is the truest guide. Alongside it, the sky was showing another scene as well.
Q2_12.intro_match: You chose ‘Gratitude.’ The sky, too, was picturing this as a year when helping hands stay close by.

Q2_01_CL_2.text: What you refused to let go of while enduring is what holds you up now. Recall one thing you protected all the way through this year, and take a moment to breathe.

Q2_01_CL_3.text: Endurance takes strength, and you're the one who found it. This week, keep one evening free of anything you have to get done.

Q2_01_CL_4.text: Not every day you endured had to be a good one. Together, those days become solid ground for you to stand on next year.

Q2_01_CL_5.text: Write down one way you got through this year. The next time things get tough, that note becomes your own little survival guide.

Q2_01_ID_2.text: If you remember this year as one of ‘Endurance,’ you had a lot to get through, and that memory is the one to trust. The sky also reveals moments when you could loosen your grip.

Q2_01_ID_3.text: Some weight is truly known only by the one who carries it. Your ‘Endurance’ comes first; the sky simply adds one more story in a slightly different key.

Q2_01_ID_4.text: Read by this year's transits alone, the year takes on a slightly different color. Still, your own sense of ‘Endurance’ is what counts, and the sky's take is simply another angle to set beside it.

Q2_01_ID_5.text: Day after day, you met this year with ‘Endurance,’ and you can trust that feeling. Beneath it all, the sky also points to breathing room slowly building up.

Q2_01_IM_2.text: The sky reads this year the same way: a season of enduring and putting down roots. It mirrors the word you chose, ‘Endurance.’

Q2_01_IM_3.text: You summed up your year in one word: ‘Endurance.’ The sky says much the same, calling it a year when carrying the weight made you stronger within.

Q2_01_IM_4.text: You worked hard to stay steady, and it shows. True to your word, ‘Endurance,’ the sky shows you standing your ground.

Q2_01_IM_5.text: The sky's portrait of this year and your ‘Endurance’ point in the same direction. You stood firm, even with the wind in your face.

Q2_02_CL_2.text: What you learn becomes yours only when you put it to use. Start by telling someone, briefly, about one thing you learned this year.

Q2_02_CL_3.text: Haven't mastered everything yet? That's fine. Being a work in progress is proof you grew this year.

Q2_02_CL_4.text: Write down, in one line, the question you kept returning to most this year. Let it be your compass when you choose what to learn next.

Q2_02_CL_5.text: Rest is part of learning, too. Before you fill up on anything new, take some unhurried time to look back on what you learned this year.

Q2_02_ID_2.text: If this year stayed with you as ‘Learning,’ trust that above all. The sky adds a note about letting what you've learned settle and rest.

Q2_02_ID_3.text: Your answer, ‘Learning,’ came from moments when you discovered something and it changed you. The sky also offers a story that heads in a slightly different direction.

Q2_02_ID_4.text: The sky was shining a light on something slightly different, but your year of ‘Learning’ comes first. Put the two side by side, and the year comes into fuller focus.

Q2_02_ID_5.text: ‘Learning’ is the answer of someone who gathers something from every day, so trust it as it is. The sky also hints at where all that learning takes root.

Q2_02_IM_2.text: The sky sees this year as a time of widening views and new skills taking hold. It points the same way as your word, ‘Learning.’

Q2_02_IM_3.text: The joy of discovering something new shines through your word, ‘Learning.’ The sky, too, pictures this year as a time of making the unfamiliar your own.

Q2_02_IM_4.text: ‘Learning’ captures this year beautifully. The sky shows it as well: a year of growing ideas and ever more questions.

Q2_02_IM_5.text: This year's sky showed new knowledge and experiences knocking at your door. That makes your answer, ‘Learning,’ all the more fitting.

Q2_03_CL_2.text: Amid all the change, look for what stayed put. When you can see both what shifted and what you kept, the way forward gets a little clearer.

Q2_03_CL_3.text: Whether the change felt welcome or strange, you're the one who came through it. Give a name to one new habit or feeling that showed up this year.

Q2_03_CL_4.text: Every shake-up also clears new ground. Think of one thing you tried for the first time this year, and give yourself some credit for it.

Q2_03_CL_5.text: When everything is changing, slowing down is a smart move. As the year wraps up, leave some gaps in your schedule so the changes can settle in.

Q2_03_ID_2.text: If this year felt like ‘Change,’ that feeling is the most reliable record you have. The sky also speaks of what stayed constant and kept you steady through it all.

Q2_03_ID_3.text: Your answer, ‘Change,’ captures the sense that something shifted. Beside it, the sky sketches a slower, unhurried process of laying groundwork.

Q2_03_ID_4.text: On the surface, things looked calm while a lot was moving underneath. Trust your sense of ‘Change,’ and let's also look at the different shade the sky reveals.

Q2_03_ID_5.text: What you live through often registers before anything your chart shows. Trust the part of you that answered ‘Change,’ and hold the sky's other story loosely in mind.

Q2_03_IM_2.text: The sky shows this year rearranging the familiar. That lines up with your answer, ‘Change.’

Q2_03_IM_3.text: A lot shifted for you this year. Just like your answer, ‘Change,’ the sky shows the current turning toward somewhere new.

Q2_03_IM_4.text: ‘Change’ is exactly the word the sky would use for this year, too. It brings upheaval and new offers together in the same season.

Q2_03_IM_5.text: Like the wind shifting direction, a major turning point passed through your chart this year. You stood right in the middle of it, and your instinct to choose ‘Change’ is exactly right.

Q2_04_CL_2.text: Standing still let you notice things you would otherwise have missed. Write one down, and it becomes a helpful signpost when you start moving again.

Q2_04_CL_3.text: Rest is a way of living your year, too. Keep this pace for as long as you need, until you feel ready to move again.

Q2_04_CL_4.text: The smaller your first step back, the easier it feels. Pick one tiny thing you can do whenever you feel up to it. That's plenty.

Q2_04_CL_5.text: If the pause felt long, that's how much time you needed. Close out the year by looking back on what that rest protected for you.

Q2_04_ID_2.text: If you remember this year as a ‘Pause,’ you needed a place to rest. The sky also speaks of choosing again, starting with small things.

Q2_04_ID_3.text: Nobody knows the weight of standing still better than the one who lived it. Your ‘Pause’ comes first, and the sky simply offers one more scene beside it.

Q2_04_ID_4.text: Life around you moved fast while you stood still inside. Your sense of ‘Pause’ is what counts; the sky's story is there simply for reference.

Q2_04_ID_5.text: This year made you want to stop in your tracks, and I respect your answer, ‘Pause.’ The sky also points to strength slowly returning during that time.

Q2_04_IM_2.text: The sky shows this year as a time to slow down and tend to your inner world. It fits your answer, ‘Pause,’ perfectly.

Q2_04_IM_3.text: Even standing still, you felt a great deal. The sky, too, pictures this year as a ‘Pause,’ a time to check your direction again.

Q2_04_IM_4.text: ‘Pause’ is close to the name the sky would give this year. It calls for staying put and sorting things out rather than rushing ahead.

Q2_04_IM_5.text: This year's sky was like waiting at a red light. Your answer, ‘Pause,’ fits right into that picture.

Q2_05_CL_2.text: Behind every achievement is a habit that kept you going. Pick one habit that helped you this year and bring it with you into next year.

Q2_05_CL_3.text: Don't put off celebrating. Mark this year in your own way, even a small one.

Q2_05_CL_4.text: Who you became along the way counts as much as the results. Next to what you accomplished, write down how you've grown.

Q2_05_CL_5.text: Your next goal can wait until you've caught your breath. First, remember what drove you this far.

Q2_05_ID_2.text: Looking back on this year as ‘Achievement’? Trust that memory. Behind those results, the sky also makes room for taking care of yourself.

Q2_05_ID_3.text: You pulled some things off, or ‘Achievement’ wouldn't be your answer. The sky adds a story about a slightly slower rhythm.

Q2_05_ID_4.text: Whatever your chart shows, nobody knows the feeling of your own ‘Achievement’ better than you do. The sky also points to things that are still growing.

Q2_05_ID_5.text: You got here through real effort, so trust your answer, ‘Achievement,’ just as it is. The sky adds a note about saving your energy for what comes next.

Q2_05_IM_2.text: The sky shows this year as one when hard work pays off. No wonder your answer, ‘Achievement,’ rings so true.

Q2_05_IM_3.text: This was a year you had something real to show for your efforts. Like your word, ‘Achievement,’ the sky shows recognition and results returning to match the work you put in.

Q2_05_IM_4.text: ‘Achievement’ suits this year's sky well. It shows you climbing one step higher.

Q2_05_IM_5.text: This year's sky was a lot like watching seeds turn into fruit. That image and your pick, ‘Achievement,’ line up perfectly.

Q2_06_CL_2.text: Grief comes and goes on its own schedule. On days you miss what's gone, let yourself miss it.

Q2_06_CL_3.text: You don't have to work at getting over the hurt. For today, sipping something warm and being a little kind to yourself is enough.

Q2_06_CL_4.text: On days that feel too heavy to carry alone, open up a little to someone you trust. Simply having someone beside you can make it easier to breathe.

Q2_01_CAREER_3.text: All year, you weighed staying against moving on, and still you held your ground for now. You weren't dodging a decision. You were waiting until you were ready, and that takes its own kind of wisdom.

Q2_01_FAMILY_1.text: You carried your family's worries on your own and still wore a brave face. You've worked hard to protect them; now carve out small pockets of rest for yourself.

Q2_01_FAMILY_2.text: Family conversations kept going wrong, and still you held back the hurt and came back to the table. You couldn't make everyone feel understood, but your steadfast presence left its mark on your family.

Q2_01_FAMILY_3.text: This year meant getting through one heavy moment after another, from holiday gatherings to dutiful check-in calls. Set the distance from family that you can truly manage. That is how you look after yourself.

Q2_01_GROWTH_1.text: Your studies or exam prep moved slower than you hoped, yet you kept yourself at the desk anyway. Holding steady on the slow days is a skill in its own right.

Q2_01_GROWTH_2.text: As the people around you seemed to settle on their paths one by one, the rush pressed in, and still you kept hold of your own direction. Measure this year by your own steps, not anyone else's pace, and you'll see how far you've come.

Q2_01_GROWTH_3.text: For a long stretch, the next step stayed blurry, so you held on to each day's to-do list. The questions that answer slowest reward the waiting most: what you endured now grounds your next choice.

Q2_01_LOVE_1.text: Even when you two weren't on the same page, you texted first and waited, because you weren't ready to let go. Protect what matters to you, and ask yourself just as honestly whether you feel at ease in it.

Q2_01_LOVE_2.text: Some nights you quietly carried feelings for someone, or the weight of being alone, and acted like everything was fine. You made it through those nights, so offer yourself a kind word tonight.

Q2_01_LOVE_3.text: Life got so full that you shelved your love life and focused on getting through each day. Don't call that lost time. Call it the season you put yourself before a relationship.

Q2_01_MONEY_1.text: As living costs climbed, you put wish-list items back on the shelf again and again and steered through month after month. All those careful days sharpened your sense of the life you want to protect.

Q2_01_MONEY_2.text: Your stomach dropped every time you checked your bank balance, yet you kept going without letting it show. Don't hold that worry alone: write down your spending rhythm once, and give yourself room to breathe.

Q2_01_MONEY_3.text: Each surprise expense sent you back to rework your plans and keep life in balance. Following the first plan perfectly matters less than the strength to readjust when things wobble, and you're building exactly that.

Q2_01_SOCIAL_1.text: You smiled your way through awkward get-togethers and group chats to keep the peace. Remember this: not every relationship needs the same tight grip.

Q2_01_SOCIAL_2.text: You bent over backwards for the people around you, pushing your own tasks aside because you couldn't say no. Practice one small "no" that protects your time; that is how friendships stay comfortable for the long haul.

Q2_01_SOCIAL_3.text: Even when no one seemed close enough to confide in, you kept your days running on your own. Now be the first to ask yourself how you're really doing.

Q2_02_CAREER_1.text: New responsibilities and unfamiliar tasks filled your year, and you met them by asking questions and learning one step at a time. Work that once felt clumsy is now second nature, the clearest record of what you built this year.

Q2_02_CAREER_2.text: Mistakes and tough feedback pushed you to refine how you work, bit by bit. What you learned there becomes your own know-how, and it travels with you wherever you go next.

Q2_02_CAREER_3.text: Watching the people you work with, you picked up new ways to approach the job and to speak up. Write down one quality you admired this year, and let it guide how you work next year.

Q2_02_FAMILY_1.text: Instead of getting stung by a family member's words the way you used to, you tried to hear the feeling underneath. Seeing each other differently is a real lesson, and this year taught it to you.

Q2_02_FAMILY_2.text: At some point, you saw someone in your family in a new light, as a person in their own right. Knowing that each of them carries their own story lifts some of the weight from your shoulders.

Q2_02_FAMILY_3.text: Looking back at the role you've played in your family, you began to see where your part ends. Realizing you don't have to fix everything is a precious harvest of its own.

Q2_02_GROWTH_1.text: Classes, books, certification prep: you made time to learn something new on more days than you realize. Even the studies you didn't finish have already left their mark on you.

Q2_02_GROWTH_2.text: When plans fell through, you started discovering what you love and what you're good at. Even the moments that looked like failures were valuable lessons that narrowed your path.

Q2_02_GROWTH_3.text: Instead of following someone else's map, you learned to find the pace and approach that suit you. Knowing what kind of learner you are is as big a harvest as anything you studied.

Q2_02_LOVE_1.text: Growing close to someone, or drifting apart, showed you once more what you truly want from a relationship. Carry that insight forward; it keeps you at ease the next time around.

Q2_02_LOVE_2.text: You rethought how you show your feelings and how you voice hurt, and you tried it a new way. Awkward or not, that one attempt is a big step in learning the art of love.

Q2_02_LOVE_3.text: Single or partnered, you learned this year how to love without losing yourself. Remember: caring for someone and caring for yourself go hand in hand.

Q2_02_MONEY_1.text: Calmly and honestly, you kept a budget or sat down to see where your money really goes. Once you see the everyday habits behind the numbers, you've learned something that matters.

Q2_02_MONEY_2.text: An unexpected expense or two taught you firsthand why a cushion matters. The personal rules you drew from it give your life a steadier footing from here on.

Q2_02_MONEY_3.text: This year showed you which purchases feel good and which leave regret behind. Finding spending rules that fit you is an essential part of building a steadier life.

Q2_02_SOCIAL_1.text: New groups and new faces brought you perspectives unlike your own, and your world grew wider. Recall one conversation that stayed with you this year, and notice what that person gave you.

Q2_02_SOCIAL_2.text: In long-standing friendships, you slowly learned to adjust the distance and to say when something hurt. Relationships are less about getting it right the first time and more about getting to know each other, again and again.

Q2_02_SOCIAL_3.text: Saying no and asking for help felt awkward, but you tried each one here and there and learned to speak up for yourself. Those small wins add up to the strength that keeps you grounded among people.

Q2_03_CAREER_1.text: A new role, or a shift in who you work with, reshaped the familiar rhythm of your days. Adapting to unfamiliar ground takes real strength, and you accomplished more than you give yourself credit for.

Q2_03_CAREER_2.text: Whether you weighed a job change or actually made the move, you spent this year redrawing where your work is headed. List what changed and what stayed the same side by side, and you'll see what you want to protect in your work.

Q2_03_CAREER_3.text: On the surface, the job looks the same, but your feelings and expectations about it have quietly shifted. A change of heart is real movement, so follow where it leads, at your own pace.

Q2_03_FAMILY_1.text: A move, or getting your own place, changed the way you live with family, and home felt unfamiliar for a while. Go easy on yourself; a new normal takes time to settle in.

Q2_03_FAMILY_2.text: Your role in the family shifted, or more of the caregiving landed on you, and you felt stretched thin. As your role changes, build new ways to look after yourself, too.

Q2_03_FAMILY_3.text: Your feelings about family slowly shifted, and you began to see each other from a new distance. Closer or a little farther apart, trust that where things stand now has its reasons.

Q2_03_GROWTH_1.text: You began rethinking a path you'd planned on for years, or felt drawn toward a completely different field. Changing direction doesn't mean you're lost. It means you know yourself better now.

Q2_03_GROWTH_2.text: You switched up how you study and how you spend your days until you found a rhythm that fits. Even one small habit that changed is a clear, precious mark this year left on your life.

Q2_03_GROWTH_3.text: Goals that once felt huge loosened their hold this year, and new hopes moved into their place. Rewriting your goals to fit who you are now isn't giving up. It's what growing looks like.

Q2_03_LOVE_1.text: As the shape of your relationship and the closeness between you changed, your heart wavered more than once. Wherever things stand now, first find the pace and distance that let you feel at ease.

Q2_03_LOVE_2.text: Your type, or what you want from love, isn't what it used to be, and you've noticed. Those new standards work like a mirror, showing you more clearly who you are today.

Q2_03_LOVE_3.text: Love took up more room in your life at some moments and less at others, shifting your center of gravity. If you chose that balance yourself, honor it just as it is.

Q2_03_MONEY_1.text: A change in your living situation reshuffled your monthly bills and spending priorities. Treat it as setting new ground rules, one at a time, for the life you have now.

Q2_03_MONEY_2.text: Spending you never thought twice about suddenly felt like a lot, or the reverse: you finally started spending on yourself. Your shifting feelings about money point straight to the life you want right now.

Q2_03_MONEY_3.text: When your monthly spending got thrown off, you worked hard to regain solid ground. The rules you rebuild after a shake-up often fit your life better than the old ones did.

Q2_03_SOCIAL_1.text: Some familiar faces faded from your days while new ones arrived. That ebb and flow is natural, so take your time getting to know the people around you now.

Q2_03_SOCIAL_2.text: A change of scene had you finding your place all over again in a new group or among new coworkers. Comfort doesn't have to come right away. Start with one conversation, with one person, and build from there.

Q2_03_SOCIAL_3.text: You changed how you deal with people, and you no longer answer every message the second it arrives. If that change protects you, there's nothing to apologize for. Own it.

Q2_04_CAREER_1.text: Whether you stepped away or a project stalled, your career clock slowed down this year. Use that pause to ask what you truly want from work; it's valuable groundwork for what comes next.

Q2_04_CAREER_2.text: Your calendar stayed packed, yet part of you felt like you were standing still. That stuck feeling is your intuition asking you to take a fresh look at how you do things.

Q2_04_CAREER_3.text: The opportunity or next step you hoped for arrived slower than expected, and the wait felt long. Everything you sharpened in the meantime backs you up when the momentum returns.

Q2_04_FAMILY_1.text: For a stretch, you and your family barely talked, or everyone kept their thoughts to themselves. Feelings were sorting themselves out in the quiet, so don't rush to fix anything.

Q2_04_FAMILY_2.text: A family matter asked you to put your own plans on hold and tend to home first. Now start making room, little by little, for what you set aside for yourself.

Q2_04_FAMILY_3.text: You set a long-running family issue aside and stepped back to catch your breath. That pause wasn't turning away. It was rest you needed to protect yourself.

Q2_04_GROWTH_1.text: At some point you moved your studies and plans to the back burner and simply let things be. That downtime was part of recharging for your next step.

Q2_04_GROWTH_2.text: Unsure of what you wanted, you held off on big choices and stayed put for a while. By not rushing to an answer, you came to understand yourself more clearly.

Q2_04_GROWTH_3.text: The self-improvement routine you'd built came apart, and some days you couldn't find the energy to start over. For now, pick up one tiny thing where you left off. That's enough.

Q2_04_LOVE_1.text: You pressed pause on your love life for a while to focus on yourself. Stepping back from dating to care for you first is a meaningful choice in its own right.

Q2_04_LOVE_2.text: Your feelings for someone, or the relationship you're in, stayed in the same place for a long while. Even when nothing seems to move, what you truly want comes into focus on its own.

Q2_04_LOVE_3.text: When someone tried to get closer, you hit pause and watched before opening up. Taking your time until you feel ready is a way of honoring yourself.

Q2_04_MONEY_1.text: You held off on big purchases and plans, kept life to the basics, and caught your breath. That pause to review your spending gives you solid ground for setting your next money rules.

Q2_04_MONEY_2.text: Your savings and money plans didn't advance the way you hoped, and it felt like running in place. Yet holding steady is exactly what kept your life from wobbling.

Q2_04_MONEY_3.text: Money weighed so heavily that you avoided looking at it for a while. When you're ready, start by glancing over a single month of spending. That's plenty.

Q2_04_SOCIAL_1.text: Fewer get-togethers, fewer plans, more time alone: you stepped back from your social life this year. Time away from people is your chance to recharge before you reconnect.

Q2_04_SOCIAL_2.text: Some days, reaching out, or even being reached, felt like too much, and messages sat unanswered for a long time. Cut yourself some slack. Those slow replies had their reasons.

Q2_04_SOCIAL_3.text: Instead of widening your circle, you paused and poured your energy into the few people closest to you. A handful of easy, comfortable bonds often gives you more strength than a crowd.

Q2_05_CAREER_1.text: You finally wrapped up a project you'd carried for ages, or saw an assignment all the way through. Remember how you worked and the grit it took, not just the result; that memory carries you into the next one.

Q2_05_CAREER_2.text: Your hard work paid off in a way others could see, through recognition or a new role. Share the win with someone and celebrate it one more time.

Q2_05_CAREER_3.text: It didn't make headlines, but you noticed yourself working more steadily and making fewer mistakes. Progress no one else sees is still a real step forward.

Q2_05_FAMILY_1.text: You finally said what you'd been meaning to tell your family, or made the first move to mend a bond that had felt awkward for years. A few small words like that ripple through a family for a long time.

Q2_05_FAMILY_2.text: You gave your family something you'd long wanted to give, or saw a family matter safely through to the end. You took such good care of them; now thank yourself for all the effort it took.

Q2_05_FAMILY_3.text: Drawing a line with family that protects your peace, and holding it, was this year's real accomplishment. Seen by others or not, choosing to protect yourself is a big, meaningful step.

Q2_05_GROWTH_1.text: You saw an exam, a certification, or a course through to the very end. List everything you accomplished this year, small stuff included, and watch the list grow longer than you expect.

Q2_05_GROWTH_2.text: Finally starting something you'd put off, and sticking with it, was one of this year's biggest rewards. Small, steady effort lays a solid floor for whatever challenge comes next.

Q2_05_GROWTH_3.text: Your biggest win this year was getting clearer about what you truly want to do. Finding your direction is as valuable as any result you can point to.

Q2_05_LOVE_1.text: You worked up the courage to say how you really feel, or finally voiced something you'd kept inside for a long time. However it turned out, honor yourself for being that brave.

Q2_05_LOVE_2.text: You and someone found a way to get along while making room for your differences, a quiet but real win. Comfortable relationships don't just happen, so recognize the care you've poured in.

Q2_05_LOVE_3.text: Time on your own taught you to treat yourself well instead of simply feeling lonely, one of the gifts this year gave you. Getting along with yourself keeps you grounded in any relationship.

Q2_05_MONEY_1.text: You hit a savings goal you'd set, or kept your living costs within budget. Every promise you keep to yourself builds confidence that you can take care of your own life.

Q2_05_MONEY_2.text: Getting your finances in order, or learning to tell what you truly need from what you don't, felt deeply rewarding. Clear rules of your own take the edge off that vague, nagging worry.

Q2_05_MONEY_3.text: Even in tight months, you kept things balanced and made it through the year, an achievement in itself. That kind of steadiness doesn't show on the outside, so be the first to recognize it.

Q2_05_SOCIAL_1.text: You were the first to walk into a new group, or you found your place among strangers. That one brave step widened your social world this year.

Q2_05_SOCIAL_2.text: Pulling something off with the people around you gave you a pride that's hard to feel alone. Send a quick thank-you to everyone who was there with you.

Q2_05_SOCIAL_3.text: You calmly spoke your mind in an uncomfortable relationship, or turned someone down with grace: a small but real win. Collect more of those moments, and being yourself around others gets easier each time.

Q2_06_CAREER_1.text: You said goodbye to a familiar workplace or to coworkers this year, and the sense of closing that chapter lingered longer than you expected. What you built there lives on in you and travels with you into whatever comes next.

Q2_06_CAREER_2.text: Quietly, you let go of a career path or dream you'd pictured for years. Missing it shows how much it meant, so release it at your own pace.

Q2_06_CAREER_3.text: Some days felt hollow, as if you were saying farewell to the hope and passion you once had for your work. Don't rush to fill that emptiness. Let it be a time to rest, at least for now.

Q2_06_FAMILY_1.text: Living apart from family, or watching your shared routine change, made home feel a little unfamiliar at times. Distance doesn't mean disconnection: send a quick "thinking of you" text and let it go a long way.

Q2_06_FAMILY_2.text: Some days you quietly nursed a hurt, sensing that you and someone in your family were drifting apart. You don't have to close that gap right away. Start by tending gently to your own hurt.

Q2_06_FAMILY_3.text: Saying goodbye to someone precious, or to a home you knew so well, left an empty space that hit you without warning. Grief keeps no schedule, so give yourself time to remember slowly and recover.

Q2_06_GROWTH_1.text: Letting go of a goal or path you'd held for a long time left a hollow feeling. Everything you poured into it still counts, so don't call that time a failure.

Q2_06_GROWTH_2.text: Almost like bidding farewell to your old self, you released familiar habits and ways of thinking. Getting to know the new you takes time, so settle in slowly; there's no rush.

Q2_06_GROWTH_3.text: Watching someone you studied or dreamed alongside head down a different road stung a little. The time and conversations you shared stay with you, even as your paths split.

Q2_06_LOVE_1.text: You worked through your feelings for someone, or let a chapter of a relationship close, and the feelings lingered longer than you expected. Everyone heals at their own speed, so honor yours.

Q2_06_LOVE_2.text: A quiet loneliness settled in, as though you were saying goodbye to what you once expected from love. Nothing is wrong with that feeling. Treat it as a cue to look closely at what you need right now.

Q2_06_LOVE_3.text: Letting go of old expectations about love, the picture of how it was "supposed" to look, left you lighter. In the space they leave behind, hopes that fit who you are now move in, one by one.

Q2_06_MONEY_1.text: Leaving a familiar home or neighborhood and rebuilding your daily life from scratch kept your mind racing. You don't need every rule for your new life at once. Settle in one piece at a time.

Q2_06_MONEY_2.text: Clearing out things you loved, or breaking long-held spending habits, came with a pang of regret. Letting them go brings what you truly need right now into sharper focus.

Q2_06_MONEY_3.text: Saying goodbye to the life you'd pictured and the plans you'd made left you uneasy for a while. Rewriting a plan isn't failing. Begin again with one small rule you can keep right now.

Q2_06_SOCIAL_1.text: A close friendship slowly drifted as you naturally fell out of touch. Every bond has its seasons, and the time you shared never simply disappears.

Q2_06_SOCIAL_2.text: Growing apart from a group you'd belonged to for years left a bigger hole than you expected. Missing it proves how much that time meant, so let the feeling be.

Q2_06_SOCIAL_3.text: You quietly put distance between yourself and a relationship that kept draining you, and said your goodbyes privately. If that distance protected you, remember it as self-care, not as something to feel guilty about.

Q2_07_CAREER_1.text: As the workload grew and late nights piled up, you spent many days running on empty, body and mind. You pushed hard, so today, put rest ahead of the to-do list.
