Q2_07_CAREER_2.text: Feeling overlooked and navigating tension at work, you kept your struggles to yourself because you couldn't say them out loud. Open up, even a little, to someone you trust, and let them share the load.

Q2_07_CAREER_3.text: Unfamiliar work and lessons learned the hard way made this an especially tough year. Getting through those clumsy early days proves how hard you worked, so give yourself that credit.

Q2_07_FAMILY_1.text: Between caring for family and keeping up at home, your own time kept slipping to the back of the line. You give your family so much care. Remember: you deserve care, too.

Q2_07_FAMILY_2.text: Caught in the middle of family conflicts, playing peacemaker and calming everyone down, you had little room to breathe. You don't have to settle every argument yourself. Step back and rest.

Q2_07_FAMILY_3.text: You worked to meet your family's expectations without ever voicing your own feelings, and it wore you down inside. Even if you couldn't meet every one, be the first to honor how hard you tried.

Q2_07_GROWTH_1.text: Juggling work and study, you cut back on sleep and gave up your weekends. Resting your tired body and mind isn't a detour. It's an essential stretch of the road to your goals.

Q2_07_GROWTH_2.text: When results didn't match your effort, you felt worn down, like spinning your wheels. The hours you put in never vanish, whatever the outcome, so set it all down for today and catch your breath.

Q2_07_GROWTH_3.text: Mapping your path and making the call all on your own made this year feel heavy and lonely. Lean on someone you can talk things through with; that's a wise way to find your direction, too.

Q2_07_LOVE_1.text: You put the other person's feelings ahead of your own to keep the relationship going, and some days it left you exhausted. You've tried so hard; now make sure you get some rest, too.

Q2_07_LOVE_2.text: Sleepless nights came when you stewed alone over feelings that wouldn't settle. Instead of blaming yourself for those nights, be kind to the person who made it through them.

Q2_07_LOVE_3.text: Going back and forth over your love life shook even your daily routine, making this an especially draining year. Ask someone close to help you carry some of that weight.

Q2_07_MONEY_1.text: Stretching a tight budget meant putting off what you wanted and never fully relaxing. Acknowledge how carefully you've managed, and let some of the tension go.

Q2_07_MONEY_2.text: One unexpected expense after another had you redoing your budget every month, with no break from it. Money worries grow heavier the longer you carry them alone, so talk them over with someone you trust.

Q2_07_MONEY_3.text: To keep your life afloat, you kept going even when your body begged for a break. You've worked so hard: pencil in one small break before anything else. That, too, is how you protect your life.

Q2_07_SOCIAL_1.text: Doing favors and keeping everyone's spirits up wore you out, leaving no time to look after yourself. You've shown up for so many people; let yourself lean on the ones you can count on.

Q2_07_SOCIAL_2.text: You put a lot of yourself into mending relationships after misunderstandings and hurt feelings. You don't have to hold on to every one of them. For now, let yourself rest first.

Q2_07_SOCIAL_3.text: In a new environment, you spent a long stretch on edge every day, working hard to fit in. You've given so much effort to new people; now make plenty of time to unwind on your own.

Q2_08_CAREER_1.text: With work and expectations piling up, the thought of setting it all down crossed your mind more than once. That's less a call for a big decision than a call for rest, so trim today's to-do list a little.

Q2_08_CAREER_2.text: Some nights, work followed you home and you just wanted to switch your brain off. Draw a small line between work and the rest of your life: mute work chat for a while after hours.

Q2_08_CAREER_3.text: The pressure to get everything right grew too heavy, and you wanted, at the very least, to stop chasing perfection. Give yourself permission to do things a little less perfectly. That's how you protect yourself.

Q2_08_FAMILY_1.text: Tired of always working so hard for your family and bending to their needs, you wanted to set it all down for a while. That feeling doesn't mean you love them any less, so carve out a little time to rest for yourself.

Q2_08_FAMILY_2.text: The same arguments and hurt feelings kept circling back, and some days you just wanted that topic to be over. You don't have to sort it out right now. Take a little distance and give yourself a rest.

Q2_08_FAMILY_3.text: You wanted to finally stop playing the one who's always fine. Before you tell your family, tell yourself first: when things are hard, you're allowed to say so.

Q2_08_GROWTH_1.text: Worn out from pushing yourself to improve nonstop, you simply wanted a break. Pausing isn't quitting; it's catching your breath, so schedule rest into your plans first.

Q2_08_GROWTH_2.text: Above all, you wanted to drop the restless habit of measuring yourself against others. That wish to stop comparing is your first step toward finding your own pace again.

Q2_08_GROWTH_3.text: After wrestling for a long time with a career question that had no clear answer, you finally told yourself it was time to try ‘Letting go’ of it for a while. Tucking a worry away in a drawer is a way of caring for yourself, and you can take it back out whenever you have more room.

Q2_08_LOVE_1.text: At some point you wanted to stop anxiously guessing what the other person felt. That's less a verdict on the relationship than a signal that your own heart needs care, too.

Q2_08_LOVE_2.text: After carrying hopes and worries about love on your own for so long, you just wanted a break from thinking about it. Set your love life aside for a day and pour your energy into something you enjoy.

Q2_08_LOVE_3.text: Some days you felt done with always being the one who bends and stays quiet in a relationship. Before deciding what to change, name one small boundary you can comfortably hold.

Q2_08_MONEY_1.text: Fretting over money every single month left you wanting it to stop. That very wish to set the worry down is your chance to rethink the ground rules of your daily life.

Q2_08_MONEY_2.text: After so long scrimping and saving, you grew tired of denying yourself even the small things. Set aside a little something for yourself within a balanced budget; that's how you keep from burning out.

Q2_08_MONEY_3.text: More than anything, you wanted to release the anxiety that comes from comparing your life to other people's. Start by writing down, one by one, what a comfortable life looks like by your own standards.

Q2_08_SOCIAL_1.text: Saying yes to every get-together and answering every message wore you out, and you wanted to care a little less. For a while, keep only the plans that truly matter, and give your social life a rest.

Q2_08_SOCIAL_2.text: You wanted, at the very least, to stop tiptoeing around others and bending yourself to fit in. Practice your boundaries: politely put off one small favor.

Q2_08_SOCIAL_3.text: With a relationship you'd worked hard to keep alive, you caught yourself wanting to stop trying so hard. You don't have to decide anything yet. For now, give only as much as you truly have energy for.

Q2_09_CAREER_1.text: Starting a new job or role, you walked into those first unfamiliar days with a case of first-day jitters. Getting through the early awkwardness, one day at a time, means you've already done a lot.

Q2_09_CAREER_2.text: You finally dipped a toe into new work or a side project you'd daydreamed about for ages. Before you weigh how big it is or how it turns out, honor the courage that first step took.

Q2_09_CAREER_3.text: Same position, new approach: this was the year you decided to change how you work. Keep that one resolution alive, even in a small way, and you carry this fresh start forward.

Q2_09_FAMILY_1.text: Getting your own place or moving changed how you live with family, and you felt excited and a little out of place all at once. Take your time finding your own rhythm for staying close from this new distance.

Q2_09_FAMILY_2.text: You reached out with a simple "How are you?" to a family member you'd drifted from for a long time. A conversation that starts with a few words slowly brings you closer.

Q2_09_FAMILY_3.text: This was the first year you truly practiced being honest about your feelings with family. It feels awkward at first, but that one step makes things a little easier for everyone, you included.

Q2_09_GROWTH_1.text: Remember the thrill of that first day back at your desk, finally cracking open the studies you'd put off? That spark fades on some days, and that's fine. Write down how you felt that day in a single line, and keep it close.

Q2_09_GROWTH_2.text: Curious about a new field, you started by researching and asking people who'd already walked that path. Small explorations like these are a welcome first step, and they open up more options for you.

Q2_09_GROWTH_3.text: You wove small new self-care habits into your life this year, like a morning routine or journaling. Days built on tiny first steps add up to a bigger difference than you'd think.

Q2_09_LOVE_1.text: Getting to know someone new, you felt excitement and caution in equal measure. There's no rush. Move at whatever pace feels comfortable for you.

Q2_09_LOVE_2.text: You decided to change how you two talk or spend time together. One small change is often all it takes to breathe new life into a relationship.

Q2_09_LOVE_3.text: This year, you opened your heart to love again, or you started putting yourself first. Either way, you began something real, and any start that honors what you need matters.

Q2_09_MONEY_1.text: Starting a budget or opening a new savings account, you tried something new to bring order to your life. Small organizing habits like these steadily take the edge off everyday money worries.

Q2_09_MONEY_2.text: Getting your own place or starting a new chapter meant running a household on your own for the first time. You're still finding your way, and learning step by step is exactly how you build your own standards for living.

Q2_09_MONEY_3.text: This year you started practicing how to tell what you need from what you don't. Let your rules wobble for now. That first step deserves recognition on its own.

Q2_09_SOCIAL_1.text: You joined a new group or club and said hello to a roomful of strangers. The courage it took to push past that first awkwardness planted the seeds of new friendships.

Q2_09_SOCIAL_2.text: A new environment meant building relationships with coworkers or neighbors from the ground up. Get to know people slowly, one at a time; that's what lasting bonds are built on.

Q2_09_SOCIAL_3.text: Reaching out first, or letting people know how you feel, was something new you tried this year. Making that first move, even once, gradually changes the way you see people.

Q2_10_CAREER_1.text: A new project or opportunity gave you butterflies for the first time in a while. Think back on what lit you up, and you'll see more clearly what you want from your work.

Q2_10_CAREER_2.text: Clicking with a great coworker, or a fresh change at work, put a spring in your step on the way in. Small joys like these keep you going even on the busiest days.

Q2_10_CAREER_3.text: Discovering something you're good at, or receiving praise you didn't see coming, gave you new hope for your work. Don't turn that hope into pressure. Hold it lightly, with the same joy you felt then.

Q2_10_FAMILY_1.text: A family trip, or a meal together after a long time apart, brought a moment of unexpected warmth. Hold on to one scene from that day, and let it be your safe harbor when you're worn out.

Q2_10_FAMILY_2.text: Happy news, or something to plan for together, filled your home with anticipation for the first time in a while. The days you spent looking forward to it together become a precious memory that keeps you connected.

Q2_10_FAMILY_3.text: Setting up your own place, you felt the thrill of making a home that's truly yours. A space you've shaped with your own hands becomes a steady anchor, your sanctum (private refuge) for rest.

Q2_10_GROWTH_1.text: You got so absorbed in a newly discovered field that you lost all track of time. Whatever pulls you in like that is a trusty compass when you choose your next direction.

Q2_10_GROWTH_2.text: Picturing what you want to do next, you felt genuinely excited about the future for the first time in a while. Turn that excitement into one small plan, and let it fuel you day after day.

Q2_10_GROWTH_3.text: New people, classes, and books revealed sides of yourself you never knew were there. Welcome that new self with open arms; it's one of the most precious things this year gave you.

Q2_10_LOVE_1.text: Just thinking about someone set off butterflies, and a single text could brighten your whole day. Don't rush that flutter. Savor it slowly, at a pace that feels right to you.

Q2_10_LOVE_2.text: One day, you suddenly saw a new side of someone you'd known for years, and your heart skipped a beat. Finding that spark in something familiar keeps a relationship warm for years to come.

Q2_10_LOVE_3.text: Romance or not, discovering new things to love made you softer and more open again. Simply having something you care about that much makes you kinder and gentler.

Q2_10_MONEY_1.text: Buying something you'd saved up for, or hitting a small goal, gave you a real thrill. Hold on to that joy and let it warm your everyday rhythm.

Q2_10_MONEY_2.text: As life gradually fell into place, planning for the future started to feel fun. Treasure that shift, from vague worry to looking ahead with hope.

Q2_10_MONEY_3.text: Little treats for yourself added a bright spark to your everyday life this year. Find your own balance between spending that makes you happy and saving that gives you peace of mind.

Q2_10_SOCIAL_1.text: Hitting it off with new people left you counting down to the next time you'd meet. Your instinct for spotting kindred spirits keeps steering you toward relationships that feel easy.

Q2_10_SOCIAL_2.text: Reconnecting with an old friend, or planning something new together, lifted your spirits. Send a short message to say how glad you are, and let that good feeling linger.

Q2_10_SOCIAL_3.text: Unexpected fun at an unfamiliar gathering made you like the version of yourself around others a little more. Remember those easy moments; they help you recognize the relationships that suit you.

Q2_11_CAREER_1.text: This may have been a year when you wrapped up piled-up work and postponed tasks one by one, clearing both your desk and your mind. The experience of finishing what needed finishing can make it easier to start the next thing lightly.

Q2_11_CAREER_2.text: There may have been moments when you sorted out which of your roles to keep and which to set down. The standards you chose that way can become your own principles for how you approach work.

Q2_11_CAREER_3.text: You may have looked again at how you work and at your relationships with colleagues, and let go of what didn't suit you. As you let those things go, the work you truly want to focus on has likely become clearer.

Q2_11_FAMILY_1.text: There may have been a time when you brought up something that had long gone unsaid in your family, or quietly came to terms with it in your own heart. Even if not everything was resolved, your heart may feel a bit lighter for having sorted through it.

Q2_11_FAMILY_2.text: There may have been a time when you sorted through the things and spaces at home and reshaped where you live. A tidy space can leave a little breathing room in your heart, too.

Q2_11_FAMILY_3.text: This may have been a year when you redivided what you'll take on in your family and what you'll set down. Sorting out roles can be one way of caring for each other for the long run.

Q2_11_GROWTH_1.text: Out of all the studies and plans you'd started, you may have kept only the ones you really wanted to continue and set the rest aside. The space that opened up likely let you put more of your heart into what remained.

Q2_11_GROWTH_2.text: There may have been a time when you sorted through a mix of what you wanted to do and what you felt you had to do. That sorting can become a helpful map as you choose your next direction.

Q2_11_GROWTH_3.text: This may have been a year when you looked back over the past few years and took stock of what stayed with you and what you learned. Taking stock of the road behind you can make the next step feel much less daunting.

Q2_11_LOVE_1.text: There may have been a moment when you let go of lingering feelings from a past relationship and quietly said goodbye to that time. Once those feelings are put to rest, there's room again to take care of yourself.

Q2_11_LOVE_2.text: You may have talked again with your partner about what you each hope for, untangling built-up misunderstandings one by one. A relationship sorted out that way can feel more comfortable than before.

Q2_11_LOVE_3.text: This may have been a year when you got clear on what you truly want, and don't want, in love. Those clearer standards can help protect you, whoever you meet next.

Q2_11_MONEY_1.text: There may have been a time when you sorted out scattered expenses and subscriptions and took a fresh look at where your money goes. Having mapped that flow once can help you set your everyday standards for next year.

Q2_11_MONEY_2.text: You may have eased your mind by wrapping up postponed paperwork or settling accounts one by one. Small acts of tidying up can add up and make your whole life feel lighter.

Q2_11_MONEY_3.text: This may have been a year when you sorted what you truly need from what you can cut back on, and reshaped your daily life. The standards you found that way can keep protecting the rhythm of your life.

Q2_11_SOCIAL_1.text: You may have looked back over your contacts and groups, keeping the relationships that feel comfortable and gently stepping back from others. Tidying up relationships can also be a way to give more of your heart to the people who remain.

Q2_11_SOCIAL_2.text: You may have worked through a lingering misunderstanding or hurt and put a relationship back in order. A relationship where things have been settled can carry on more lightly than before.

Q2_11_SOCIAL_3.text: This may have been a year when, rather than looking after lots of people, you reconnected with the few who matter most to you. Relationships chosen that way can quietly support your days ahead.

Q2_12_CAREER_1.text: There may have been moments when a colleague or mentor stepped in on a tough day and gave you room to breathe. Remembering that help may make it easier for you to offer the same hand to someone else next time.

Q2_12_CAREER_2.text: There may have been a day when a single word recognizing your work gave you the strength to keep going. Moments like that have likely been adding up and supporting where you are now.

Q2_12_CAREER_3.text: This may have been a year when your familiar workplace and the people you work with felt newly precious. Sharing your thanks, even briefly, can make the atmosphere at work a little softer.

Q2_12_FAMILY_1.text: There may have been a moment when your family's care, so constant that it was easy to forget, suddenly felt precious. Even a short check-in message can be enough to let them know.

Q2_12_FAMILY_2.text: An ordinary day spent with family may have stayed with you longer than you expected. Days like that have likely been adding up to make a place you can come home to.

Q2_12_FAMILY_3.text: Because family matters took a lot of care and attention this year, the moments when you looked out for each other may stand out more clearly. Holding on to those moments can help your heart stay softer the next time you clash.

Q2_12_GROWTH_1.text: On your path of learning and preparing, there may have been moments when you met someone who offered advice or came across great resources. Thanks to those encounters, you may have glimpsed a path you wouldn't have found on your own.

Q2_12_GROWTH_2.text: There may have been days when you felt grateful to yourself for the effort you kept up, even if slowly. Gratitude toward yourself can become a quiet strength that helps you keep taking the next step.

Q2_12_GROWTH_3.text: This may have been a year when simply having the chance to learn felt like something to be grateful for, even if it wasn't as much as you'd hoped. Learning carried on one step at a time with that feeling tends to stay with you longer than you'd expect.

Q2_12_LOVE_1.text: There may have been days when small acts of care from the person beside you felt especially precious. Putting that feeling into words one more time can make the relationship feel even warmer.

Q2_12_LOVE_2.text: You may now be able to look back on what you learned from a past relationship with gratitude. A heart that has settled in that way can make your next relationship feel more at ease.

Q2_12_LOVE_3.text: This may have been a year when you realized anew that, even in your time alone, there are people who care about you. Having relationships that fill your heart, even outside of romance, is a real source of strength.

Q2_12_MONEY_1.text: There may have been moments when simply managing to keep your life steady, even without much to spare, felt like something to be grateful for. Noticing what you already have can be a good foundation for setting your everyday standards.

Q2_12_MONEY_2.text: There may have been times when someone helped out when you needed it, or shared useful information, and gave you room to breathe. Remembering that gratitude may help you be that support for someone else one day.

Q2_12_MONEY_3.text: This may have been a year when simple days without big expenses actually felt comfortable. That sense of being content with small things can keep protecting your peace of mind going forward.

Q2_12_SOCIAL_1.text: There may have been days when a friend reaching out after a long time, or someone checking in first, warmed your heart. This time, you might be the one to share that joy first.

Q2_12_SOCIAL_2.text: There may have been moments when having someone listen to your struggles made things feel a little lighter. Simply having someone like that around can make relationships a strong source of support.

Q2_12_SOCIAL_3.text: This may have been a year when you felt grateful to have people around you, even just a few, you can laugh with easily. Cherishing those relationships can be a gift that stays with all of you for a long time.

RULE_FIT.rule_en: If the 2026 theme is among the themes that fit the Q2 word, it 'matches'. If the top theme doesn't fit but the second does and scores at least 80% of the top, use the second theme and count it as a match. Otherwise it 'differs'. A12c cells are looked up by (word, theme); the fit value is already in the table.

RULE_ORDER.rule_en: Bold summary (B11 SUM_2026) → A12c first paragraph (word × theme) → the year's turning point (A18) → A12d (word × concern area) → A12/A12b closing → quarterly table → folded reasons. A12/A12b intro_match and intro_differ are fallbacks when the theme can't be calculated. When a cell holds several phrasings, pick one by birth-data hash.

RULE_PICK.rule_en: Score every 2026 event with the points above and use the highest score per theme as that theme's score. The top theme is the person's 2026 theme. On a tie, the lower priority number wins. If all are under 40, use Even flow.

THEME_CALM.rule_en: When all five themes above score under 40

THEME_GROWTH.rule_en: Jupiter conjunct, trine or sextile the Sun, Moon, Ascendant or Midheaven 55 / Jupiter enters the 1st or 10th house (time known) or the Sun sign 50

THEME_RELEASE.rule_en: Pluto conjunct, square or opposite the Sun, Moon, Ascendant or Midheaven 55 / Neptune conjunct, square or opposite the same points 50 / Neptune enters the Ascendant sign 45

THEME_REVIEW.rule_en: 15 for each 2026 Mercury, Venus or Mars retrograde whose retrograde span falls in the Sun, Moon or Ascendant sign (if time known: the 1st, 4th, 7th or 10th house), up to 45

THEME_SHIFT.rule_en: Uranus enters the Ascendant sign 75 / Uranus conjunct, square or opposite the Sun, Moon, Ascendant or Midheaven 70 / Uranus changes sign (birth time unknown, grade C) 45

THEME_WEIGHT.rule_en: Saturn return (exact within 2026) 100 / Saturn conjunct, square or opposite the Sun, Moon, Ascendant or Midheaven 60 / Saturn enters the Ascendant sign 55

WISH_01_FAV.short_line: Open Year · Build a sturdier home base
WISH_01_FAV.text: For stability, the coming year is an Open Year. With {{근거}}, your home life grows roomier and more secure. Use this year well by putting your home, work, and relationships in order rather than starting something new. And even as life gets comfortable, don't rush to lock everything in: settle in one step at a time.

WISH_01_HEAD.short_line: Building Year · Secure the one thing that matters most
WISH_01_HEAD.text: The coming year is a Building Year, and stability takes patience to reach. With {{근거}}, looking after your home and life feels like a heavy load, and things move slower than you'd hoped. Don't try to hold everything at once: choose the one thing that matters most and build outward from there. A foundation laid this way becomes a steadfast stability that is truly yours.

WISH_01_NEU.short_line: Steady Year · Small anchors build your stability
WISH_01_NEU.text: Stability sits in a Steady Year for you. The sky doesn't tip strongly either way, so your daily choices, and how faithfully you keep them, shape the outcome. Choose one anchor you'll keep even on hectic days, like a set bedtime or a regular grocery day.

WISH_01_OPEN.fallback_text: No clear Open Year for stability appears in the next five years, so the strength you build yourself counts for more than any boost from the sky. Stability comes closest in {{가까운해}}. Keep that year in sight and start with small daily anchors you can stick to.
WISH_01_OPEN.short_line: Open Year · Stability comes within reach
WISH_01_OPEN.text: In {{열리는해}}, {{근거}} brings the stability you've been hoping for within reach. That year, put down roots rather than spreading out. Until then, shore up the basics of daily life one by one (sleep, spending, the people closest to you) and you'll make that good stretch last.

WISH_02_FAV.short_line: Open Year · Take on the challenge you've put off
WISH_02_FAV.text: Hoping for a leap? The coming year is an Open Year. With {{근거}} on your side, doors of opportunity open wide to new roles and challenges. Bring out the proposal you've been holding back, or try the thing you've wanted to do, even in a small way. As momentum builds, though, leave extra room in your schedule and your energy.

WISH_02_HEAD.short_line: Building Year · Build the launchpad for your next leap
WISH_02_HEAD.text: The coming year is a Building Year, made for building a launchpad rather than leaping. With {{근거}}, your responsibilities at work grow heavier, and results take longer to show than you'd like. Sharpen your skills, gather what you need, and train your eye for the right moment to jump. The launchpad you build now sets the height of your next leap.

WISH_02_NEU.short_line: Steady Year · The direction you choose becomes your path
WISH_02_NEU.text: For your wish to leap forward, the coming year is a Steady Year. The forces pushing you and holding you back are about even, so your choices and consistency decide where you jump and how far. Pick one thing you'd love to try and give it a small shot once a month. If the year turns out to be a Moving Year, that momentum adds lift to your leap.

WISH_02_OPEN.fallback_text: Over the next five years, the skills and preparation you build shape your leap more than any Open Year could. Your leap comes closest in {{가까운해}}. Set your sights on that year and keep stacking up your preparation, one step at a time.
WISH_02_OPEN.short_line: Open Year · Your leap comes within reach
WISH_02_OPEN.text: In {{열리는해}}, thanks to {{근거}}, the leap you've been hoping for moves within reach. That year, bring out the challenge or new role you've been holding back. Until then, get your skills, your portfolio, and your people in place, and you'll stride through that door with confidence when it opens.

WISH_03_FAV.short_line: Open Year · A year to refill your energy
WISH_03_FAV.text: If recovery is your wish, the coming year is an Open Year. With {{근거}}, your energy returns without you having to push. Block off open time between commitments first, and you make full use of this year. Once you feel like yourself again, build back up gradually instead of jumping straight to your old pace.

WISH_03_HEAD.short_line: Building Year · Put rest on the calendar first
WISH_03_HEAD.text: The coming year is a Building Year, and recovery asks for patience. With {{근거}}, your to-do list and responsibilities keep growing even when all you want is rest. So treat rest as something you schedule first, never something you squeeze into leftover time. The rest habit you protect through a busy year becomes the foundation of a recovery that carries into the next.

WISH_03_NEU.short_line: Steady Year · The more rest you schedule, the more you refill
WISH_03_NEU.text: Recovery sits in your own hands next year: a Steady Year. The supportive and heavy influences either balance out or stay mild, so the rest you actually build into your schedule sets your pace of recovery. Start tonight: mark one evening a week on your calendar with nothing planned.

WISH_03_OPEN.fallback_text: No clear Open Year for recovery appears in the next five years, so the rest habits you keep shape your recovery. It comes closest in {{가까운해}}. Until then, protect a little rest every day, however small.
WISH_03_OPEN.text: In {{열리는해}}, thanks to {{근거}}, the recovery you've been hoping for draws close. That year, leave generous room in your schedule and your mind, and make recharging your priority. Until then, guard your sleep and rest rhythms little by little, and you'll savor that easier stretch even more deeply.

WISH_04_FAV.short_line: Open Year · Say how you feel
WISH_04_FAV.text: For love, the coming year is an Open Year. With {{근거}}, giving and receiving affection comes more naturally. Be the first to say thank you, or tell someone close how much they mean to you, and you make the most of this year. Just remember that their pace matters as much as yours.

WISH_04_HEAD.short_line: Building Year · Get clear on what your heart needs
WISH_04_HEAD.text: The coming year is a Building Year, and love doesn't always land the way you want it to. With {{근거}}, your role in relationships feels heavier, and the gap between hope and reality looks wider than usual. Rather than rushing a relationship, get clear on what you want and what you want to protect. That clarity becomes a steadfast set of standards that guards you whenever you open your heart.

WISH_04_NEU.short_line: Steady Year · Your openness sets the warmth
WISH_04_NEU.text: In love, the coming year is a Steady Year. The cosmic scales don't tip strongly either way, so how open you keep your heart sets the warmth of your relationships. Write one sentence tonight about the moments when you feel most loved.

WISH_04_OPEN.fallback_text: Over the next five years, your readiness to open your heart shapes love more than any Open Year. Love comes closest in {{가까운해}}. Until then, practice two things side by side: caring for yourself and saying how you feel.
WISH_04_OPEN.text: In {{열리는해}}, thanks to {{근거}}, the love you've been hoping for draws near. That year, expressing your feelings and sharing tenderness comes easily. Until then, learn how to care for yourself and what you truly want in a relationship, so you can welcome that year with an open heart.

WISH_05_FAV.text: The coming year is an Open Year for meeting good people. With {{근거}}, groups and shared projects bring you kindred spirits you truly click with. Go to the meetup you've been curious about, or reach out first to someone you haven't talked to in a while. You don't have to show up to everything, though: choose the spaces that feel right for you.

WISH_05_HEAD.short_line: Building Year · Go deeper with the few who are close
WISH_05_HEAD.text: If good people are your wish, the coming year is a Building Year, made for deepening your circle rather than widening it. With {{근거}}, you take on more responsibility in groups or communities, and the care you give doesn't always come back the way you'd hoped. Pour your energy into the few people already close to you. As you move through this season, you see clearly who's with you for the long haul.

WISH_05_NEU.short_line: Steady Year · Reaching out first builds your circle
WISH_05_NEU.text: For your connections, the coming year is a Steady Year. The sky isn't tipping either way, so a single message you send first shapes what your relationships become. Begin with one quick note a month to someone you're grateful for.

WISH_05_OPEN.fallback_text: No clear Open Year for good connections appears in the next five years, so the relationships you nurture shape who's in your life. You grow closest to good people in {{가까운해}}. Until then, keep reaching out first to the people you're grateful for.
WISH_05_OPEN.short_line: Open Year · You find your people
WISH_05_OPEN.text: In {{열리는해}}, {{근거}} makes finding your people far easier. That year, keep the door open to new groups and shared projects. Until then, tend the relationships you already have with real care, and good connections will find plenty of room to stay.

WISH_06_FAV.short_line: Open Year · Savor time for yourself
WISH_06_FAV.text: Hoping for breathing room? The coming year is an Open Year. With {{근거}}, you slow down and truly enjoy yourself. Put time for yourself on the calendar ahead of time, like a hobby you've been meaning to try or a short getaway. And guard that freed-up space: don't let other tasks rush in to fill it.

WISH_06_HEAD.short_line: Building Year · Protect the small pauses in your day
WISH_06_HEAD.text: The coming year is a Building Year, when to-dos crowd in before breathing room arrives. With {{근거}}, overlapping schedules and responsibilities leave you feeling rushed. Don't hold out for a big break; protect a few short pauses in your day instead. The small pockets of calm you keep in a busy year teach you the pace that truly suits you.

WISH_06_NEU.short_line: Steady Year · Let go of more, and you'll have more room
WISH_06_NEU.text: When it comes to breathing room, the coming year is a Steady Year. The push and pull are about even, so what you let go of decides how much room you gain. This week, cross off one task that doesn't actually need you.

WISH_06_OPEN.fallback_text: Over the next five years, your power to let things go shapes your breathing room more than any Open Year. It comes closest in {{가까운해}}. Until then, practice dropping one thing each day.
WISH_06_OPEN.short_line: Open Year · Breathing room comes closest
WISH_06_OPEN.text: In {{열리는해}}, thanks to {{근거}}, the breathing room you've been hoping for is finally within reach. That year, slow down and give yourself fully to joy and rest. Until then, sort out what to let go of and what to keep, and when that room arrives, it's entirely yours to enjoy.

WISH_07_FAV.short_line: Open Year · Start a new routine
WISH_07_FAV.text: If you want better daily habits, the coming year is an Open Year for healthy routines. With {{근거}}, new habits are easy to start and easy to keep. Choose one small routine (a set bedtime, a walk, regular mealtimes) and do it at the same time every day. Even when motivation runs high, add habits one at a time rather than all at once.

WISH_07_HEAD.short_line: Building Year · Keep one tiny habit going
WISH_07_HEAD.text: The coming year is a Building Year, and keeping your chosen routines takes real effort. With {{근거}}, more work and responsibility squeeze the time you have for your daily rhythm. Forget the perfect plan: choose the smallest habit you can keep even on your busiest days. The small routine you protect through a heavy year becomes a solid floor beneath your feet.

WISH_07_NEU.short_line: Steady Year · Small habits shape your everyday life
WISH_07_NEU.text: For healthy routines, the coming year is a Steady Year. The supportive and heavy influences either balance out or stay mild, so the small choices you repeat every day shape the texture of your life. Begin with one easy habit, like a glass of water each morning or a short evening walk.

WISH_07_OPEN.fallback_text: No clear Open Year for healthy routines appears in the next five years, so the habits you keep up set your daily rhythm. A healthy rhythm comes closest in {{가까운해}}. Until then, stay with one easy routine.
WISH_07_OPEN.short_line: Open Year · A healthy rhythm comes within reach
WISH_07_OPEN.text: In {{열리는해}}, thanks to {{근거}}, the healthy rhythm you've been hoping for comes within reach. That year, bring in new routines and let them take root. Until then, sync your basic rhythms, like sleep and mealtimes, bit by bit, and that year's habits will stick with ease.

WISH_08_FAV.short_line: Open Year · Set your money rules
WISH_08_FAV.text: The coming year is an Open Year for building toward financial ease. With {{근거}}, you set clear money rules for yourself and give your life a sturdier base. Review your fixed expenses once and decide how much to set aside each month. As you feel more at ease, spending tends to creep up too, so sleep on any big purchase for at least a day.

WISH_08_HEAD.short_line: Building Year · Shore up your spending rules and the basics
WISH_08_HEAD.text: The coming year is a Building Year, and feeling relaxed about money takes work. With {{근거}}, the weight of running your life and covering your expenses presses harder than before. Skip the big plans and put your energy into reviewing fixed costs and shoring up the basics, like an emergency fund. The money rules you set now become a fence that protects your future peace of mind.

WISH_08_NEU.short_line: Steady Year · Spending rules make room for comfort
WISH_08_NEU.text: For your wish for financial ease, the coming year is a Steady Year. The sky doesn't lean strongly either way, so the spending rules you set each month decide how comfortable life feels. Track your spending for one month in two columns: needs, and things just for joy.

WISH_08_OPEN.fallback_text: Over the next five years, the spending rules and daily rhythms you set shape your financial ease more than any Open Year. You firm up that base best in {{가까운해}}. Until then, keep your monthly spending rules, one at a time.
WISH_08_OPEN.short_line: Open Year · Your financial footing firms up
WISH_08_OPEN.text: In {{열리는해}}, thanks to {{근거}}, you build a solid base for financial ease with far less strain. That year, fine-tune how you spend and save, and widen your sense of security. Until then, keep a steady record of your monthly spending, so you can set realistic rules when that year arrives.

WISH_09_FAV.short_line: Open Year · Let your work be seen
WISH_09_FAV.text: An Open Year is on its way, with the sky backing your wish for recognition. With {{근거}}, the work you've been putting in gets noticed. Share a short summary of what you've done, or speak up first about a role you want, and you seize this moment. Don't let praise talk you into taking on more than you can carry, though.

WISH_09_HEAD.short_line: Building Year · Track your wins by your own standards
WISH_09_HEAD.text: The coming year is a Building Year, when recognition lags behind your effort. With {{근거}}, your responsibilities grow while the visible rewards arrive slowly. Don't wait for others to judge your work: track the year's wins by your own standards. The skills and track record you build now speak for you when the next opportunity comes.

WISH_09_NEU.short_line: Steady Year · Show what you've done, and recognition follows
WISH_09_NEU.text: For recognition, the coming year is a Steady Year. The push and pull are about even, so how you present your work shapes the outcome. At the end of each week, jot down three things you got done, and bring them up when the moment calls for it.

WISH_09_OPEN.fallback_text: No clear Open Year for recognition appears in the next five years, so the skills and track record you build are what earn it. Recognition comes closest in {{가까운해}}. Keep that year in sight and log your wins, one at a time.
WISH_09_OPEN.text: In {{열리는해}}, thanks to {{근거}}, the recognition you've been hoping for moves within reach. That year, put your work out there and step into new roles. Until then, keep a running record of what you've accomplished, so you can show what you're capable of with confidence when the chance comes.

WISH_10_FAV.short_line: Open Year · Your direction comes into focus
WISH_10_FAV.text: The coming year is an Open Year for living as yourself. With {{근거}}, what you love and where you want to go come into sharp focus. Make one choice at a time based on what draws you, not what others expect, and this year works in your favor. As you discover what feels true, share your thoughts with the people close to you, too.

WISH_10_HEAD.short_line: Building Year · Guard the time that's yours
WISH_10_HEAD.text: The coming year is a Building Year, when roles and expectations pull you away from yourself. With {{근거}}, what you have to do keeps coming before what you want to do. Protect a little time each day that's all yours, however brief, and notice what brings you joy in it. The time you guard while carrying that weight builds steadfast standards of your own.

WISH_10_NEU.short_line: Steady Year · Small choices make you who you are
WISH_10_NEU.text: Through the lens of being yourself, the coming year is a Steady Year. The cosmic scales don't tip strongly either way, so how closely you follow your heart in small choices shapes the outcome. This week, write down one thing you chose by your own standards instead of someone else's. If it's a Moving Year, that momentum helps you find your way back to yourself.

WISH_10_OPEN.fallback_text: Over the next five years, the standards you set for your own choices shape how true to yourself you live, more than any Open Year. Being yourself comes closest in {{가까운해}}. Until then, keep adding up small choices made by your own rules.
WISH_10_OPEN.short_line: Open Year · Being yourself comes easiest
WISH_10_OPEN.text: In {{열리는해}}, thanks to {{근거}}, living as yourself comes within reach. That year, choose to work and live on your own terms. Until then, note the moments when you feel most like yourself, and the choices of that year will come with ease.

WISH_11_FAV.short_line: Open Year · Take your first step
WISH_11_FAV.text: Dreaming of a fresh start? The coming year is an Open Year. With {{근거}}, doors of opportunity open wide to new learning, new places, and things you've never tried. Choose one beginning you've been thinking about for a long time and take the first step, however small. In the excitement, though, focus on one thing first rather than launching everything at once.

WISH_11_HEAD.short_line: Building Year · Get ready for a fresh start
WISH_11_HEAD.text: The coming year is a Building Year, made for getting ready rather than starting fresh. With {{근거}}, whatever you want to begin arrives with responsibilities and strings attached, and things move slower than you'd like. Don't rush the start: line up the learning and preparation you need, step by step. The groundwork you lay now becomes the roots that keep your fresh start growing.

WISH_11_NEU.short_line: Steady Year · You choose the first step
WISH_11_NEU.text: For your wish for a new start, the coming year is a Steady Year. The supportive and heavy influences either balance out or stay mild, so when and how you take that first step is your call. Choose one thing you want to start and write down the smallest first step you can take this month. If it's a Moving Year, that momentum gives your fresh start a push.

WISH_11_OPEN.fallback_text: No clear Open Year for a new start appears in the next five years, so your preparation shapes your first step. A new start comes closest in {{가까운해}}. Keep that year in sight and build up the learning and preparation you need, one piece at a time.
WISH_11_OPEN.short_line: Open Year · A fresh start comes within reach
WISH_11_OPEN.text: In {{열리는해}}, thanks to {{근거}}, the fresh start you've been hoping for comes within reach. That year, keep the door open to new learning, new places, and first-time experiences. Until then, build a list of what you want to start and what you need to get there, and you'll step into that year with ease.

WISH_01_FAV_2.text: If you've been longing for stability, welcome the coming year with open arms: it's an Open Year for stability. With {{근거}} in play, your living space and daily rhythm settle gracefully into place. Start with that drawer or corner you've been putting off, and make the space within arm's reach feel like home.

WISH_01_FAV_3.text: With {{근거}}, the coming year is an Open Year for stability. The scattered pieces of your life fall into place, and you see clearly where you belong. To make the most of it, choose one evening a week to stay in and truly unwind. Comfort built without hurry is the kind that lasts.

WISH_01_FAV_4.text: Craving roots in your home and daily life? The coming year is an Open Year for stability. Thanks to {{근거}}, the ground you lean on and rest in grows wider. Create a small ritual: rise at the same time each morning and sip a cup of tea in the same spot. That repetition becomes an anchor that lets you feel stability in your body.

WISH_01_FAV_5.text: The coming year is an Open Year for stability, and a scattered routine finds its footing again. Set one small house rule for yourself. With {{근거}}, a commitment like that feels comforting, not confining. Even as things go well, don't rush big decisions: give it a season and watch how things unfold.

WISH_01_HEAD_2.text: You're wishing for stability, but the coming year is a Building Year, with a lot on your plate and real weight on your shoulders. With {{근거}}, your home and life need extra attention, and the things you meant to sort out take more than one go. Make a list with just one fix per week, and cross each one off as you finish. Filled in slowly, that list becomes a framework you can count on once this year is behind you.

WISH_01_HEAD_3.text: With {{근거}}, the coming year is a Building Year, and stability takes time to feel within reach. The practical demands of running your life arrive one after another, like tests. Meet them with a small wind-down routine at the same time every night. The rhythm you build while carrying that weight becomes a solid floor that holds steady through every bump.

WISH_01_HEAD_4.text: The coming year is a Building Year, less about gaining stability and more about raising the pillars that will hold it. With {{근거}}, your share of the load grows heavier, and the payoff for your effort takes time to show. Choose the one space at home you use most, and keep at least that spot tidy all year. That one protected corner becomes the starting point for more stability next year.

WISH_01_HEAD_5.text: Let's be honest: stability doesn't come easily in the coming year. With {{근거}}, it's a Building Year, and life's responsibilities land on your shoulders all at once. Name one person you can lean on and one block of rest ahead of time, so you never carry it all alone. The standards you set this season become a cornerstone of stability that holds firm.

WISH_01_NEU_2.text: In the coming year, stability won't simply arrive on its own: it's a Steady Year. The sky isn't pushing either way, so your everyday habits build the foundation of your life. Begin with one thing that calms your mornings, like laying out what you need the night before.

WISH_01_NEU_3.text: Hoping for stability? The coming year is a Steady Year. Support and pressure sit in near balance, so what you keep up decides how grounded you feel. Choose one check-in day a month to review your schedule, chores, and spending at a glance.

WISH_01_NEU_4.text: The more you build, the steadier the coming year becomes. It's a Steady Year, and the sky isn't leaning hard in either direction. Keep half a day each weekend free of plans to tend your home and stock the fridge, and your whole week stands on firmer ground.

WISH_01_NEU_5.text: Steady Year: that's the coming year's stability in a nutshell. No strong force pushes you one way, so the small rules you choose become the center of gravity in your day. Recall the moments when you feel unsteady, and pick one place of your own to return to when they hit. A favorite walking route or café works beautifully.

WISH_01_OPENFB_2.text: No Open Year for stability stands out over the next five years, so the habits you build day by day are your greatest asset. In {{가까운해}}, when stability comes closest, review and fine-tune the standards for living you've built up.

WISH_01_OPENFB_3.text: Stability comes closest in {{가까운해}}, though no clear Open Year shows up within the next five. Don't wait for a big push from the sky: give recurring chores like grocery shopping and tidying a set routine of your own. That's how stability grows.

WISH_01_OPENFB_4.text: Looking five years out, no year gives stability a strong lift, so the foundation you build yourself matters most. Still, things lean a little toward stability in {{가까운해}}. Lock in one thing first, like your bedtime or a mealtime, and greet that year ready.

WISH_01_OPENFB_5.text: Across the five years ahead, how you shape your days builds your foundation more than any opening in the sky. The flow runs smoothest in {{가까운해}}. Until then, keep making evenings where you and the people close to you share each other's days.

WISH_01_OPEN_2.text: The stability you've been hoping for comes into sharpest focus in {{열리는해}}. With {{근거}}, that year gives your home and the shape of your life room to expand. Until then, tidy your space and your schedule on the last day of each month, and you'll settle into that year with ease.

WISH_01_OPEN_3.text: In {{열리는해}}, a time of {{근거}}, the scattered parts of your life come together. That year, neatly gather what you already have rather than adding anything new. Until then, clear out a few unused things each season, and you make plenty of room for stability to move in.

WISH_01_OPEN_4.text: Of the next five years, {{열리는해}} is the one that opens up for stability. Thanks to {{근거}}, you widen and firm up the ground you can safely lean on that year. While you wait, protect your bedtime, if nothing else, and you'll enjoy that open year for a long time.

WISH_01_OPEN_5.text: The door to stability opens widest in {{열리는해}}. With {{근거}}, pointing your home, work, and relationships in one direction feels far lighter that year. Until then, write down three things stability means to you, so you know exactly where to begin when that door opens.

WISH_02_FAV_2.text: The coming year is an Open Year for a leap. Thanks to {{근거}}, the door to a new stage or a bigger role swings wide open. This month, ask one person you know about a position or project you've had your eye on. When opportunities pile up, choose the one that excites you most and give it your full focus.

WISH_02_FAV_3.text: With {{근거}} in play, the coming year is an Open Year for anyone dreaming of a leap. The skills you've built get noticed, and more people reach out to help. Sum up what you want to do in a single paragraph, so you can say yes without hesitation when an offer arrives. Just leave blank space in your calendar so the thrill doesn't lead you to overcommit.

WISH_02_FAV_4.text: Ready to move up? Keep your eye on the coming year: it's an Open Year for a leap. With {{근거}}, what you've learned and lived turns into real, visible results. Pick one contest or application you've been hesitating over and send it in before the deadline.

WISH_02_FAV_5.text: If you've been hoping for a leap, the coming year is an Open Year, with the wind at your back. With {{근거}}, bridges form between you and new people and opportunities. Put your work on a single page and ask a trusted colleague or mentor for feedback. Even as momentum builds, guard your days off first: that's what keeps you going over time.

WISH_02_HEAD_2.text: You're dreaming of a leap, but the coming year is a Building Year, a time to steady the ground under your feet. With {{근거}}, the opportunities you've waited for arrive late, and hurdles show up first. Choose one credential or skill you need for the next step and keep working at it. The preparation you build under that weight becomes the strength to jump without hesitation once the door opens.

WISH_02_HEAD_3.text: With {{근거}}, the coming year is a Building Year, more about holding steady and building skills than about leaping. Your workload grows while results take time to show, and that tests your patience. Once a month, sum up what you've learned and accomplished on one page and take stock. The more those pages add up, the higher your launchpad for the next leap.

WISH_02_HEAD_4.text: The coming year is a Building Year, made for digging in your footing rather than jumping high, so your leap needs a little more time. With {{근거}}, positions of responsibility bring a string of moments that feel like tests. Don't dodge them: treat them as a chance to see one project all the way through. Finishing what you started becomes proof that you can trust yourself on your next leap.

WISH_02_HEAD_5.text: For all your eagerness to leap, the coming year is a slower-moving Building Year. With {{근거}}, things take longer than planned, and the next door opens only after you check off a few requirements. Keep the big picture as it is, but scale this year's goals down to a size you can hold in your hands. Small wins add up and move next year's starting line well ahead.

WISH_02_NEU_2.text: In the coming year, the stage for your leap won't set itself: it's a Steady Year. Support and pressure run about even, so the same year plays out very differently depending on which doors you knock on. Write your direction in one line, and start one small bit of learning that fits it before the season is out.

WISH_02_NEU_3.text: How high you leap in the coming year is entirely your choice. It's a Steady Year, and the sky isn't leaning hard either way. Read one article in your field over lunch or on your way home, and jot down the thoughts it sparks. Those notes pile up into your next stepping stone. If it's a Moving Year, that momentum gives you a nudge, too.

WISH_02_NEU_4.text: Whether you make that leap in the coming year depends more on you than on the stars. It's a Steady Year, with the push and the pull about even. Choose one thing you truly want to do this year and tell someone who'll back you. A goal spoken out loud moves faster than one you keep to yourself.

WISH_02_NEU_5.text: In the coming year, how far you jump is largely your call. It's a Steady Year, when the supportive and heavy influences either balance out or stay mild, so your preparation sets the height of your leap. Choose one strength you already have and create a small piece of work that shows it off.

WISH_02_OPENFB_2.text: No clear Open Year for a leap appears in the next five years, so your own preparation sets the height more than any wind from the sky. Your leap gains a bit more lift in {{가까운해}}. Start shaping one piece of work now, slowly, that you can show when that time comes.

WISH_02_OPENFB_3.text: Your leap comes closest in {{가까운해}}, though no strong tailwind year opens wide within the next five. So skip the one big jump: frequent small attempts widen your path.

WISH_02_OPENFB_4.text: The five years ahead ask you to build your skills like climbing stairs, step by step, instead of waiting for a tailwind. The flow leans most toward a leap in {{가까운해}}. Aim for that year, choose one thing to learn, and stick with it.

WISH_02_OPENFB_5.text: Looking five years out, no Open Year for a leap stands out, so steady building matters more. What you've built shines through in {{가까운해}}. Write one line each year about what you accomplished.

WISH_02_OPEN_2.text: You make your biggest leap in {{열리는해}}, when doors of opportunity open wide for you. With {{근거}}, stepping onto a bigger stage feels natural that year. Until then, collect small pieces of work that show what you do best, so you have plenty to offer when the door opens.

WISH_02_OPEN_3.text: In {{열리는해}}, a time of {{근거}}, the challenges you've put off start moving. That year, raise your hand for the role you've hesitated over, or take on something new. Start now by talking to people already doing that work and learning what you need bit by bit, and your first step will feel much lighter.

WISH_02_OPEN_4.text: By {{열리는해}}, thanks to {{근거}}, your steps toward a leap gather real strength. That year, go bigger with what you've wanted to do. Until then, team up with someone you'd love to work with on a small project, and you'll carry that momentum further.

WISH_02_OPEN_5.text: The moment you've been waiting for draws close in {{열리는해}}. With {{근거}}, what you've prepared meets the right opportunity that year. Until then, add one new skill or experience each season, and you'll bring far more with you through that door.

WISH_03_FAV_2.text: The coming year is an Open Year for recovery, a season to rest and recover when you're worn out. With {{근거}} in play, your energy returns bit by bit without you having to force it. Start an evening habit: put away screens and dim the lights an hour before bed. Recovery doesn't happen overnight, so take your time and savor feeling better.

WISH_03_FAV_3.text: Thanks to {{근거}}, the coming year is an Open Year for anyone hoping to recover. Rest feels like real rest, and even small pleasures recharge you. Now and then, wake on a weekend morning without an alarm and take a slow walk. As your strength returns, spend it protecting the ground you've regained before you fill your calendar again.

WISH_03_FAV_4.text: If it's been ages since you truly rested, make the coming year your year of recovery. It's an Open Year for recovery, and with {{근거}}, chances to set your worries down arrive naturally. Once a week, put on music you love and spend time doing absolutely nothing.

WISH_03_FAV_5.text: Recovery gets an Open Year in the coming year. With {{근거}}, you shake off built-up fatigue and find your rhythm again with ease. Set aside two or so evenings a week for a warm shower and an early night, and you make full use of this year. As your energy returns, don't give those evenings away.

WISH_03_HEAD_2.text: You're hoping for recovery, but the coming year is a Building Year, and time to rest gets squeezed. With {{근거}}, your share of the load grows and fatigue lingers longer than you'd expect. So don't save rest for one big vacation; take it in small doses every day. The short breaks you protect between busy days build the stamina for a recovery that carries into next year.

WISH_03_HEAD_3.text: With {{근거}}, the coming year is a Building Year, when responsibilities cut in line ahead of rest. Carving out recovery time takes effort, and some days that tired feeling lingers. On those days, write 'Rest' at the top of your to-do list and cross it off when it's done, like any other task. Protecting rest under that weight sets a steadfast standard for caring for yourself from here on.

WISH_03_HEAD_4.text: For recovery, the coming year is a Building Year: a time to build the footing for recovery rather than rush it. With {{근거}}, demands arrive one after another like tests, and your body and mind feel the weight. Make one promise to yourself for the whole year: you'll protect your bedtime. That single promise becomes the solid ground that carries you through and helps you rebuild your strength.

WISH_03_HEAD_5.text: Seen through your wish for recovery, the coming year is a Building Year. With {{근거}}, responsibilities and demands pile up, and some stretches leave you unrefreshed even after rest. Don't try to handle everything yourself: pick one task to take off your plate and ask someone for help. Learning to share the load now protects your recovery long after.

WISH_03_NEU_2.text: For your wish for recovery, the coming year is a Steady Year. Support and pressure run about even, so whether you postpone rest or protect it decides how you feel all year. At the end of each day, jot down one moment that let you rest.

WISH_03_NEU_3.text: If recovery is your wish, this is a Steady Year: take care of yourself rather than waiting. The sky doesn't lean strongly either way, so the way you choose to rest decides how deep your recovery goes. Start with a habit of stepping outside into the sun after lunch, even for ten minutes.

WISH_03_NEU_4.text: How much you treasure rest shapes your recovery in the coming year. It's a Steady Year, with the push and the pull about even. Pick one time each day to silence phone notifications, and give that time back to yourself.

WISH_03_NEU_5.text: Because the coming year is a Steady Year, your recovery grows as much as you make room for it. With neither force taking the lead, small moments of rest add up to a big difference. Give yourself a signal: when you get home, change into comfy clothes first and take five minutes just to breathe.

WISH_03_OPENFB_2.text: No year in the next five stands out as an Open Year for recovery, so the rest rhythm you keep matters most. The flow tilts a little toward recovery in {{가까운해}}. Until then, keep a steady bedtime.

WISH_03_OPENFB_3.text: Recovery comes closest in {{가까운해}}, though no clear Open Year appears in the next five years. Don't wait for one big break: sprinkle short pauses through your day. That's what restores you.

WISH_03_OPENFB_4.text: The next five years ask you to make rest for yourself rather than wait for the sky to hand it over. Recovery flows most gently in {{가까운해}}. Until then, keep one evening a week free of plans.

WISH_03_OPENFB_5.text: Looking five years out, no year brings a strong tailwind for recovery, so steady, small acts of self-care count for more. That care sinks in more deeply in {{가까운해}}. Gather a few ways to soothe yourself ahead of time, like a warm cup of tea or a short walk.

WISH_03_OPEN_2.text: The recovery you've been hoping for deepens in {{열리는해}}. With {{근거}}, that year you feel your strength return as you rest. Until then, protect one half-day a week with nothing on the calendar, and you'll take in that year more fully.

WISH_03_OPEN_3.text: In {{열리는해}}, a time of {{근거}}, you shake off built-up fatigue with far less effort. That year, slow your work pace and pour your energy into whatever fills you back up. Start making your bedroom a little cozier now, and you'll savor that flow even more.

WISH_03_OPEN_4.text: Once {{열리는해}} comes around, thanks to {{근거}}, the sun comes back out for you after a tiring stretch. That year, plan the things that let you rest, like the break you've been putting off or a short trip. Until then, jot down whatever helps you feel most at ease, so you make that year's rest truly count.

WISH_03_OPEN_5.text: Of the next five years, {{열리는해}} is when recovery flows most freely. With {{근거}}, that year you reset the rhythm of your body and mind. While you wait, build a few more breathing breaks into your day, and that year's recovery stays with you longer.

WISH_04_FAV_2.text: The coming year is an Open Year for love. With {{근거}} in play, the moments when you open your heart feel warmer and more tender. Tell someone dear to you what you rarely say, in a short handwritten note or a text. Everyone takes in feelings at their own pace, so give them room and let the reply come in its own time.

WISH_04_FAV_3.text: Love flows more easily both ways in the coming year, an Open Year. With {{근거}}, your tenderness toward yourself and toward others grows naturally. Start by treating yourself to a small gift that delights you. The more kindness you show yourself, the more it flows through your relationships.

WISH_04_FAV_4.text: With {{근거}}, the coming year reads as an Open Year for love. Your conversations with the people close to you go deeper, and you meet your differences with an open heart. Create one small ritual to share with someone close, like a walk together or cooking a meal side by side. Don't ask them to match your intensity; focus on expressing your own feelings freely.

WISH_04_FAV_5.text: Greet the coming year with butterflies: it's an Open Year for love. With {{근거}}, sweet words and warm glances fill more of your moments. Choose one thing you've wanted to do with someone you care about and casually suggest it. The more you laugh together, the warmer things grow, little by little.

WISH_04_HEAD_2.text: Because you want love so deeply, the waiting feels long in the coming year, a Building Year. With {{근거}}, your responsibilities in a relationship weigh more, and truly opening up to each other takes time. When something hurts, let it rest for a day before you speak, then share it in calm, clear words. That way of talking things through becomes a sturdy pillar for a lasting relationship.

WISH_04_HEAD_3.text: With {{근거}}, the coming year is a Building Year, and you approach love with more care. Your feelings don't always come back as much as you'd hoped, and the strings attached to a relationship weigh on you. Don't try to change the other person; explore the distance and pace that feel right to you. Once you know your own pace, it guards you, whoever you open your heart to next.

WISH_04_HEAD_4.text: The coming year is a Building Year, more about strengthening love than rushing it. With {{근거}}, you have the feelings but not always the bandwidth to express them, and your relationship moves slowly. Make yourself a small promise: even in busy weeks, send at least a quick check-in to someone you care about. Promises kept over time build a foundation of trust that holds a relationship up for years.

WISH_04_HEAD_5.text: In love, the coming year is a Building Year. With {{근거}}, you reflect more on your own share of the responsibility in a relationship. On a quiet evening alone, write three sentences on ‘what kind of love do I want to give and receive?’ The answers that come clear this year guide your relationships from here on.

WISH_04_NEU_2.text: For your wish for love, the coming year is a Steady Year. Support and pressure run about even, so the warmth you offer first shapes the feel of your relationships. Once a day, truly listen to someone close to you, all the way to the end.

WISH_04_NEU_3.text: In the coming year, your mindset shapes whether love deepens, more than the stars do. It's a Steady Year, with neither force taking the lead. Write down, side by side, one thing you want to protect in a relationship and one thing you're willing to give.

WISH_04_NEU_4.text: Love in the coming year comes down to one phrase: Steady Year. The flow doesn't lean either way, so even one small gesture changes the warmth of a relationship. This week, say ‘I couldn't have done it without you’ to someone you're grateful for.

WISH_04_NEU_5.text: If love is your wish, the coming year is a Steady Year. The push and the pull are about even, so the way you treat yourself carries straight over into the way you treat your relationships. Start each morning by saying one kind thing to yourself in the mirror.

WISH_04_OPENFB_2.text: No year in the next five stands out as an Open Year for love, so the way you tend your heart sets the warmth of your relationships. The flow tilts a little toward love in {{가까운해}}. Until then, build a habit of showing gratitude.

WISH_04_OPENFB_3.text: Love comes closest in {{가까운해}}, though no clear Open Year appears in the next five years. So, more than any wind from the sky, your kindness toward yourself makes room for love to arrive.

WISH_04_OPENFB_4.text: The next five years invite you to grow deep roots in your relationships rather than wait for a tailwind. Love flows most gently in {{가까운해}}. Until then, build a track record of keeping small promises with the people you care about.

WISH_04_OPENFB_5.text: Looking five years out, no year brings a strong tailwind for love, so how open your heart is matters more. In {{가까운해}}, your feelings reach others more easily. Until then, practice gently voicing both hurt and gratitude.

WISH_04_OPEN_2.text: The love you've been hoping for arrives with new warmth in {{열리는해}}. With {{근거}}, expressing and receiving feelings comes naturally that year. Until then, discover the things that make you happy, one by one, and you'll share love in your own way when that time comes.

WISH_04_OPEN_3.text: In {{열리는해}}, a time of {{근거}}, the tenderness in your relationships deepens. That year, say how you feel without holding back. Before then, practice putting your feelings into honest words in everyday conversation, and opening up will feel easy when the moment comes.
