QB_LEAN_08.q3: What does a life that feels like 'this is plenty' look like for you?
QB_LEAN_08.why_template: If leaning on people drains you, you're especially likely to keep hard topics like money to yourself. {{기질문장}} Talk through your everyday standards with someone you trust, and vague worry turns into a concrete plan.

QB_LEAN_09.headline_q: Who do you want recognition from, and for what?
QB_LEAN_09.q1: When did you wish someone would notice something you worked hard to pull off?
QB_LEAN_09.q2: What would it take for wins you achieved with help to still feel like your own?
QB_LEAN_09.q3: Think of the person you hope will notice your effort. What do you want to hear from them?
QB_LEAN_09.why_template: Leaning on others doesn't come naturally to you, so you tend to believe recognition only counts if you did it all without help. {{기질문장}} Fully own what you achieved together, and the joy of being recognized stays with you longer.

QB_LEAN_10.headline_q: Who do you feel most like yourself around?
QB_LEAN_10.q1: Picture yourself with someone you can be completely unguarded around. Who are you in those moments?
QB_LEAN_10.q2: What comes up for you when you picture yourself asking for help?
QB_LEAN_10.q3: What part of yourself will you show more openly from here on?
QB_LEAN_10.why_template: Because leaning on others takes real effort, you easily believe only the strong, 'I'm fine' version of you is the real you. {{기질문장}} Embrace the part of you that wants to lean on someone, and being yourself becomes roomier and more relaxed.

QB_LEAN_11.headline_q: Who do you want beside you as you begin something new?
QB_LEAN_11.q1: When you're about to start something new, who's the first person you want to tell?
QB_LEAN_11.q2: When did you start something on your own and wish you'd had someone's help?
QB_LEAN_11.q3: As you prepare for a fresh start, what small favor will you ask of the people close to you?
QB_LEAN_11.why_template: Relying on others costs you energy, so you tend to keep a new start to yourself until everything is ready. {{기질문장}} Share your beginning early, and your first step into the unknown feels far lighter.

QB_REPAIR_01.headline_q: How will you build faith that you can reconnect, even after things go wrong?
QB_REPAIR_01.q1: Is there a relationship that took a long time to feel easy again after an argument? What made it take so long?
QB_REPAIR_01.q2: When has a conflict actually brought you closer to someone?
QB_REPAIR_01.q3: Pick a short phrase you can say first when things go sideways. What will it be?
QB_REPAIR_01.why_template: When mending things takes a lot out of you, even a small argument feels like it's shaking the whole relationship. {{기질문장}} If stability is your wish, don't aim for zero conflict. Collect experiences of reconnecting after a rough patch; that is your real key.

QB_REPAIR_02.headline_q: What do you need to get past a clash and keep moving forward?
QB_REPAIR_02.q1: Recall a time a disagreement left you struggling to focus on work for a while.
QB_REPAIR_02.q2: Think of a time you bounced back after hearing feedback or pushback. What helped?
QB_REPAIR_02.q3: How will you handle the friction that comes with taking on challenges?
QB_REPAIR_02.why_template: If repairing relationships is draining, worry about conflict makes you step back from new challenges. {{기질문장}} Big leaps come with bumps along the way. Your ability to reopen the conversation after a clash is the solid ground you move forward on.

QB_REPAIR_03.headline_q: How will you work through the hard feelings that linger?
QB_REPAIR_03.q1: Think of a time a past argument kept replaying in your mind and weighed on you even when you tried to rest.
QB_REPAIR_03.q2: When you think of a hurt that still lingers, what does that feeling need?
QB_REPAIR_03.q3: Whether you reach out or give it time, what can you do to take care of yourself first?
QB_REPAIR_03.why_template: For those who find repair hard, unresolved conflict keeps its grip even during downtime, and it wears you out. {{기질문장}} If recovery is your wish, acknowledge the hurt you're still carrying first. Fixing the relationship can come after.

QB_REPAIR_04.headline_q: When things go wrong with someone you love, how will you find your way back?
QB_REPAIR_04.q1: Recall a time after an argument with someone close when it felt hard to be the first to reach out.
QB_REPAIR_04.q2: When you felt you'd made up, what words or gestures passed between you?
QB_REPAIR_04.q3: After a falling-out, what kind words will you offer someone dear to you?
QB_REPAIR_04.why_template: If mending things is hard for you, the awkward silence after an argument is especially tough to sit with when it's someone you love. {{기질문장}} If love is your wish, learn your own way back after a fight. That, more than never fighting at all, is what keeps a relationship strong.

QB_REPAIR_05.headline_q: Which relationships are worth keeping, even when feelings get hurt?
QB_REPAIR_05.q1: Picture a relationship that drifted apart after something hurtful. What did you leave unsaid?
QB_REPAIR_05.q2: Recall a time you laughed off a small misunderstanding with someone. What was that like?
QB_REPAIR_05.q3: Who is it time to check in with again?
QB_REPAIR_05.why_template: When repairing feels draining, you tend to quietly let a relationship go once conflict shows up. {{기질문장}} The good people who stay in your life are rarely the ones you never clashed with. They are the ones you found your way back to after a hurt.

QB_REPAIR_06.headline_q: How will you stop pouring so much of yourself into unresolved conflict?
QB_REPAIR_06.q1: Recall a night you couldn't rest because you kept replaying an old conversation in your head.
QB_REPAIR_06.q2: What's a conflict that doesn't need to be sorted out right now?
QB_REPAIR_06.q3: When your mind is tangled, what's your go-to way to set your thoughts aside for a while?
QB_REPAIR_06.why_template: If mending things takes effort, replaying unfinished conflicts in your head eats up your breathing room. {{기질문장}} Give yourself permission not to fix every misunderstanding right away, and you make room to breathe again.

QB_REPAIR_07.headline_q: What daily rhythm will you keep, even on days you're hurting?
QB_REPAIR_07.q1: On a day you argued with someone, how did your routine, like sleep or meals, change?
QB_REPAIR_07.q2: What daily habit do you want to keep even when something upsets you?
QB_REPAIR_07.q3: On a day your mind is all over the place, what small routine brings you back to normal?
QB_REPAIR_07.why_template: When repair is hard for you, a rift in a relationship throws off your basics too, like sleep and meals. {{기질문장}} Choose one small routine to keep even on emotional days. It becomes the steady place you come back to.

QB_REPAIR_08.headline_q: How will you work through the awkwardness money has caused?
QB_REPAIR_08.q1: Think of a time money made things awkward with someone close. What bothered you most?
QB_REPAIR_08.q2: When you clear up a misunderstanding about money, what approach feels comfortable for you both?
QB_REPAIR_08.q3: What ground rules for spending or living costs, agreed on in advance, would put your mind at ease?
QB_REPAIR_08.why_template: If repairing things is draining, you carry money-related awkwardness for a long time without bringing it up. {{기질문장}} Financial ease isn't only about the numbers. It also grows in relationships where you talk about money openly and sort things out together.

QB_REPAIR_09.headline_q: How will you bounce back after feedback that stung?
QB_REPAIR_09.q1: Recall a time you felt down for a while after being corrected or criticized.
QB_REPAIR_09.q2: Think of a time you kept a relationship on good terms even after feedback that hurt. What helped?
QB_REPAIR_09.q3: What conversation do you want to have with someone whose recognition matters to you?
QB_REPAIR_09.why_template: When repair takes effort, the more you want recognition, the longer a single critical comment stays with you. {{기질문장}} Keep the conversation going even after an unfair review. As that strength builds, recognition returns to you as deeper trust.

QB_REPAIR_10.headline_q: How will you stay true to yourself, even in conflict?
QB_REPAIR_10.q1: Think of a time you backed down against your own feelings just to end a conflict quickly.
QB_REPAIR_10.q2: If you shared your feelings honestly after an argument, how would you like to begin?
QB_REPAIR_10.q3: When have you protected a relationship without losing yourself?
QB_REPAIR_10.why_template: If mending things wears you out, you push your own feelings aside in the rush to set things right. {{기질문장}} Being yourself shows not in avoiding conflict, but in how you reach out again after a rift while still honoring what you feel.

QB_REPAIR_11.headline_q: How will you handle the disagreements that come with a fresh start?
QB_REPAIR_11.q1: Recall a time you made a new choice and someone close saw it differently. What happened?
QB_REPAIR_11.q2: Think of a time you kept a relationship going even when someone didn't understand your decision. What helped?
QB_REPAIR_11.q3: As your fresh start approaches, what will you say to someone dear beforehand?
QB_REPAIR_11.why_template: When repairing is hard, worry that someone will feel hurt makes you hesitate to start something new. {{기질문장}} New beginnings bring small disagreements. Trust your ability to reconnect after a misstep; it is what protects your fresh start.

QB_SPEAK_01.headline_q: What do you need to say out loud so you can finally relax?
QB_SPEAK_01.q1: Think of a time you held your tongue and felt uneasy about it long afterward.
QB_SPEAK_01.q2: Where do you feel free to say what you think?
QB_SPEAK_01.q3: To feel more settled, what will you talk through with someone close before it becomes an issue?
QB_SPEAK_01.why_template: When speaking up takes effort, holding back to avoid conflict lets worry build up inside. {{기질문장}} If stability is your wish, say what's on your mind, even in a small way. It makes your relationships stronger, not shakier.

QB_SPEAK_02.headline_q: What will you voice out loud to launch your leap?
QB_SPEAK_02.q1: Recall a meeting or conversation where you had a good idea but let the moment pass.
QB_SPEAK_02.q2: If you had to sum up what you want to do in one sentence, what would you say?
QB_SPEAK_02.q3: Who's the first person you'd like to tell about your plans?
QB_SPEAK_02.why_template: If speaking up is draining, you keep ideas to yourself until everything's perfect, and the moment slips by. {{기질문장}} The door to a big leap rarely opens with a finished result. It opens when you say out loud what you want to do, so say it first.

QB_SPEAK_03.headline_q: How will you put into words just how tired you are?
QB_SPEAK_03.q1: When was the last time you said 'I'm fine' when things were actually hard?
QB_SPEAK_03.q2: If your mood lately were a weather forecast, what would it be?
QB_SPEAK_03.q3: When you open up about feeling worn out, what response do you want from the person listening?
QB_SPEAK_03.why_template: When it's hard to speak up, you push through exhaustion alone for a long time without ever saying so. {{기질문장}} If recovery is your wish, name how you're doing, even in one sentence. Saying it matters as much as rest.

QB_SPEAK_04.headline_q: What haven't you told someone you love yet?
QB_SPEAK_04.q1: Think of a time someone dear hurt your feelings and you let it slide without a word.
QB_SPEAK_04.q2: What's the easiest way for you to show thanks or affection?
QB_SPEAK_04.q3: If you gently told someone close what you've been wishing for lately, what words would you choose?
QB_SPEAK_04.why_template: Speaking up feels hardest with the people you love, where you hope they'll simply know. {{기질문장}} Practice putting your feelings into words, a little at a time. Misunderstandings fade, and love feels closer.

QB_SPEAK_05.headline_q: What kinds of conversations do you want to have with the good people in your life?
QB_SPEAK_05.q1: Recall a conversation that flowed so well you lost track of time.
QB_SPEAK_05.q2: When you hesitate to speak up in a group, what's running through your mind?
QB_SPEAK_05.q3: What would you like to talk about more often with the people closest to you?
QB_SPEAK_05.why_template: If speaking up takes effort, you settle into the role of listener, and your relationships take longer to deepen. {{기질문장}} Share a little more of your own story each time. That is how good people become kindred spirits.

QB_SPEAK_06.headline_q: What will you stop putting off saying, so you can breathe again?
QB_SPEAK_06.q1: Has your schedule ever filled up because you couldn't bring yourself to say 'Now isn't a good time'?
QB_SPEAK_06.q2: When you're holding a lot inside, how does it feel?
QB_SPEAK_06.q3: To give yourself breathing room, what about your situation will you be honest with people about?
QB_SPEAK_06.why_template: When speaking up is a struggle, you shoulder everything alone instead of explaining what's going on, and your breathing room disappears. {{기질문장}} Let people know where things stand, even in a few words. It is the most practical way to make space to breathe.

QB_SPEAK_07.headline_q: What will you say to protect your daily rhythm?
QB_SPEAK_07.q1: Recall a day you pushed on with your plans instead of admitting 'I'm tired.'
QB_SPEAK_07.q2: To protect your daily rhythm, what would you like your family or coworkers to know?
QB_SPEAK_07.q3: When you start a new habit, what will you say out loud to someone about it?
QB_SPEAK_07.why_template: If voicing your needs is hard, staying quiet about being tired leaves your routine at the mercy of other people's schedules. {{기질문장}} Tell the people around you about the routine you want to keep. Your words become a promise, and the habit sticks.

QB_SPEAK_08.headline_q: What have you been putting off saying about money?
QB_SPEAK_08.q1: Think of an awkward moment when money was hard to bring up.
QB_SPEAK_08.q2: If you raised a tricky money topic, like pay or living costs, who would you go to first?
QB_SPEAK_08.q3: In one sentence, what does financial ease look like in your life?
QB_SPEAK_08.why_template: When speaking up feels draining, money talk gets so uncomfortable that you miss the chance to ask for what you need or work things out. {{기질문장}} Put your own money rules into words. That simple act makes the path to financial ease much clearer.

QB_SPEAK_09.headline_q: How will you talk about what you've accomplished?
QB_SPEAK_09.q1: Recall something you worked hard on but never mentioned, so nobody knew.
QB_SPEAK_09.q2: If you shared your accomplishments as an explanation rather than a brag, how would you start?
QB_SPEAK_09.q3: Where do you want your efforts to be seen?
QB_SPEAK_09.why_template: If speaking up is hard, you wait quietly and trust your results to speak for themselves. {{기질문장}} If recognition is your wish, practice explaining what you've done, calmly and plainly. It makes a bigger difference than you'd expect.

QB_SPEAK_10.headline_q: When do your words feel most like you?
QB_SPEAK_10.q1: Recall a time you said something you didn't really think, just to go along with the mood.
QB_SPEAK_10.q2: When have you spoken up and felt, 'Yes, this is what I really think'?
QB_SPEAK_10.q3: What opinions or tastes of yours deserve to be shared more often?
QB_SPEAK_10.why_template: When speaking up takes energy, reading the room leads you to choose safe words over your real thoughts. {{기질문장}} Being yourself grows less from grand declarations than from everyday conversations, where you voice your thoughts one sentence at a time.

QB_SPEAK_11.headline_q: How will you put a new beginning into words?
QB_SPEAK_11.q1: Think of a time you wanted to try something but never said it out loud.
QB_SPEAK_11.q2: If you told someone about something you'd love to learn or a path you'd like to explore, how would you begin?
QB_SPEAK_11.q3: Picture saying out loud what you want to start. How does that change the way you feel?
QB_SPEAK_11.why_template: If speaking up is a struggle, you keep a new beginning to yourself until it feels certain. {{기질문장}} Say what you want to do out loud, early. Those words become your first promise, the one that keeps your fresh start from slipping away.

QB_TRUST_01.headline_q: What would it take for you to feel at ease?
QB_TRUST_01.q1: Think of a recent moment when your worries settled and you could breathe easy. What was happening?
QB_TRUST_01.q2: When anxiety hits, what's the first thing you find yourself checking?
QB_TRUST_01.q3: What stays by your side, steady and unchanged, even on shaky days?
QB_TRUST_01.why_template: Trusting takes a lot out of you, and the more you crave stability, the more energy you pour into double-checking and bracing for what's next. {{기질문장}} Notice what's already holding you up. That is your first step toward stability.

QB_TRUST_02.headline_q: What step can you take even before you feel completely sure?
QB_TRUST_02.q1: What have you wanted to try but kept putting off, telling yourself 'not yet'?
QB_TRUST_02.q2: When you started something without knowing how it would turn out, what kept you grounded?
QB_TRUST_02.q3: What safety net would help you feel okay even if a new challenge doesn't go as planned?
QB_TRUST_02.why_template: When trust doesn't come easily, you tend to hold off on starting until everything feels certain. {{기질문장}} If a leap is your wish, the key isn't perfect certainty. Secure a place to come back to, and then jump.

QB_TRUST_03.headline_q: What will you trust so you can let your guard down?
QB_TRUST_03.q1: When was your body resting while your mind just wouldn't switch off?
QB_TRUST_03.q2: Think of a time you rested deeply, feeling 'I'm okay now.' What was different then?
QB_TRUST_03.q3: What will you tell yourself so you can set your worries down for a while?
QB_TRUST_03.why_template: If trusting drains you, you often spend your downtime preparing for the next worry, and your recovery slows. {{기질문장}} Recovery begins not only when you step away from your to-do list, but when you give yourself permission to relax.

QB_TRUST_04.headline_q: In love, what will you trust so you can open your heart?
QB_TRUST_04.q1: When someone close to you is slow to text back, what thoughts start running through your head?
QB_TRUST_04.q2: What little things help you believe you're loved?
QB_TRUST_04.q3: When you crave reassurance in a relationship, how do you soothe yourself?
QB_TRUST_04.why_template: Even in love, trusting takes effort, so you often want to check, again and again, how your partner feels. {{기질문장}} Instead of checking, practice remembering the kindness you've already received, and love feels more relaxed.

QB_TRUST_05.headline_q: Who do you feel at ease around?
QB_TRUST_05.q1: Think of someone you were wary of at first but slowly grew comfortable with. When did you start to open up?
QB_TRUST_05.q2: What do the people you can relax around have in common?
QB_TRUST_05.q3: Which relationship would you like to put a little more trust in?
QB_TRUST_05.why_template: Trust takes energy for you, so you naturally need time before opening up to new people. {{기질문장}} Your best connections grow in relationships where you're free to build trust slowly.

QB_TRUST_06.headline_q: Where can you let go of planning for everything?
QB_TRUST_06.q1: When did your plans fall apart, yet things turned out better than you expected?
QB_TRUST_06.q2: Think of a moment you couldn't enjoy because you were busy worrying ahead. Where was your mind?
QB_TRUST_06.q3: What could you loosen your grip on a little?
QB_TRUST_06.why_template: For you, trusting feels draining, and bracing for every 'what if' fills even the space meant for breathing room with worry. {{기질문장}} Breathing room comes not from preparing for everything, but from trusting the parts you haven't prepared for and letting them be.

QB_TRUST_07.q1: What habit helps you wind down at the end of the day?
QB_TRUST_07.q2: On nights when worries keep you up, what helps you let go of your thoughts?
QB_TRUST_07.q3: What small habit, done at the same time every day, could anchor your day?
QB_TRUST_07.why_template: If trusting takes a lot out of you, a predictable daily flow becomes a steadfast source of support. {{기질문장}} Small daily routines keep your life in order, and on shaky days they give you something steady to come back to.

QB_TRUST_08.headline_q: What's your own everyday standard for feeling secure?
QB_TRUST_08.q1: Think back to when your money worries were at their worst. What scared you most then?
QB_TRUST_08.q2: When you check your bank account, what would it need to show for you to feel at ease?
QB_TRUST_08.q3: What everyday ground rules, like an emergency fund or a clear view of your fixed costs, would let you breathe easier?
QB_TRUST_08.why_template: When trust takes effort, that nagging 'it's still not enough' feeling lingers no matter how much your savings grow. {{기질문장}} Trade the vague goal for a concrete everyday baseline that puts your mind at ease, and you start to recognize financial ease when it arrives.

QB_TRUST_09.headline_q: Which of your efforts can you believe in, even without anyone's praise?
QB_TRUST_09.q1: Recall a time you were praised but still couldn't relax. What was happening?
QB_TRUST_09.q2: What's something you know you did well, even though nobody noticed?
QB_TRUST_09.q3: How will you keep track of your own wins, on your own terms?
QB_TRUST_09.why_template: If trust doesn't come easily, even sincere praise takes a while to sink in. {{기질문장}} Keep your own record of what you've done alongside other people's feedback, and recognition finally stays with you.

QB_TRUST_10.headline_q: What steadfast core of yours can you count on, even when you're shaken?
QB_TRUST_10.q1: Recall a time you changed course because you were worried how others would react.
QB_TRUST_10.q2: What personal rule will you hold on to, whatever happens?
QB_TRUST_10.q3: Think of a moment you truly trusted yourself. What were you doing?
QB_TRUST_10.why_template: For those who struggle to trust, self-belief rises and falls with other people's reactions. {{기질문장}} Being yourself doesn't mean never wobbling. You grow steadfast by knowing exactly which values to return to once you do.

QB_TRUST_11.headline_q: You don't have every answer yet. What will you trust as you begin?
QB_TRUST_11.q1: What have you wanted to start but kept putting off because you didn't feel sure?
QB_TRUST_11.q2: The first time you tried something unfamiliar, what kept you going?
QB_TRUST_11.q3: If a new start doesn't unfold the way you pictured, where can you come home to?
QB_TRUST_11.why_template: When trust is hard, you tend to wait at the starting line until you can see the whole road ahead. {{기질문장}} If a fresh start is your wish, don't wait to feel certain. Notice what already holds you up, and let that carry your first step.

TEMP_AIR_AIR.sun_moon_line: Your {{태양별자리}} Sun is breezy and easy to talk to, and your {{달별자리}} Moon also processes feelings by thinking them through. With both pointing the same way, you see the big picture brilliantly. Just don't let your own feelings take a back seat to your thoughts.
TEMP_AIR_AIR.temperament_line: Inside and out, your first instinct is to think things through.

TEMP_AIR_EARTH.sun_moon_line: On the surface, you're a breezy, easy-to-talk-to {{태양별자리}} Sun, but your {{달별자리}} Moon likes to sort things out step by step. If you chat easily with anyone, then come home and replay everything you said, the gap between these two energies explains it.
TEMP_AIR_EARTH.temperament_line: You mingle easily, but inside you feel settled only after you've gone over things one by one.

TEMP_AIR_FIRE.sun_moon_line: You come across as a breezy, easy-to-talk-to {{태양별자리}} Sun, and your {{달별자리}} Moon shows what it feels right away. Air and Fire fan each other's flames, so your thoughts and feelings leap into words and action in no time.
TEMP_AIR_FIRE.temperament_line: You're lively and quick, and your thoughts and feelings turn into words and actions almost instantly.

TEMP_AIR_WATER.sun_moon_line: People see a breezy, easy-to-talk-to {{태양별자리}} Sun, but your {{달별자리}} Moon feels deeply and needs a real emotional connection to feel at ease. If you keep a conversation sparkling yet struggle to open up about how you really feel, you're feeling the contrast between these two energies.
TEMP_AIR_WATER.temperament_line: You keep conversations light and easy, but underneath lies a deep, sensitive inner world.

TEMP_EARTH_AIR.sun_moon_line: People see a calm, dependable {{태양별자리}} Sun, but your {{달별자리}} Moon feels better once it talks things out. If you look quiet while your mind runs through possibilities nonstop, you're seeing the contrast between these two energies at work.
TEMP_EARTH_AIR.temperament_line: You seem quiet and steady, but your mind never really stops turning things over.

TEMP_EARTH_EARTH.sun_moon_line: Your {{태양별자리}} Sun is calm and dependable, and your {{달별자리}} Moon is happiest when everyday life is in order, too. With your outer and inner self aligned, you follow through steadily on whatever you commit to. Unexpected changes weigh on you for a while, so build a little flex into your plans.
TEMP_EARTH_EARTH.temperament_line: Inside and out, you feel most secure when you can build things one solid step at a time.

TEMP_EARTH_FIRE.sun_moon_line: On the surface, you're a calm, dependable {{태양별자리}} Sun, but your {{달별자리}} Moon wants to show what it feels the moment it feels it. If you quietly stick to the plan and then feel pent-up frustration bubble over all at once, that's the tension between your Sun and Moon.
TEMP_EARTH_FIRE.temperament_line: Beneath your calm, stick-to-the-plan surface, a fire catches in an instant.

TEMP_EARTH_WATER.sun_moon_line: Outwardly, you're a calm, dependable {{태양별자리}} Sun, and inside, your {{달별자리}} Moon feels deeply and needs close emotional connection to feel at ease. Earth and Water support each other, so warmth flows naturally through the practical ways you care for people.
TEMP_EARTH_WATER.temperament_line: You show care in practical ways, and underneath it runs a deep, tender heart.

TEMP_FIRE_AIR.sun_moon_line: The world sees a quick, confident {{태양별자리}} Sun, while your {{달별자리}} Moon settles once it puts its thoughts into words. Fire and Air fuel each other, so your ideas turn into action fast. Give your feelings a little time and distance to catch up.
TEMP_FIRE_AIR.temperament_line: You move fast, yet inside you like to step back and think things through.

TEMP_FIRE_EARTH.sun_moon_line: Outwardly, you're a quick, confident {{태양별자리}} Sun. Inside, your {{달별자리}} Moon is happiest when things are sorted step by step. If you often leap first and then quietly double-check everything afterward, you're feeling the push and pull between these two energies.
TEMP_FIRE_EARTH.temperament_line: You act first on the outside, yet inside you relax only once you've checked every detail.

TEMP_FIRE_FIRE.sun_moon_line: Your {{태양별자리}} Sun is quick and confident, and your {{달별자리}} Moon shows what it feels the second it feels it. With your outer and inner self racing in the same direction, you have boundless get-up-and-go. Schedule your downtime on purpose, because it won't arrive on its own.
TEMP_FIRE_FIRE.temperament_line: You catch fire fast, inside and out, so make pausing a skill you practice on purpose.

TEMP_FIRE_WATER.sun_moon_line: You come across as a quick, confident {{태양별자리}} Sun, but your {{달별자리}} Moon feels things deeply and needs real emotional closeness to feel at ease. If you lead the charge in public yet replay one small comment for hours once you're alone, these two contrasting energies are at play.
TEMP_FIRE_WATER.temperament_line: You lead boldly on the outside, while inside, even a few small words linger for a long time.

TEMP_WATER_AIR.sun_moon_line: Your {{태양별자리}} Sun is gentle and reads people well, but your {{달별자리}} Moon likes to step back and think things through. If you empathize deeply yet still need time to yourself, you're living the push and pull between these two energies.
TEMP_WATER_AIR.temperament_line: You empathize deeply with others, yet you also need time alone to think.

TEMP_WATER_EARTH.sun_moon_line: You come across as a gentle {{태양별자리}} Sun who reads people well, and your {{달별자리}} Moon is happiest when daily life is in order. Water and Earth support each other, so your sensitivity to people naturally turns into steady, reliable care.
TEMP_WATER_EARTH.temperament_line: You notice what people need, and you keep showing up for them, steadily and reliably.

TEMP_WATER_FIRE.sun_moon_line: Outwardly, you're a gentle {{태양별자리}} Sun who reads people well, but your {{달별자리}} Moon says what it feels the moment it feels it. If you usually tune in to others first, then suddenly find the words bursting out of you, these two contrasting energies are the reason.
TEMP_WATER_FIRE.temperament_line: You tend to others first, yet inside you burns a spark that catches fast.

TEMP_WATER_WATER.sun_moon_line: On the surface, you're a gentle {{태양별자리}} Sun who reads people well, and inside, your {{달별자리}} Moon feels things deeply too. With both pointing the same way, your empathy runs strong. Remember that other people's moods are theirs to carry, not yours.
TEMP_WATER_WATER.temperament_line: You're tuned in to feelings through and through, so you soak up other people's moods along with your own.

TP_CHIRON_RETURN.text: Around {{날짜}}, Chiron returned to where it was when you were born. Chiron is a small body in the sky that symbolizes old wounds and our power to tend them. Arriving around age 50, this season invites you to tend old hurts and notice the strength and tenderness they grew in you.

TP_JUPITER_LEO_C.text: On {{날짜}}, Jupiter, the planet of expansion, moved into Leo, the sign of self-expression. From that day, Jupiter opened the way toward being seen and finding your joy again. That spark of confidence you felt later in the year? You were riding that breeze.

TP_JUPITER_LEO_H.text: With Jupiter, the planet of expansion, entering Leo on {{날짜}}, a tailwind began blowing through {{하우스영역}}. You gained momentum for showing up as yourself and enjoying life your way here. If something good came along in the second half of the year, it connects to this shift.

TP_JUPITER_RETURN.text: Around {{날짜}}, Jupiter, the planet of expansion, came home to the spot it held at your birth: your Jupiter return. Roughly once every twelve years, this return opens a fresh cycle of growth. What you started and the opportunities that arrived around then are seeds for the next few years, so tend them well.

TP_LUNAR_ECLIPSE_ON_POINT.text: On {{날짜}}, a lunar eclipse landed right on your natal {{행성}}. Lunar eclipses mark the moments when a chapter closes and loose ends get tied up. If something ended around then in the part of life {{행성}} rules, it was clearing space for what comes next.

TP_NEPTUNE_ARIES_C.text: On {{날짜}}, Neptune, the planet of dreams, crossed into Aries and set off on a long journey. Quietly, it asks, 'What am I dreaming of, and what do I want to begin?' Those moments when you felt adrift or unsure of your direction were the blank canvas before a new picture.

TP_NEPTUNE_ARIES_H.text: Neptune, the planet of dreams, entered Aries on {{날짜}} and began a long stay in {{하우스영역}}. Hopes that once felt vague in this area start rising into a new vision. If it still looks hazy, trust the pace: this transit takes shape slowly, and nothing here needs rushing.

TP_NEPTUNE_SQUARE.text: Around {{날짜}}, Neptune, the planet of dreams, formed a tense angle to its place in your birth chart. Goals you believed in for years start to blur, and you catch yourself asking, 'Is this really what I wanted?' If you felt lost, you were redrawing a dream that fits you better.

TP_QUIET_YEAR.text: The sky stayed quiet for you this year: the big planets made no strong contact with the key points in your chart. With less pressure from outside, you set your own pace. What you accomplished and when you chose to rest were, in large part, your own choices.

TP_SATURN_ARIES_C.text: On {{날짜}}, Saturn, the planet of responsibility, entered Aries, the sign of beginnings. Since that day, Saturn has asked all of us, 'What new responsibility am I ready to take on, and what do I want to start?' If your to-do list felt unusually heavy this year, you were feeling this shift.

TP_SATURN_ARIES_H.text: On {{날짜}}, Saturn, the planet of responsibility, moved into Aries and settled into {{하우스영역}}. This marks the starting line of a long review: what you take on in this part of life, and what you build from the ground up. If it has felt heavy, that weight is the sign you have begun laying a foundation built to last for years.

TP_SATURN_INTO_ASC_SIGN.text: Saturn, the planet of responsibility, entered {{별자리}}, your rising sign, on {{날짜}}. Since then, the way you present yourself and your body's rhythms carry new weight. Heavy as it feels, this is your chance to keep only what truly suits you and stand up again, steadier than before.

TP_SATURN_RETURN_1.text: Around {{날짜}}, you reached your first Saturn return, the threshold where Saturn comes back to the spot it held when you were born. Arriving around age 30, it is a major life review that asks, 'What am I willing to take responsibility for?' However much it shook you, it also hands you the chance to rebuild your life on a framework that truly fits.

TP_SATURN_RETURN_2.text: Your second Saturn return arrived around {{날짜}}, as Saturn came back to its birth position once more. It reviews everything you've built so far: what to hold on to, and what to set down. Skip the rush. Take this time to map out, calmly, how you want to spend the years ahead.

TP_SOLAR_ECLIPSE_ON_POINT.text: The solar eclipse on {{날짜}} fell right on your natal {{행성}}. Astrologers read solar eclipses as cosmic signals that open the door to new beginnings. Whatever began around then in the part of life {{행성}} rules is a seed with a long life ahead of it.

TP_STATION_ON_POINT.text: Around {{날짜}}, a slow-moving planet stationed right on your natal {{행성}}, appearing to stand still before it changed direction. When a planet lingers on one point like this, the themes of that area come into sharp focus. Whatever stayed with you from that time is a clue to what this year was really asking of you.

TP_URANUS_GEMINI_C.text: On {{날짜}}, Uranus, the planet of change, moved into Gemini, the sign of communication and learning. For all of us, the way we learn, talk, and connect began changing fast. Say yes to the unfamiliar tool or the new face: either one can open a bigger door than you expect.

TP_URANUS_GEMINI_H.text: When Uranus, the planet of change, entered Gemini on {{날짜}}, it began its stay in {{하우스영역}}. Familiar routines in this area start to shake loose, and at the same time, surprise offers and new paths open up. Over the next few years, expect this part of life to reinvent itself, bit by bit.

TP_URANUS_INTO_ASC_SIGN.text: On {{날짜}}, Uranus, the planet of change, entered {{별자리}}, your rising sign, and settled in for a long stay. Your answer to 'Who am I?' and the way you present yourself begin a slow transformation. The new version of you feels unfamiliar at first, but you now have a long, open stretch to try it on.

TP_URANUS_OPPOSITION.text: Around {{날짜}}, Uranus, the planet of change, reached the point directly opposite where it sat when you were born. Arriving around age 40, this transit signals a major turning point and asks how you want to live your next chapter. Where familiar things got shaken, a door opened to the parts of yourself you had put on hold.

LUNA_FULL_H01.line: Look back on who you've been so far and give yourself some praise.

LUNA_FULL_H02.line: It's a good day to sort out your spending and saving so far.

LUNA_FULL_H03.line: It's a day worth looking back on the conversations you've had and what you've learned.

LUNA_FULL_H04.line: Take a look at the feelings that have built up between you and your family.

LUNA_FULL_H05.line: It's a good day to wrap up something you've been enjoying.

LUNA_FULL_H06.line: It's a day worth setting down a routine that's been too heavy.

LUNA_FULL_H07.line: Gently consider the feelings you've given and received in a relationship.

LUNA_FULL_H08.line: It's a good day to reaffirm trust with someone close.

LUNA_FULL_H09.line: It's a day worth looking back on what you've learned and experienced.

LUNA_FULL_H10.line: Give yourself credit for what you've accomplished at work.

LUNA_FULL_H11.line: It's a good day to thank the people who've been with you.

LUNA_FULL_H12.line: It's a day to set down built-up tiredness and rest deeply.

LUNA_NEW_H01.line: Try making one new promise to yourself.

LUNA_NEW_H02.line: It's a good day to make a small new plan for money and spending.

LUNA_NEW_H03.line: It's a day to think of something you'd like to learn or someone you'd like to reach out to.

LUNA_NEW_H04.line: Try writing down a small promise for your home and family.

LUNA_NEW_H05.line: It's a good day to start something fun or creative.

LUNA_NEW_H06.line: It's a day worth choosing one new daily routine.

LUNA_NEW_H07.line: Quietly picture what you hope for in a relationship.

LUNA_NEW_H08.line: It's a good day to think about what you'd like to share with someone close.

LUNA_NEW_H09.line: It's a day worth imagining new learning or a place you'd like to visit.

LUNA_NEW_H10.line: Try putting what you want to achieve at work into one line.

LUNA_NEW_H11.line: It's a good day to think about the people you want to be with and your hopes for what's ahead.

LUNA_NEW_H12.line: It's a day to quietly clear your mind and get ready for a new promise.

SUN_AQUARIUS.shadow_line: When you lead with your head instead of your heart, the people closest to you can feel a little shut out.
SUN_AQUARIUS.table_line: You see things from a fresh angle and dream up better ways of doing them. You're at your most powerful when you're free to be completely yourself.
SUN_AQUARIUS.text: The question that drives you: "Does it really have to be done this way?" You're the one who shakes things up, proposing a new tool or rule for something everyone else took for granted. You care deeply about how people can get along while staying true to who they are.

SUN_ARIES.shadow_line: When impatience kicks in, you're quick to jump to conclusions before hearing the whole story.
SUN_ARIES.table_line: You're a starter. You'd rather jump in and figure things out as you go, and nothing makes you feel more alive than a fresh challenge.
SUN_ARIES.text: Your fuel is the pure itch to try. When the room goes quiet and no one volunteers, you're the first to say, "I'll take it." And once things pick up speed, your mind grows even sharper.

SUN_CANCER.shadow_line: You're so busy looking after everyone else that your own needs tend to end up last in line.
SUN_CANCER.table_line: You draw strength from protecting the people you love and the place you call home. Caring for someone grounds you like nothing else.
SUN_CANCER.text: At heart, you want your people to feel at ease. You're the friend who remembers an offhand comment and shows up next time with the very snack they mentioned. The safer your home base, the braver you are out in the world.

SUN_CAPRICORN.shadow_line: Locked onto your to-do list, you can start treating even rest as another chore.
SUN_CAPRICORN.table_line: You set goals and climb toward them one step at a time. Delivering results people can count on makes you feel rock-solid.
SUN_CAPRICORN.text: You're driven by a strong sense of responsibility and the satisfaction of hitting milestones, one after another. When others have given up on a project, you're the one who reworks the schedule and pushes it over the finish line. People's trust in you only deepens with time.

SUN_GEMINI.shadow_line: Pulled in too many directions, you can lose interest right before the finish line.
SUN_GEMINI.table_line: You follow your curiosity wherever it leads, weaving ideas and people together along the way. Lively conversation charges you up.
SUN_GEMINI.text: Curiosity runs the show for you: "Wait, why is that?" You hear something at lunch, look it up that night, and can't wait to share it the next day. A dozen tabs open in your head doesn't drain you; it wakes you up.

SUN_LEO.shadow_line: When your hard work goes unrecognized, the sting lingers longer than you expect.
SUN_LEO.table_line: You light up when you get to be fully yourself and someone notices. Pouring your whole heart into self-expression keeps your fire burning.
SUN_LEO.text: Nothing motivates you like saying, "I made this." Even a single presentation slide doesn't feel finished until it carries your signature touch. And when you fill the room with laughter, you glow your warmest too.

SUN_LIBRA.shadow_line: Trying to keep everyone happy, you sometimes lose sight of what you actually want.
SUN_LIBRA.table_line: You're the natural mediator, the one who brings balance to relationships and smooths out the rough edges. You shine brightest when everyone lands on a better answer together.
SUN_LIBRA.text: What drives you is the sweet spot where everyone feels heard and everything looks and feels just right. When a group can't decide where to eat, you're the one quietly reading everyone's preferences and suggesting a spot that works for all. Your thoughts run clearest in a calm, harmonious space.

SUN_PISCES.shadow_line: You can take other people's feelings so much to heart that you start to lose track of where they end and you begin.
SUN_PISCES.table_line: You sense what others are feeling and hold space for it with real tenderness. Life feels richest when you're dreaming and empathizing.
SUN_PISCES.text: You're moved by feelings that words can't quite capture. One favorite song shifts your whole mood, and one look at a friend's face tells you something's off. Your imagination, which gently dissolves the line between you and the world, is a true gift.

SUN_SAGITTARIUS.shadow_line: Guarding your freedom, you sometimes let promises and follow-through slide.
SUN_SAGITTARIUS.table_line: You're always heading toward a bigger world and meaningful insights. Learning, traveling, and stretching yourself make you feel most alive.
SUN_SAGITTARIUS.text: Your adventurous spirit keeps asking, "What's out there?" Wandering an unfamiliar neighborhood on the weekend, or picking up a book on a subject that's new to you, recharges you deeply. And your knack for finding something to laugh about, even in tough times, lifts everyone around you.

SUN_SCORPIO.shadow_line: When your trust is shaken, you're quick to close your heart all at once.
SUN_SCORPIO.table_line: Once you set your mind on something, you go all in. You won't stop digging until you get to the truth, and that drive sits at the very core of who you are.
SUN_SCORPIO.text: You're always searching for what's real beneath the surface. One soul you can go truly deep with means more to you than ten casual friends. You don't open up easily, but once you lock in on something, you see it all the way through.

SUN_TAURUS.shadow_line: Your love of the familiar can tempt you to put off changes you truly need.
SUN_TAURUS.table_line: Your strength grows from the stability you've built slowly and surely. Trust your own pace and instincts; that's when you stand strongest.
SUN_TAURUS.text: You're driven by results you can hold in your hands and comforts that last. A small ritual carries you through the day, like stopping by your favorite bakery after work for the usual. Once you commit, you quietly see it through, and that staying power is your secret weapon.

SUN_VIRGO.shadow_line: In aiming for perfection, you can end up sweating every little detail and being far too hard on yourself.
SUN_VIRGO.table_line: You have a gift for refining the little things until they truly work. Knowing you're genuinely useful fuels you.
SUN_VIRGO.text: Your eye is always thinking, "This could be a little better." You're the first to catch the typo in a spreadsheet or the gap in a schedule that everyone else missed, and you fix it without fuss. Checking off a neat to-do list, one item at a time, leaves your whole day feeling lighter.

MOON_AQUARIUS.comfort_line: Protect your alone time while staying loosely connected to people who get you. That balance is your strength.
MOON_AQUARIUS.table_line: You feel at ease when your space and your freedom of thought are respected. You observe your emotions from a step away.
MOON_AQUARIUS.text: When strong feelings hit, your first move is to step back and understand them calmly. Even with the people closest to you, you thrive on giving each other room rather than being joined at the hip. Loose ties with like-minded friends form your safety net.

MOON_ARIES.comfort_line: Work up a light sweat and feel the knots inside you loosen.
MOON_ARIES.table_line: Your feelings rise fast and honest. You find relief the moment you can voice them and act.
MOON_ARIES.text: When anger or hurt flares, you let it out on the spot and shake it off rather than let it simmer. On a restless day, skip the overthinking: a brisk walk or a quick workout clears your head faster. You feel most settled when you have room to move on your own terms.

MOON_CANCER.comfort_line: Share unhurried time with someone easy to be around, ideally over a home-cooked meal, and feel your cup fill again.
MOON_CANCER.table_line: You feel at ease when your loved ones and your space are safe. Caring and being cared for are the roots of your calm.
MOON_CANCER.text: You feel deeply and catch even the smallest shift in a room's mood. After a draining day, simply coming home and cooking something familiar warms you right back up. You tend to hold hurt inside rather than voice it, so keep someone safe close by.

MOON_CAPRICORN.comfort_line: Give yourself credit for what you've achieved, and block out downtime in advance that has nothing to do with work.
MOON_CAPRICORN.table_line: You feel calm when you know you have things in hand. You tackle what needs doing before you tend to how you feel.
MOON_CAPRICORN.text: Even when you're upset, you take care of business first and deal with your feelings later, on your own. Quietly toughing it out comes more naturally to you than admitting you're struggling. A solid plan and a predictable schedule make you steadfast inside.

MOON_GEMINI.comfort_line: Pour everything in your head onto paper, or share an easy conversation with someone you trust.
MOON_GEMINI.table_line: Putting feelings into words lightens you. Your emotions breathe best when ideas flow freely back and forth.
MOON_GEMINI.text: When something upsets you, you make sense of it by talking it through or writing it down. One long text chat with a friend, and you often find the worry has sorted itself out. Stay stuck in one place too long, though, and you grow restless and cooped up.

MOON_LEO.comfort_line: Lose yourself in a hobby that's pure fun for you. It rekindles your inner fire.
MOON_LEO.table_line: You relax when your true feelings are seen and welcomed. Warm attention and a genuine response are your emotional fuel.
MOON_LEO.text: Your joy and your hurt both run big and bright. Watching someone light up over a little gift you chose melts a long day away. When you're hurt, pride tempts you to act as if everything's fine, so seek out a space where you can be honest.

MOON_LIBRA.comfort_line: Share a cup of tea with a kindred spirit, or rest your eyes on something beautiful.
MOON_LIBRA.table_line: Peace and harmony among your people let you breathe easy. When one relationship falls out of tune, part of you can't fully relax.
MOON_LIBRA.text: Rather than stewing alone, you find your balance by talking things over with someone. When an argument breaks out, you read the room before checking in with yourself, and you rush to make peace. Harmonious surroundings, like good music or a well-kept space, calm you too.

MOON_PISCES.comfort_line: Music, a warm bath, a walk by the water: give your senses something gentle to rest on.
MOON_PISCES.table_line: You feel at peace when your emotions have room to drift and flow. Like a sponge, you soak up the feelings around you.
MOON_PISCES.text: You feel other people's moods as if they were your own, and a single sad film can move you to tears. On draining days, drifting along to music or strolling by the water washes the day away. Long stretches in crowds sap your energy before you even notice.

MOON_SAGITTARIUS.comfort_line: Take a short day trip or learn something new. Widening your horizons helps you unwind.
MOON_SAGITTARIUS.table_line: Freedom to roam and fresh experiences lift your spirits. Feel boxed in, and your mood sinks with it.
MOON_SAGITTARIUS.text: Even when life gets hard, your optimism hunts for the meaning and finds a way to laugh it off. On days you feel completely stuck, simply hopping on a bus to an unfamiliar neighborhood helps you breathe again. Still, give heavy feelings their due: brush past them too quickly, and they tend to come flooding back later.

MOON_SCORPIO.comfort_line: Claim some time alone to feel your emotions fully, then let them flow out onto the page.
MOON_SCORPIO.table_line: With someone you trust completely by your side, you finally relax. You crave deep connection over surface-level sharing.
MOON_SCORPIO.text: You feel things intensely but rarely let it show, processing them inside for a long time. Even when a hurt looks resolved, you turn it over in your mind again and again. Only with someone you fully trust do you reveal what's really going on.

MOON_TAURUS.comfort_line: Savor a favorite meal in a space that feels like yours. That's how you refill.
MOON_TAURUS.table_line: Familiar rhythms and simple comforts let you exhale. For you, stability means a daily life that doesn't shift overnight.
MOON_TAURUS.text: Even when you're shaken, you rarely show it; you digest your feelings slowly and thoroughly. A warm meal, a soft blanket, your usual walking route: these small comforts calm you faster than anything. When change arrives out of nowhere, give yourself a little extra time to take it in.

MOON_VIRGO.comfort_line: Tidy one small corner, then write down what you accomplished today. Your mind settles as you do.
MOON_VIRGO.table_line: An orderly space and a clear to-do list put your mind at rest. You meet worry by sorting things out and fixing them.
MOON_VIRGO.text: When anxiety creeps in, you steady yourself by jotting down a to-do list or clearing your desk. When someone's struggling, you show love by rolling up your sleeves rather than reaching for comforting words. Just watch your inner critic: when it gets loud, even downtime stops feeling like rest.

ASC_AQUARIUS.table_line: You read as one of a kind and free-spirited. You greet the world warmly while keeping a little space of your own.
ASC_AQUARIUS.text: You chat easily with anyone, yet people sense you see the world a little differently. Your taste follows your own compass, not the trends. The gift of this rising sign: you stay true to your own colors, even in a crowd.

ASC_ARIES.table_line: People see you as energetic and refreshingly direct. Instead of hesitating, you greet the world with action.
ASC_ARIES.text: Even among strangers, you're the one who speaks up first or sets the tone. You walk fast and your face is an open book, so people read your thoughts at a glance. Your greatest strength with this rising sign: diving straight into new situations.

ASC_CANCER.table_line: Others read you as gentle and kind. In unfamiliar settings, you take the measure of a place before you open up.
ASC_CANCER.text: You seem a little shy at first, but your warmth puts people at ease. Your thoughtfulness shows without effort, like when you make a point of checking on the person sitting alone at a gathering. Once you feel safe, you laugh more freely and open your heart wide.

ASC_CAPRICORN.table_line: You come off as reliable and mature beyond your years. You keep a measured distance and build trust step by step.
ASC_CAPRICORN.text: At first you seem serious, even hard to approach, but people trust you because you always follow through. Over time, a surprising sense of humor and real warmth come to light. People often say you grow easier to be around the longer they know you.

ASC_GEMINI.table_line: First impression: light, curious, and easy to talk to. You respond to new information in a flash.
ASC_GEMINI.text: Your quick wit finds a thread of conversation with anyone, even someone you've just met. With your expressive face and animated hands, people often call you upbeat and youthful. You mingle easily with all kinds of people and help the whole room loosen up.

ASC_LEO.table_line: You carry a bright, magnetic presence. You face the world with confidence, unafraid to show who you are.
ASC_LEO.text: People often say a room lights up the moment you walk in. Your personal flair shines through in how you dress and speak, and eyes naturally drift your way. With this rising sign, stepping in front of people energizes you rather than drains you.

ASC_LIBRA.table_line: To others, you seem warm and refined. You approach people with grace and consideration.
ASC_LIBRA.text: Even with people you've just met, you set a polite, comfortable tone. The way you nod along and truly listen wins people over quickly. Your instinct to seek common ground rather than clash shines through in every first impression.

ASC_PISCES.table_line: You seem soft and dreamy to others. You meet the world by tuning delicately in to the mood around you.
ASC_PISCES.text: Your cozy, welcoming aura makes even new acquaintances want to confide in you. Your expression is gentle, and you naturally match your tone to how the other person feels. Big crowds wear you out quickly, though, so carve out time to recharge on your own.

ASC_SAGITTARIUS.table_line: You strike people as upbeat and open-minded. You embrace new people and new experiences without a second thought.
ASC_SAGITTARIUS.text: Your frank, playful way of talking puts even new acquaintances at ease fast. You love swapping travel stories and sharing what you've just learned, and conversations open wide around you. Your free spirit and refusal to be boxed in are what make your first impression so charming.

ASC_SCORPIO.table_line: People sense a depth in you they can't easily read. You open up only after you've taken someone's full measure.
ASC_SCORPIO.text: You don't say much, yet your gaze and presence carry real intensity. Others read distance at first, but you're simply getting to know them with care. Once you let someone in, you hold them closer than almost anyone else would.

ASC_TAURUS.table_line: You give off a calm, easygoing presence. You connect with the world and its people at your own unhurried pace.
ASC_TAURUS.text: You seem quiet at first, yet people walk away feeling steadied by your presence. Your love of texture, beauty, and scent shows naturally in your clothes, the objects you keep close, and the fragrances you choose. You warm to new places slowly, but once you settle in, you stay for the long haul.

ASC_VIRGO.table_line: You come across as polished and thoughtful. You take stock of the situation first, then pitch in exactly where you're needed.
ASC_VIRGO.text: At first you observe quietly, so people see you as calm and conscientious. Small habits, like arriving on time and bringing what's needed before anyone asks, earn their trust. You look composed on the outside while taking in every detail within.

CHAR_01_OTTER.care_tip: Before you hit send, check in with yourself: is it conversation you need right now, or rest?
CHAR_01_OTTER.energy_moment: A message you sent first sits unanswered, and your mind starts racing on its own.
CHAR_01_OTTER.intro: When loneliness creeps in, River Otter is the first to dive in and start a playful splash with a friend. Rather than toughing it out alone, it chooses to swim together and share the warmth.
CHAR_01_OTTER.share_line: The courage to reach out first: that's River Otter's warmth
CHAR_01_OTTER.strength: You break the ice first and make everyone around you feel welcome in no time.
CHAR_01_OTTER.type_line: Leaning on others takes a lot out of you, and when it does, you're the first to reach out
CHAR_01_OTTER.why_text: Of your five planets, the Moon, ruler of your emotions, carries the most tension. That makes leaning on others the capacity that costs you the most energy. And because Fire burns strongest in your chart, you reach out and make the first move instead of waiting.

CHAR_02_SEA_OTTER.care_tip: Today, before checking anyone else's mood, write down your own in a single word.
CHAR_02_SEA_OTTER.energy_moment: Even on days you need a shoulder, you get so absorbed in their mood that your own story stays unspoken.
CHAR_02_SEA_OTTER.intro: Sea otters hold hands while they sleep so no one drifts away. Sea Otter knows the art of leaning in quietly, moving with the rhythm of whoever floats beside it.
CHAR_02_SEA_OTTER.share_line: Like sea otters floating hand in hand: thank you for staying by my side
CHAR_02_SEA_OTTER.strength: You sense how someone feels without a word, and you become the comforting presence they need.
CHAR_02_SEA_OTTER.type_line: Leaning on others is hard work for you, so you tune in and go along with the other person
CHAR_02_SEA_OTTER.why_text: The Moon, keeper of your emotional security, is the most stressed of your five planets. So leaning on someone is where you spend the most energy. With Water strongest in your chart, you tune in to the other person's feelings before your own and simply stay close.

CHAR_03_SEAL.care_tip: Once you've sorted things out on your own, share just the conclusion with one person you trust, even in a sentence or two.
CHAR_03_SEAL.energy_moment: Part of you longs for comfort, yet you say "I'm fine" and haul yourself up onto your rock alone.
CHAR_03_SEAL.intro: Seal stays close to the group yet always keeps its own spot on the rocks to rest. On heavy days, it slips beneath the water and surfaces just its head to survey the world.
CHAR_03_SEAL.share_line: Even while resting solo, you popped your head up. So glad you did
CHAR_03_SEAL.strength: Even when emotions run high, you step back and see the situation with a clear head.
CHAR_03_SEAL.type_line: Leaning on others drains you, so you'd rather step back and sort things out on your own
CHAR_03_SEAL.why_text: Your Moon, the planet of feelings, carries more tension than any of your other four planets. That makes leaning on others emotionally your most draining capacity. Air is the strongest element in your chart, so you seek time to sort out your thoughts alone before leaning on anyone.

CHAR_04_BEAVER.care_tip: Add one line to the very top of your to-do list: tell someone how I feel today.
CHAR_04_BEAVER.energy_moment: You push your hurt aside, keep working through your to-do list, and quietly run yourself ragged.
CHAR_04_BEAVER.intro: When Beaver longs for someone to lean on, it starts building a shared home before saying a word. Branch by branch, it creates a place where leaning on each other feels safe.
CHAR_04_BEAVER.share_line: Building a cozy nest where we can rest together. What a steadfast Beaver
CHAR_04_BEAVER.strength: Support, for you, is never just talk: you build a real, everyday foundation others can lean on.
CHAR_04_BEAVER.type_line: Leaning on others takes real effort, so you work it out in practical terms
CHAR_04_BEAVER.why_text: Among your five planets, the Moon, guardian of your emotional security, faces the most tension. As a result, leaning on others takes more energy than anything else. Earth is your chart's strongest element, so instead of pouring your heart out, you get practical and line up shared plans and schedules.

CHAR_05_MANDARIN_DUCK.care_tip: When the urge to ask hits, recall three moments the two of you have built together.
CHAR_05_MANDARIN_DUCK.energy_moment: You've already heard the reassurance, yet you still can't settle and long to ask one more time.
CHAR_05_MANDARIN_DUCK.intro: When worry stirs, Mandarin Duck paddles over first and swims side by side, just to make sure you're still there. The more time you share, the calmer it grows.
CHAR_05_MANDARIN_DUCK.share_line: Swimming side by side is pure treasure to a Mandarin Duck
CHAR_05_MANDARIN_DUCK.strength: You never hide how much you care, and that openness breathes warmth into your relationships.
CHAR_05_MANDARIN_DUCK.type_line: Trusting a relationship enough to relax takes a lot of energy, so you reach out first to check in
CHAR_05_MANDARIN_DUCK.why_text: Saturn, the planet of responsibility and structure, is the most stressed of your five planets. That makes trusting a relationship enough to relax your most draining capacity. Since Fire is your strongest element, you ask and say how you feel rather than worry in silence.

CHAR_06_PENGUIN.care_tip: Today, say one thing you want first, and watch how well the relationship holds.
CHAR_06_PENGUIN.energy_moment: Afraid of rocking the boat, you swallow even your hurt feelings and simply go along.
CHAR_06_PENGUIN.intro: On cold days, penguins huddle close and take turns braving the windy outer edge. Even amid countless calls, Penguin picks out the voice of someone it loves and goes to stand right beside them.
CHAR_06_PENGUIN.share_line: Making room for others on the coldest days. Such a warm Penguin
CHAR_06_PENGUIN.strength: You keep an eye on everyone's feelings and hold your place so no one is left out in the cold.
CHAR_06_PENGUIN.type_line: Letting your guard down in a relationship is hard for you, so you adapt to the other person
CHAR_06_PENGUIN.why_text: Saturn, ruler of time and responsibility, bears the heaviest tension among your five planets. That's why believing a relationship stands on solid ground takes the most energy for you. With Water strongest in your chart, you adapt to others to keep the whole huddle warm.

CHAR_07_HERON.care_tip: From everything you've observed, choose one moment when someone already proved trustworthy, and thank them for it.
CHAR_07_HERON.energy_moment: You welcome someone's warmth, yet you spend ages alone weighing whether you can truly trust it.
CHAR_07_HERON.intro: Heron stands in the shallows for a long while, watching the ripples before taking a single step. Unhurried, it observes from a distance and decides for itself whether it's safe to trust.
CHAR_07_HERON.share_line: Heron watches long and trusts deeply
CHAR_07_HERON.strength: You watch people and situations with a calm, clear eye, never swept away by the moment.
CHAR_07_HERON.type_line: Trusting others is draining for you, so you step back and think it through alone
CHAR_07_HERON.why_text: Of your five planets, Saturn, the planet of responsibility and tests, is under the most tension. That's why fully trusting a relationship takes so much out of you. Air is your strongest element, so instead of moving in close, you step back and think the situation through.

CHAR_08_SWAN.care_tip: Stop paddling for a moment, and put one worry into words.
CHAR_08_SWAN.energy_moment: You act calm on the surface while quietly redrawing all your plans underneath.
CHAR_08_SWAN.intro: On the surface, Swan glides with effortless grace, but beneath the water its feet never stop paddling. It looks serene, yet it works steadily below to keep the relationship balanced.
CHAR_08_SWAN.share_line: A Swan on still water, always working hard beneath
CHAR_08_SWAN.strength: You keep your word and show up day after day, building relationships people can rely on.
CHAR_08_SWAN.type_line: Feeling secure in a relationship takes effort, so you find practical ways to make it work
CHAR_08_SWAN.why_text: Saturn rules structure and commitments, and of your five planets, it carries the most tension. As a result, trusting a relationship enough to relax takes more energy than anything else. Because Earth is strongest in your chart, you find reassurance by aligning promises and daily routines in practical ways.

CHAR_09_PUFFERFISH.care_tip: When you feel yourself puffing up, breathe out slowly and choose just one thing you want to say.
CHAR_09_PUFFERFISH.energy_moment: Your body puffs up before your feelings catch up, and your words come out harsher than you meant.
CHAR_09_PUFFERFISH.intro: When Pufferfish senses someone crossing a line, it puffs up to send a clear signal right away. Most of the time it's round and mellow, but it never hesitates when something needs protecting.
CHAR_09_PUFFERFISH.share_line: A Pufferfish brave enough to puff up honestly. Love that courage
CHAR_09_PUFFERFISH.strength: You never let things fester. You speak up honestly, and that keeps your relationships clear and transparent.
CHAR_09_PUFFERFISH.type_line: Holding your boundaries takes a lot out of you, so you speak up and meet it head-on
CHAR_09_PUFFERFISH.why_text: Mars, ruler of drive and action, faces the most tension among your five planets. That makes setting and holding your boundaries your most draining capacity. Fire is the strongest element in your chart, so rather than letting things slide, you draw the line by speaking up on the spot.

CHAR_10_HERMIT_CRAB.care_tip: This week, kindly turn down one small request: "I can't this time."
CHAR_10_HERMIT_CRAB.energy_moment: "No" is right on the tip of your tongue, then you see their face and swallow it.
CHAR_10_HERMIT_CRAB.intro: Hermit crabs line up with their neighbors and take turns swapping shells. Hermit Crab works so hard to make everyone comfortable that it sometimes misses the home that truly fits.
CHAR_10_HERMIT_CRAB.share_line: Here's to finding a shell that fits you just right, Hermit Crab
CHAR_10_HERMIT_CRAB.strength: You read what others are going through and yield gracefully to keep the peace.
CHAR_10_HERMIT_CRAB.type_line: Saying where your limits are is hard for you, so you often go along with others
CHAR_10_HERMIT_CRAB.why_text: Mars governs your power to stand up for yourself, and of your five planets, it's under the most tension. So saying "this far, no further" is where you spend the most energy. With Water as your strongest element, you give up a little of your own space to match someone's mood instead of saying no.

CHAR_11_TURTLE.care_tip: When you head into your shell, leave a quick word: you need a little rest, and you'll talk again soon.
CHAR_11_TURTLE.energy_moment: Instead of saying something feels off, you retreat into your shell and linger there a long time.
CHAR_11_TURTLE.intro: When Turtle feels its space invaded, it quietly withdraws into its shell to catch its breath. Only after a good rest does it poke its head back out and slowly carry on.
CHAR_11_TURTLE.share_line: Rest, then walk on. Turtle's pace is perfectly fine
CHAR_11_TURTLE.strength: Even in a clash, you hold your ground calmly instead of reacting in the heat of the moment.
CHAR_11_TURTLE.type_line: Defending your boundaries drains you, so you pull back and regroup on your own
CHAR_11_TURTLE.why_text: Of your five planets, Mars, the planet of action and self-assertion, bears the most strain. That's why putting your boundaries into words takes so much energy. Air is strongest in your chart, so instead of pushing back, you step away for a while and sort through your thoughts alone.

CHAR_12_CLAM.care_tip: Before you weigh the pros and cons, ask yourself whether you even want to open up right now.
CHAR_12_CLAM.energy_moment: You're so busy calculating whether to open or close that you never pause to check how you actually feel.
CHAR_12_CLAM.intro: Clam opens its shell just a crack when the water runs clear and clamps it shut when the water turns murky. A careful gatekeeper, it reads each situation to decide how far to open.
CHAR_12_CLAM.share_line: Slow to open, yet so soft inside. That's Clam
CHAR_12_CLAM.strength: You have a practical gift for sorting what to let in from what to keep out.
CHAR_12_CLAM.type_line: Holding your boundaries takes real effort, so you weigh things practically and adjust
CHAR_12_CLAM.why_text: Mars, your planet of drive and self-protection, carries more tension than any of your other four planets. That's why setting and holding your boundaries takes the most energy. Because Earth is your strongest element, you weigh conditions and circumstances, not feelings, to decide how far to open up.

CHAR_13_FUR_SEAL.care_tip: Before you bring up something important, choose the one sentence you most want them to hear.
CHAR_13_FUR_SEAL.energy_moment: In a rush, the words tumble out first, and afterward you replay them again and again.
CHAR_13_FUR_SEAL.intro: When Fur Seal has something to say, it hauls itself onto a rock and calls out loud and clear. Even in a noisy, crowded colony, it raises its voice to get the conversation going.
CHAR_13_FUR_SEAL.share_line: Thanks for always saying hi first, Fur Seal. You make me smile
CHAR_13_FUR_SEAL.strength: You break awkward silences first and get the conversation flowing with your honesty.
CHAR_13_FUR_SEAL.type_line: Putting your feelings into words takes a lot out of you, yet you still reach out first
CHAR_13_FUR_SEAL.why_text: Mercury, ruler of thought and speech, is under the most tension of your five planets. That's why putting your feelings into words takes the most out of you. With Fire as your strongest element, you speak up first instead of holding back.

CHAR_14_DOLPHIN.care_tip: After you agree with someone, add one sentence about how you actually felt.
CHAR_14_DOLPHIN.energy_moment: You're so busy matching the mood that the conversation ends before you share what you really think.
CHAR_14_DOLPHIN.intro: Dolphins listen closely to the sounds of their pod and whistle along in rhythm. Dolphin finds the words that lift the mood faster than anyone.
CHAR_14_DOLPHIN.share_line: A Dolphin who keeps the beat. I'd love to hear your song too
CHAR_14_DOLPHIN.strength: You read people and find just the right tone to reach each one.
CHAR_14_DOLPHIN.type_line: Saying what you really think is hard for you, so you follow the other person's lead
CHAR_14_DOLPHIN.why_text: Mercury, the planet of words and communication, is the most stressed of your five planets. So saying exactly what you think takes the most energy for you. Water is your strongest element, which is why you reach for what the other person wants to hear before what you want to say.

CHAR_15_HUMPBACK_WHALE.care_tip: Even if your thoughts aren't fully sorted, let people know you're still thinking and will come back to it soon.
CHAR_15_HUMPBACK_WHALE.energy_moment: While you're still polishing your thoughts, the moment to speak slips by, and you're left holding the words alone.
CHAR_15_HUMPBACK_WHALE.intro: Deep in the ocean, Humpback Whale spends a long time alone refining its song before sending it out across the sea. Its voice is slow to emerge, but it carries deep and far.
CHAR_15_HUMPBACK_WHALE.share_line: Humpback Whale's slow song travels far
CHAR_15_HUMPBACK_WHALE.strength: You think things through before you speak, so your words carry weight and linger with people.
CHAR_15_HUMPBACK_WHALE.type_line: Putting feelings into words drains you, so you step back and sort out your thoughts first
CHAR_15_HUMPBACK_WHALE.why_text: Mercury, the planet of words and thought, faces the most tension among your five planets. That makes putting your feelings into words your most draining capacity. Because Air is strongest in your chart, you take time to fully sort out your thoughts before you speak.

CHAR_16_FROG.care_tip: Instead of holding out for the perfect moment, choose one day this week to say it.
CHAR_16_FROG.energy_moment: You keep waiting for a better moment, and the chance to speak keeps slipping further away.
CHAR_16_FROG.intro: Frog waits until the rain falls and the moment ripens, then raises its voice. Moving between water and land, it chooses the right place and time to speak.
CHAR_16_FROG.share_line: When a Frog with perfect timing speaks up, you can count on it
CHAR_16_FROG.strength: You know when and where to raise things, so you get your point across without misunderstandings.
CHAR_16_FROG.type_line: Speaking your mind takes effort, so you choose your moment and approach it practically
CHAR_16_FROG.why_text: Mercury, ruler of thought and expression, is the most stressed of your five planets. That's why voicing what's on your mind takes so much energy. Earth is your strongest element, so rather than speaking on impulse, you weigh the timing and the best way to say it.

CHAR_17_OCTOPUS.care_tip: Once you've offered to make up, give them about a day to respond.
CHAR_17_OCTOPUS.energy_moment: The other person is still collecting themselves, but you want it fixed now and reach out with every arm at once.
CHAR_17_OCTOPUS.intro: When a relationship hits a snag, Octopus reaches out with all eight arms, eager to be the first to mend it. It even shifts colors, showing exactly how it feels.
CHAR_17_OCTOPUS.share_line: Thanks for reaching out first, Octopus. Message received, with love
CHAR_17_OCTOPUS.strength: When things turn awkward, you're the first to reach out and get everyone smiling again.
CHAR_17_OCTOPUS.type_line: Making up after a fight takes a lot out of you, yet you're the first to reach out
CHAR_17_OCTOPUS.why_text: Among your five planets, Venus, ruler of relationships and harmony, faces the most tension. So reconnecting after a fight is the capacity that takes the most out of you. Fire burns strongest in your chart, so you reach out and offer to make up rather than wait it out.

CHAR_18_JELLYFISH.care_tip: Once things have calmed down, gently bring up one thing that hurt you.
CHAR_18_JELLYFISH.energy_moment: Eager to smooth things over fast, you let your own hurt drift by unspoken.
CHAR_18_JELLYFISH.intro: When the water turns rough, Jellyfish doesn't fight it. It lets go and sways along. Like its translucent body, it mirrors the other person's mood and softens the atmosphere.
CHAR_18_JELLYFISH.share_line: Thanks for keeping the waters calm, Jellyfish
CHAR_18_JELLYFISH.strength: You take the edge off a tense moment so everyone can settle back in together.
CHAR_18_JELLYFISH.type_line: Getting close again after a conflict is hard work, so you adapt to the other person
CHAR_18_JELLYFISH.why_text: Venus governs what you love and who you hold close, and it's the most stressed of your five planets. That's why warming a strained relationship back up takes the most energy. With Water strongest in your chart, you ease the mood by putting the other person's feelings ahead of your own side of things.

CHAR_19_STINGRAY.care_tip: When you step away to catch your breath, agree in advance on when you'll talk again.
CHAR_19_STINGRAY.energy_moment: Your rest in the sand drags on, and the other person grows weary of waiting.
CHAR_19_STINGRAY.intro: When the waves get rough, Stingray buries itself in the sand and rests until the waters settle. Once it's caught its breath, it spreads its wide wings and glides gracefully back up.
CHAR_19_STINGRAY.share_line: Take your time resting, stingray. I'll be here when you rise again
CHAR_19_STINGRAY.strength: Once the storm passes, you reopen the conversation with calm, clear words.
CHAR_19_STINGRAY.type_line: Reconnecting after a conflict drains you, so you settle your feelings on your own first
CHAR_19_STINGRAY.why_text: Of your five planets, Venus, which governs harmony and relationships, carries the most tension. That's why drawing close again after a conflict drains you so much. Air is your strongest element, so before resolving anything, you take time alone to let your feelings settle.

CHAR_20_STARFISH.care_tip: Before offering a fix, start with something simple, like "That must have really hurt."
CHAR_20_STARFISH.energy_moment: The other person just wants to feel understood, but you're already lining up solutions.
CHAR_20_STARFISH.intro: Starfish regrows even an injured arm, taking all the time it needs. Unhurried, it moves its tiny feet one by one, making its way back to where things went wrong.
CHAR_20_STARFISH.share_line: Slowly but surely growing back. Rooting for you, Starfish
CHAR_20_STARFISH.strength: You trace a conflict back to its roots, step by step, and fine-tune things so it's less likely to repeat.
CHAR_20_STARFISH.type_line: Patching things up after a fight takes effort, so you work through it practically, step by step
CHAR_20_STARFISH.why_text: Venus, the planet of relationships and harmony, carries the most tension of your five. As a result, mending things after a fight takes more energy than anything else. Because Earth leads in your chart, you look practically at what went wrong and set it right piece by piece.

COMP_BOUNDARY.astro_text: Mars fuels your drive, your actions, and your instinct to protect yourself. When Mars takes many hard aspects, choosing when and how to say "no" costs you real effort. Look to Mars, then, to see how you draw your lines and hold them.
COMP_BOUNDARY.plain: With Holding boundaries, you know what feels comfortable and what doesn't, and you stand by it.
COMP_BOUNDARY.when_shaky: You say yes to every favor and end up overloaded, or you bottle things up until they burst out, sharper than you meant. When you lose track of what's truly yours to handle, you notice how drained you are only much later.

COMP_LEAN.astro_text: The Moon governs your emotions and your sense of inner safety. When it takes many hard aspects, the part of you that longs to lean on someone keeps colliding with the part that insists on going it alone. So the Moon is where we look to see how freely you let yourself lean on others.
COMP_LEAN.plain: Leaning on others is your capacity for intimacy: you rely on the people closest to you, and you give and receive comfort freely.
COMP_LEAN.when_shaky: When things get hard, you either brush it off and act fine, or a single text sends your mood swinging. Part of you longs to lean on someone, while another part worries about becoming a burden.

COMP_REPAIR.astro_text: Venus governs what you love, your relationships, and harmony itself. When Venus takes many hard aspects, smoothing things over after a falling-out drains you emotionally. We turn to Venus to see how you mend a bond once a rift opens.
COMP_REPAIR.plain: Repairing is how you work through conflict, finding your way back to warmth after an argument or hurt feelings.
COMP_REPAIR.when_shaky: Even after a small spat, you stay weighed down for days, worried the tension won't lift. While you debate whether to apologize first or wait, the moment to make up passes.

COMP_SPEAK.astro_text: Mercury rules thought, speech, and staying in touch. With many hard aspects to Mercury, your mind brims with ideas, yet voicing them takes real effort. Mercury shows how readily you turn feelings into words.
COMP_SPEAK.plain: Speaking up is your gift for expression: you put your thoughts and feelings into words the other person truly understands.
COMP_SPEAK.when_shaky: You rewrite a message again and again and never hit send, or you say something and replay it for hours. Afraid of being misunderstood, you swallow even the words that truly need saying.

COMP_TRUST.astro_text: Saturn governs responsibility, structure, and the power to endure over time. When Saturn takes many hard aspects, you keep testing whether a relationship truly stands on solid ground. Saturn reveals the kind of trust you build slowly, season by season.
COMP_TRUST.plain: Trusting brings you security. You believe a relationship won't crumble at the first bump, and you let yourself relax into it.
COMP_TRUST.when_shaky: A slow reply or a slight shift in tone makes the whole relationship feel shaky. Even after someone reassures you, the relief fades fast, and all that checking wears you out.
