STYLE_APPROACH.astro_text: Fire, the element of Aries, Leo, and Sagittarius, burns with passion and the spark to begin. In a Fire-heavy chart, the moment your feelings stir, you want to act. That's why Fire pairs with reaching out first when you're shaken.
STYLE_APPROACH.plain: Reaching out is your way of closing the gap when you feel unsettled: instead of waiting, you call, text, or make the first move.
STYLE_APPROACH.when_shaky: This is how you've kept relationships from going cold: you never let an awkward silence linger, and you reach out first. Push it too far, though, and you press for an answer before the other person is ready, which only feeds your own urgency.

STYLE_ATTUNE.astro_text: Cancer, Scorpio, and Pisces share the Water element, the power to feel deeply and absorb everything around you. A Water-heavy chart means you read the mood before you hear the words. So Water connects to tuning in to the other person when you're shaken.
STYLE_ATTUNE.plain: Accommodating means keeping the peace when you feel unsettled. You tune yourself to the other person's mood and to the atmosphere in the room.
STYLE_ATTUNE.when_shaky: You sense what others feel before they say it and make room for them, and that's how you've stayed close without clashing. Taken too far, though, your own feelings keep sliding to the back, and quiet resentment can build before you notice.

STYLE_COORDINATE.astro_text: As the element of Taurus, Virgo, and Capricorn, Earth builds solid ground and protects what's real. With plenty of Earth in your chart, you reach for a practical fix before dwelling on feelings. This is why Earth matches weighing things up step by step and working out a compromise when you're shaken.
STYLE_COORDINATE.plain: Balancing is how you get practical when you feel unsettled: you weigh what's realistically possible and find the middle ground.
STYLE_COORDINATE.when_shaky: Rather than getting swept up in emotion, you start with what can actually be done, and that keeps your relationships on solid ground. The flip side: offer solutions before you truly listen, and the other person can end up feeling hurt.

STYLE_DISTANCE.astro_text: Air is the element of Gemini, Libra, and Aquarius: the power to think things through and see them from a step away. When Air dominates your chart, you make sense of rising emotions in your head first. It goes hand in hand with stepping back to catch your breath when you're shaken.
STYLE_DISTANCE.plain: In the Stepping back style, you give yourself space when you feel unsettled, taking time alone to sort out your thoughts.
STYLE_DISTANCE.when_shaky: When emotions race ahead, stepping back has helped you choose calm thoughts over words you'd regret. Lean on it too hard, though, and you start to feel like a closed door to the other person, widening the distance between you.

ELEM_AIR_STRONG.style_link: With Air as your strongest element, you often lean toward the 'Stepping back' style, taking time alone to sort things out when you feel unsettled.
ELEM_AIR_STRONG.text: Strong Air makes you a quick thinker who steps back and sees the bigger picture. You excel at connecting people and ideas through conversation and information. The catch: stop at understanding things in your head, and you risk losing touch with how you actually feel.

ELEM_AIR_WEAK.text: A chart with little Air means you react first through action, your senses, or gut feeling rather than talking things through. As a result, the judgment you've earned from hands-on experience runs deep. When emotions run high, step back and jot down your thoughts, or ask someone else how they see it.

ELEM_EARTH_STRONG.style_link: When Earth leads your chart, you naturally fall back on the 'Balancing' style, weighing things up and adjusting course when you feel unsettled.
ELEM_EARTH_STRONG.text: Strong Earth gives you sharp practical sense and the power to build real, visible results step by step. You make plans and see them through, and people trust you for it. Just watch that a growing checklist doesn't crowd out spontaneous fun.

ELEM_EARTH_WEAK.text: With little Earth in your chart, you've followed your passions, ideas, and feelings more than any set structure. That flexibility lets you adapt quickly when life shifts. Anchor yourself with simple routines like sleep, meals, and tidying up, and your mind and mood settle noticeably.

ELEM_FIRE_STRONG.style_link: If Fire is your strongest element, you reach for the 'Reaching out' style, making the first move when you feel unsettled.
ELEM_FIRE_STRONG.text: With strong Fire, your drive and passion shine: the moment you decide, you're already moving. New beginnings light you up, and your energy sets everyone around you in motion. The more Fire you carry, the more it pays to schedule rest on purpose. Put it on the calendar.

ELEM_FIRE_WEAK.text: When Fire runs low in your chart, you've moved things forward through consistency, careful thought, or empathy rather than spur-of-the-moment drive. That way of working is already a strength of its own. Is something waiting on your list? Start it today, even in a small way.

ELEM_WATER_STRONG.style_link: When Water is strongest, you gravitate toward the 'Accommodating' style, adjusting to the other person to keep the peace when you feel unsettled.
ELEM_WATER_STRONG.text: Strong Water gives you a gift for reading people and empathizing deeply. You sense the mood without a word being said, and you're often the first to offer comfort. Carrying everyone else's feelings wears you out fast, though, so guard some time alone to release what you've absorbed.

ELEM_WATER_WEAK.text: If your chart has little Water, you've handled life through action, logic, or practical sense rather than lingering in your feelings. That keeps you calm and centered even when things get tough. Every so often, check in with yourself ('How am I actually feeling right now?') and share the answer with someone you trust.

TR_JUPITER_ASC_CONJ.meaning_line: Jupiter lands on the point that shows the world who you are — your stage grows bigger
TR_JUPITER_ASC_CONJ.table_future: Introduce yourself in a whole new light.
TR_JUPITER_ASC_CONJ.table_past: You stood in front of people more often, and the way others saw you shifted.
TR_JUPITER_ASC_CONJ.text: As Jupiter crosses your Ascendant, the part of your chart that shows the world who you are, you carry yourself with new ease, and first impressions go your way. Step into a new group or a new role and let people see a different side of you.
TR_JUPITER_ASC_CONJ.title: Jupiter–Ascendant conjunction

TR_JUPITER_ASC_HARM.meaning_line: The planet of expansion smiles on your first-impression point — new people and new lessons lighten your mood
TR_JUPITER_ASC_HARM.table_future: Open the door to new places and new faces.
TR_JUPITER_ASC_HARM.table_past: Meeting someone new or picking up a quick new skill left you noticeably lighter.
TR_JUPITER_ASC_HARM.text: Jupiter makes a supportive angle to your Ascendant, the point tied to first impressions. People warm to you without you having to try, and new connections form easily. Sign up for a short class after work or chat with the new coworker: small moments like these keep you going longer than you'd expect.
TR_JUPITER_ASC_HARM.title: Jupiter–Ascendant trine/sextile (harmony)

TR_JUPITER_ASC_TENSE.meaning_line: Jupiter at a tense angle to your first-impression point — the urge to do more gets ahead of you
TR_JUPITER_ASC_TENSE.table_future: Protect what you already have instead of reaching for more.
TR_JUPITER_ASC_TENSE.table_past: Eager to show more of yourself, you took on several things and ended up a bit overwhelmed.
TR_JUPITER_ASC_TENSE.text: While Jupiter challenges your Ascendant, you keep adding plans and roles just to show more of yourself. Pick only one new thing, put the rest of your energy into tending what you already have, and you find your balance.
TR_JUPITER_ASC_TENSE.title: Jupiter–Ascendant square/opposition (tension)

TR_JUPITER_MARS_CONJ.meaning_line: Jupiter lands on the planet of drive — your energy and courage to act surge
TR_JUPITER_MARS_CONJ.table_future: Stop planning and finally start that challenge you've been putting off.
TR_JUPITER_MARS_CONJ.table_past: Your drive surged: you launched something new or finally pushed through a task you had put off.
TR_JUPITER_MARS_CONJ.text: Jupiter crosses your Mars, the planet of drive and action. You're itching to move forward, and ideas turn into action with ease. Channel this energy into one or two goals, and you'll have real results to show for it.
TR_JUPITER_MARS_CONJ.title: Jupiter–Mars conjunction

TR_JUPITER_MARS_HARM.meaning_line: The planet of expansion backs the planet of drive — your effort pays off readily
TR_JUPITER_MARS_HARM.table_future: Pick up the pace on what you've been steadily building.
TR_JUPITER_MARS_HARM.table_past: Your hard work paid off, and you had the stamina to keep at it.
TR_JUPITER_MARS_HARM.text: With Jupiter at an easy angle to your Mars, you get back what you put in, and your projects gather momentum. Start a new routine that gets you moving, like daily walks or workouts; it sticks easily now.
TR_JUPITER_MARS_HARM.title: Jupiter–Mars trine/sextile (harmony)

TR_JUPITER_MARS_TENSE.meaning_line: A tense angle between Jupiter and the planet of drive — enthusiasm pushes you past your limits
TR_JUPITER_MARS_TENSE.table_future: Figure out where to spend your energy and where to save it.
TR_JUPITER_MARS_TENSE.table_past: At times your enthusiasm made you overdo it or charge into conflict too fast.
TR_JUPITER_MARS_TENSE.text: Jupiter is at odds with your Mars. With energy to spare, you're tempted to juggle too much at once or push back hard when things get frustrating. Block out downtime at the end of each day first, and that energy lasts much longer.
TR_JUPITER_MARS_TENSE.title: Jupiter–Mars square/opposition (tension)

TR_JUPITER_MC_CONJ.meaning_line: The planet of expansion reaches the peak of your career — opportunities and recognition open up at work
TR_JUPITER_MC_CONJ.table_future: Aim your work goals one notch higher.
TR_JUPITER_MC_CONJ.table_past: New opportunities came your way at work, or your efforts finally got noticed.
TR_JUPITER_MC_CONJ.text: Jupiter crosses your Midheaven, the highest point of your chart and the area of work and career. Your efforts get noticed, and new roles and offers come knocking. When an opportunity shows up, check that it fits the direction you're already heading, then grab it.
TR_JUPITER_MC_CONJ.title: Jupiter–Midheaven conjunction

TR_JUPITER_MC_HARM.meaning_line: An easy angle from Jupiter supports your career direction — work moves along smoothly
TR_JUPITER_MC_HARM.table_future: Ask for help at work and team up with more people.
TR_JUPITER_MC_HARM.table_past: Work went smoothly, with helpful people in your corner.
TR_JUPITER_MC_HARM.text: With Jupiter at an easy angle to your Midheaven, work moves forward without you forcing it, and colleagues and higher-ups are ready to back you. Tell people which direction you want to go, and the right connections follow.
TR_JUPITER_MC_HARM.title: Jupiter–Midheaven trine/sextile (harmony)

TR_JUPITER_MC_TENSE.meaning_line: Jupiter clashes with your career direction — your work-life balance tips easily
TR_JUPITER_MC_TENSE.table_future: Scale your work goals to a realistic size.
TR_JUPITER_MC_TENSE.table_past: Your ambitions at work grew, and you felt pulled between work and home.
TR_JUPITER_MC_TENSE.text: When Jupiter clashes with your Midheaven, you set your sights on a bigger role and bigger results, but your work-life balance tips easily to one side. Even when a tempting opportunity arrives, ask whether your day-to-day life can truly carry it.
TR_JUPITER_MC_TENSE.title: Jupiter–Midheaven square/opposition (tension)

TR_JUPITER_MERCURY_CONJ.meaning_line: Jupiter joins the planet of thought and speech — suddenly you have so much to learn and say
TR_JUPITER_MERCURY_CONJ.table_future: Carve out time for learning, writing, and speaking your mind.
TR_JUPITER_MERCURY_CONJ.table_past: You learned new things, talked more, and ideas came thick and fast.
TR_JUPITER_MERCURY_CONJ.text: While Jupiter crosses your Mercury, the planet of thought and speech, your curiosity grows and your thoughts flow into words, spoken or written, with new ease. Pick up the studies or journaling you shelved, or finally have that long-overdue conversation.
TR_JUPITER_MERCURY_CONJ.title: Jupiter–Mercury conjunction

TR_JUPITER_MERCURY_HARM.meaning_line: The planet of expansion smooths the way for your thoughts and words — conversations flow and messages land
TR_JUPITER_MERCURY_HARM.table_future: Pitch your ideas, reach out, and put your thoughts in order before you speak.
TR_JUPITER_MERCURY_HARM.table_past: People were easy to reach, and finding folks on your wavelength made things go smoothly.
TR_JUPITER_MERCURY_HARM.text: Jupiter makes an easy angle to your Mercury, so your explanations come across clearly and the right information and people are easy to find. Send that pitch or message you've been sitting on.
TR_JUPITER_MERCURY_HARM.title: Jupiter–Mercury trine/sextile (harmony)

TR_JUPITER_MERCURY_TENSE.meaning_line: Jupiter at odds with the planet of thought and speech — your words and promises race ahead of you
TR_JUPITER_MERCURY_TENSE.table_future: Think it through before you speak, and promise a little less.
TR_JUPITER_MERCURY_TENSE.table_past: Your mind felt crowded, or you made promises that were tough to keep.
TR_JUPITER_MERCURY_TENSE.text: Ideas flow freely while Jupiter challenges your Mercury, but details slip past you and you're tempted to talk a bigger game than you can deliver. Read the fine print on contracts and schedules one more time.
TR_JUPITER_MERCURY_TENSE.title: Jupiter–Mercury square/opposition (tension)

TR_JUPITER_MOON_CONJ.meaning_line: Jupiter meets the planet of feelings — you feel more generous, and home feels cozier
TR_JUPITER_MOON_CONJ.table_future: Make your home, and your inner world, a little roomier and warmer.
TR_JUPITER_MOON_CONJ.table_past: You felt more generous, and you found comfort at home and with the people closest to you.
TR_JUPITER_MOON_CONJ.text: As Jupiter passes over your Moon, the planet of feelings, you have more emotional room, and you go easier on yourself and the people around you. Tidy your space or share a dinner with someone dear: these simple acts keep nourishing you long after the moment passes.
TR_JUPITER_MOON_CONJ.title: Jupiter–Moon conjunction

TR_JUPITER_MOON_HARM.meaning_line: Expansion flows gently toward the planet of feelings — your emotional cup refills on its own
TR_JUPITER_MOON_HARM.table_future: Bring one new habit into your days that puts you at ease.
TR_JUPITER_MOON_HARM.table_past: Your mood stayed steady, and small everyday joys showed up often.
TR_JUPITER_MOON_HARM.text: Jupiter lends your Moon a helping hand. Even when nothing big is happening, you feel replenished, and leaning on others comes more easily than usual. Turn this ease into a small routine, and it becomes a harbor to return to when life gets busy.
TR_JUPITER_MOON_HARM.title: Jupiter–Moon trine/sextile (harmony)

TR_JUPITER_MOON_TENSE.meaning_line: A tense angle between the planet of expansion and the planet of feelings — highs and hurts alike swell out of proportion
TR_JUPITER_MOON_TENSE.table_future: When feelings run high, sleep on big decisions.
TR_JUPITER_MOON_TENSE.table_past: Your mood rode big waves, or you said yes to more plans than usual simply because it felt right.
TR_JUPITER_MOON_TENSE.text: With Jupiter at a challenging angle to your Moon, good moods and hurt feelings both hit harder than usual, and you're tempted to overspend or overcommit on a whim. When emotions swell, give yourself a day before acting on them.
TR_JUPITER_MOON_TENSE.title: Jupiter–Moon square/opposition (tension)

TR_JUPITER_SUN_CONJ.meaning_line: Jupiter, the planet of expansion, lands right on your core — your urge to spread your wings grows stronger
TR_JUPITER_SUN_CONJ.table_future: Give the things that feel most like you room to grow bigger.
TR_JUPITER_SUN_CONJ.table_past: You stepped into the spotlight more often, and your confidence grew a notch.
TR_JUPITER_SUN_CONJ.text: Jupiter, the planet of expansion, sits right on your Sun, the core of who you are. Your self-belief swells, and the challenges you've been putting off suddenly feel within reach. At work and at home, you catch yourself saying ‘Let's do it’ more and more.
TR_JUPITER_SUN_CONJ.title: Jupiter–Sun conjunction

TR_JUPITER_SUN_HARM.meaning_line: An easy angle from the planet of expansion supports your core — things fall into place without a struggle
TR_JUPITER_SUN_HARM.table_future: Say an easy yes to the opportunities that drift your way.
TR_JUPITER_SUN_HARM.table_past: More than once, things clicked without much effort on your part.
TR_JUPITER_SUN_HARM.text: Jupiter forms an easy angle to your Sun, so help and opportunities find you when you simply show up as yourself. Lend an extra ear to the suggestions and introductions people offer you now.
TR_JUPITER_SUN_HARM.title: Jupiter–Sun trine/sextile (harmony)

TR_JUPITER_SUN_TENSE.meaning_line: Where the planet of expansion rubs against your core — your drive grows, and so does the pull toward overconfidence
TR_JUPITER_SUN_TENSE.table_future: From everything that tempts you, pick only the few things you truly want.
TR_JUPITER_SUN_TENSE.table_past: With so much you wanted to do, you took on more than you had planned.
TR_JUPITER_SUN_TENSE.text: Jupiter squares off with your Sun at a tense angle. Rising confidence and drive are good signs, but you're prone to promising more than you can deliver. Before you commit, ask yourself once, ‘Can I really see this through?’ That one question is enough.
TR_JUPITER_SUN_TENSE.title: Jupiter–Sun square/opposition (tension)

TR_JUPITER_VENUS_CONJ.meaning_line: The planet of expansion meets the planet of love and relationships — joy and warmth multiply
TR_JUPITER_VENUS_CONJ.table_future: Savor what you love, and show some love to the people you're grateful for.
TR_JUPITER_VENUS_CONJ.table_past: You had plenty to enjoy, and your relationships glowed warmer.
TR_JUPITER_VENUS_CONJ.text: Jupiter passes over your Venus, the planet of love and the things you enjoy. Your heart opens to beautiful things, fun gatherings, and kind people. Enjoy it fully, and keep one eye on the spending that creeps up when you're feeling good.
TR_JUPITER_VENUS_CONJ.title: Jupiter–Venus conjunction

TR_JUPITER_VENUS_HARM.meaning_line: An easy angle from Jupiter supports the planet of love and relationships — warmth flows through your connections
TR_JUPITER_VENUS_HARM.table_future: Treat yourself to something small, and bring extra warmth to your relationships.
TR_JUPITER_VENUS_HARM.table_past: Social plans felt easy, and little strokes of luck came your way.
TR_JUPITER_VENUS_HARM.text: Under Jupiter's supportive angle to your Venus, your warmth comes through easily and time with others flows smoothly. Reach out first to someone you've been grateful to; this is the perfect moment.
TR_JUPITER_VENUS_HARM.title: Jupiter–Venus trine/sextile (harmony)

TR_JUPITER_VENUS_TENSE.meaning_line: When the planet of expansion clashes with your sense of pleasure and money — a good mood tips easily into excess
TR_JUPITER_VENUS_TENSE.table_future: Hold on to your joy, and draw clear lines around spending and plans.
TR_JUPITER_VENUS_TENSE.table_past: As the fun grew, so did your spending or your calendar, and later you felt a bit stretched.
TR_JUPITER_VENUS_TENSE.text: When Jupiter rubs up against your Venus, the planet of pleasure and money, a great mood makes your list of things to buy and do balloon all at once. Keep the fun; just enjoy it within limits you set ahead of time, and you keep the good part with no regrets.
TR_JUPITER_VENUS_TENSE.title: Jupiter–Venus square/opposition (tension)

TR_NEPTUNE_ASC_CONJ.meaning_line: Neptune crosses your Ascendant — your presence takes on a softer air
TR_NEPTUNE_ASC_CONJ.table_future: Embrace your soft, unfiltered side as a new kind of charm.
TR_NEPTUNE_ASC_CONJ.table_past: People told you your presence had changed, and you weren't sure how to present yourself.
TR_NEPTUNE_ASC_CONJ.text: As Neptune crosses your Ascendant, you come across as gentle and a little mysterious. The flip side: you shift to match how others see you and lose track of your own center. Keep regular sleep and meal times; that steady rhythm keeps you grounded.
TR_NEPTUNE_ASC_CONJ.title: Neptune–Ascendant conjunction

TR_NEPTUNE_ASC_HARM.meaning_line: Neptune supports how you show up — your warmth comes through
TR_NEPTUNE_ASC_HARM.table_future: Use your empathy to help the people around you feel at ease.
TR_NEPTUNE_ASC_HARM.table_past: Even with people you'd just met, you came across as kind and easy to be around.
TR_NEPTUNE_ASC_HARM.text: With Neptune in a soft angle to your Ascendant, your knack for reading the room comes alive, no words needed. People open up to you more easily. Offer yourself that same warmth.
TR_NEPTUNE_ASC_HARM.title: Neptune–Ascendant trine/sextile (harmony)

TR_NEPTUNE_ASC_TENSE.meaning_line: Neptune blurs your Ascendant — your sense of self wavers
TR_NEPTUNE_ASC_TENSE.table_future: Redraw your boundaries by deciding what to say no to and what to say yes to.
TR_NEPTUNE_ASC_TENSE.table_past: Trying to meet others' expectations, you felt at times that you'd lost sight of who you really are.
TR_NEPTUNE_ASC_TENSE.text: Neptune clashes with your Ascendant, and other people's demands sweep you along until your boundaries blur. People misread you, or your intentions come across differently than you meant. Practice answering small requests with 'Let me think about it and get back to you'; it helps you find your edges again.
TR_NEPTUNE_ASC_TENSE.title: Neptune–Ascendant square/opposition (tension)

TR_NEPTUNE_MARS_CONJ.meaning_line: Neptune meets your Mars — it's harder to tell where your drive is headed
TR_NEPTUNE_MARS_CONJ.table_future: Reconnect your goals to why they matter, and build rest into your rhythm.
TR_NEPTUNE_MARS_CONJ.table_past: You wanted to give it your all but couldn't find the energy, or lost sight of what you were working toward.
TR_NEPTUNE_MARS_CONJ.text: With Neptune on your Mars, your drive feels muffled, as if wrapped in fog, and you tire more easily. Yet meaningful work and helping others energize you more than competition does. Block out rest in your schedule first, then pour your energy into the one thing that matters most.
TR_NEPTUNE_MARS_CONJ.title: Neptune–Mars conjunction

TR_NEPTUNE_MARS_HARM.meaning_line: Neptune inspires your Mars — your energy goes where your heart is
TR_NEPTUNE_MARS_HARM.table_future: Spend your energy on things that move you, like creative projects or volunteering.
TR_NEPTUNE_MARS_HARM.table_past: For a stretch, you threw yourself into meaningful work and never seemed to tire.
TR_NEPTUNE_MARS_HARM.text: Under a helpful Neptune–Mars angle, things flow when you follow your gut. Fluid movement, like dancing, swimming, or walking, suits you beautifully. Start from desire rather than duty: what calls to you now is what lasts.
TR_NEPTUNE_MARS_HARM.title: Neptune–Mars trine/sextile (harmony)

TR_NEPTUNE_MARS_TENSE.meaning_line: Neptune drains your Mars — your energy keeps running low
TR_NEPTUNE_MARS_TENSE.table_future: Narrow where your energy goes, and rebuild around what truly needs doing.
TR_NEPTUNE_MARS_TENSE.table_past: Your efforts didn't seem to show, which left you deflated, and your plans kept slipping back.
TR_NEPTUNE_MARS_TENSE.text: Neptune at odds with your Mars lets your energy leak away before you notice where your effort is going. Forcing your way through a murky situation only piles on fatigue. Keep your to-do list short and check off each item as you finish; that's how you gather your strength again.
TR_NEPTUNE_MARS_TENSE.title: Neptune–Mars square/opposition (tension)

TR_NEPTUNE_MC_CONJ.meaning_line: Neptune reaches your Midheaven — you start wanting your work to mean something
TR_NEPTUNE_MC_CONJ.table_future: Take small, practical steps toward work that's closer to your ideals.
TR_NEPTUNE_MC_CONJ.table_past: You found yourself wanting meaning from your work, more than money or results.
TR_NEPTUNE_MC_CONJ.text: Neptune reaches your Midheaven, and you ask more and more whether your work fits your ideals. Your interest drifts toward meaningful fields like the arts or caregiving. Goals blur easily now, so write down one thing you can do this month toward the work you dream of.
TR_NEPTUNE_MC_CONJ.title: Neptune–Midheaven conjunction

TR_NEPTUNE_MC_HARM.meaning_line: Neptune favors your career — your intuition and empathy become strengths at work
TR_NEPTUNE_MC_HARM.table_future: Try your hand at creative planning or roles that help people.
TR_NEPTUNE_MC_HARM.table_past: Your intuition and thoughtfulness stood out at work and earned you praise.
TR_NEPTUNE_MC_HARM.text: A helpful angle from Neptune to your Midheaven turns your sensitivity and imagination into your secret weapon at work. Your talent shines in planning, design, and anything that calls for reading people. Turn an idea in your head into something small you can actually show.
TR_NEPTUNE_MC_HARM.title: Neptune–Midheaven trine/sextile (harmony)

TR_NEPTUNE_MC_TENSE.meaning_line: Neptune clouds your career direction — your goals get lost in the fog
TR_NEPTUNE_MC_TENSE.table_future: When things turn murky, confirm roles and expectations in writing.
TR_NEPTUNE_MC_TENSE.table_past: Your goals at work, and the way you were judged, felt unclear, leaving you unsure where you were headed.
TR_NEPTUNE_MC_TENSE.text: Neptune at odds with your Midheaven leaves your role vague, and your work feels as if it goes unnoticed. Fuzzy promises and offers that sound great but lack substance tempt you, too. Make a habit of confirming terms and roles in writing; it's the most practical way to clear the fog right now.
TR_NEPTUNE_MC_TENSE.title: Neptune–Midheaven square/opposition (tension)

TR_NEPTUNE_MERCURY_CONJ.meaning_line: Neptune meets your Mercury — imagination gets ahead of logic
TR_NEPTUNE_MERCURY_CONJ.table_future: Channel your imagination into writing or art, and put anything important on paper.
TR_NEPTUNE_MERCURY_CONJ.table_past: Your imagination ran in overdrive, while focus slipped and small things escaped your mind.
TR_NEPTUNE_MERCURY_CONJ.text: Neptune meets your Mercury, so your words take on more feeling and your gift for storytelling grows. The flip side: details slip by and your message comes across as vague. Let your imagination run free in creative work, but get anything that must be exact, like plans, promises, or contracts, in writing.
TR_NEPTUNE_MERCURY_CONJ.title: Neptune–Mercury conjunction

TR_NEPTUNE_MERCURY_HARM.meaning_line: Neptune inspires your Mercury — your words carry a warm, persuasive touch
TR_NEPTUNE_MERCURY_HARM.table_future: Let your thoughts unfold through writing, journaling, and deep conversation.
TR_NEPTUNE_MERCURY_HARM.table_past: Your heartfelt words reached someone and truly landed.
TR_NEPTUNE_MERCURY_HARM.text: A helpful angle from Neptune to your Mercury lets intuition and logic work hand in hand. Your words carry real empathy, so even difficult conversations go down gently. Work through your thoughts in a journal or a short piece of writing, and unexpected inspiration follows.
TR_NEPTUNE_MERCURY_HARM.title: Neptune–Mercury trine/sextile (harmony)

TR_NEPTUNE_MERCURY_TENSE.meaning_line: Neptune clouds your Mercury — misunderstandings come easily
TR_NEPTUNE_MERCURY_TENSE.table_future: Double-check anything important, and ask right away when something isn't clear.
TR_NEPTUNE_MERCURY_TENSE.table_past: Crossed wires and fuzzy information made it hard to make up your mind at times.
TR_NEPTUNE_MERCURY_TENSE.text: Under a tense Neptune–Mercury angle, information arrives muddled, or your words land differently than you meant. Decisions keep getting postponed, and some days your head feels foggy. Ask about anything unclear on the spot, and save big decisions for the hours when your mind is sharpest.
TR_NEPTUNE_MERCURY_TENSE.title: Neptune–Mercury square/opposition (tension)

TR_NEPTUNE_MOON_CONJ.meaning_line: Neptune meets your Moon — the line between your feelings and other people's wears thin
TR_NEPTUNE_MOON_CONJ.table_future: Treasure your empathy, and guard some quiet downtime just for you.
TR_NEPTUNE_MOON_CONJ.table_past: Other people's feelings felt like your own, and a longing you couldn't explain crept in.
TR_NEPTUNE_MOON_CONJ.text: With Neptune on your Moon, you soak up the mood around you like a sponge. Your gift for empathy and comfort grows, yet your feelings and other people's blur together and leave you drained. Set aside regular time alone, and the waters inside you grow calm again.
TR_NEPTUNE_MOON_CONJ.title: Neptune–Moon conjunction

TR_NEPTUNE_MOON_HARM.meaning_line: Neptune soothes your Moon — feelings you've held tight start to soften
TR_NEPTUNE_MOON_HARM.table_future: Fill your days with what soothes your soul: music, open sky, unhurried rest.
TR_NEPTUNE_MOON_HARM.table_past: In a cozy space or beside the right person, feelings you'd held for ages melted away.
TR_NEPTUNE_MOON_HARM.text: Neptune forms a soft angle to your Moon, and feelings that hardened over time quietly melt. Ordinary moments, like gazing at the sea or playing a favorite song, bring deep comfort. Lean into dreams and imagination; this season welcomes them.
TR_NEPTUNE_MOON_HARM.title: Neptune–Moon trine/sextile (harmony)

TR_NEPTUNE_MOON_TENSE.meaning_line: Neptune fogs your Moon — the reasons behind your feelings hide from view
TR_NEPTUNE_MOON_TENSE.table_future: Name your hazy feelings and find firm emotional footing again.
TR_NEPTUNE_MOON_TENSE.table_past: Your mood sank for no clear reason, and things felt uncertain with someone you count on.
TR_NEPTUNE_MOON_TENSE.text: Neptune clashes with your Moon, bringing more days when you can't quite explain your mood. At home or in close relationships, expectations and reality drift apart and leave you feeling let down. Write your mood in a single word each day; that simple act gives foggy feelings their shape again.
TR_NEPTUNE_MOON_TENSE.title: Neptune–Moon square/opposition (tension)

TR_NEPTUNE_SUN_CONJ.meaning_line: Neptune, the planet of dreams, meets your Sun — your sense of who you are softens at the edges for a while
TR_NEPTUNE_SUN_CONJ.table_future: Don't rush for answers; follow what draws you in, one slow step at a time.
TR_NEPTUNE_SUN_CONJ.table_past: You weren't sure what you wanted, and your mind kept drifting somewhere far away.
TR_NEPTUNE_SUN_CONJ.text: Neptune, the planet of haze, sits on your Sun, and your goals drift into a fog while your confidence ebbs and flows. At the same time, what truly calls to you, like art, caregiving, or meaningful work, comes into sharper focus. Hold off on big conclusions: keep notes on what draws you and get reacquainted with yourself.
TR_NEPTUNE_SUN_CONJ.title: Neptune–Sun conjunction

TR_NEPTUNE_SUN_HARM.meaning_line: Neptune inspires your Sun — your sensitivity becomes a strength
TR_NEPTUNE_SUN_HARM.table_future: Put your imagination and empathy to work, in daily life and in creative projects.
TR_NEPTUNE_SUN_HARM.table_past: Music, writing, and other people's stories moved you more than usual.
TR_NEPTUNE_SUN_HARM.text: Neptune's gentle angle to your Sun fine-tunes your sensitivity and intuition. You find deep satisfaction in making something or helping someone. Jot down images and phrases as they come; they become rich material later.
TR_NEPTUNE_SUN_HARM.title: Neptune–Sun trine/sextile (harmony)

TR_NEPTUNE_SUN_TENSE.meaning_line: Neptune clouds your Sun — your sense of direction dims for a while
TR_NEPTUNE_SUN_TENSE.table_future: Weigh your ideals against reality and choose a goal you can truly keep.
TR_NEPTUNE_SUN_TENSE.table_past: Even while working hard, you felt adrift, and some hopes fell short and left you disappointed.
TR_NEPTUNE_SUN_TENSE.text: A tense angle from Neptune to your Sun hides what you're working toward, and that leaves you running on empty. Bending yourself to other people's expectations or vague ideals wears you out, too. Set one small, concrete goal; it keeps you on course through the fog.
TR_NEPTUNE_SUN_TENSE.title: Neptune–Sun square/opposition (tension)

TR_NEPTUNE_VENUS_CONJ.meaning_line: Neptune meets your Venus — you're drawn to beauty and ideals
TR_NEPTUNE_VENUS_CONJ.table_future: Pour your heart into what you love, while staying realistic.
TR_NEPTUNE_VENUS_CONJ.table_past: For a while, you put someone or something on a pedestal and fell hard.
TR_NEPTUNE_VENUS_CONJ.text: Neptune meets your Venus, and art, beautiful things, and romance draw you in deeply. You also see people and things as lovelier than they really are. Savor what you love, but take a second, clear-eyed look at anything involving money or commitments.
TR_NEPTUNE_VENUS_CONJ.title: Neptune–Venus conjunction

TR_NEPTUNE_VENUS_HARM.meaning_line: Neptune sweetens your Venus — affection flows easily
TR_NEPTUNE_VENUS_HARM.table_future: Let art, hobbies, and warm relationships widen the joy in your life.
TR_NEPTUNE_VENUS_HARM.table_past: Small kindnesses and beautiful things filled you with joy.
TR_NEPTUNE_VENUS_HARM.text: As Neptune makes a soft angle to your Venus, understanding and generosity flow naturally through your relationships. Galleries, music, and hands-on hobbies nourish your soul. Show someone close how you feel with a small gift or a handwritten note instead of words.
TR_NEPTUNE_VENUS_HARM.title: Neptune–Venus trine/sextile (harmony)

TR_NEPTUNE_VENUS_TENSE.meaning_line: Neptune clashes with your Venus — what you hope for and what you get don't line up
TR_NEPTUNE_VENUS_TENSE.table_future: Spell out clearly what you want, in your relationships and your spending.
TR_NEPTUNE_VENUS_TENSE.table_past: A relationship or choice you'd pinned your hopes on turned out differently, leaving you disappointed or confused.
TR_NEPTUNE_VENUS_TENSE.text: Neptune at odds with your Venus reveals gaps between what you hope for from someone and who they really are. Money slips through your fingers with your moods, and saying yes when you mean no costs you. Trade vague hopes for one clear sentence about what you want; it sharpens your standards in love and money alike.
TR_NEPTUNE_VENUS_TENSE.title: Neptune–Venus square/opposition (tension)

TR_PLUTO_ASC_CONJ.meaning_line: Pluto crosses your Ascendant — your presence grows deeper
TR_PLUTO_ASC_CONJ.table_future: Think deeply about the self you want to show, and grow into someone new.
TR_PLUTO_ASC_CONJ.table_past: Your look, and the way you carry yourself with people, changed in a big way.
TR_PLUTO_ASC_CONJ.text: As Pluto crosses your Ascendant, you make a strong, lasting impression, and your presence carries more weight. A long process begins in which the way you present yourself changes, like a snake shedding its skin. Give your new self time to grow, and a stronger you emerges.
TR_PLUTO_ASC_CONJ.title: Pluto–Ascendant conjunction

TR_PLUTO_ASC_HARM.meaning_line: Pluto supports how you show up — people find you deeply trustworthy
TR_PLUTO_ASC_HARM.table_future: Grow your influence calmly and keep building trust.
TR_PLUTO_ASC_HARM.table_past: Even without saying much, you came across as dependable and were trusted with important things.
TR_PLUTO_ASC_HARM.text: With Pluto in a helpful angle to your Ascendant, you give off a trustworthy air without even trying. Your calm stands out when things get tough, and people lean on you. Use that trust as a springboard: say clearly which role you want to take on.
TR_PLUTO_ASC_HARM.title: Pluto–Ascendant trine/sextile (harmony)

TR_PLUTO_ASC_TENSE.meaning_line: Pluto presses on your Ascendant — it's time to take off a mask that doesn't fit
TR_PLUTO_ASC_TENSE.table_future: Practice showing up as your real self, not a version made to please others.
TR_PLUTO_ASC_TENSE.table_past: At some point, you felt you couldn't keep going as the person you'd always been.
TR_PLUTO_ASC_TENSE.text: Pluto clashes with your Ascendant, and pressure from the people around you or friction in relationships makes it hard to keep being who you've been. Pushing yourself to hold it together throws your daily rhythm off, too. This pressure is helping you take off a mask that no longer fits, so protect your downtime first and let the real you come out little by little.
TR_PLUTO_ASC_TENSE.title: Pluto–Ascendant square/opposition (tension)

TR_PLUTO_MARS_CONJ.meaning_line: Pluto meets your Mars — a powerful will wakes up
TR_PLUTO_MARS_CONJ.table_future: Channel your stronger will into one long-term goal and go all in.
TR_PLUTO_MARS_CONJ.table_past: You pushed ahead with a strong will to see something all the way through.
TR_PLUTO_MARS_CONJ.text: Pluto sits on your Mars, and once you set your mind on something, you see it through. That drive helps you accomplish big things, but pushing nonstop without a break burns you out. The harder you go, the more you need recovery time built into your schedule.
TR_PLUTO_MARS_CONJ.title: Pluto–Mars conjunction

TR_PLUTO_MARS_HARM.meaning_line: Pluto backs your Mars — you gain grit and resilience
TR_PLUTO_MARS_HARM.table_future: Take on a long-haul challenge, or start changing a habit.
TR_PLUTO_MARS_HARM.table_past: You stuck with something you'd wanted to give up on and saw real results.
TR_PLUTO_MARS_HARM.text: With Pluto forming a helpful angle to your Mars, you gain both staying power and the ability to bounce back. Rebuild your workout routine, or break a big goal into a longer plan. Slow and steady effort now turns into visible change.
TR_PLUTO_MARS_HARM.title: Pluto–Mars trine/sextile (harmony)

TR_PLUTO_MARS_TENSE.meaning_line: Pluto clashes with your Mars — it's force against force
TR_PLUTO_MARS_TENSE.table_future: Take that clashing energy and redirect it into one thing you want to change.
TR_PLUTO_MARS_TENSE.table_past: You butted heads with someone over who was in charge, and swallowing your anger took real effort.
TR_PLUTO_MARS_TENSE.text: Pluto pushes hard against your Mars, so power struggles flare up and pent-up anger builds. The harder you push, the more pushback you get. Channel that intense energy into something you want to change, like a new workout or a long-overdue declutter, and the conflict becomes fuel for change.
TR_PLUTO_MARS_TENSE.title: Pluto–Mars square/opposition (tension)

TR_PLUTO_MC_CONJ.meaning_line: Pluto reaches your Midheaven — the whole game changes at work
TR_PLUTO_MC_CONJ.table_future: Rethink, from the ground up, the role you want to play in the world.
TR_PLUTO_MC_CONJ.table_past: One chapter of your work ended, and a completely different one began.
TR_PLUTO_MC_CONJ.text: Pluto reaches your Midheaven, and your work life closes one chapter and moves onto a whole new playing field. You may be handed bigger responsibilities or a more influential role, or you rethink your work from the ground up. Don't dwell on what's ending; put your energy into what you want to build next.
TR_PLUTO_MC_CONJ.title: Pluto–Midheaven conjunction

TR_PLUTO_MC_HARM.meaning_line: Pluto backs your career — your influence grows on solid ground
TR_PLUTO_MC_HARM.table_future: Deepen your expertise and let your influence grow.
TR_PLUTO_MC_HARM.table_past: Your skills won recognition at work, bringing you more authority or responsibility.
TR_PLUTO_MC_HARM.text: As Pluto forms a flowing angle to your Midheaven, the skills you've built over time turn into real influence. You shine in roles that restructure systems or solve tough problems. Set long-range career goals and work toward them one step at a time.
TR_PLUTO_MC_HARM.title: Pluto–Midheaven trine/sextile (harmony)

TR_PLUTO_MC_TENSE.meaning_line: Pluto challenges your career direction — the ground shifts under your work
TR_PLUTO_MC_TENSE.table_future: Read how the power is shifting, and get clear on what you value in your work and want to protect.
TR_PLUTO_MC_TENSE.table_past: Amid changes at work or tension with higher-ups, you rethought where you stand.
TR_PLUTO_MC_TENSE.text: Pluto at odds with your Midheaven sends changes beyond your control, like restructuring or power struggles, crashing into your work. The pressure feels hard to bear. Yet this transit also clears out old structures and moves you somewhere new, so first get clear on what you value in your work and want to protect.
TR_PLUTO_MC_TENSE.title: Pluto–Midheaven square/opposition (tension)

TR_PLUTO_MERCURY_CONJ.meaning_line: Pluto meets your Mercury — your mind grows deep and sharp
TR_PLUTO_MERCURY_CONJ.table_future: Rework the foundations of your thinking through deep study and exploration.
TR_PLUTO_MERCURY_CONJ.table_past: You dove deep into one idea, or felt a strong need to get to the truth.
TR_PLUTO_MERCURY_CONJ.text: Pluto sits on your Mercury, and you read between the lines with new precision. Throw yourself into research or serious study, but watch that you don't get stuck on one thought too long. When your mind circles, get it down on paper and clear your head with a walk.
TR_PLUTO_MERCURY_CONJ.title: Pluto–Mercury conjunction

TR_PLUTO_MERCURY_HARM.meaning_line: Pluto powers up your Mercury — your words carry weight and conviction
TR_PLUTO_MERCURY_HARM.table_future: Dive into serious study, or start that important conversation.
TR_PLUTO_MERCURY_HARM.table_past: One well-aimed comment from you turned a situation around.
TR_PLUTO_MERCURY_HARM.text: With Pluto in a supportive angle to your Mercury, insights that cut straight to the heart of a problem come easily. Your words, spoken or written, carry real power in persuasion and negotiation. Bring up that important conversation you've been putting off.
TR_PLUTO_MERCURY_HARM.title: Pluto–Mercury trine/sextile (harmony)

TR_PLUTO_MERCURY_TENSE.meaning_line: Pluto clashes with your Mercury — conversations can get heavy
TR_PLUTO_MERCURY_TENSE.table_future: Practice talking to understand, not to win.
TR_PLUTO_MERCURY_TENSE.table_past: Sharp words flew at times, and your thoughts got stuck in a rut that left you frustrated.
TR_PLUTO_MERCURY_TENSE.text: Under a tense Pluto–Mercury angle, words turn sharp, and a conversation meant to persuade becomes a power struggle. Worries run deep, and at times you struggle to get out of your own head. Before an important talk, write two lists, what you want to win and what you want to understand; it turns down the heat.
TR_PLUTO_MERCURY_TENSE.title: Pluto–Mercury square/opposition (tension)

TR_PLUTO_MOON_CONJ.meaning_line: Pluto meets your Moon — something deep inside you stirs
TR_PLUTO_MOON_CONJ.table_future: Bring old feelings into the open, sort through them, and rebuild your emotional foundation.
TR_PLUTO_MOON_CONJ.table_past: Feelings you'd buried long ago resurfaced, and your emotions felt unusually deep and heavy.
TR_PLUTO_MOON_CONJ.text: With Pluto on your Moon, emotions you thought you'd put behind you rise to the surface. Feelings tied to home and close relationships hit harder than usual. Write them down or talk them through with someone you trust, and a weight you've carried for years slowly lightens.
TR_PLUTO_MOON_CONJ.title: Pluto–Moon conjunction

TR_PLUTO_MOON_HARM.meaning_line: Pluto strengthens your Moon — your emotional life grows deeper and steadier
TR_PLUTO_MOON_HARM.table_future: Strengthen your emotional roots through honest, heartfelt talks.
TR_PLUTO_MOON_HARM.table_past: Opening up to someone close made the trust between you stronger.
TR_PLUTO_MOON_HARM.text: Pluto's supportive angle to your Moon gives you the strength to face your feelings instead of avoiding them. Quietly work through old emotional baggage, or build deeper bonds. A single honest conversation heals more than you'd expect.
TR_PLUTO_MOON_HARM.title: Pluto–Moon trine/sextile (harmony)

TR_PLUTO_MOON_TENSE.meaning_line: Pluto stirs up your Moon — emotional waves run higher
TR_PLUTO_MOON_TENSE.table_future: Rather than bottling up strong feelings, find safe ways to let them out.
TR_PLUTO_MOON_TENSE.table_past: You rode through big emotional ups and downs around close relationships or family.
TR_PLUTO_MOON_TENSE.text: Pluto clashes with your Moon, and the urge to control the people closest to you, or a sense of hurt, grows strong. Emotions arrive in bigger waves than usual. Before you react, move your body or pour it all onto paper, then talk; handled this way, this transit makes you a steadier navigator of your own feelings.
TR_PLUTO_MOON_TENSE.title: Pluto–Moon square/opposition (tension)

TR_PLUTO_SUN_CONJ.meaning_line: Pluto, the planet of rebirth, meets your Sun — it remakes you from the roots up
TR_PLUTO_SUN_CONJ.table_future: Let go of your old self and rise stronger; this long process is worth every step.
TR_PLUTO_SUN_CONJ.table_past: You moved through a change so deep it shook the very foundation of who you are.
TR_PLUTO_SUN_CONJ.text: Pluto sits on your Sun, and a change begins far below the surface, reshaping you from deep within. Roles and habits that no longer fit fall away on their own, revealing the strength hidden underneath. This transit moves slowly and powerfully, so don't rush: choose with care what you release.
TR_PLUTO_SUN_CONJ.title: Pluto–Sun conjunction

TR_PLUTO_SUN_HARM.meaning_line: Pluto backs your Sun — your inner strength grows steadfast
TR_PLUTO_SUN_HARM.table_future: Focus deeply and build your own influence, step by step.
TR_PLUTO_SUN_HARM.table_past: Getting through something hard showed you strength you didn't know you had.
TR_PLUTO_SUN_HARM.text: With Pluto in a supportive angle to your Sun, you gain the staying power to see long-held goals all the way through. No fanfare needed; confidence builds quietly from within. Dive deep into one field, or finally break an old habit.
TR_PLUTO_SUN_HARM.title: Pluto–Sun trine/sextile (harmony)

TR_PLUTO_SUN_TENSE.meaning_line: Pluto pressures your Sun — it asks you to drop the ways you've been getting by
TR_PLUTO_SUN_TENSE.table_future: Instead of fighting for control, find new strength in choosing what to release.
TR_PLUTO_SUN_TENSE.table_past: Faced with things beyond your control, you had to let go of the way you'd always done things.
TR_PLUTO_SUN_TENSE.text: A tense angle from Pluto to your Sun brings power struggles over authority or influence, or changes you simply can't avoid. The harder you hold on, the heavier it feels. This pressure clears out what no longer fits, and you come through it stronger than before.
TR_PLUTO_SUN_TENSE.title: Pluto–Sun square/opposition (tension)

TR_PLUTO_VENUS_CONJ.meaning_line: Pluto meets your Venus — your relationships and values change at a deep level
TR_PLUTO_VENUS_CONJ.table_future: Hold on to only what truly matters, and set new standards for your relationships and values.
TR_PLUTO_VENUS_CONJ.table_past: Your feelings about love, money, and the things you enjoy ran far stronger and deeper than before.
TR_PLUTO_VENUS_CONJ.text: Pluto sits on your Venus, and your feelings about what you love and what you want grow intense. You crave real depth over casual connection, and the way you see money and your own worth shifts, too. Don't let a powerful attraction sweep you away; ask whether you truly need it, and reset your standards from there.
TR_PLUTO_VENUS_CONJ.title: Pluto–Venus conjunction

TR_PLUTO_VENUS_HARM.meaning_line: Pluto deepens your Venus — close bonds grow stronger
TR_PLUTO_VENUS_HARM.table_future: Choose depth over breadth, and nurture the relationships and interests you hold dear.
TR_PLUTO_VENUS_HARM.table_past: A few of your relationships grew deeper and more trusting.
TR_PLUTO_VENUS_HARM.text: As Pluto makes a flowing angle to your Venus, your relationships grow more sincere and deep. Trusting your own worth, you get clear on how you spend your money and time. Invest more in the people and hobbies you want in your life for the long haul.
TR_PLUTO_VENUS_HARM.title: Pluto–Venus trine/sextile (harmony)

TR_PLUTO_VENUS_TENSE.meaning_line: Pluto clashes with your Venus — you're caught between holding on and letting go
TR_PLUTO_VENUS_TENSE.table_future: Take an honest look at what to hold on to and what to let go.
TR_PLUTO_VENUS_TENSE.table_past: In love or money, the part of you that couldn't let go clashed with the part that wanted to move on.
TR_PLUTO_VENUS_TENSE.text: Pluto at odds with your Venus stirs jealousy or controlling feelings in relationships, or turns money into a source of tension. The tighter you grip, the more suffocating it feels. This transit shows you what truly fulfills you, so when emotions run high, write things down before you decide anything.
TR_PLUTO_VENUS_TENSE.title: Pluto–Venus square/opposition (tension)

TR_SATURN_ASC_CONJ.meaning_line: Saturn lands on the point that shows the world who you are — you feel the weight of rebuilding yourself
TR_SATURN_ASC_CONJ.table_future: Decide, calmly and clearly, who you want to become.
TR_SATURN_ASC_CONJ.table_past: You grew noticeably more serious and mature, and tougher on yourself.
TR_SATURN_ASC_CONJ.text: As Saturn crosses your Ascendant, the point that shows the world who you are, your body and mind feel sluggish, and you hold yourself to stricter standards. Sort out your daily rhythm and the way you present yourself now, and you lay a lasting foundation for a new you.
TR_SATURN_ASC_CONJ.title: Saturn–Ascendant conjunction

TR_SATURN_ASC_HARM.meaning_line: The planet of responsibility backs your first-impression point — you come across as someone people can count on
TR_SATURN_ASC_HARM.table_future: Settle into solid routines and build trust.
TR_SATURN_ASC_HARM.table_past: People trusted you with more, and you came across as calm and steady.
TR_SATURN_ASC_HARM.text: Saturn makes a supportive angle to your Ascendant. Your words and actions come across as steady, and people readily trust and rely on you. Set regular rhythms for sleep and meals while Saturn supports you.
TR_SATURN_ASC_HARM.title: Saturn–Ascendant trine/sextile (harmony)

TR_SATURN_ASC_TENSE.meaning_line: A tense angle from Saturn to your first-impression point — other people's expectations press in on you
TR_SATURN_ASC_TENSE.table_future: Separate other people's expectations from your own standards.
TR_SATURN_ASC_TENSE.table_past: Bending to fit everyone's expectations and demands left you feeling small.
TR_SATURN_ASC_TENSE.text: When Saturn challenges your Ascendant, demands from relationships and work grow, and you have less room to simply be yourself. Working through this pressure teaches you how far to bend and where to draw the line, and that line keeps you on solid ground.
TR_SATURN_ASC_TENSE.title: Saturn–Ascendant square/opposition (tension)

TR_SATURN_MARS_CONJ.meaning_line: The planet of responsibility lands on the planet of action — it feels like driving with the brakes on
TR_SATURN_MARS_CONJ.table_future: Slow down and pour your energy into one thing.
TR_SATURN_MARS_CONJ.table_past: You were in a hurry, but things refused to move the way you wanted, and the frustration was real.
TR_SATURN_MARS_CONJ.text: Saturn crosses your Mars, the planet of drive and action. You want to get moving, but something keeps pumping the brakes, and frustration builds. The grit you develop now stays with you as the power to see things through without rushing.
TR_SATURN_MARS_CONJ.title: Saturn–Mars conjunction

TR_SATURN_MARS_HARM.meaning_line: Saturn's steady angle backs the planet of action — you spend your energy wisely and for the long run
TR_SATURN_MARS_HARM.table_future: Push your long-haul projects forward, right on plan.
TR_SATURN_MARS_HARM.table_past: Working methodically, you finally wrapped up something that had dragged on.
TR_SATURN_MARS_HARM.text: With Saturn at an easy angle to your Mars, you waste no energy and move steadily, just as you planned. At work or in your workouts, a little every day adds up to results you can see.
TR_SATURN_MARS_HARM.title: Saturn–Mars trine/sextile (harmony)

TR_SATURN_MARS_TENSE.meaning_line: When Saturn challenges the planet of action — frustration builds each time you hit a roadblock
TR_SATURN_MARS_TENSE.table_future: When anger flares, change tactics instead of pushing back on the spot.
TR_SATURN_MARS_TENSE.table_past: You kept hitting walls, and some days left you angry or completely drained.
TR_SATURN_MARS_TENSE.text: Saturn forms a challenging angle to your Mars. You feel stuck no matter how hard you try, and that frustration spills into anger or flatness. Try a different way of using your energy now, and you learn to keep moving forward without wearing yourself out.
TR_SATURN_MARS_TENSE.title: Saturn–Mars square/opposition (tension)

TR_SATURN_MC_CONJ.meaning_line: Saturn reaches the peak of your career — tests and rewards arrive together at work
TR_SATURN_MC_CONJ.table_future: Take a realistic look at your career path and redraw it.
TR_SATURN_MC_CONJ.table_past: Your responsibilities at work grew, or you carried the weight of having your work reviewed.
TR_SATURN_MC_CONJ.text: Saturn crosses your Midheaven, the peak of your chart and the area of work and career. You step into bigger responsibilities or see your track record under review. It feels heavy, but whatever you've built with steady effort now settles into a place that is truly yours.
TR_SATURN_MC_CONJ.title: Saturn–Midheaven conjunction

TR_SATURN_MC_HARM.meaning_line: The planet of responsibility supports your career direction — diligence builds your reputation
TR_SATURN_MC_HARM.table_future: Put steady time into long-term career goals.
TR_SATURN_MC_HARM.table_past: Your steady work earned you a good reputation and put your career on firmer footing.
TR_SATURN_MC_HARM.text: With Saturn at an easy angle to your Midheaven, your diligent work builds into a solid reputation, and you earn the trust of your organization and higher-ups. Set concrete goals that take time, like a certification or deeper experience.
TR_SATURN_MC_HARM.title: Saturn–Midheaven trine/sextile (harmony)

TR_SATURN_MC_TENSE.meaning_line: Saturn at a tense angle to your career direction — you feel the pressure and delays at work firsthand
TR_SATURN_MC_TENSE.table_future: Hold steady and check your foundations instead of chasing quick wins.
TR_SATURN_MC_TENSE.table_past: Work dragged on longer than expected, and you felt squeezed between your job and the rest of your life.
TR_SATURN_MC_TENSE.text: While Saturn challenges your Midheaven, results arrive late or your workplace asks more of you, and both work and life feel stretched thin. Fine-tune how you work and what you prioritize now, and you build a base that keeps you steady when the next opportunity comes.
TR_SATURN_MC_TENSE.title: Saturn–Midheaven square/opposition (tension)

TR_SATURN_MERCURY_CONJ.meaning_line: Saturn joins the planet of thought and speech — your words and decisions grow careful and weighty
TR_SATURN_MERCURY_CONJ.table_future: Get your thoughts down in writing and settle matters one at a time.
TR_SATURN_MERCURY_CONJ.table_past: You had a lot on your mind and said less, with plenty of paperwork and contracts to track.
TR_SATURN_MERCURY_CONJ.text: Saturn crosses your Mercury, the planet of thought and speech. Your mind feels heavy and words come slowly, but your judgment grows more careful. This is the ideal stretch for steadily finishing detail-heavy work like studying, paperwork, or contracts.
TR_SATURN_MERCURY_CONJ.title: Saturn–Mercury conjunction

TR_SATURN_MERCURY_HARM.meaning_line: The planet of responsibility steadies your thoughts and words — focus and organization come easily
TR_SATURN_MERCURY_HARM.table_future: Put your focus on things with staying power, like certifications, studies, or important documents.
TR_SATURN_MERCURY_HARM.table_past: Focused study or a systematic overhaul of your work brought real progress.
TR_SATURN_MERCURY_HARM.text: Saturn makes an easy angle to your Mercury. Your thoughts fall into place and your word carries weight, so you earn trust readily. Take a study you've put off, or a long-term plan, and break it into concrete steps.
TR_SATURN_MERCURY_HARM.title: Saturn–Mercury trine/sextile (harmony)

TR_SATURN_MERCURY_TENSE.meaning_line: A tense angle between Saturn and the planet of thought and speech — worries pile up and words get stuck
TR_SATURN_MERCURY_TENSE.table_future: Put important conversations and decisions in writing, and take things slowly.
TR_SATURN_MERCURY_TENSE.table_past: Crossed wires and paperwork holdups left you frustrated.
TR_SATURN_MERCURY_TENSE.text: While Saturn challenges your Mercury, one worry leads to another, and what you're trying to say doesn't quite get through. Build the habit of writing things down and double-checking now, and people learn they can count on your word.
TR_SATURN_MERCURY_TENSE.title: Saturn–Mercury square/opposition (tension)

TR_SATURN_MOON_CONJ.meaning_line: Saturn meets the planet of feelings — you feel weighed down, and you try to shoulder it all alone
TR_SATURN_MOON_CONJ.table_future: Line up real people and places to lean on instead of toughing it out alone.
TR_SATURN_MOON_CONJ.table_past: Many days you felt weighed down and kept it to yourself, while taking on more for your home and loved ones.
TR_SATURN_MOON_CONJ.text: Saturn passes over your Moon, the planet of feelings. Your mood dips easily, and you try to push through alone without letting anyone see you struggle. Moving through this heavy stretch shows you what truly makes you feel secure, and you discover your own ways of caring for your feelings.
TR_SATURN_MOON_CONJ.title: Saturn–Moon conjunction

TR_SATURN_MOON_HARM.meaning_line: Saturn's steady angle supports the planet of feelings — your emotions find solid ground
TR_SATURN_MOON_HARM.table_future: Firm up your daily rhythm and put your home in order.
TR_SATURN_MOON_HARM.table_past: You felt calmer, and daily life gradually found its footing.
TR_SATURN_MOON_HARM.text: With Saturn at a supportive angle to your Moon, your emotions stay even and you find comfort in the structure of everyday life. Set a few small routines, like a regular bedtime or a quick tidy-up, and they become a lasting source of stability.
TR_SATURN_MOON_HARM.title: Saturn–Moon trine/sextile (harmony)

TR_SATURN_MOON_TENSE.meaning_line: Where Saturn challenges the planet of feelings — you feel torn between duty and what you need emotionally
TR_SATURN_MOON_TENSE.table_future: Jot down what your feelings are telling you, and put rest on the calendar first.
TR_SATURN_MOON_TENSE.table_past: Caught between what you had to do and what you wanted, you felt worn out and lonely at times.
TR_SATURN_MOON_TENSE.text: When Saturn forms a challenging angle to your Moon, outside obligations clash with your inner needs: rest stops feeling restful, and small hurts pile up. Learn to face your feelings now instead of shelving them, and that skill becomes solid ground for whatever comes next.
TR_SATURN_MOON_TENSE.title: Saturn–Moon square/opposition (tension)

TR_SATURN_RETURN.meaning_line: Saturn comes back to where it was when you were born — time to rethink the structure of your life
TR_SATURN_RETURN.table_future: Decide which responsibilities to keep carrying and which burdens to put down.
TR_SATURN_RETURN.table_past: Facing the question of what you'd take responsibility for, you rebuilt your life's framework.
TR_SATURN_RETURN.text: Saturn returns to the spot it held when you were born. You ask whether the way your work, relationships, and daily life are set up still fits you, and the parts that don't start to feel heavy. Take stock and redefine your responsibilities as an adult: the direction you choose now becomes a framework that lasts.
TR_SATURN_RETURN.title: Saturn return

TR_SATURN_SUN_CONJ.meaning_line: Saturn, the planet of responsibility, presses on your core — you feel the full weight of your roles
TR_SATURN_SUN_CONJ.table_future: Sort out what truly needs doing and what you can let go of.
TR_SATURN_SUN_CONJ.table_past: Responsibilities piled up all at once and wore you down, and you often wondered, 'Am I doing okay?'
TR_SATURN_SUN_CONJ.text: Saturn, the planet of responsibility, sits on your Sun. Your roles feel heavy and fatigue builds, so you move slower than usual. Still, the priorities you set now become the backbone that carries you through the next few years.
TR_SATURN_SUN_CONJ.title: Saturn–Sun conjunction

TR_SATURN_SUN_HARM.meaning_line: The planet of responsibility steadies your core — consistent effort earns recognition
TR_SATURN_SUN_HARM.table_future: Make long-term plans and build on them step by step.
TR_SATURN_SUN_HARM.table_past: The work you kept at slowly earned recognition, and your place felt more secure.
TR_SATURN_SUN_HARM.text: Saturn forms a supportive angle to your Sun. It isn't flashy, but every bit of effort you invest turns into results. If you're beginning a study or plan with the long game in mind, lay its groundwork now.
TR_SATURN_SUN_HARM.title: Saturn–Sun trine/sextile (harmony)

TR_SATURN_SUN_TENSE.meaning_line: A tense angle between Saturn and your core — pressure puts your strength to the test
TR_SATURN_SUN_TENSE.table_future: Check your direction rather than your speed, and build your staying power.
TR_SATURN_SUN_TENSE.table_past: When things kept refusing to go your way, there were moments you doubted yourself.
TR_SATURN_SUN_TENSE.text: Saturn squares off with your Sun. Results lag behind your effort, or outside expectations clash with what you want. Working through this pressure shows you what's truly worth keeping and what you can release, and your faith in yourself grows steadfast.
TR_SATURN_SUN_TENSE.title: Saturn–Sun square/opposition (tension)

TR_SATURN_VENUS_CONJ.meaning_line: Saturn meets the planet of love and relationships — you take an honest look at relationships and money
TR_SATURN_VENUS_CONJ.table_future: Figure out which relationships and spending habits are worth keeping for the long haul.
TR_SATURN_VENUS_CONJ.table_past: You weighed relationships and money more practically, with a little less room for fun.
TR_SATURN_VENUS_CONJ.text: Saturn passes over your Venus, the planet of love and the things you enjoy. Duty comes before fun, and you take a serious look at your relationships and spending. This season clarifies what you truly value, so you pour more of yourself into the relationships that last.
TR_SATURN_VENUS_CONJ.title: Saturn–Venus conjunction

TR_SATURN_VENUS_HARM.meaning_line: The planet of responsibility steadies love and everyday life — relationships and finances settle into a calm groove
TR_SATURN_VENUS_HARM.table_future: Keep giving steady care to lasting relationships and healthy everyday habits.
TR_SATURN_VENUS_HARM.table_past: Relationships you can count on deepened, and you handled money with a calmer hand.
TR_SATURN_VENUS_HARM.text: Under Saturn's supportive angle to your Venus, relationships built on trust rather than flashy thrills, and planned purchases rather than impulse buys, feel just right. Show steady appreciation to the people who have stood by you for years.
TR_SATURN_VENUS_HARM.title: Saturn–Venus trine/sextile (harmony)

TR_SATURN_VENUS_TENSE.meaning_line: Saturn at odds with the planet of love and relationships — distance or disappointment creeps into your connections
TR_SATURN_VENUS_TENSE.table_future: Redefine your own standards for relationships and money.
TR_SATURN_VENUS_TENSE.table_past: You felt let down in a relationship, or had to hold off on things you wanted.
TR_SATURN_VENUS_TENSE.text: Saturn forms a challenging angle to your Venus. You feel you give more than you get back, or you have to postpone the things you enjoy. Out of that disappointment comes a clearer sense of what you need from relationships and spending, and those standards protect you.
TR_SATURN_VENUS_TENSE.title: Saturn–Venus square/opposition (tension)

TR_URANUS_ASC_CONJ.meaning_line: Uranus crosses your Ascendant — the way you come across is changing
TR_URANUS_ASC_CONJ.table_future: Try on a new version of yourself, no pressure attached.
TR_URANUS_ASC_CONJ.table_past: Your style, the way you speak, and how you treat people began to change.
TR_URANUS_ASC_CONJ.text: As Uranus crosses your Ascendant, the self you show the world changes, sometimes slowly and sometimes in ways everyone notices. Stepping into a new setting or role, you hear that your first impression has changed. Don't cling to who you were; follow what feels comfortable now.
TR_URANUS_ASC_CONJ.title: Uranus–Ascendant conjunction

TR_URANUS_ASC_HARM.meaning_line: Uranus supports how you show up — a new side of you emerges with ease
TR_URANUS_ASC_HARM.table_future: Welcome every chance to introduce yourself in new circles.
TR_URANUS_ASC_HARM.table_past: You showed a different side of yourself somewhere new, and people loved it.
TR_URANUS_ASC_HARM.text: Uranus's helpful angle to your Ascendant makes it far easier to be yourself, even in unfamiliar places. New coworkers or a new group spot a charm you didn't know you had. Go ahead with a small reinvention; people take to it easily.
TR_URANUS_ASC_HARM.title: Uranus–Ascendant trine/sextile (harmony)

TR_URANUS_ASC_TENSE.meaning_line: Uranus pushes against your Ascendant — your current self starts to feel like a bad fit
TR_URANUS_ASC_TENSE.table_future: Close the gap between who others expect you to be and who you want to be.
TR_URANUS_ASC_TENSE.table_past: Your familiar self started to feel awkward, and you grew suddenly self-conscious about how others saw you.
TR_URANUS_ASC_TENSE.text: Uranus pushes against your Ascendant, and the way you've always been starts to feel like clothes you've outgrown. As other people's expectations collide with who you want to be, your daily rhythm turns uneven. Change one thing at a time, not everything at once, and the awkwardness settles into a new you.
TR_URANUS_ASC_TENSE.title: Uranus–Ascendant square/opposition (tension)

TR_URANUS_MARS_CONJ.meaning_line: Uranus joins your Mars — a jolt of energy urges you to act now
TR_URANUS_MARS_CONJ.table_future: Pour this surge of drive into one new challenge, not ten.
TR_URANUS_MARS_CONJ.table_past: A sudden, powerful urge to start something new, or to quit something, took hold of you.
TR_URANUS_MARS_CONJ.text: With Uranus on your Mars, energy surges until sitting still feels impossible, and your decisions come faster. You find the nerve to launch a new project or walk away from something you've tolerated too long. Energy this strong scatters easily, so aim it at a single goal.
TR_URANUS_MARS_CONJ.title: Uranus–Mars conjunction

TR_URANUS_MARS_HARM.meaning_line: Uranus backs your drive — bold moves pay off
TR_URANUS_MARS_HARM.table_future: Dare to do things differently; that courage turns into real results now.
TR_URANUS_MARS_HARM.table_past: You took a leap you'd normally think twice about, and it worked out better than expected.
TR_URANUS_MARS_HARM.text: Uranus forms a supportive angle to your Mars, pairing the courage to try something new with the drive to follow through. Small innovations suit you now: mix up your workout, or reshuffle the order of your day. Take the first step on that challenge you've been putting off.
TR_URANUS_MARS_HARM.title: Uranus–Mars trine/sextile (harmony)

TR_URANUS_MARS_TENSE.meaning_line: Uranus clashes with your Mars — impatience runs high and sparks fly
TR_URANUS_MARS_TENSE.table_future: When the urge to rush hits, take a beat and check your direction.
TR_URANUS_MARS_TENSE.table_past: Your patience ran out at times, and you wanted to push back hard or scrap your plans entirely.
TR_URANUS_MARS_TENSE.text: Uranus squares off with your Mars, so frustration builds and then bursts all at once, and haste tangles things up. The same charge gives you the power to shake loose situations that have been stuck for ages. Before you act, move your body to burn off the restless energy, then make the call.
TR_URANUS_MARS_TENSE.title: Uranus–Mars square/opposition (tension)

TR_URANUS_MC_CONJ.meaning_line: Uranus reaches your Midheaven — a new path opens in your work life
TR_URANUS_MC_CONJ.table_future: Give a new field or a new way of working a serious look.
TR_URANUS_MC_CONJ.table_past: An unexpected offer or a shift in your role at work came your way.
TR_URANUS_MC_CONJ.text: Uranus reaches your Midheaven and brings an unexpected turning point to your career and public direction. It arrives as a sudden shake-up at work, or as an offer from a completely different field. Ask first how it connects to what you do now, and you make the change your own.
TR_URANUS_MC_CONJ.title: Uranus–Midheaven conjunction

TR_URANUS_MC_HARM.meaning_line: Uranus boosts your career — new roles open up smoothly
TR_URANUS_MC_HARM.table_future: Be the first to pitch a new role or a better way of working.
TR_URANUS_MC_HARM.table_past: Chances to take on a new project or a different role came to you naturally.
TR_URANUS_MC_HARM.text: A flowing angle from Uranus to your Midheaven means your new ideas at work land with little pushback. Learning a new skill or teaming up with another group widens your path. If there's something you've wanted to try, raise your hand now.
TR_URANUS_MC_HARM.title: Uranus–Midheaven trine/sextile (harmony)

TR_URANUS_MC_TENSE.meaning_line: Uranus challenges your career direction — you start questioning the path you're on
TR_URANUS_MC_TENSE.table_future: Before you change anything, sketch in detail what the work you want actually looks like.
TR_URANUS_MC_TENSE.table_past: Your career direction felt shaky, and the question of whether to stay in your current job grew louder.
TR_URANUS_MC_TENSE.text: Uranus at odds with your Midheaven brings reorganizations or sudden shifts at work that throw your direction off course. The urge to 'just change everything now' grows strong, too. This transit also delivers unexpected offers and new roles, so slow your decisions by a beat and weigh each opportunity with a clear head.
TR_URANUS_MC_TENSE.title: Uranus–Midheaven square/opposition (tension)

TR_URANUS_MERCURY_CONJ.meaning_line: Uranus meets the planet of thought — brilliant ideas pour in
TR_URANUS_MERCURY_CONJ.table_future: Stretch your thinking by embracing new knowledge and skills.
TR_URANUS_MERCURY_CONJ.table_past: Unexpected ideas and news kept rolling in, and your mind stayed busy.
TR_URANUS_MERCURY_CONJ.text: Uranus crosses your Mercury, the planet of thought and speech, so your mind speeds up and fresh ideas arrive easily. New studies, insights from other fields, or an unexpected message shift the way you think. Rather than blurting out every idea, jot them down; the good ones stand out more clearly.
TR_URANUS_MERCURY_CONJ.title: Uranus–Mercury conjunction

TR_URANUS_MERCURY_HARM.meaning_line: An easy angle from the planet of change sharpens your thinking — you spot new solutions to old problems
TR_URANUS_MERCURY_HARM.table_future: Shake up how you work a little, with new tools or new skills.
TR_URANUS_MERCURY_HARM.table_past: A surprising answer came to a problem you'd been stuck on, or welcome news arrived.
TR_URANUS_MERCURY_HARM.text: When Uranus makes a supportive angle to your Mercury, you see the same old problem from a brand-new angle. A conversation with someone new or a short class hands you the clue you need. Try a tool or method you don't normally use.
TR_URANUS_MERCURY_HARM.title: Uranus–Mercury trine/sextile (harmony)

TR_URANUS_MERCURY_TENSE.meaning_line: Uranus strains your words and thoughts — your mind races ahead of you
TR_URANUS_MERCURY_TENSE.table_future: Double-check and sort out your thoughts instead of jumping to conclusions.
TR_URANUS_MERCURY_TENSE.table_past: Some days rushed by in a blur of sudden plan changes and crossed wires.
TR_URANUS_MERCURY_TENSE.text: Uranus forms a challenging angle to your Mercury. Your head feels cluttered, last-minute schedule changes and miscommunications multiply, and with so much going on, words slip out before you've thought them through. Write down important points and decisions, then read them over: that is how you stay in step with this fast-moving season.
TR_URANUS_MERCURY_TENSE.title: Uranus–Mercury square/opposition (tension)

TR_URANUS_MOON_CONJ.meaning_line: The planet of change meets your emotional center — the things you leaned on emotionally begin to shift
TR_URANUS_MOON_CONJ.table_future: Within a new daily rhythm, define what stability means to you now.
TR_URANUS_MOON_CONJ.table_past: Something you leaned on emotionally, like your home or living situation, changed in ways you didn't see coming.
TR_URANUS_MOON_CONJ.text: When Uranus crosses your Moon, the planet of feelings, your moods swing wider, from easily excited to suddenly low. Changes that shift your emotional ground, like moving house or changing how you live, often arrive with this transit. Amid the unfamiliar, keep one small daily routine: it becomes your anchor.
TR_URANUS_MOON_CONJ.title: Uranus–Moon conjunction

TR_URANUS_MOON_HARM.meaning_line: Uranus gently awakens your feelings — you get room to breathe
TR_URANUS_MOON_HARM.table_future: Refresh your mood by switching up your space or habits a little.
TR_URANUS_MOON_HARM.table_past: Pent-up feelings finally found air, or a new space made you feel lighter.
TR_URANUS_MOON_HARM.text: As Uranus makes a supportive angle to your Moon, long-held emotions loosen on their own. Small changes, like rearranging your room or wandering an unfamiliar neighborhood, bring a surprisingly big refresh. Explore new ways to feel at ease; you find them easily now.
TR_URANUS_MOON_HARM.title: Uranus–Moon trine/sextile (harmony)

TR_URANUS_MOON_TENSE.meaning_line: A tense angle from the planet of change unsettles your feelings — your usual sense of security wobbles for a while
TR_URANUS_MOON_TENSE.table_future: Even while things feel unsettled, build safe places to return to, one by one.
TR_URANUS_MOON_TENSE.table_past: The places where you usually find rest, like home or close relationships, felt shaky for a while.
TR_URANUS_MOON_TENSE.text: With Uranus at a challenging angle to your Moon, unexpected changes pop up in your living situation or in how close you are to people. Some days you feel restless for no clear reason. That restlessness makes you question whether your usual ways of feeling secure still work, so set aside a deliberate time and place to rest.
TR_URANUS_MOON_TENSE.title: Uranus–Moon square/opposition (tension)

TR_URANUS_SUN_CONJ.meaning_line: Uranus, the planet of change, lands on your core — you're itching to break out of the familiar you
TR_URANUS_SUN_CONJ.table_future: Test-drive, in a small way, the 'true-to-you choice' you've put off for so long.
TR_URANUS_SUN_CONJ.table_past: The life you want suddenly snapped into focus, or the way things were started to feel stifling.
TR_URANUS_SUN_CONJ.text: When Uranus, the planet of change, crosses your Sun, you long to show a side of yourself you've never shown before. A sudden pull toward an unfamiliar field arrives, or an unexpected offer could land in your lap. Rather than changing everything at once, start with small experiments, and this shake-up carries you toward a new you.
TR_URANUS_SUN_CONJ.title: Uranus–Sun conjunction

TR_URANUS_SUN_HARM.meaning_line: An easy angle from the planet of change supports your core — new ventures open without a struggle
TR_URANUS_SUN_HARM.table_future: Say a casual yes to opportunities that come from outside your usual routine.
TR_URANUS_SUN_HARM.table_past: New work and new people gave you chances to express yourself more freely.
TR_URANUS_SUN_HARM.text: With Uranus at a supportive angle to your Sun, a fresh breeze blows into your life without much fuss. A new group, a different way of working, or a first-time hobby turns out to be a surprisingly good fit. Whatever you've been hesitating over, start it small, at a size that feels easy.
TR_URANUS_SUN_HARM.title: Uranus–Sun trine/sextile (harmony)

TR_URANUS_SUN_TENSE.meaning_line: Uranus puts pressure on your core — you start asking whether your current role still fits
TR_URANUS_SUN_TENSE.table_future: Tell a passing impulse from what you truly want, then choose what to change and what to keep.
TR_URANUS_SUN_TENSE.table_past: Your current position or role suddenly felt too small, and the urge to break free rose up.
TR_URANUS_SUN_TENSE.text: Uranus forms a challenging angle to your Sun, so plans change unexpectedly or your current role suddenly feels suffocating. That restlessness signals that what you want out of life has shifted. Instead of changing everything at once, write down what feels restrictive; what to change and what to keep comes into view.
TR_URANUS_SUN_TENSE.title: Uranus–Sun square/opposition (tension)

TR_URANUS_VENUS_CONJ.meaning_line: Uranus meets the planet of what you love — what draws you begins to change
TR_URANUS_VENUS_CONJ.table_future: Explore new tastes and new ways of loving with an open, curious heart.
TR_URANUS_VENUS_CONJ.table_past: Your tastes, and the way you approach love and money, shifted faster than you saw coming.
TR_URANUS_VENUS_CONJ.text: Uranus, the planet of change, lands on your Venus, and old favorites suddenly lose their spark while something completely different catches your eye. In love, too, you crave more freedom and honesty. Before you splurge or overhaul a relationship overnight, pause and ask what this new pull is telling you.
TR_URANUS_VENUS_CONJ.title: Uranus–Venus conjunction

TR_URANUS_VENUS_HARM.meaning_line: Uranus lights up love and pleasure — fresh delight flows into your days
TR_URANUS_VENUS_HARM.table_future: Bring a new activity into a familiar relationship and rekindle the spark.
TR_URANUS_VENUS_HARM.table_past: New people and new hobbies brought you joy you never saw coming.
TR_URANUS_VENUS_HARM.text: Uranus makes a friendly angle to your Venus, and fresh delight slips naturally into everyday life. A place you've never been, a new crowd, or a different look brightens your mood. Skip the usual routine and try something new with the people you love most.
TR_URANUS_VENUS_HARM.title: Uranus–Venus trine/sextile (harmony)

TR_URANUS_VENUS_TENSE.meaning_line: Uranus rattles your relationships and values — the closeness you want is changing
TR_URANUS_VENUS_TENSE.table_future: Find the closeness and balance you truly want, in love and with money.
TR_URANUS_VENUS_TENSE.table_past: A sudden ‘Is this really what I want?’ surfaced around your relationships or your spending.
TR_URANUS_VENUS_TENSE.text: A tense angle from Uranus to your Venus leaves you craving more breathing room, or feeling as if your heart has cooled overnight. Impulse buys creep in, too. This restlessness doesn't mean walk away; it means your needs for closeness and balance have changed, so sleep on any big decision for a day or two.
TR_URANUS_VENUS_TENSE.title: Uranus–Venus square/opposition (tension)

JUP_H01.caution: Riding high, you're tempted to say yes to too many plans at once. Take them on one at a time.
JUP_H01.keyword: A Year to Grow Into Yourself
JUP_H01.keyword_alt: A year your presence grows · A year to put yourself out there
JUP_H01.opportunity: When a chance to introduce yourself comes up, step forward. Don't put it off.
JUP_H01.table_line: You get more chances to show who you are, and your confidence grows with them.
JUP_H01.text: Jupiter, the planet of expansion, spends time in your self area. Introducing yourself first somewhere new, or finally sharing the plans you'd shelved, comes far more easily now. When the spotlight finds you, own it instead of shying away.

JUP_H02.caution: A thicker wallet can make you eager to spend more, so think twice before any big purchase.
JUP_H02.keyword: A Year to Grow Your Worth
JUP_H02.keyword_alt: A year your resources grow · A year you learn to make the most of what you have
JUP_H02.opportunity: When you see someone who could use your skills, offer them. No big pitch needed.
JUP_H02.table_line: Now you discover what your talents are really worth.
