JUP_H02.text: As the planet of expansion moves through your money & possessions area, it broadens your sense of what you have to offer. Charging what your skills and time are worth starts to feel natural, and it shows up as a side income or a fresh way to use one of your talents.

JUP_H03.caution: You'll be tempted to start five things at once. Pick the one you'll actually finish, and start there.
JUP_H03.keyword: A Year of Learning and Speaking Up
JUP_H03.keyword_alt: A year your learning branches out · A year good conversations carry you
JUP_H03.opportunity: When a short class or meetup catches your eye, drop in.
JUP_H03.table_line: Quick lessons and good talks with people close to you lift your spirits.
JUP_H03.text: With the planet of expansion in your learning & communication area, your curiosity is wide awake. A short course, some writing, or a chat with someone close opens bigger doors than you expect. Even everyday errands around the neighborhood bring you useful information.

JUP_H04.caution: Before any big decision about where you live, weigh the practical facts first, then check in with your gut.
JUP_H04.keyword: A Year to Widen Your Roots
JUP_H04.keyword_alt: A year your home life opens up · A year your safe place gets bigger
JUP_H04.opportunity: Choose one spot where you truly unwind, and give it some love.
JUP_H04.table_line: Home, family, and your safe spaces grow roomier and warmer.
JUP_H04.text: The planet of expansion moves into your home & roots area, giving you more room to rest and recharge. Fixing up your place or spending time with family leaves you feeling full and secure. With home on solid ground, you meet the outside world with far more ease.

JUP_H05.caution: Don't let fun swallow all your downtime. Even good times need a stopping point.
JUP_H05.keyword_alt: A year to make more room for what you love · A year to enjoy yourself fully
JUP_H05.opportunity: Take that hobby you've been putting off for ages and start it this time.
JUP_H05.table_line: You return to enjoying and making the things you love.
JUP_H05.text: This year the planet of expansion lights up your joy & creativity area. Picking up a hobby you'd put off, or making the thing you've been dreaming about, suddenly feels easy. With more to look forward to, notice what truly makes you smile.

JUP_H06.caution: Feeling capable, you're tempted to take on more than you should. Leave yourself room to say no.
JUP_H06.keyword: A Year to Tend Your Days
JUP_H06.keyword_alt: A year your days get steadier · A year your work and body find a better rhythm
JUP_H06.opportunity: Spot a tool or trick that lightens your load? Start using it right away.
JUP_H06.table_line: Your daily tasks and routines run much more smoothly.
JUP_H06.text: While the planet of expansion travels through your daily routines area, covering everyday work and how you care for your body, you gain momentum to rework how you do things or add a new routine. One small habit reshapes the whole rhythm of your day.

JUP_H07.caution: Don't overcommit just to keep the other person happy. Promise only what you can deliver.
JUP_H07.keyword_alt: A year you grow alongside the people next to you · A year to find a good partner
JUP_H07.opportunity: When someone suggests teaming up, look over the terms and start an easygoing conversation.
JUP_H07.table_line: Good colleagues and partners become a real source of support.
JUP_H07.text: The planet of expansion passes through your one-on-one relationships area. People to work with, and people you can trust for advice, step into your life. Share what you used to carry alone, and new paths open up.

JUP_H08.caution: With shared money or agreements, put the terms in writing, especially while everyone's getting along.
JUP_H08.keyword_alt: A year of deeper trust · A year to build more together
JUP_H08.opportunity: When someone offers you a favor, accept with gratitude instead of waving it off.
JUP_H08.table_line: Open up to people you trust, and let help flow both ways.
JUP_H08.text: Jupiter, the planet of expansion, settles into your deep bonds area, which covers shared resources too. You find someone you can truly open up to, or help arrives from an unexpected place. The more you release what you've been holding on your own, the more replenished you feel.

JUP_H09.caution: When the big picture runs away with you, bring it back to one first step you can take today.
JUP_H09.keyword_alt: A year your world gets bigger · A year learning takes you far
JUP_H09.opportunity: If there's a place you've always wanted to go or a subject you've longed to learn, put a date on the calendar.
JUP_H09.table_line: Travel and deeper study broaden your horizons.
JUP_H09.text: The planet of expansion lights up your higher learning & travel area. You feel more open to exploring somewhere new or committing to a subject you'll study for years. Conversations with people who see things differently stretch your own point of view, too.

JUP_H10.caution: When opportunities pour in, don't grab them all. Start with the ones that fit where you're headed.
JUP_H10.keyword_alt: A year you step onto a bigger stage at work · A year your hard work gets noticed
JUP_H10.opportunity: If there's a role you've had your eye on, raise your hand first this time.
JUP_H10.table_line: Your work earns recognition, and new roles come within reach.
JUP_H10.text: Jupiter, the planet of expansion, spends time in your career area, where your public role lives. Your past work finally gets noticed, and new offers start to arrive. Speak up in meetings and show what you've done: people respond well.

JUP_H11.caution: As your social calendar fills, block off solo rest days first.
JUP_H11.keyword_alt: A year good people gather around you · A year you find goals to share
JUP_H11.opportunity: If there's a group or community you've been curious about, show up once and see.
JUP_H11.table_line: Good people and groups help carry you toward your future goals.
JUP_H11.text: With the planet of expansion moving through your community & future area, like-minded groups and new connections clear a path to your next goal. Share a plan you've been keeping to yourself, and someone steps up to help.

JUP_H12.caution: Don't let rest drift on until your to-dos blur. Keep at least one small deadline on the books.
JUP_H12.keyword: A Year to Fill Up From Within
JUP_H12.keyword_alt: A year rest refills you · A year to look after yourself
JUP_H12.opportunity: Set aside a little quiet time each day just for you, and guard it.
JUP_H12.table_line: Rest and recharge on the inside rather than chasing outer results.
JUP_H12.text: With the planet of expansion in your rest & inner life area, you enter a quieter season. Little shows on the outside, but inside, you're sorting through your feelings and preparing for what comes next. Solo walks or time with a journal comfort you more than you expect.

SAT_H01.caution: You don't have to prove everything single-handedly. Break your tasks into small pieces and check them off one by one.
SAT_H01.keyword_alt: A year to stand on firmer ground · A year to set your own standards
SAT_H01.opportunity: When this season is behind you, you stand on your own terms instead of living up to other people's expectations.
SAT_H01.table_line: Rethink how you show up and what you're willing to take on.
SAT_H01.text: Saturn, the planet of responsibility, moves into your self area and asks, 'Who do I want to be?' You take on more, and some days you feel the weight in body and mind. Meet it head-on: this is your chance to drop what doesn't fit and grow into a stronger, steadier you.

SAT_H02.caution: Don't try to overhaul everything at once. Start by tracking your spending for a single month.
SAT_H02.keyword: A Year to Build Your Financial Base
SAT_H02.keyword_alt: A year to define what's worth it to you · A year to put your finances on solid ground
SAT_H02.opportunity: What you walk away with: money habits that hold steady even when life gets shaky.
SAT_H02.table_line: Take an honest look at your spending habits and your own worth.
SAT_H02.text: The planet of responsibility passes through your money & possessions area. You keep a closer eye on what comes in and goes out, and money feels tighter for a while. In return, you get crystal clear about where your money and time truly belong.

SAT_H03.caution: Don't wait until you feel perfectly ready. Set a small daily amount and chip away at it.
SAT_H03.keyword: A Year to Ground Your Words and Learning
SAT_H03.keyword_alt: A year to choose your words with care · A year to keep building what you know
SAT_H03.opportunity: When this transit ends, you hold solid knowledge and a voice people trust.
SAT_H03.table_line: Your words and studies carry more weight, so the details matter.
SAT_H03.text: With the planet of responsibility in your learning & communication area, you face work that builds step by step, like studying for a certification or handling paperwork. Every word feels weighty at times, and that's exactly how you learn to organize your thoughts and say them clearly.

SAT_H04.caution: Don't shoulder all the home and family work alone. Talk it out and agree on who handles what.
SAT_H04.keyword: A Year to Strengthen Your Roots
SAT_H04.keyword_alt: A year to make your home and inner life more secure · A year to build a place to come home to
SAT_H04.opportunity: On the other side of this, you have a home base where you can truly relax.
SAT_H04.table_line: You shoulder more at home and with family as you shore up the foundations of your life.
SAT_H04.text: As Saturn, the planet of responsibility, enters your home & roots area, the basics of your life call for attention: a move, chores, or caring for family. It feels like a lot, and you're laying a foundation that serves you for years. Trust the work.

SAT_H05.caution: Keep joy from turning into homework. Aim to keep going, not to be great at it.
SAT_H05.keyword: A Year to Go Deeper With What You Love
SAT_H05.keyword_alt: A year to go all in on what you love · A year to put real effort into your joy
SAT_H05.opportunity: The payoff: a hobby or project you've stuck with becomes something that's truly your own.
SAT_H05.table_line: Commitment matters more than fun now, and your passions run deeper.
SAT_H05.text: The planet of responsibility moves through your joy & creativity area. Even pastimes you once did just for fun start to take effort and lose some sparkle. Choose one thing you truly love and keep polishing it, and this season turns it into real skill.

SAT_H06.caution: When you're worn out, don't just push harder. Schedule one real break into each day first.
SAT_H06.keyword_alt: A year to give your days some structure · A year to find a steady rhythm for work and body
SAT_H06.opportunity: By the end of this stretch, you own routines that hold up even on your busiest days.
SAT_H06.table_line: Reset your daily schedule and how you look after your body.
SAT_H06.text: While the planet of responsibility stays in your daily routines area, covering everyday work and caring for your body, your workload grows and fatigue piles up fast, pushing you to rethink how you do things. Sort out sleep, meals, and breaks one at a time, and you build a rhythm you can sustain.

SAT_H07.caution: Don't let hurt feelings stack up. Calmly name what you'd like, one thing at a time.
SAT_H07.keyword_alt: A year to get clear on what you promise each other · A year to grow closer and steadier with your people
SAT_H07.opportunity: Once you're through this, you have relationships you can count on, where everyone knows their part.
SAT_H07.table_line: Take a fresh look at the promises and responsibilities in your close relationships.
SAT_H07.text: The planet of responsibility travels through your one-on-one relationships area. Agreements with colleagues or partners, and what each of you expects, come into sharp focus. Bring up the awkward topics: that's how the ground rules between you become clear.

SAT_H08.caution: Don't try to untangle it all in one go. List everything and work through it item by item.
SAT_H08.keyword: A Year to Set Ground Rules for Sharing
SAT_H08.keyword_alt: A year to sort out your deepest ties · A year to set ground rules for what you share
SAT_H08.opportunity: When this season wraps up, you know exactly what you share, and with whom.
SAT_H08.table_line: Sort out shared money and the ground rules of your closest bonds.
SAT_H08.text: Saturn, the planet of responsibility, settles into your deep bonds area, which also covers shared resources. Tangled joint matters, like loans, insurance, or shared bills, call for sorting out. Deep, personal talks get harder to brush aside, and your trust in each other grows sturdier for it.

SAT_H09.caution: Don't rush to an answer. Pick one field and keep digging into it.
SAT_H09.keyword: A Year to Ground Your Beliefs
SAT_H09.keyword_alt: A year to firm up what you think · A year to see your studies through
SAT_H09.opportunity: After this transit, you carry a sense of direction that other people's opinions can't easily knock off course.
SAT_H09.table_line: Deepen your studies and beliefs, and settle on a direction.
SAT_H09.text: The planet of responsibility moves through your higher learning & travel area, where your beliefs live too. Learning that takes time, like a long course of study or a certification program, takes on more weight. You spend a while asking what you believe and where you're headed, and the answers become a map you use for years.

SAT_H10.caution: You can't meet every expectation. Write down the few priorities you truly need to protect.
SAT_H10.keyword: A Year to Secure Your Place
SAT_H10.keyword_alt: A year to solidify your place at work · A year your responsibilities grow
SAT_H10.opportunity: When this season is done, you stand on solid footing at work, with the trust that comes with it.
SAT_H10.table_line: Your responsibilities at work grow, and your track record gets a closer look.
SAT_H10.text: With the planet of responsibility entering your career area, where your public role lives, your role grows heavier and you take stock of what you've achieved so far. Some days feel like a lot, but you're steadily building the kind of skill that earns recognition.

SAT_H11.caution: You don't have to keep up with every group. Narrow your energy down to a few that matter.
SAT_H11.keyword: A Year to Choose Your People
SAT_H11.keyword_alt: A year to narrow your circle · A year to learn who's in it for the long haul
SAT_H11.opportunity: What stays with you afterward: people who stick around and goals you can actually reach.
SAT_H11.table_line: Get realistic about your friendships and your goals for the future.
SAT_H11.text: The planet of responsibility passes through your community & future area. You take on more roles in your groups, or you start asking which relationships truly suit you. Right now, depth beats breadth in friendship, and concrete goals beat vague ones.

SAT_H12.caution: Don't tough it out alone. Find one person to confide in, or one place to write it all down.
SAT_H12.keyword_alt: A year to tidy up inside · A year to quietly gather your strength
SAT_H12.opportunity: Once it's over, you hold a clean slate and the freedom to begin again, lighter than before.
SAT_H12.table_line: Sort things out behind the scenes, and rest.
SAT_H12.text: With the planet of responsibility in your rest & inner life area, you enter a quiet season. Instead of visible results, you spend your time working through feelings and tasks you've set aside. It feels stifling at times, but you're clearing space for your next fresh start.

EDGE_LOW_HIGH.edge_en: On the edge of a Steady Year
EDGE_LOW_HIGH.edge_line: Your year sits right on the borderline. Know which months feel heavier and prepare for them, and you move through it much like a Steady Year. Gather a few small attempts for the stretches when supportive currents arrive.
EDGE_LOW_HIGH.line: You landed on a Building Year, but the heavy currents only barely outweigh the supportive ones. Doors may take time to open, and you are far from stuck.

EDGE_MID_LOW.condition_en: Steady · just above the Building Year line
EDGE_MID_LOW.edge_en: On the edge of a Building Year
EDGE_MID_LOW.edge_line: A year like this tips slightly either way. Lighten your load during the heavier stretches, and the supportive currents take the lead more easily.
EDGE_MID_LOW.line: Supportive and heavy currents are almost evenly matched this year. You landed on a Steady Year, but you're close to the line, so plan wisely for the heavier side too.

EDGE_UP_CLEAR.condition_en: Steady · just below the Open Year line · nothing blocking
EDGE_UP_CLEAR.edge_line: Your year sits right on the borderline. It falls a hair short, yet it has every chance of opening up. Keep building on what you laid down in the years before, and you enjoy it much like an Open Year.
EDGE_UP_CLEAR.line: Only supportive currents flow through your year, with nothing blocking your way. You land just shy of the Open Year line, so don't think of this as a low year for a moment.

EDGE_UP_MIXED.condition_en: Steady · just below the Open Year line · some blocks too
EDGE_UP_MIXED.edge_line: Your year sits right on the borderline, so once you move through the heavier stretches, it still opens up fully. Mark the months when supportive currents arrive, and save your energy for them.
EDGE_UP_MIXED.line: Supportive currents clearly outweigh the heavy ones this year. The margin falls just short of the Open Year line, which is the only reason you landed on a Steady Year.

TEASE_S6_HEAD.text: On the other hand, {역풍해} is closer to a year for slowing down and strengthening your foundation.

TEASE_S6_NOHEAD.text: The other years have no strong blocking currents, so the choices you make along the way tend to shape the outcome.

TEASE_S6_OPEN.text: Within {열리는해}, that flow tends to become clearer from around {열리는달}.

BRIDGE_27_01.text: The stability you've been hoping for comes most within reach around {{흐름근거}}. Until then, choose one thing in your home or daily rhythm that you won't let slide. Something small you can keep even on busy days, like a set bedtime or a weekly grocery run, is all it takes. Once it's in place, you have a steady harbor to return to, whatever the new year brings.

BRIDGE_27_02.text: Look to {{흐름근거}} as your window to step toward the leap. To be ready by then, polish one piece of your current work that you can show. The more tangible, the better: a one-page portfolio, a short proposal, or a note describing a role you'd love to try. Fortune favors the prepared, and when the door opens, you walk right through.

BRIDGE_27_03.text: Around {{흐름근거}}, you have the perfect timing to tend your tired mind and body. Until then, block off some open time between your commitments. Keep it small: leave one evening a week free, or put your phone away an hour before bed. Once rest becomes a habit, the year's tides carry you even further toward recovery.

BRIDGE_27_04.text: When {{흐름근거}} comes around, express your feelings and share your warmth freely. Before then, get clear on how much closeness feels right and what you want from a relationship. Practice telling someone, in a few words, about a moment you were grateful for, or gently raise something that hurt within a day. The clearer you are about how you care for yourself, the more easily you welcome the people coming into your life.

BRIDGE_27_05.text: Around {{흐름근거}}, you click easily with like-minded people. In the meantime, pour a little more care into the relationships you already have. Reach out to someone you haven't talked to in a while, or sign up for a group that sparks your interest. Open the door even a crack, and good connections find their way in that year.

BRIDGE_27_06.text: Once {{흐름근거}} rolls around, slow down and catch your breath. Before then, take stock of what you can drop and what you truly need to keep. Cross one thing that can wait off this week's to-do list, and put something you love in its place. Leave some room open, and you savor every bit of the breathing room that year brings.

BRIDGE_27_07.text: Around {{흐름근거}}, you're perfectly placed to start a new routine and make it stick. Until then, ease your basic rhythms on track, like sleep and mealtimes. Pick one easy habit, like a glass of water first thing in the morning or a ten-minute walk after lunch, and do it at the same time every day. Once a small routine sticks, the year's momentum carries you toward healthier days.

BRIDGE_27_08.text: The period around {{흐름근거}} is your window to tighten up how you spend and save. Before then, look at where your money goes each month. Go through your automatic payments and subscriptions and cancel one you don't use, or set your monthly living budget as one clear number. The clearer your rules, the more easily you build firmer financial footing that year.

BRIDGE_27_09.text: Around {{흐름근거}}, let the work you've been building shine. In the meantime, keep a steady record of what you've accomplished. Once a week, jot down three lines about something you wrapped up well and how it turned out, and keep them handy. As that record grows, you show what you can do with real confidence when an opportunity arrives.

BRIDGE_27_10.text: When {{흐름근거}} arrives, choose a way of working and living that's truly yours. Before then, notice when you feel most like yourself. At the end of each day, write down the moment you felt most at ease and the moment you had to push hardest. As those notes add up, you make that year's choices by your own standards, not anyone else's.

BRIDGE_27_11.text: Around {{흐름근거}}, act on the fresh start you've been holding close. Until then, narrow what you want to begin down to just one thing. Choose something you'd like to learn, a place you'd like to go, or something you'd like to try, and write down the tiniest first step. With that step mapped out, you set off lightly the moment the door opens.

BRIDGE_5Y_01.text: Look at the next five years through your wish for stability, and {{바라던해}} is when it comes closest. The years leading up to it are for strengthening the foundations of daily life, one piece at a time: home, work, and the people close to you. This year, pick one thing that tends to wobble, like living costs, sleep, or keeping in touch, and set a ground rule for it. Stability built on a foundation like that stands firm.

BRIDGE_5Y_02.text: Over the next five years, your biggest leap lines up with {{바라던해}}. Use the years before it to steadily gather skills, work you can show, and people to go forward with. Come away from each year with one piece of work you're proud to share. The more you have ready when the door opens, the farther you jump.

BRIDGE_5Y_03.text: Viewed through your wish for recovery, the next five years flow most gently in {{바라던해}}. Until then, focus less on big breaks and more on weaving rest into your everyday life. Choose one rhythm you can keep, like a set bedtime or a regular day off, and build on it a little each year. Those rest habits make your recovery that year deeper and longer-lasting.

BRIDGE_5Y_04.text: Within the next five years, love comes closest in {{바라던해}}. The years before then are for learning how to cherish yourself and what you truly want in a relationship. Keep up small practices: put your feelings into words, and gently bring up what bothers you. A ready heart welcomes the right people in with ease.

BRIDGE_5Y_05.text: Through the lens of your wish for good people, {{바라던해}} is the year you click with kindred spirits most easily. The years before it are for nurturing the relationships you have now and discovering who you feel at ease with. Each year, pick one new group to join and one person to reconnect with, opening the door a little at a time. The relationships you nurture become a place where good people want to stay.

BRIDGE_5Y_06.text: Over the next five years, breathing room comes closest in {{바라던해}}. The years before it are for sorting out, bit by bit, what to release and what to keep. Each year, pick one thing to stop doing and one new thing to enjoy. The more space you clear, the more fully you savor the breathing room that year brings.

BRIDGE_5Y_07.text: Seen through your wish for healthy routines, {{바라던해}} is when that rhythm settles in most easily. The years leading up to it are for making easy habits second nature, one at a time. Choose one rhythm to refine each year, like sleep this year and meals the next. Habits built slowly are the ones that last, and they carry you steadily through that year.

BRIDGE_5Y_08.text: Through the lens of financial ease, {{바라던해}} is the year you build firmer financial footing most easily. The years before it are for setting your own rules for spending and saving. Review where your money goes once a month, and each year, pick one fixed expense to trim. The clearer your rules become, the lighter the choices that strengthen your footing feel that year.

BRIDGE_5Y_09.text: Of the next five years, recognition comes closest in {{바라던해}}. Use the years before it to build your skills and keep track of what you've achieved. Each year, pick three accomplishments and sum them up on a single page. When an opportunity comes, that record will speak for you.

BRIDGE_5Y_10.text: Look at the next five years through your wish to be yourself, and {{바라던해}} is when it comes closest. The years before it are for gathering small choices made on your own terms. Each year, pick one thing to do because your heart says so, not because others expect it. Those choices become the strength you draw on to choose a path that's truly yours that year.

BRIDGE_5Y_11.text: In the next five years, a fresh start comes closest in {{바라던해}}. The years before it are for narrowing down what you want to begin and getting ready for it. Each year, pick one thing to learn and one small thing to try, and dip a toe in early. The more prepared you are, the lighter that first step feels, and the farther it carries you.

BLUR_S4_01.text: {닉네임}, from now until the end of the year, guard your work and your words with extra care.

BLUR_S4_02.text: You chose Work & career as your main concern, and every signal in your chart points to that same corner of your life.

BLUR_S4_03.text: Slow your decisions by one beat: hold off on changing jobs, signing contracts or making big purchases until mid-month, even if your mind feels made up. If you reach the same conclusion after that, you can still move in plenty of time.

BLUR_S4_04.text: Check your words and records twice: emails, schedules and work instructions get crossed easily right now. Reread before you hit send, and clear up any misunderstanding quickly with a short message.

BLUR_S4_05.text: Spend your energy wisely: with fatigue piling up, a good mood can tempt you to add plans and spending all at once. Don't try to finish everything alone; end the year with one less task and one less commitment than usual.

BLUR_S4_06.text: Around then, Jupiter forms a supportive angle to your Ascendant. Jupiter is moving through your area of learning, communication and the people close to you, so help arrives through a nearby colleague, a friend or a short course rather than a stranger out of nowhere. A coworker hears you mention a problem and introduces exactly the right person, or a talk you happen to catch gives you a method you can use at work the next day. This is practical, hands-on help, and it opens when you ask and reach out first. So don't sit alone with your questions; asking one more time is enough.

BLUR_S5_01.text: {닉네임}, your keyword for that year is 'Putting down roots in what you've built.'

BLUR_S5_02.text: For you, wishing for Stability, that year is a Steady Year. Your chart doesn't tilt hard in either direction, so what you keep doing becomes exactly what you get. Around then, Saturn, the planet of responsibility, passes over your Mercury, which rules your home and daily life, so everyday matters carry extra weight. At the same time, Jupiter supports that Mercury, and until then Jupiter travels through your home, family and roots.

BLUR_S5_03.text: That year is also a Moving Year. That doesn't mean moving around again and again; it means one change unfolds step by step. In one month Uranus, the planet of change, touches your career point (Midheaven), and in another it touches your Moon, so the same change reaches your work and then your home life. With an Aries Sun and strong Fire, change is familiar ground for you. When an unexpected offer or new role arrives, check first how it connects to what you already do.

BLUR_S5_04.text: So in that year, build steadily on what you have rather than starting something brand new. Mars goes retrograde through your home area in the first half, so take your time with big decisions about moving house or changing jobs. If you do move or decide, the most natural time is after Jupiter enters your home and daily-life area, and when Jupiter meets your Moon, the work you've carried starts to feel like your own place. In one month Neptune overlaps Mars, the planet of action, and your drive or direction blurs for a while, so treat it as a month for tidying up, not launching.

BLUR_S5_05.text: Your Sun, Mercury and Mars gathered in Aries make speed your strength. While Saturn passes through, though, direction matters more than speed.

BLUR_S5_06.text: {닉네임}, leaning on others takes a lot of energy for you, and when it does, you reach out first (Leaning on others × Reaching out). That makes leaning on others both your most draining capacity and the one your chart supports most in the second half of that year. Asking the people close to you for one specific kind of help at a time is your fastest path to stability.

BLUR_S6_01.text: {닉네임}, your Open Year for Stability is that year.

BLUR_S6_02.text: The first half of that year is your preparation stretch. Around then, Saturn leaves Aries and lifts a weight you've carried for more than two years. Saturn then forms a supportive angle to your Moon, and emotional steadiness settles in. Until then, Jupiter stays in your home and daily-life area and widens your foundation, and a second Saturn–Moon trine/sextile locks that stability in.

BLUR_S6_03.text: The other four years are all Steady Years. One of them comes close to an Open Year. In one month Saturn, and in another Jupiter, supports your Moon, and nothing stands in your way. The support falls just shy of the Open Year line, so there is no reason to see it as a low year.

BLUR_S6_04.text: Years like this sit right on the borderline. They fall a little short, yet they have every chance to open up, so simply keeping the home, routines and people you built that year lets you enjoy it much like an Open Year. One year carries both emotional weight and support. Two others are Moving Years, and for you, at home with change, they open a new stage.

BLUR_S6_05.text: That year, stability doesn't land in your hands right away; instead, you feel more weight on your mind. In two months Saturn forms a tense angle to your Moon, and obligations crowd out emotional breathing room. Still, in two other months Jupiter supports your natal Saturn, and the structure of your responsibilities actually becomes easier to organize.

BLUR_S6_06.text: In one month Saturn enters your Ascendant sign (Gemini) and sets new homework in how you present yourself. This is less a weight blocking your stability and more a movement in your life. With the home, routines and people you built in those two years beside you, this year's weight is one you can share.

BLUR_S6_07.text: These five years begin with your thirties check-in (Saturn return) and end with Uranus reaching your Ascendant, the start of a 'new you.' Stability opens wide once, in one year, and in the others it grows sturdier the more you keep at it. Change and stability aren't opposites; what you start in a Moving Year becomes the root of the year after.

BLUR_S7_01.text: {닉네임}, the question the stars have for you is 'What will you keep carrying?'

BLUR_S7_02.text: That year, your Saturn return asked you once what you would take responsibility for, and until early in the next year Saturn passes over your Sun and piles on more. Then Saturn returns to your self area and asks about the weight of your load again. On top of that, an Aries Sun that takes things on first and finishes fast, paired with a Virgo Moon that only relaxes once everything is checked, makes it easy to add burdens and hard to set them down. So the question that matters most now isn't what to add, but what to keep carrying.

BLUR_S7_03.text: Of everything you took responsibility for this year, what do you want to keep carrying next year, and what do you want to set down?

BLUR_S7_04.text: {닉네임}, what scene feels like 'stable' to you? Is it closer to your bank balance, an ordinary evening, or someone you can trust?

BLUR_S7_05.text: Who do you reach out to first when things get hard? How much have you told them about how you've been lately?

BLUR_S7_06.text: Let a decision note sit for a day: when a big decision comes to mind, don't act right away. Write it down, then reread it a day or a week later. It's practice in putting a little distance between you and the 'right now' feeling. If you still feel the same, that decision deserves your trust.

BLUR_S7_07.text: Choose two people to lean on, and ask specifically: as someone who reaches out first, you look for people when things are hard, but when work gets busy, contact is the first thing to drop. Pick two people you can talk to, and instead of 'Help me,' ask with a time and a topic: 'Could you listen for a few minutes on Friday?' The more specific the ask, the easier it is for them to say yes.

BLUR_S7_08.text: Once a week, tidy one corner of your space: for a Virgo Moon, an orderly view is the fastest way to feel steady. One desk drawer or one bag, something you can finish in a few minutes, is enough. The feeling of looking at a freshly tidied spot connects to the 'putting down roots' of the second half of that year.

GREET_DEFAULT.text: Hi {닉네임}, I'm Sowella AI, SSOL's wellness coach 🌙 I've read your star report closely. You carry the light of {태양별자리}, {닉네임}, and I'd love to hear how you've been feeling these days. Pick one line from the report that tugged at you and bring it here. We'll start from there, at your pace.

GREET_HEAD.text: {닉네임}, I'm Sowella AI, SSOL's wellness coach, and I'm glad you came 🌙 Your report called this a year for laying groundwork rather than reaching {바람} right away. First, tell me how that landed for you. If it felt heavy, say so. I'm here for that, too.

GREET_LASTDAY.text: {닉네임}, your 3-day Sowella AI pass ends today ✨ Did you try any of the small steps from your report? If not, that's completely fine. Let's pick one thing you can keep doing on your own.

GREET_NOTIME.text: Hi {닉네임}, I'm Sowella AI, SSOL's wellness coach ✨ Even without your birth time, the stars had plenty to tell. Which part of your report made you think, “That's so me”? Let's begin there.

GREET_OPEN.text: Hey {닉네임}, I'm Sowella AI, SSOL's wellness coach, and I'm so glad you're here! Your report says doors open wide for {바람} in 2027 ✨ Did that feel exciting, or almost too good to be true? Let's sketch out together how you want to walk through that door.

GREET_QUESTION.text: Welcome, {닉네임}. I'm Sowella AI, SSOL's wellness coach ✨ Remember the question the stars left you with at the end of your report? “{질문1}” Turn it over with me today, or bring up something else entirely. Where do you want to start?

GREET_RETURN.text: {닉네임}, welcome back 🌙 Last time we talked about “{지난대화요약}.” How have you been feeling since then? Pick up where we left off, or bring something new.

GREET_SOFT.text: {닉네임}, I'm Sowella AI, SSOL's wellness coach, and I'm glad you're here. You chose ‘{단어}’ for this year, and that word has stayed with me. You don't need to decide anything today. Start with whatever weighs on you most right now 🌙

PL_JUPITER_AQUARIUS.short_line: Your luck kicks in when you try something new with like-minded people.
PL_JUPITER_AQUARIUS.text: Ideas that go against the grain are exactly what bring opportunities your way, so speak up. Kicking off a small project with people you met in an online community suits you well. Caring about what's good for everyone fuels your growth.

PL_JUPITER_ARIES.short_line: Doors of opportunity open when you have the courage to go first.
PL_JUPITER_ARIES.text: When you finally take the first step on something you've been putting off, unexpected opportunities follow. Volunteer for the task no one else wanted, and a new connection finds you. When your enthusiasm gives other people courage, your own world grows bigger too.

PL_JUPITER_CANCER.short_line: Good fortune flows to you wherever you share and care for others.
PL_JUPITER_CANCER.text: Kindness you show someone comes back to you down the road. Picture sharing home cooking with a neighbor and ending up looking out for each other for years. You grow the most in places where you truly belong.

PL_JUPITER_CAPRICORN.short_line: Your luck turns rock solid as you work steadily toward realistic goals.
PL_JUPITER_CAPRICORN.text: Opportunities come your way less through one big lucky break than through skills built step by step. Picture a certification you prepared for patiently opening the door to a new role one day. You keep your word, and people repay it with trust, which is its own kind of luck.

PL_JUPITER_GEMINI.short_line: Every time you learn, ask, or connect, more doors open for you.
PL_JUPITER_GEMINI.text: The more people you chat with, the more chances come your way. A talk you happen to catch points you toward your next path. Share what you know freely; that's how your luck multiplies.

PL_JUPITER_LEO.short_line: Opportunities find you when you confidently show the world who you are.
PL_JUPITER_LEO.text: The more openly you share what you love, the more people rally behind you. Imagine a little project you posted just for fun turning into an unexpected offer. Cheer others on in their moments to shine, and your generosity runs deeper still.

PL_JUPITER_LIBRA.short_line: Teaming up with good people is how your luck grows.
PL_JUPITER_LIBRA.text: Things fall into place when you collaborate and find common ground instead of struggling alone. A new venture can begin with someone you met through a friend. In relationships built on mutual respect, you grow more open and generous too.

PL_JUPITER_PISCES.short_line: Things go your way when you trust your kindness and your gut.
PL_JUPITER_PISCES.text: Good things come when you follow your heart instead of calculating. A small kindness you offered expecting nothing returns to you as welcome news. Rest and let your mind go quiet; that's where new inspiration grows.

PL_JUPITER_SAGITTARIUS.short_line: Luck opens wide for you when you set out toward a bigger world.
PL_JUPITER_SAGITTARIUS.text: New learning and unfamiliar experiences open paths you never expected. A conversation on a last-minute trip plants the seed for your next goal. Your optimism, and the joy with which you share what you believe in, brightens everyone around you.

PL_JUPITER_SCORPIO.short_line: Your luck deepens when you go all the way in and share closely with others.
PL_JUPITER_SCORPIO.text: When you explore one field all the way down, you find opportunities others miss. Joining forces with someone you've trusted for years suits you beautifully. The insight you earn by getting through hard times becomes a way to help others.

PL_JUPITER_TAURUS.short_line: Your luck grows as the things you've built slowly begin to pay off.
PL_JUPITER_TAURUS.text: Good fortune grows from what you nurture patiently rather than rush. Opportunities show up in familiar places, like surprising good news at a spot where you've been a regular for years. Share generously, and your life grows richer still.

PL_JUPITER_VIRGO.short_line: Luck finds you as you tend the small things with care.
PL_JUPITER_VIRGO.text: When you take care with even the behind-the-scenes tasks, trust builds and opportunities follow. Notes you helped a coworker organize become a stepping stone to something big. Your generosity shows up as practical, hands-on help.

PL_MARS_AQUARIUS.short_line: You get a surge of energy when you're heading in a direction you believe in.
PL_MARS_AQUARIUS.text: You're most motivated when you do things your way, not the way someone else laid out. While everyone sticks to the familiar road, you're the one testing a new method. When you're angry, you explain it with logic rather than feelings, so name what actually hurt and let your words land.

PL_MARS_ARIES.short_line: Once you want something, you're already moving before you've finished the thought.
PL_MARS_ARIES.text: The rush of beginning is your best fuel. Decide to get in shape, and you're lacing up your sneakers that same evening. Your anger flares fast and blows over just as fast.

PL_MARS_CANCER.short_line: You're at your strongest when you're protecting the people and places you love.
PL_MARS_CANCER.text: You find more drive acting for the people you care about than for yourself alone. When a friend is in trouble, you're the first one at their door. Hurt feelings tend to stay bottled up, so voice them early, even in just a few words.

PL_MARS_CAPRICORN.short_line: Once you set a goal, you climb toward it steadily, one rung at a time.
PL_MARS_CAPRICORN.text: You stay motivated longest when you keep your eye on the long-term payoff rather than your mood of the moment. While others take the weekend off, you quietly finish what you planned. Even when angry, you keep a cool head and look for a solution first.

PL_MARS_GEMINI.short_line: Curiosity and good conversation fire you up.
PL_MARS_GEMINI.text: Bouncing between several projects energizes you more than sticking with one. Trade ideas with someone for a while, and you've already sketched out a plan. When you're upset, your words rush out, so take a beat first and let your point land.

PL_MARS_LEO.short_line: Your wish to be seen and appreciated burns as a fiery drive.
PL_MARS_LEO.text: When your work has a chance to shine, you throw in twice the energy. In group projects, you naturally step up front and rally everyone. A bruised ego makes your temper flare, but you warm up and let it go just as quickly.

PL_MARS_LIBRA.short_line: Your drive kicks in when you're in sync with the people around you.
PL_MARS_LIBRA.text: You'd rather move forward by talking things through with someone than by pushing ahead alone. When conflict arises, you read the room and wait for the right moment instead of confronting it head-on. Voice the frustrations you've been holding in, calmly and sooner rather than later, and both you and the relationship breathe easier.

PL_MARS_PISCES.short_line: When something truly moves you, you find a deep, quiet strength.
PL_MARS_PISCES.text: You stay absorbed far longer in work you believe in than in anything you have to force yourself through. When you're helping someone, hours pass before you notice you're tired. You tend to swallow your anger, so write it down or let it drift away with music.

PL_MARS_SAGITTARIUS.short_line: The promise of wider horizons is what gets you going.
PL_MARS_SAGITTARIUS.text: A meaningful goal or a new adventure puts a spring in your step. When a plan starts to take shape, you're already looking up flights. Even when you're angry, you don't stew; you say what's on your mind and move on.

PL_MARS_SCORPIO.short_line: On the surface you look calm, but underneath, your willpower burns deep and never quits.
PL_MARS_SCORPIO.text: Once you've set your sights on a goal, you rarely let go; you see it through to the very end. Working quietly on something for ages and then one day simply pulling it off is classic you. Anger lingers with you, so talk to someone you trust or work it off through exercise.

PL_MARS_TAURUS.short_line: You're slow to get started, but once you're moving, there's no stopping you.
PL_MARS_TAURUS.text: You stay motivated longest at a steady pace, not a sprint. When others burn out and quit, you're still there, quietly plugging away. You're slow to anger, so let frustrations out little by little before they pile up; it takes a real weight off.

PL_MARS_VIRGO.short_line: Nothing motivates you like the chance to get something exactly right.
PL_MARS_VIRGO.text: A clear to-do list gets you moving far faster than a fuzzy goal. You need a tidy desk before you can truly focus. Rather than blowing up, your irritation slips out first as a small critical comment.

PL_MERCURY_AQUARIUS.short_line: Your original mind flips ideas around to find the angles others overlook.
PL_MERCURY_AQUARIUS.text: You're the one asking, "Does it really have to be done this way?" When everyone else reaches for the usual method, you go hunting for a new tool or a different route. Your thinking runs clearest when you follow logic and principle rather than feeling.

PL_MERCURY_ARIES.short_line: Your mind is quick and candid: the moment a thought sparks, it's out of your mouth.
PL_MERCURY_ARIES.text: You lead with the bottom line and fill in the reasons later. When a good idea strikes mid-meeting, your hand shoots up before you've even thought it through. Keep conversations short and direct; that's where you're sharpest.

PL_MERCURY_CANCER.short_line: Feelings, memories, and the mood in the room shape how you think and speak.
PL_MERCURY_CANCER.text: Long after the exact words fade, you remember the look on someone's face and the feeling in the air. You're the friend who recalls a worry shared months ago and quietly checks in. Around people who feel safe, your words flow freely.

PL_MERCURY_CAPRICORN.short_line: Step by step, your mind builds ideas that hold up in the real world.
PL_MERCURY_CAPRICORN.text: Before you speak up, you check one more time that an idea is realistic. When a meeting goes in circles, you're the one who wraps it up with, "Okay, who's doing what, and by when?" Whatever you take the time to learn becomes a solid, lasting asset.

PL_MERCURY_GEMINI.short_line: You link ideas at lightning speed and put them into words with ease.
PL_MERCURY_GEMINI.text: You keep up easily when a conversation jumps around, and you spot links between completely different stories in a flash. Juggling several chats at once without missing a reply is second nature. Learning is its own reward for you, so dive into new subjects without a second thought.

PL_MERCURY_LEO.short_line: You turn ideas into stories and bring them vividly to life.
PL_MERCURY_LEO.text: Even familiar material grabs attention when you tell it your way, with your own flair. Building a presentation, you picture a scene before you ever reach for a spreadsheet. Get going on a topic you believe in, and your voice carries naturally.

PL_MERCURY_LIBRA.short_line: Before you speak, you weigh every side and choose your words with care.
PL_MERCURY_LIBRA.text: Rather than jumping to conclusions after hearing one side, you want the other person's story too. When two friends clash, you're the one who calmly lays out both points of view. Even your tone shows how much you consider the people you're talking to.

PL_MERCURY_PISCES.short_line: Sensitive and intuitive, your mind grasps things through feelings and images before the words arrive.
PL_MERCURY_PISCES.text: Long before you can explain something logically, you simply sense it. A stuck idea comes loose while you're out walking with music in your ears. Jot those passing thoughts down; what feels hazy now becomes real inspiration.

PL_MERCURY_SAGITTARIUS.short_line: You see the big picture and what it means long before you get to the details.
PL_MERCURY_SAGITTARIUS.text: Instead of picking apart every detail, your first question is, "So where is this going?" Flip through a travel guide, and you skip the itinerary for stories about the people who live there. Your frank, upbeat way of talking lifts the energy in any room.

PL_MERCURY_SCORPIO.short_line: Deep and sharp, your mind is always reading between the lines.
PL_MERCURY_SCORPIO.text: Once something sparks your curiosity, you skip the surface and dig until you reach the bottom of it. In conversation, you sense what someone leaves unsaid and gently ask about it. You don't waste words, so when you speak, people listen.

PL_MERCURY_TAURUS.short_line: You think things over at your own steady pace, and once an idea clicks, it stays with you for good.
PL_MERCURY_TAURUS.text: When you hear something new, you'd rather mull it over than answer on the spot. You're the type who reads the whole manual before switching anything on. You can look slow to decide, but once you've made up your mind, you rarely waver.

PL_MERCURY_VIRGO.short_line: Your mind catches the subtle differences and files every thought neatly in its place.
PL_MERCURY_VIRGO.text: Hand you a jumble of information, and you put it in order and spot what's missing. You're the first to catch a typo or a scheduling gap everyone else missed. Over time, that eye for detail earns you a reputation as someone people can count on.

PL_SATURN_AQUARIUS.short_line: You shape your own principles while staying part of a community.
PL_SATURN_AQUARIUS.text: You're learning to stay true to yourself in a group while still pulling your weight. You're often the one who sets a group's ground rules or builds systems that last. Over time, people come to see you as clear-headed and dependable.

PL_SATURN_ARIES.short_line: Learning to stick with what you start is what makes you strong.
PL_SATURN_ARIES.text: Your challenge is carrying that burst of starting energy all the way to the finish line. Rein in the urge to rush and see just one thing through; real confidence follows. Over time, you learn to wield courage and patience together.

PL_SATURN_CANCER.short_line: Creating your own safe place to land makes you stronger over time.
PL_SATURN_CANCER.text: In close relationships where people lean on each other, you feel the weight of responsibility. Lovingly set up even one room where you can truly unwind; it means more than you'd expect. Over time, you learn to care for yourself as much as you care for others.

PL_SATURN_CAPRICORN.short_line: You prove yourself through what you've built, year after year.
PL_SATURN_CAPRICORN.text: You feel the weight of responsibility in your work and public roles, and you climb the ladder one step at a time. As you keep seeing things through, you become the person everyone counts on. All the time you've put in stays with you as skill and resilience.

PL_SATURN_GEMINI.short_line: You mature as you learn to organize your thoughts and stand behind your words.
PL_SATURN_GEMINI.text: Whenever you learn or explain something, you catch yourself asking, "Do I really know this well enough?" You're the type who rewrites your notes again and again before a presentation. Words and knowledge polished this way become an ever more reliable tool.

PL_SATURN_LEO.short_line: Over time, you build the courage to let people see who you really are.
PL_SATURN_LEO.text: Self-expression and recognition are where life tests you most. Picture yourself rehearsing again and again before going on stage, calming your nerves a little more each time. As you learn to shine by your own standards instead of waiting for applause, real confidence takes root.

PL_SATURN_LIBRA.short_line: You grow by keeping your relationships balanced, so both sides feel respected.
PL_SATURN_LIBRA.text: In close relationships, you take promises and commitments seriously. You feel at ease when everyone's share is clear and each person holds up their end. Trust built over time becomes a steadfast foundation in any relationship.

PL_SATURN_PISCES.short_line: You get stronger as you learn to give shape to feelings that are hard to pin down.
PL_SATURN_PISCES.text: When your feelings and imagination overflow, your challenge is turning them into something real. Break a fuzzy dream into small tasks and check them off one by one. Make room for rest and set clear boundaries, and your sensitivity becomes a strength.

PL_SATURN_SAGITTARIUS.short_line: You come into your own by working out for yourself what you truly believe.
PL_SATURN_SAGITTARIUS.text: In learning and belief, you face moments of seriously asking yourself, "What do I actually believe?" Studying one subject for years and sharpening your own perspective suits you well. Beliefs you take the time to build become a compass that doesn't spin easily.

PL_SATURN_SCORPIO.short_line: Learning to handle deep trust and intense emotions gives you staying power.
PL_SATURN_SCORPIO.text: In close relationships where you open up deeply, you learn both caution and responsibility. You're slow to open up, and after a long while you know exactly who you can trust. Be honest with yourself about your feelings; over time, that honesty becomes inner strength.

PL_SATURN_TAURUS.short_line: You find your footing by building money and security with your own two hands.
PL_SATURN_TAURUS.text: Your responsibilities and tests show up around protecting and growing what's yours. One look at savings you've built bit by bit, however small, and you start believing in yourself. Security built without rushing doesn't crumble easily.

PL_SATURN_VIRGO.short_line: You build real strength by fine-tuning your daily routines and the quality of your work.
PL_SATURN_VIRGO.text: You feel a strong sense of responsibility for your daily tasks and for caring for your body. A small habit, like rising at the same time every morning and writing down your plan, becomes the backbone of your day. Choose consistency over perfection, and much of the pressure lifts.

PL_VENUS_AQUARIUS.short_line: You like relationships that feel like friendship, where each of you gets to stay your own person.
PL_VENUS_AQUARIUS.text: Even as you grow close, your affection lasts longer when your own time and ideas are respected. Stumbling on an obscure interest or a quirky find delights you. Your fun multiplies among people who share your passions.

PL_VENUS_ARIES.short_line: When you like someone, you don't play it cool. You make the first move, honestly and without hesitation.
PL_VENUS_ARIES.text: Love comes alive for you when you say how you feel instead of sitting on it. If something catches your eye in a store, you grab it on the spot rather than agonize. Relationships with a spark and fresh kinds of fun are what truly light you up.

PL_VENUS_CANCER.short_line: Your love shows up as presence: being there and looking after the people who matter to you.
PL_VENUS_CANCER.text: If someone you love skips a meal, it nags at you until you hand them something, even just a snack. You're happiest in a cozy, homey space surrounded by familiar faces. Money feels best when you spend it on the people you cherish.

PL_VENUS_CAPRICORN.short_line: Your love shows up as steady loyalty that holds strong over the years.
PL_VENUS_CAPRICORN.text: You take it slow at first, but once trust is built, you stay by someone's side through thick and thin. You have an eye for quality that lasts rather than whatever's trending. You relax most when both your spending and your fun fit into a plan.

PL_VENUS_GEMINI.short_line: You fall for people you can really talk to, and for fun that keeps things light.
PL_VENUS_GEMINI.text: Your affection blooms in relationships full of laughter and good conversation. A long phone call or a text thread that runs past midnight can be the most thrilling thing of all. You get a kick out of new hobbies and all kinds of playful little experiments.

PL_VENUS_LEO.short_line: You love out loud and generously, and you live for moments when you both get to shine.
PL_VENUS_LEO.text: When you give your heart, you go all in, and you're thrilled when the other person notices. Planning a little surprise for a friend's birthday excites you. Money spent on joy feels like a gift that lets you shine.

PL_VENUS_LIBRA.short_line: You flourish in a harmonious atmosphere and in relationships built on mutual respect.
PL_VENUS_LIBRA.text: Things that come together beautifully, like a lovely space or a well-balanced conversation, lift your mood. When you choose a place to meet, the lighting and music matter almost as much as the food. In love, you keep the give-and-take even.

PL_VENUS_PISCES.short_line: Your love is tender and boundless, slipping past walls without even trying.
PL_VENUS_PISCES.text: You sense how someone feels without a word and quietly tune in to them. Even tearing up during a favorite movie leaves you feeling full rather than drained. Beauty that stirs you, like music or art, is one of your deepest comforts.

PL_VENUS_SAGITTARIUS.short_line: Love and joy grow for you when you explore the world with someone.
PL_VENUS_SAGITTARIUS.text: You're most at ease in relationships where you each keep your freedom instead of tying each other down. Wandering an unfamiliar neighborhood or walking into a new restaurant gives you a little thrill. Spend on experiences rather than things; that happiness lasts longer.

PL_VENUS_SCORPIO.short_line: Once you give your heart, your love runs deep, intense, and long.
PL_VENUS_SCORPIO.text: A casual crush does little for you; you're drawn to relationships where you can share what's really going on inside. Rather than mingling with a crowd, you feel most fulfilled talking late into the night with a few kindred souls. When you fall for something, you go all in and explore every corner of it.

PL_VENUS_TAURUS.short_line: You love comfort you can touch and beauty that stands the test of time.
PL_VENUS_TAURUS.text: Sensory pleasures win you over: a meal made with good ingredients, clothes that feel wonderful against your skin. Cherishing one favorite mug for years is very you. In love and in money alike, you feel safest building slowly and steadily.

PL_VENUS_VIRGO.short_line: Thoughtful gestures and care in the little things are your love language.
PL_VENUS_VIRGO.text: Instead of grand declarations, you quietly make sure the other person has what they need. On a trip together, you're the one who writes the packing list first. Useful, well-made things bring you a quiet, steady joy.

PL_NEPTUNE_AQUARIUS.short_line: You dream of a world where everyone does well together.
PL_NEPTUNE_AQUARIUS.text: This generation imagines a better world through online connection and community. In daily life, you seek out your people, the ones who think like you do.

PL_NEPTUNE_ARIES.short_line: You have the courage to stake your dreams on new beginnings.
PL_NEPTUNE_ARIES.text: Your generation pins its dreams and ideals on forging new paths and stepping up first. In daily life, inspiration finds you once you get moving, not while you wait around.

PL_NEPTUNE_CANCER.short_line: You dream of a warm home and a life full of care.
PL_NEPTUNE_CANCER.text: Your generation places its ideals in family, hometown, and the warmth of being cared for. In daily life, you long for somewhere you can truly rest and feel at ease.

PL_NEPTUNE_CAPRICORN.short_line: You're redrawing what dreams look like in the real world.
PL_NEPTUNE_CAPRICORN.text: People born in this era see the meaning of success, security, and status blur and get redrawn. Day to day, you chase achievements you can truly believe in, not standards someone else set.

PL_NEPTUNE_GEMINI.short_line: Words and stories are where your dreams take root.
PL_NEPTUNE_GEMINI.text: This generation feeds its imagination on speech and writing, stories and information. You find inspiration by hopping between many ideas.

PL_NEPTUNE_LEO.short_line: You dream of the spotlight and of romance.
PL_NEPTUNE_LEO.text: People born in this era find their dreams in creativity, performance, and romantic stories. Day to day, you want your inner light to shine as brightly as it can.

PL_NEPTUNE_LIBRA.short_line: You dream of harmony in your relationships and peace in the world.
PL_NEPTUNE_LIBRA.text: Your generation holds up peace, harmony, and beautiful relationships as ideals. Day to day, you'd rather meet others halfway than fight.

PL_NEPTUNE_PISCES.short_line: You have deep empathy and a vivid imagination.
PL_NEPTUNE_PISCES.text: Your generation carries a heightened sense of empathy and artistic sensitivity. Day to day, you have a gift for feeling other people's emotions as if they were your own.

PL_NEPTUNE_SAGITTARIUS.short_line: You dream of freedom and a bigger sense of meaning.
PL_NEPTUNE_SAGITTARIUS.text: Your generation pins its dreams on travel, learning, and the search for life's meaning. You carry a thrilling sense that a bigger world is out there waiting for you.

PL_NEPTUNE_SCORPIO.short_line: Deep emotions and hidden truths draw you in.
PL_NEPTUNE_SCORPIO.text: Born during this stretch, you're drawn to the feelings and truths that lie far beneath the surface. In daily life, you crave deep connections where real feelings are shared, not casual ones.

PL_NEPTUNE_TAURUS.short_line: You dream of the beauty found in nature and the senses.
PL_NEPTUNE_TAURUS.text: Those born in this era find their ideals in nature, the body's senses, and beauty you can hold in your hands. Day to day, you take comfort in simple, cozy things.

PL_NEPTUNE_VIRGO.short_line: Helping and caring for others is where you find your ideals.
PL_NEPTUNE_VIRGO.text: This generation finds its ideals in useful work and in helping others. In daily life, you take pride in doing even small things right.

PL_PLUTO_AQUARIUS.short_line: You're transforming the way people connect and build communities.
PL_PLUTO_AQUARIUS.text: This generation was born as technology and networks began reshaping relationships and power at the root. You carry a gut sense that bigger change happens together, not alone.

PL_PLUTO_ARIES.short_line: You're forging a new kind of strength to stand on your own two feet.
PL_PLUTO_ARIES.text: Your generation rebuilds personal willpower and courage from the ground up. In daily life, you carry a firm resolve to make it on your own.

PL_PLUTO_CANCER.short_line: You're rebuilding what family and roots mean.
PL_PLUTO_CANCER.text: You grew up as the meaning of home, family, country, and roots changed dramatically. In daily life, you set out to build a solid place to belong, on your own.

PL_PLUTO_CAPRICORN.short_line: You're coming of age as society's foundations are being rebuilt.
PL_PLUTO_CAPRICORN.text: Your generation is growing up while old institutions and authority are shaken up and rebuilt. In daily life, you'd rather lay your own lasting foundation than just follow the existing playbook.

PL_PLUTO_GEMINI.short_line: You're changing, at a deep level, how people think and talk.
PL_PLUTO_GEMINI.text: This generation renews, from the ground up, how we learn, speak, and handle information. You know keenly how much a single word can carry.

PL_PLUTO_LEO.short_line: You've reawakened the power of self-expression.
PL_PLUTO_LEO.text: Your generation saw personal expression and creativity gain power and change dramatically. Day to day, you feel a strong urge to show the world all of who you are.

PL_PLUTO_LIBRA.short_line: You're redefining what balance and fairness in relationships look like.
PL_PLUTO_LIBRA.text: This generation takes a hard second look at what balance and fairness in relationships really mean. Day to day, you expect the people closest to you to meet you as equals.

PL_PLUTO_PISCES.short_line: Your capacity for empathy and imagination runs especially deep.
PL_PLUTO_PISCES.text: People born in this era see empathy, imagination, and invisible connections take on great power. Day to day, your sensitivity lets you feel other people's pain deeply.

PL_PLUTO_SAGITTARIUS.short_line: You're building new beliefs and new ways of seeing the world.
PL_PLUTO_SAGITTARIUS.text: As borders between countries and cultures become easier to cross, your generation builds new beliefs and worldviews. Day to day, you insist on discovering for yourself what really matters.

PL_PLUTO_SCORPIO.short_line: Facing your deepest feelings is what makes you strong.
PL_PLUTO_SCORPIO.text: People born in this era confront long-buried issues of emotion and power directly. In daily life, you're slow to open up, then form deep bonds once you trust someone.

PL_PLUTO_TAURUS.short_line: You're transforming what value and ownership really mean.
PL_PLUTO_TAURUS.text: People born in this era question the meaning of money, possessions, and value at the root. Day to day, you keep only what truly matters.

PL_PLUTO_VIRGO.short_line: You're reworking, at a deep level, how people work and live.
PL_PLUTO_VIRGO.text: Born during this stretch, you carry a deep shift in how we work, our daily habits, and how we care for our bodies. In daily life, you fine-tune even the small details to make things better.

PL_URANUS_AQUARIUS.short_line: You invent new ways of doing things through connection and technology.
PL_URANUS_AQUARIUS.text: Born as the internet and technology became part of everyday life, your generation is reinventing how people connect. You value your own individuality and your community in equal measure.

PL_URANUS_ARIES.short_line: For you, change comes from blazing your own trail.
PL_URANUS_ARIES.text: Your generation is wired to find change by going first and carving out its own path. Day to day, you feel it as an urge to just try something rather than wait your turn.

PL_URANUS_CANCER.short_line: You're redrawing the picture of what home and family can be.
PL_URANUS_CANCER.text: Those born under this placement carry a shift in what home, family, and belonging mean. Day to day, you'd rather create a sense of home on your own terms than follow a set template.

PL_URANUS_CAPRICORN.short_line: You update old structures in practical, workable ways.
PL_URANUS_CAPRICORN.text: You grew up as society's long-standing systems and rules began to shift, and you carry a talent for reworking structures realistically. Day to day, you work out, step by step, what actually works rather than changing things for the sake of it.

PL_URANUS_GEMINI.short_line: You arrived just as the way we share words and information started changing fast.
PL_URANUS_GEMINI.text: This generation grows up while the ways we learn, stay in touch, and share information shift dramatically. You notice it as a curiosity that branches in many directions and a knack for mastering new tools in no time.

PL_URANUS_LEO.short_line: You're here to break the mold by expressing who you really are.
PL_URANUS_LEO.text: Your generation looks for fresh ways to show up and express itself. In everyday life, you feel the pull to show your true colors instead of blending in.

PL_URANUS_LIBRA.short_line: You're part of a generation rewriting the rules of relationships.
PL_URANUS_LIBRA.text: You grew up as the shape of relationships and commitments was changing. Day to day, you look for what works for both of you rather than sticking to set roles.

PL_URANUS_PISCES.short_line: With empathy and imagination, you move easily across boundaries.
PL_URANUS_PISCES.text: As the lines between offline and online, and between you and others, blur, this generation finds new uses for empathy and imagination. In daily life, you pick up on other people's feelings easily and long to turn them into stories or art.

PL_URANUS_SAGITTARIUS.short_line: You're always setting out in search of a bigger world and fresh ideas.
PL_URANUS_SAGITTARIUS.text: Your generation broadens its horizons through travel, learning, and meeting other cultures. In daily life, you feel an urge to go further instead of settling for familiar ideas.

PL_URANUS_SCORPIO.short_line: You're driven to look at what's hidden and change it.
PL_URANUS_SCORPIO.text: People born in this era are drawn to uncover buried issues of emotion and power and transform them. You notice it as a deep curiosity about the story beneath the surface.

PL_URANUS_TAURUS.short_line: You carry a wave of change in how people think about money and everyday life.
PL_URANUS_TAURUS.text: People born in this era grow up as ways of earning a living, and of relating to money and possessions, are reinvented. In everyday life, you seek a balance between familiar security and new ways of doing things.

PL_URANUS_VIRGO.short_line: You bring fresh ideas to how people work and live day to day.
PL_URANUS_VIRGO.text: Born during this stretch, you carry a pull toward upgrading how we work and how we look after our bodies. The moment you spot something inefficient, you itch to fix it.

HS_MARS_H01.short_line: Your drive charges straight into putting yourself out front.
HS_MARS_H01.text: Once you decide, your body is already moving. You come across as lively and confident. You move fast, so pause now and then to catch your breath and check your direction; that is how you go the distance.

HS_MARS_H02.short_line: You channel your energy into earning money and guarding what's yours.
HS_MARS_H02.text: When you want something, you have the drive to earn it and claim it yourself. You pour much of your energy into protecting what's yours and the standards you live by. When the urge to splurge hits, sleep on it for a day.

HS_MARS_H03.short_line: Your fire goes into learning, speaking up, and staying in touch with those around you.
HS_MARS_H03.text: When you have something to say, you say it quickly and clearly. The moment something sparks your interest, you're off to learn it. When a conversation heats up, choose your words before you speak, and your point lands.

HS_MARS_H04.short_line: You pour your energy into building up your home, family, and personal space.
HS_MARS_H04.text: You put real effort into fixing up and organizing your home. You fiercely protect the people close to you, and that same fire can make tempers run hot at home. When things heat up, burn off steam with a workout or a brisk walk first, then talk.

HS_MARS_H05.short_line: Fun, romance, and creative projects set you on fire.
HS_MARS_H05.text: When you find something you love, you throw yourself into it. Play that uses body and mind alike, like sports, games, or making things, charges you up. You have the courage to express yourself without holding back.

HS_MARS_H06.short_line: You channel your drive into daily tasks and your body's rhythm.
HS_MARS_H06.text: You knock out your tasks quickly and diligently. Your days run best on a routine that keeps you physically active. You can run nonstop, so pencil in breaks before exhaustion catches up with you.

HS_MARS_H07.short_line: Your drive comes alive when you team up with a partner.
HS_MARS_H07.text: You gain momentum when you work alongside someone rather than alone. When you clash with someone close, you face it honestly and head-on. Sync your pace and agree on a shared goal, and the two of you become a powerful team.

HS_MARS_H08.short_line: You fight for your deepest bonds and meet big changes head-on.
HS_MARS_H08.text: Once your mind is set, you dig in and see it through to the end. You pour serious energy into protecting your closest bonds and everything you share. When big changes arrive, you face them squarely instead of backing away.

HS_MARS_H09.short_line: Your drive heads for big learning, far-off places, and the causes you believe in.
HS_MARS_H09.text: Setting off somewhere new or taking on an ambitious course of study sets your drive ablaze. You stand up boldly for what you believe is right. The stronger your convictions, the more you gain by hearing out other views, so let your energy reach further.

HS_MARS_H10.short_line: You aim your drive squarely at your career and your goals.
HS_MARS_H10.text: The moment you spot a goal at work, you charge toward it. Challenging roles don't drain you; they fire you up. You push hard for results, so carve out room for rest as well.

HS_MARS_H11.short_line: You pour your energy into future goals you reach together with others.
HS_MARS_H11.text: In teams and groups, you lead the charge. Around people who share your dream, your momentum doubles. When the group can't agree, bring everyone back to the shared goal and watch the energy pull together.

HS_MARS_H12.short_line: Your drive works quietly, behind the scenes.
HS_MARS_H12.text: You'd rather get things done behind the scenes than step into the spotlight. You tend to hold anger or ambition inside instead of showing it. Give that energy a quiet outlet, like a solo workout or a good tidy-up, and feel a weight lift from your mind.

HS_MERCURY_H01.short_line: Your thoughts and words are front and center in how you come across.
HS_MERCURY_H01.text: Whatever's on your mind shows up right away in your words and on your face. In a first conversation, you come across as quick-witted and smart. Take a beat before you speak, and you say exactly what you mean.

HS_MERCURY_H02.short_line: Money, possessions, and what things are really worth take up a lot of your mental energy.
HS_MERCURY_H02.text: You think carefully about what's useful and worth it to you. You're good at putting ideas to work in real life: budgeting, comparing options, planning ahead. Your words and ideas can become valuable assets in their own right.

HS_MERCURY_H03.short_line: Learning and chatting with the people around you is where your mind feels at home.
HS_MERCURY_H03.text: The moment you're curious about something, you look it up and want to share it. You have a gift for quick, easy communication, like short posts, texts, and casual chats. When your thoughts branch off in every direction, jot them down before they slip away.

HS_MERCURY_H04.short_line: Home, family, and your roots are often on your mind.
HS_MERCURY_H04.text: Your real thoughts come out in relaxed conversations at home. You often revisit old memories to make sense of who you are now. Quick chats with family or close friends help you put your thoughts in order.

HS_MERCURY_H05.short_line: You think best when there's fun, play, or a creative project involved.
HS_MERCURY_H05.text: You turn ideas into play, whether it's wordplay or wild daydreams. Expressing ideas through writing, video, or planning projects is genuinely fun for you. Talk about something you love, and your words come alive.

HS_MERCURY_H06.short_line: You put your mind to organizing your daily work and routines.
HS_MERCURY_H06.text: Making a to-do list and setting priorities clears your head. You're good at spotting and fixing the small gaps in your work. When your mind won't switch off, jot a few notes before bed and unload.

HS_MERCURY_H07.short_line: Your best thinking happens in one-on-one conversations and in talking things over with a partner.
HS_MERCURY_H07.text: Instead of worrying things over alone, you sort out your thoughts by talking with one person face to face. You're a good listener with a gift for balanced, thoughtful replies. The bigger the decision, the more you gain from talking it over with someone you trust.

HS_MERCURY_H08.short_line: Your mind is drawn to what lies beneath: deep feelings and hidden motives.
HS_MERCURY_H08.text: You care less about what's said on the surface than about the real reason behind it. You have the focus to dig deep into a single subject. When your thoughts get too heavy, step outside for fresh air and give your mind a break.

HS_MERCURY_H09.short_line: Higher learning, travel, and life's big questions capture your imagination.
HS_MERCURY_H09.text: Big questions like "Why is it like that?" interest you far more than small details. Your thinking grows through learning that broadens your horizons, like foreign languages, philosophy, or travel stories. When you pass on what you've learned, your words carry real weight.

HS_MERCURY_H10.short_line: Your communication skills go to work for your career and your role in the world.
HS_MERCURY_H10.text: At work, your speaking and writing show what you can do. You shine in roles where you organize and share ideas, like planning, explaining, and presenting. Keep a regular record of your ideas; it helps you steer the direction of your work.

HS_MERCURY_H11.short_line: People, community, and plans for the future keep your mind buzzing.
HS_MERCURY_H11.text: Your mind speeds up when you're bouncing ideas around with lots of people. In groups or online communities, you end up being the one who shares information and connects people. Say your plans for the future out loud, and the picture comes into focus.

HS_MERCURY_H12.short_line: Your thoughts turn inward, toward quiet reflection and sorting things out on your own.
HS_MERCURY_H12.text: You mull things over long before you say them out loud. Alone, your intuition and imagination run rich and luminous. Pour your inner thoughts into a journal or a few quick notes, and feel your head clear.

HS_MOON_H01.short_line: You feel most at peace when you can simply be yourself.
HS_MOON_H01.text: Your mood shows on your face and in your body language almost instantly. You feel better when you're honest with yourself about your feelings instead of hiding them. Start each day by checking in on how you're really doing.

HS_MOON_H02.short_line: Financial security and a sense of your own worth help you feel emotionally safe.
HS_MOON_H02.text: When life's basics are covered, you can finally relax. Surrounding yourself with things you love and know well calms you. Practice separating your worth from your bank balance.

HS_MOON_H03.short_line: Talking things through with the people close to you brings you calm.
HS_MOON_H03.text: When something's bothering you, talking it out with someone helps you let it go. Small connections, like quick texts or a stroll around the neighborhood together, bring real comfort. Write your thoughts down, too; it calms your mind.

HS_MOON_H04.short_line: Home, family, and your roots are where you feel safe.
HS_MOON_H04.text: You're most at ease in familiar surroundings with the people you're close to. When your home is in order, your emotions follow. Keep a cozy corner that's all yours, a place to come back to when life feels shaky.

HS_MOON_H05.short_line: Losing yourself in something you enjoy is how you find calm.
HS_MOON_H05.text: Getting lost in a favorite hobby lets you set your worries aside for a while. Creating something, whether drawing, singing, or cooking, fills you up. Never underestimate a good laugh; it does wonders for your peace of mind.

HS_MOON_H06.short_line: Daily routines and your body's natural rhythm keep you on an even keel.
HS_MOON_H06.text: Rising at the same time and checking off your tasks one by one helps you feel settled. When your rhythm gets thrown off, your mood rides the waves with it. On busy days especially, hold on to at least one small ritual, like a walk or a cup of tea.

HS_MOON_H07.short_line: Having one special person by your side gives you emotional security.
HS_MOON_H07.text: You feel most at ease when you can open up to one person you trust. You're sensitive to other people's moods and read the room first. Remember that your feelings matter just as much as theirs, and the relationship feels lighter.

HS_MOON_H08.short_line: Bonds you can trust completely are what make you feel safe.
HS_MOON_H08.text: Surface-level relationships don't do it for you; you feel safe with people who can hold your deepest feelings. Because you feel things so intensely, opening up doesn't always come easily. Share a little at a time with one person you trust, and you find your footing.

HS_MOON_H09.short_line: Learning about the world and holding to your own beliefs bring you peace of mind.
HS_MOON_H09.text: When you're feeling boxed in, a trip somewhere new or a fresh book helps you breathe again. Seeing life from a wider angle makes the small stuff easier to shrug off. Write down one value you believe in, in a single sentence, and lean on it.

HS_MOON_H10.short_line: Feeling secure in your work and your place in the world steadies you.
