HS_MOON_H10.text: You feel settled when you're doing your job well and getting recognized for it. When things are rocky at work, your mood takes a hit too. Keep one place outside of work where you can truly unwind; it keeps you balanced.

HS_MOON_H11.short_line: Being part of a community, among people you click with, helps you feel at home.
HS_MOON_H11.text: You're most comfortable among friends or groups you get along with. Just knowing others are heading in the same direction makes you feel supported. Don't tough it out alone; lean on your people.

HS_MOON_H12.short_line: Quiet time alone to rest and reset is what restores your calm.
HS_MOON_H12.text: Emotions that build up around other people unwind slowly once you have time to yourself. Your own private ways of resting, like quiet music or journaling, recharge you. When you're worn out, cancel a plan and rest; that's self-care too.

HS_SUN_H01.short_line: Your Sun's power points straight at you: who you are and the first impression you make.
HS_SUN_H01.text: People notice you right away, even at a first meeting. Life comes into focus when you decide who you are and show it. Choose your own way over what others expect; that's where your strength lives.

HS_SUN_H02.short_line: Here, that power flows into money, what you own, and your sense of self-worth.
HS_SUN_H02.text: You find yourself in what you've earned with your own hands and the things you've chosen. How you spend your money and time says a lot about who you are. Set your own standards, and you feel grounded.

HS_SUN_H03.short_line: You channel it into learning, talking, and staying connected with the people around you.
HS_SUN_H03.text: Learn something new, and you're itching to tell someone right away. Your ideas grow through chats with neighbors, siblings, or old friends. Learning and sharing are what light up your life.

HS_SUN_H04.short_line: It points you home, toward family and the roots of who you are.
HS_SUN_H04.text: Whatever you accomplish out in the world, you need a comfortable home base to feel strong. You feel centered when you set up your space your way and look after the people closest to you. Home is where you rest, and it's where you get back on your feet.

HS_SUN_H05.short_line: You pour it into fun, romance, and creative projects.
HS_SUN_H05.text: Your whole face lights up when you're doing something you love. Your truest self comes out when you're making something or expressing what you're drawn to. Make time for play; it's what makes your life feel full.

HS_SUN_H06.short_line: Your daily work, routines, and the rhythm of your body draw that power.
HS_SUN_H06.text: Planning your day well and doing your tasks thoroughly gives you real satisfaction. You know in your bones that small habits add up to who you are. When work piles up, you're tempted to schedule even your downtime, so leave at least one slot empty.

HS_SUN_H07.short_line: One-on-one relationships and partners are where that energy goes.
HS_SUN_H07.text: You see yourself more clearly sitting across from one other person than you do alone. Whether it's a coworker, a friend, or a partner, relationships where you find your rhythm together show you where you stand. Let others be your mirror, but keep making room for your own voice.

HS_SUN_H08.short_line: It draws you toward deep bonds, what you share with others, and transformation.
HS_SUN_H08.text: Rather than knowing lots of people a little, you feel most alive when you're deeply connected to one or two. You take what you share seriously, whether it's feelings, time, or a household. Life's big turning points leave you stronger, not weaker.

HS_SUN_H09.short_line: It reaches toward higher learning, travel, and the values you live by.
HS_SUN_H09.text: Your eyes light up when you travel somewhere new or come across a fresh idea. Taking time to ask what's right and how you want to live keeps you grounded. The wider your learning grows, the more you grow with it.

HS_SUN_H10.short_line: Your career and the role you play in the world are where that light aims.
HS_SUN_H10.text: The role you play at work and in society is a big part of how you see yourself. Setting goals and climbing toward them step by step energizes you. Just don't measure yourself by achievements alone; nurture the you outside of work too.

HS_SUN_H11.short_line: That power flows toward your friends, communities, and goals for the future.
HS_SUN_H11.text: Your place in the world comes into focus among people who share your goals. Talking about the future with a group or team charges you up. Dreams you share with others outlast the ones you dream alone.

HS_SUN_H12.short_line: It turns inward, toward rest, your inner life, and the parts of you that stay out of sight.
HS_SUN_H12.text: You find your center sorting through your thoughts somewhere quiet, away from the spotlight. Time alone isn't running away; it's how you recharge. Your true self shines in the behind-the-scenes care and organizing no one else sees.

HS_VENUS_H01.short_line: Your love of beauty blooms in how you dress, style, and present yourself.
HS_VENUS_H01.text: You make a soft, warm first impression, and people like you from the start. Your personal taste shines through how you show up, from your clothes to the way you speak. Treat yourself with care, and that glow brightens every relationship around you.

HS_VENUS_H02.short_line: Venus draws your affection toward money, your possessions, and your own worth.
HS_VENUS_H02.text: You have a fine eye for choosing things you'll truly love. Spending on beauty and comfort brings you deep satisfaction. Own your worth, and your whole life feels richer.

HS_VENUS_H03.short_line: Kind words, learning, and neighborly chats bring your warmth to life.
HS_VENUS_H03.text: One kind word from you softens the whole room. You treasure easygoing ties with close friends, siblings, and neighbors. A beautifully turned phrase or a fun new subject lights up your day.

HS_VENUS_H04.short_line: Home, family, and a space that feels like yours are where your affection blooms.
HS_VENUS_H04.text: You feel happiest when you make your home cozy and fill it with what you love. Sharing a meal with close friends at your table is time you treasure. Your comfortable home becomes the steady ground your relationships stand on.

HS_VENUS_H05.short_line: Fun, romance, and creativity bring your loving nature into full bloom.
HS_VENUS_H05.text: When you love something, you give it your whole heart. Art, hobbies, and the thrill of a new crush pull you in naturally. Make time to savor what you love; that is what puts the sparkle in your life.

HS_VENUS_H06.short_line: You find joy in tending your everyday work and routines.
HS_VENUS_H06.text: You keep a neat, lovely workspace and build a warm atmosphere with your coworkers. Small everyday pleasures carry you through the day. Turn your self-care into a ritual you truly enjoy, and you'll keep it up for the long run.

HS_VENUS_H07.short_line: Your heart opens in partnerships and one-on-one bonds.
HS_VENUS_H07.text: Harmony with the one person beside you matters deeply to you. You're considerate and quick to meet people halfway, so your relationships run smoothly. Say what you want out loud, too; that keeps the peace for the long run.

HS_VENUS_H08.short_line: Venus draws you toward deep bonds and a life truly shared.
HS_VENUS_H08.text: Passing crushes rarely hold you; you crave relationships with real depth and intensity. You treasure bonds where you share not only feelings but your time and your daily life. As trust builds, those connections glow ever richer.

HS_VENUS_H09.short_line: Faraway places, big ideas, and new cultures make your heart skip a beat.
HS_VENUS_H09.text: Food, music, and landscapes from other countries thrill you. Open-minded people you can learn from win your heart. Travel and new studies open the widest channels for joy in your life.

HS_VENUS_H10.short_line: What you love flows into your career and your place in the world.
HS_VENUS_H10.text: At work, people remember you as likable and polished. Your talents shine in fields of beauty, people, and harmony. Weave what you love into your work, and the work itself becomes a joy.

HS_VENUS_H11.short_line: Your warmth flourishes among friends, community, and shared dreams.
HS_VENUS_H11.text: Time with kindred spirits is one of your greatest joys. In any group, you're the one who connects people and smooths things over. Dream up a future together, and your friendships deepen.

HS_VENUS_H12.short_line: You find delight in quiet rest and private joys only you know.
HS_VENUS_H12.text: You keep your affection close rather than wearing it on your sleeve. Hidden joys, like music you play just for yourself or kindnesses no one sees, are precious to you. Turn that tenderness toward yourself, too, and you feel more whole.

HS_JUPITER_H01.short_line: You were born with the gift of being openly, generously yourself.
HS_JUPITER_H01.text: Even with people you've just met, your open, friendly face invites conversation. You settle into new places quickly, a strength that serves you for life. When a good mood has you saying yes to every plan, pause and weigh how much you can truly take on.

HS_JUPITER_H02.short_line: You see the value in what you have, and all the ways to use it.
HS_JUPITER_H02.text: You find many uses for a single skill and naturally show what it's worth. You're as generous with others as you are with yourself. On days your wallet feels thicker, set one simple spending rule so that sense of plenty lasts.

HS_JUPITER_H03.short_line: Learning and conversation open doors for you.
HS_JUPITER_H03.text: One quick chat or a chance read sends your mind off in exciting new directions. Explaining things and swapping stories with the people around you is a natural joy. Your interests branch out in every direction, so choose one topic at a time to stick with and let your learning deepen.

HS_JUPITER_H04.short_line: Home and family become a warm, generous haven for you.
HS_JUPITER_H04.text: You draw strength from making your space comfortable and opening your door to others. Knowing you have a solid place to come home to carries you through everything out there. Feelings run ahead of you when it comes to home, so before any big decision, look at the practical side first.

HS_JUPITER_H05.short_line: Fun and creativity are where you truly blossom.
HS_JUPITER_H05.text: When you're doing what you love, your whole face lights up, and that glow spreads to everyone around you. A hobby or project you started just for fun can open an unexpected door. When the fun starts piling up, keep only the few things you truly cherish.

HS_JUPITER_H06.short_line: Jupiter grows your luck through your daily work and routines.
HS_JUPITER_H06.text: Good fortune flows your way when you fine-tune how you work or lend a hand to coworkers. You have a knack for turning self-care into habits you enjoy. Your can-do spirit tempts you to take on too much, so leave some open space in your day.

HS_JUPITER_H07.short_line: The people you partner with widen your path.
HS_JUPITER_H07.text: Partners, and the people you sit down with to talk things through, open new doors for you. Your generosity in seeing the best in others keeps your relationships strong over the years. When expectations grow, spell out what each of you hopes for, and that warmth stays intact.

HS_JUPITER_H08.short_line: Your life grows richer when you share it with people you deeply trust.
HS_JUPITER_H08.text: You draw great strength from relationships where you can truly open up, and help arrives when you need it. You come out of seemingly hopeless moments more generous and open than before. With shared money or commitments, keep records as thorough as your generosity.

HS_JUPITER_H09.short_line: A wide world and big ideas set your spirit free.
HS_JUPITER_H09.text: A new place or a fresh perspective leaves you feeling lighter than air. You have a lasting gift for weaving what you learn into a personal philosophy. When a great idea starts to balloon, turn it into one small step you can take today.

HS_JUPITER_H10.short_line: Opportunities find you through your work and public role.
HS_JUPITER_H10.text: Your ability to see the big picture and lead others gets you noticed. Offers and referrals keep coming, so the scope of your work widens over time. On days you feel you could do it all, set your priorities first so your energy stays focused.

HS_JUPITER_H11.short_line: Your goals for the future grow as you connect with others.
HS_JUPITER_H11.text: In like-minded groups, one new connection or tip leads to the next. Share a dream, and someone steps up to help more often than you'd expect. As your circles multiply, choose the ones that truly lift you up and invest your energy there.

HS_JUPITER_H12.short_line: A quiet strength grows in your time alone.
HS_JUPITER_H12.text: You find deep peace in helping others behind the scenes or sorting through your feelings. At every rough patch, help seems to find its way to you. Your generosity can have you shouldering other people's burdens, so guard your own rest time.

HS_NEPTUNE_H01.short_line: Your soft, mysterious air draws people in.
HS_NEPTUNE_H01.text: You come across a little differently to each person, which makes you easy to approach. You soak up the mood around you so well that, some days, your feelings and other people's get tangled. When that happens, ask yourself, 'Whose feeling is this, really?'

HS_NEPTUNE_H02.short_line: With money and possessions, you thrive when you honor both your ideals and reality.
HS_NEPTUNE_H02.text: Meaningful work and beautiful things draw you in, so feeling leads before the numbers do. That sensitivity is also a gift: it lets you create your own kind of value through creative or helping work. If your finances feel fuzzy, set a monthly date to write down what came in and what went out.

HS_NEPTUNE_H03.short_line: Imagination colors everything you think and say.
HS_NEPTUNE_H03.text: You have a rare gift for expressing feelings through stories, writing, or art. You also tend to read your own meaning into what people say, which leads to mix-ups. Make it a habit to double-check important plans and details before you wrap up.

HS_NEPTUNE_H04.short_line: At home, you find your dreams and your comfort.
HS_NEPTUNE_H04.text: To you, home is more than a place to live; it's a sanctuary where you can rest, and you dream of filling it with warmth. Because your picture of home is so idealized, some days the gap with reality stings. When it does, bring the rest you long for into your current space, one small piece at a time.

HS_NEPTUNE_H05.short_line: Dreamy imagination fills your play and creativity.
HS_NEPTUNE_H05.text: You lose yourself in what stirs your emotions, like music, art, and stories, and you long for true romance in love. Your imagination shines brightest when it flows into creative work or play. As the thrill grows, take time to see the person and the situation as they really are.

HS_NEPTUNE_H06.short_line: The clearer the line between work and rest, the more at ease you feel.
HS_NEPTUNE_H06.text: You give yourself fully to work that helps others or feels meaningful. That same devotion blurs the line between work and rest, so you notice your tiredness late. Bookend each day with the same small ritual, and you keep your rhythm.

HS_NEPTUNE_H07.short_line: You bring deep empathy and high ideals to your relationships.
HS_NEPTUNE_H07.text: In close one-on-one relationships, you tune in to how the other person feels, and you long for a bond of true mutual understanding. When that empathy runs too deep, you see only their good side or lose track of your own needs. The closer you are, the more you need to say out loud what you want and what you find hard.

HS_NEPTUNE_H08.short_line: In your deepest bonds, keep a gentle eye on your boundaries.
HS_NEPTUNE_H08.text: When you connect deeply with someone, you cherish the feeling of merging into one. That same longing blurs where shared money and emotional responsibilities begin and end. In your closest relationships, write down who handles what; the connection feels easier for it.

HS_NEPTUNE_H09.short_line: You're an idealist who finds inspiration in big ideas and deep beliefs.
HS_NEPTUNE_H09.text: The unseen calls to you, from philosophy and spirituality to tales of faraway lands, and it broadens your outlook. Your capacity for big ideals brings meaningful insights to your life. When a new belief or teaching pulls you in, look for evidence you can check for yourself as well.

HS_NEPTUNE_H10.short_line: In your work and public life, your dreams and sensitivity shine.
HS_NEPTUNE_H10.text: You feel most like yourself in work rich with meaning and feeling, like art or helping others. When your direction feels hazy, though, you can spend a long time agonizing over your path or bending to other people's expectations. When things feel vague, write out specific scenes of the work you'd love, then test one in a small way.

HS_NEPTUNE_H11.short_line: Together with others, you dream warm, hopeful dreams.
HS_NEPTUNE_H11.text: In communities and groups, you dream of a future where everyone thrives, and helping others moves you deeply. You trust people easily, so some days you feel let down when they don't live up to your hopes. When you share a goal, agree on roles and commitments clearly from the start.

HS_NEPTUNE_H12.short_line: Rest and your inner life are deep wells of inspiration and comfort.
HS_NEPTUNE_H12.text: You recharge best alone, listening to music or lost in daydreams. You soak up the feelings around you like a sponge, so some days you feel drained for no clear reason. After a day full of people, make a point of spending time alone to clear your head.

HS_PLUTO_H01.short_line: You seem quiet, but you carry a deep, powerful presence.
HS_PLUTO_H01.text: Even without saying much, you leave a strong impression, and you rarely let people see inside. Your great strength is the resilience to rebuild yourself at every turning point. If you've been holding it all together alone for too long, open up a little to someone you trust.

HS_PLUTO_H02.short_line: You have the power to rebuild your resources and self-worth from the ground up.
HS_PLUTO_H02.text: Your feelings about money and possessions run strong, so you swing between wanting to hold on and wanting to change everything. Moving through that tension teaches you to decide for yourself what you truly value. When you feel pressured, calmly write down what you have now and what you can do.

HS_PLUTO_H03.short_line: Your mind has the focus to get to the bottom of things.
HS_PLUTO_H03.text: When something sparks your curiosity, you keep digging until you understand it fully, and every word you say carries weight. That depth sharpens into insight into what people really feel. When a conversation turns sharp, open with a question instead of a conclusion.

HS_PLUTO_H04.short_line: Deep in your roots lies the power to come back stronger.
HS_PLUTO_H04.text: Your feelings about home and family run deep, so you often find yourself taking a hard look at your emotional foundations. As you explore those roots, your power to get back on your feet grows. On heavy days, set up a space, even a small one, to be your own refuge.

HS_PLUTO_H05.short_line: You love with an intensity that holds nothing back.
HS_PLUTO_H05.text: Whether it's a hobby, a creative project, or a romance, once you're drawn in, you commit completely. That focus reaches beyond ordinary fun and leaves you with work or experiences that change you. When you get too absorbed in one thing, keep one light, easy pastime close at hand.

HS_PLUTO_H06.short_line: You get your strength back by transforming your daily routines.
HS_PLUTO_H06.text: You dig into your work so thoroughly that you can transform how a whole task gets done. That same intensity tempts you to push yourself until you burn out. Instead of overhauling your daily rhythm all at once, change one thing at a time so the strength you regain lasts.

HS_PLUTO_H07.short_line: In relationships, you transform and grow the most.
HS_PLUTO_H07.text: In close one-on-one relationships, you want a deep, wholehearted connection, and you and your partner leave a powerful mark on each other. That intensity helps you discover new sides of yourself. When things grow tense over who's in control, calmly put into words what each of you wants.

HS_PLUTO_H08.short_line: Deep bonds and big changes awaken your remarkable power to renew yourself.
HS_PLUTO_H08.text: Intense feelings in close relationships or around shared resources lead you to rethink yourself from the ground up. Like a snake shedding its skin, you come out of each big change tougher; that resilience is your strength. When heavy feelings pool inside, let them out little by little, to someone you trust or onto the page.

HS_PLUTO_H09.short_line: Diving deep into beliefs and ideas, you transform your whole life.
HS_PLUTO_H09.text: You want the truth of things, and once an idea takes hold, you're all in. Learning or travel can completely change how you see the world. As your beliefs grow stronger, make a point of truly listening to people who think differently.

HS_PLUTO_H10.short_line: Through your work and public role, you build real influence over time.
HS_PLUTO_H10.text: You want real responsibility and influence at work, and once you set a goal, you focus hard and push forward. Major career shifts help you rediscover the role that's truly yours. When work starts to take over your whole life, protect time for the parts of you that live outside it.

HS_PLUTO_H11.short_line: When you join forces with others, you spark deep change.
HS_PLUTO_H11.text: In groups and communities, you'd rather connect deeply with a few people you truly click with than keep lots of casual ties. The goals you dream up together become a force that transforms you and everyone around you. When you've poured so much into others that you're worn out, take time alone to get clear on the future you want.

HS_PLUTO_H12.short_line: Deep in your inner world lies a powerful resilience.
HS_PLUTO_H12.text: In time alone, deep feelings and old thoughts surface, and you face them quietly. Working through your inner world like this builds your power to pick yourself back up. When your mood sinks low, give your feelings a way out, like a walk or a journal.

HS_SATURN_H01.short_line: Year by year, you build a steady, solid sense of who you are.
HS_SATURN_H01.text: You've held yourself to high standards since early on, so people often say you seem more serious at first than you really are. Year by year, experience turns that seriousness into a reassuring, steadfast presence. On days you're hard on yourself, write down what you've achieved so far, one line at a time.

HS_SATURN_H02.short_line: You build your resources and self-worth slowly but surely.
HS_SATURN_H02.text: You're careful about money and about what your skills are worth, and the feeling of having enough arrives late. In return, what you gather bit by bit becomes a foundation that doesn't shake easily. If you catch yourself selling yourself short, look back over everything you've accomplished.

HS_SATURN_H03.short_line: Your gift for shaping your thoughts and saying exactly what you mean keeps growing.
HS_SATURN_H03.text: You weigh your words carefully before speaking, and you only feel settled once you've mastered the basics step by step. It takes time, but what you learn sticks, and your explanations gain real depth. When the words come slowly and you feel impatient, write your thoughts down first.

HS_SATURN_H04.short_line: You grow strong by laying down your own roots.
HS_SATURN_H04.text: You take home and family seriously, and responsibility comes to mind before relaxing does. The groundwork you lay becomes, over time, a safe haven all your own. On days you can't unwind even at home, set aside time that's purely for rest.

HS_SATURN_H05.short_line: You polish what you love over time until it becomes real skill.
HS_SATURN_H05.text: Letting loose or showing your feelings doesn't come easily, so at first nerves get ahead of fun. Once you choose a hobby or creative outlet, though, you stick with it and refine it into something with real depth. When you feel pressure to be good at it, make time on purpose to enjoy it without judging the results.

HS_SATURN_H06.short_line: Steady daily effort earns you people's trust.
HS_SATURN_H06.text: You want to do every task thoroughly, so you feel the weight of everyday responsibilities early in life. Over time, the work habits and rhythms you've honed become strengths few can match. On days you're running on empty, schedule your rest before your to-do list.

HS_SATURN_H07.short_line: Slowly but surely, you build relationships that are deep and dependable.
HS_SATURN_H07.text: In close one-on-one relationships, you take promises and responsibilities seriously, and you take your time to open up. Bonds built this way, one careful step at a time, become lasting trust. When you find yourself carrying the whole load alone, tell the other person what you need in a single sentence.

HS_SATURN_H08.short_line: You take your time building deep trust that holds firm.
HS_SATURN_H08.text: You don't hand over your inner feelings or shared resources lightly; you watch a long time before deciding someone is trustworthy. Because you're so careful, the deep bonds you do form are rock solid. If something feels too heavy to carry alone, share it, bit by bit, with one person you trust.

HS_SATURN_H09.short_line: Over the years, your beliefs deepen into a personal code you live by.
HS_SATURN_H09.text: Big ideas and long journeys make you cautious, so you spend a long time preparing for study or travel. In return, the beliefs you've tested for yourself become a compass that keeps you steady. Stop waiting for the perfect moment: start small with a short trip nearby or a one-day class.

HS_SATURN_H10.short_line: You build your career and reputation brick by brick over time.
HS_SATURN_H10.text: Taking on responsibility early or holding yourself to high standards makes work feel especially heavy. As years of effort harden into skill and trust, recognition follows, slowly but surely. When progress feels slow, set last year's you beside today's you and compare.

HS_SATURN_H11.short_line: With a few close friends, you map out your future with care.
HS_SATURN_H11.text: You'd rather get to know people one at a time than blend into a crowd, so busy gatherings can feel awkward. Over time, you gather people who stay for the long haul and goals you can actually reach. On days groups feel like too much, start by making plans with one person you're comfortable with.

HS_SATURN_H12.short_line: Out of sight, your ability to work through your feelings keeps growing.
HS_SATURN_H12.text: Some days, worries grow louder in your time alone, or part of you feels heavy even while you rest. Working through those moments, again and again, builds an inner strength that doesn't crumble. When your thoughts start spiraling, get what's in your head down on paper.

HS_URANUS_H01.short_line: You have a one-of-a-kind air, and you show it your own way.
HS_URANUS_H01.text: You choose a look you love over whatever's trending, and your style can change dramatically from one phase to the next. Feeling boxed in frustrates you fast, but you also adapt quickly to new situations. When restlessness hits, test the waters by changing just one thing about your look.

HS_URANUS_H02.short_line: You handle money and self-worth in your own unconventional way.
HS_URANUS_H02.text: You feel your worth most when you find unusual ways to use your talents instead of following a set path. Your income and spending run up and down at times, but that rhythm also helps you spot new opportunities quickly. If the flow shifts often, set aside a separate amount for basic living costs.

HS_URANUS_H03.short_line: Your mind sparks with ideas, and fresh thoughts pop right out.
HS_URANUS_H03.text: You come up with offbeat but useful ideas in places others overlook. You learn best when you follow your curiosity instead of a fixed order. When your mind races so fast your mouth gets ahead of you, take a beat and read the other person's reaction.

HS_URANUS_H04.short_line: At home, you need room to breathe and be free.
HS_URANUS_H04.text: Rather than staying put for long, you want to change your living space or the feel of your home often. Familiar patterns get shaken up at times, but each time you discover a new way to rest that suits you. When home feels stuffy, freshen the air by rearranging the furniture or swapping out one small item.

HS_URANUS_H05.short_line: You have a creative streak that plays and expresses itself like no one else.
HS_URANUS_H05.text: In hobbies, romance, and creative work, the new and unexpected pull you in more than the predictable. A sudden new obsession can awaken a talent you never knew you had. If your interests shift so fast you're left with regrets, keep a list of what you've tried rather than what you've finished.

HS_URANUS_H06.short_line: You do your best work when you set your own rhythm.
HS_URANUS_H06.text: The same routine day after day bores you quickly; your focus comes alive when you reinvent how you work. You're often the first to discover new tools or smarter ways of doing things. If your routine keeps falling apart, choose one or two basic habits to keep no matter what.

HS_URANUS_H07.short_line: You're happiest in relationships where both people have room to be themselves.
HS_URANUS_H07.text: Even in close one-on-one relationships, you need your own space to breathe, and people with a strong sense of self catch your eye. When a relationship changes shape in ways you didn't expect, you learn a new kind of closeness that fits you. If getting closer starts to feel stifling, tell the other person early that you need time to yourself.

HS_URANUS_H08.short_line: Deep change tends to arrive out of the blue, and it renews you.
HS_URANUS_H08.text: Unexpected turns in deep bonds or shared resources change your thinking in a flash. That shake-up becomes your chance to shed old patterns and see things in a new light. For shared money or commitments, keep basic records so change never catches you off guard.

HS_URANUS_H09.short_line: You're a free spirit drawn to unconventional ideas and new worlds.
HS_URANUS_H09.text: You trust the perspectives you've found yourself over ready-made answers, and you fall fast for unfamiliar cultures or new fields of study. On a trip or in a class, an unplanned detour leads to the biggest eye-openers. When your ideas drift too far off, talk them through with people around you to bring them back down to earth.

HS_URANUS_H10.short_line: In your career, you blaze a trail of your own.
HS_URANUS_H10.text: You thrive in roles where you can work your own way rather than follow a set track. Your career takes unexpected turns, and those changes lead you to a role that's truly yours. When a new path calls, test it in a small way alongside your current work first.

HS_URANUS_H11.short_line: You dream up new futures with people who are on your wavelength.
HS_URANUS_H11.text: You get along easily with people of every age and background, and you find kindred spirits in unusual groups. The goals you dream up together can grow into ideas ahead of their time. When your circle keeps shifting and you feel a little empty, reach out first to someone you've known for years.

HS_URANUS_H12.short_line: Flashes of intuition come to you in moments alone.
HS_URANUS_H12.text: Answers arrive out of nowhere while you're resting or drifting off to sleep. The inner freedom you keep to yourself supports you more than you realize. When your mind is buzzing and your sleep runs light, jot down a few lines at day's end and set your thoughts aside.

ASP_JUPITER_SATURN_CONJ.line_meaning: The planet of expansion and the planet of responsibility sit side by side.
ASP_JUPITER_SATURN_CONJ.text: The dreamer and the realist in you live under one roof. Make big plans, then attach deadlines and steps to them, and both sides of you do their best work.
ASP_JUPITER_SATURN_CONJ.title: Jupiter-Saturn conjunction

ASP_JUPITER_SATURN_HARM.line_meaning: The planet of expansion and the planet of responsibility keep each other in balance.
ASP_JUPITER_SATURN_HARM.text: You spot new opportunities and build on them realistically. Set long-term goals and check in on them regularly, and that balance adds up to big results.
ASP_JUPITER_SATURN_HARM.title: Jupiter-Saturn trine/sextile (harmony)

ASP_JUPITER_SATURN_TENSE.line_meaning: The planet of expansion wants to speed up while the planet of responsibility wants to slow down.
ASP_JUPITER_SATURN_TENSE.text: You feel caught between moving ahead and protecting what you already have. Decide up front what you'll try and what you'll hold on to, and those two impulses start working as a team.
ASP_JUPITER_SATURN_TENSE.title: Jupiter-Saturn square/opposition (tension)

ASP_MARS_JUPITER_CONJ.line_meaning: Drive meets the planet of expansion, so your energy runs high.
ASP_MARS_JUPITER_CONJ.text: You have the nerve and the passion to chase big goals. When you're tempted to take on too much at once, budget your energy and time up front so you still have fuel in the tank at the finish line.
ASP_MARS_JUPITER_CONJ.title: Mars-Jupiter conjunction

ASP_MARS_JUPITER_HARM.line_meaning: The planet of expansion gives your drive wings.
ASP_MARS_JUPITER_HARM.text: You meet challenges with confidence and seize opportunities fast. Give that energy a big outlet, like a sport or a new project, and let it shine.
ASP_MARS_JUPITER_HARM.title: Mars-Jupiter trine/sextile (harmony)

ASP_MARS_JUPITER_TENSE.line_meaning: Drive and the planet of expansion keep egging each other on.
ASP_MARS_JUPITER_TENSE.text: Your enthusiasm outruns you, pushing you to overdo it or rush for results. Pencil rest into your schedule too, and you go the distance without burning out.
ASP_MARS_JUPITER_TENSE.title: Mars-Jupiter square/opposition (tension)

ASP_MARS_SATURN_CONJ.line_meaning: Drive meets the planet of responsibility, giving you real staying power.
ASP_MARS_SATURN_CONJ.text: Once you start something, you have the grit and self-discipline to see it through. You're so used to toughing things out that tiredness can pile up unnoticed, so shake it off early and your strength lasts.
ASP_MARS_SATURN_CONJ.title: Mars-Saturn conjunction

ASP_MARS_SATURN_HARM.line_meaning: The planet of responsibility turns your drive into steady strength.
ASP_MARS_SATURN_HARM.text: Slow and steady is your style: you make a plan and keep at it instead of rushing. Your strength shines brightest in goals with a long horizon.
ASP_MARS_SATURN_HARM.title: Mars-Saturn trine/sextile (harmony)

ASP_MARS_SATURN_TENSE.line_meaning: Drive and the planet of responsibility keep hitting the brakes on each other.
ASP_MARS_SATURN_TENSE.text: The urge to go and the voice telling you to stop collide, and frustration builds. Break big jobs into small steps and finish them one at a time, and that tension becomes unshakable strength.
ASP_MARS_SATURN_TENSE.title: Mars-Saturn square/opposition (tension)

ASP_MERCURY_JUPITER_CONJ.line_meaning: Your mind is joined by the planet of expansion, giving you a wide-angle view.
ASP_MERCURY_JUPITER_CONJ.text: With your big-picture vision and easy way with words, you show people what's possible. When ideas are overflowing, pick one concrete next step so your words turn into results.
ASP_MERCURY_JUPITER_CONJ.title: Mercury-Jupiter conjunction

ASP_MERCURY_JUPITER_HARM.line_meaning: The planet of expansion opens your mind wide.
ASP_MERCURY_JUPITER_HARM.text: You're great at soaking up new knowledge and connecting the dots between different fields. Dig deep into a topic you're curious about, or try teaching it to someone, and this gift will take you even further.
ASP_MERCURY_JUPITER_HARM.title: Mercury-Jupiter trine/sextile (harmony)

ASP_MERCURY_JUPITER_TENSE.line_meaning: Your mind and the planet of expansion feed each other's big thinking.
ASP_MERCURY_JUPITER_TENSE.text: You see possibilities on such a grand scale that details slip past you and promises pile up. Keep your big ideas, but pair them with a checklist, and they turn into follow-through people can count on.
ASP_MERCURY_JUPITER_TENSE.title: Mercury-Jupiter square/opposition (tension)

ASP_MERCURY_MARS_CONJ.line_meaning: Your mind and your drive merge, so your words pack a punch.
ASP_MERCURY_MARS_CONJ.text: You think fast and speak with conviction, so you push your ideas forward clearly. When your words race ahead, pause for a beat and read the other person's reaction; you'll be even more convincing.
ASP_MERCURY_MARS_CONJ.title: Mercury-Mars conjunction

ASP_MERCURY_MARS_HARM.line_meaning: Your thoughts and actions are perfectly in sync.
ASP_MERCURY_MARS_HARM.text: You're quick to turn an idea into action. That strength comes in handy in meetings or debates, where you need to organize your thoughts fast.
ASP_MERCURY_MARS_HARM.title: Mercury-Mars trine/sextile (harmony)

ASP_MERCURY_MARS_TENSE.line_meaning: Your mind and drive clash, which gives your words an edge.
ASP_MERCURY_MARS_TENSE.text: When you're frustrated, you talk faster and more bluntly. The more important the conversation, the more it pays to jot down what you want to say first; the edge softens and your point comes through clearly.
ASP_MERCURY_MARS_TENSE.title: Mercury-Mars square/opposition (tension)

ASP_MERCURY_SATURN_CONJ.line_meaning: Your mind is joined by the planet of responsibility, so you choose your words carefully.
ASP_MERCURY_SATURN_CONJ.text: You think before you speak, and your mind runs deep. If you hold back until every thought is perfectly in order, share a rough draft first and let it grow from there.
ASP_MERCURY_SATURN_CONJ.title: Mercury-Saturn conjunction

ASP_MERCURY_SATURN_HARM.line_meaning: Saturn, the planet of responsibility, gives your thinking structure and weight.
ASP_MERCURY_SATURN_HARM.text: Your mind works carefully and methodically, untangling even knotted problems one step at a time. This gift shines in study or work that rewards patient, deep digging.
ASP_MERCURY_SATURN_HARM.title: Mercury-Saturn trine/sextile (harmony)

ASP_MERCURY_SATURN_TENSE.line_meaning: Your thoughts and the planet of responsibility press hard on each other.
ASP_MERCURY_SATURN_TENSE.text: You worry about getting it wrong before you even open your mouth, and you edit your own thoughts too harshly. Share small opinions often: each time it goes well, your caution grows into a strength people rely on.
ASP_MERCURY_SATURN_TENSE.title: Mercury-Saturn square/opposition (tension)

ASP_MERCURY_VENUS_CONJ.line_meaning: How you think and speak blends with what you love.
ASP_MERCURY_VENUS_CONJ.text: You speak gently and have a gift for saying things in a way people love to hear. Don't let your true feelings get lost in all those kind words; share your honest thoughts now and then, too.
ASP_MERCURY_VENUS_CONJ.title: Mercury-Venus conjunction

ASP_MERCURY_VENUS_HARM.line_meaning: Your mind and your sense of beauty bring out the best in each other.
ASP_MERCURY_VENUS_HARM.text: You have a talent for spotting beauty and capturing it in words. A hobby that shows off your taste, like writing or design, makes this strength shine even brighter.
ASP_MERCURY_VENUS_HARM.title: Mercury-Venus trine/sextile (harmony)

ASP_MERCURY_VENUS_TENSE.line_meaning: Mercury and Venus never form this angle.
ASP_MERCURY_VENUS_TENSE.text: Both planets stay close to the Sun, so they can never form a tense angle with each other. This combination doesn't appear in birth charts, so feel free to skip it.
ASP_MERCURY_VENUS_TENSE.title: Mercury-Venus square/opposition (tension)

ASP_MOON_JUPITER_CONJ.line_meaning: Your emotions are joined by the planet of expansion, giving you a big heart.
ASP_MOON_JUPITER_CONJ.text: You're big-hearted and generous with your warmth. Your feelings run wide, too, so when you're worn out, give yourself plenty of time alone to recharge.
ASP_MOON_JUPITER_CONJ.title: Moon-Jupiter conjunction

ASP_MOON_JUPITER_HARM.line_meaning: The planet of expansion wraps your emotions in warmth.
ASP_MOON_JUPITER_HARM.text: You have the resilience to find hope again even when life gets hard. On heavy days, think of one thing you're grateful for, and you'll find your footing faster.
ASP_MOON_JUPITER_HARM.title: Moon-Jupiter trine/sextile (harmony)

ASP_MOON_JUPITER_TENSE.line_meaning: Your emotions and the planet of expansion make each other larger than life.
ASP_MOON_JUPITER_TENSE.text: Whether you're thrilled or disappointed, your feelings loom larger than they really are. When you're riding high or feeling low, give it a day and take another look; you'll find your balance.
ASP_MOON_JUPITER_TENSE.title: Moon-Jupiter square/opposition (tension)

ASP_MOON_MARS_CONJ.line_meaning: Your emotions and your drive merge, so you act with real fire.
ASP_MOON_MARS_CONJ.text: You're honest and passionate, and your feelings turn into action the instant you have them. When emotions surge, burn them off by moving your body first, and you'll be less likely to say something sharp.
ASP_MOON_MARS_CONJ.title: Moon-Mars conjunction

ASP_MOON_MARS_HARM.line_meaning: Your emotions and your drive naturally team up.
ASP_MOON_MARS_HARM.text: When your heart is in something, you act without hesitating. Start what you feel drawn to right away, even in a small way, and you put this strength to good use.
ASP_MOON_MARS_HARM.title: Moon-Mars trine/sextile (harmony)

ASP_MOON_MARS_TENSE.line_meaning: Your emotions and drive collide, and your temper runs hot.
ASP_MOON_MARS_TENSE.text: Hurt or frustration can flare into anger fast. When feelings rise, step away for a moment or take a walk, and you channel that energy into protecting yourself.
ASP_MOON_MARS_TENSE.title: Moon-Mars square/opposition (tension)

ASP_MOON_MERCURY_CONJ.line_meaning: Your emotions blend with how you think and speak.
ASP_MOON_MERCURY_CONJ.text: You put feelings into words the moment you have them, so you express yourself honestly and vividly. When emotions run high, write them down before you speak, and watch your thoughts settle.
ASP_MOON_MERCURY_CONJ.title: Moon-Mercury conjunction

ASP_MOON_MERCURY_HARM.line_meaning: Your feelings and thoughts work in sync.
ASP_MOON_MERCURY_HARM.text: You notice how you feel and put it into words with ease. Use that gift for regular, open conversations with the people close to you, and your relationships feel much lighter.
ASP_MOON_MERCURY_HARM.title: Moon-Mercury trine/sextile (harmony)

ASP_MOON_MERCURY_TENSE.line_meaning: Your feelings and thoughts are telling you different things.
ASP_MOON_MERCURY_TENSE.text: Your head often says you're fine while your heart disagrees. Write your thoughts and feelings down separately, and you'll see what each one needs.
ASP_MOON_MERCURY_TENSE.title: Moon-Mercury square/opposition (tension)

ASP_MOON_SATURN_CONJ.line_meaning: Your emotions are joined by the planet of responsibility, making you careful with your feelings.
ASP_MOON_SATURN_CONJ.text: You sort through your feelings privately rather than showing them easily. If you're used to handling everything alone, practice opening up, little by little, to one person you trust.
ASP_MOON_SATURN_CONJ.title: Moon-Saturn conjunction

ASP_MOON_SATURN_HARM.line_meaning: The planet of responsibility keeps your emotions calm and steady.
ASP_MOON_SATURN_HARM.text: Even when your feelings are shaken, you regain your footing quickly. A regular daily rhythm protects your peace of mind, so keep up a routine that works for you.
ASP_MOON_SATURN_HARM.title: Moon-Saturn trine/sextile (harmony)

ASP_MOON_SATURN_TENSE.line_meaning: Your emotions and the planet of responsibility weigh each other down.
ASP_MOON_SATURN_TENSE.text: Leaning on others doesn't come easily, and you worry that showing your feelings will make you a burden. Start with small requests; each time you learn it's okay to lean on someone, you feel a little lighter.
ASP_MOON_SATURN_TENSE.title: Moon-Saturn square/opposition (tension)

ASP_MOON_VENUS_CONJ.line_meaning: Your emotions are intertwined with what you love.
ASP_MOON_VENUS_CONJ.text: You feel most at home in a kind, warm atmosphere. When looking after others wears you out, refill your own cup first with the things you love.
ASP_MOON_VENUS_CONJ.title: Moon-Venus conjunction

ASP_MOON_VENUS_HARM.line_meaning: Your emotions and your tastes support each other with ease.
ASP_MOON_VENUS_HARM.text: Beautiful things and easygoing relationships help you find your calm. Keep a favorite space or hobby close in daily life, and make the most of your knack for bouncing back quickly.
ASP_MOON_VENUS_HARM.title: Moon-Venus trine/sextile (harmony)

ASP_MOON_VENUS_TENSE.line_meaning: What you need emotionally and what you're drawn to don't quite match.
ASP_MOON_VENUS_TENSE.text: Some moments feel confusing when what you need emotionally isn't what attracts you. When something catches your eye, pause and ask what you really want right now; choosing gets much easier.
ASP_MOON_VENUS_TENSE.title: Moon-Venus square/opposition (tension)

ASP_SUN_JUPITER_CONJ.line_meaning: Your core self is joined by the planet of expansion.
ASP_SUN_JUPITER_CONJ.text: You're an optimist at heart, always on the lookout for bigger possibilities. When your wish list grows long, set priorities so that generous energy stays focused.
ASP_SUN_JUPITER_CONJ.title: Sun-Jupiter conjunction

ASP_SUN_JUPITER_HARM.line_meaning: The planet of expansion gives your core self generous backing.
ASP_SUN_JUPITER_HARM.text: You meet new learning and opportunities with an open mind. Giving and receiving help comes easily to you, so you thrive when learning alongside others.
ASP_SUN_JUPITER_HARM.title: Sun-Jupiter trine/sextile (harmony)

ASP_SUN_JUPITER_TENSE.line_meaning: Your core self and the planet of expansion pump each other up.
ASP_SUN_JUPITER_TENSE.text: Your expectations run high, and you're tempted to take on too much at once. Break your plans into small pieces and check them off one by one, and big dreams become realistic steps.
ASP_SUN_JUPITER_TENSE.title: Sun-Jupiter square/opposition (tension)

ASP_SUN_MARS_CONJ.line_meaning: Your sense of self and your drive merge, giving you serious momentum.
ASP_SUN_MARS_CONJ.text: Once your mind is made up, you're off, which makes you a natural at getting things started. When you have energy to burn, work it off through exercise or physical activity, and the restlessness eases.
ASP_SUN_MARS_CONJ.title: Sun-Mars conjunction

ASP_SUN_MARS_HARM.line_meaning: Your sense of self and your drive work hand in hand.
ASP_SUN_MARS_HARM.text: You turn what you want into action with ease. Pour that follow-through steadily into one thing you want to keep doing, and it adds up to real, visible results.
ASP_SUN_MARS_HARM.title: Sun-Mars trine/sextile (harmony)

ASP_SUN_MARS_TENSE.line_meaning: Your sense of self and your drive butt heads, throwing off sparks.
ASP_SUN_MARS_TENSE.text: Eagerness sometimes makes you impatient or quick to snap. Make a habit of taking one breath before you act, and you aim that fiery energy exactly where you want it.
ASP_SUN_MARS_TENSE.title: Sun-Mars square/opposition (tension)

ASP_SUN_MERCURY_CONJ.line_meaning: Your sense of self blends with how you think and speak.
ASP_SUN_MERCURY_CONJ.text: Your personality shines through how you think and talk, so you state your opinions plainly. When you feel especially sure of yourself, ask what the other person thinks, and the conversation flows smoothly.
ASP_SUN_MERCURY_CONJ.title: Sun-Mercury conjunction

ASP_SUN_MERCURY_HARM.line_meaning: The Sun and Mercury never form this angle.
ASP_SUN_MERCURY_HARM.text: Mercury always stays close to the Sun, so this aspect never shows up in a birth chart. You won't see this combination on your screen, so you can skip it.
ASP_SUN_MERCURY_HARM.title: Sun-Mercury trine/sextile (harmony)

ASP_SUN_MERCURY_TENSE.line_meaning: The Sun and Mercury never form this angle.
ASP_SUN_MERCURY_TENSE.text: Mercury always stays close to the Sun, so this aspect never shows up in a birth chart. You won't see this combination on your screen, so you can skip it.
ASP_SUN_MERCURY_TENSE.title: Sun-Mercury square/opposition (tension)

ASP_SUN_MOON_CONJ.line_meaning: Your core self and your emotions align and point the same way.
ASP_SUN_MOON_CONJ.text: What you want and how you feel point in the same direction, so you throw your full weight behind whatever you set out to do. That focus can turn one-sided, so hear out other perspectives now and then to stay balanced.
ASP_SUN_MOON_CONJ.title: Sun-Moon conjunction

ASP_SUN_MOON_HARM.line_meaning: Your sense of self and your emotions naturally back each other up.
ASP_SUN_MOON_HARM.text: What you want and how you feel rarely pull against each other, so you accept yourself with ease. Use that stability as your base and take on new challenges, one at a time.
ASP_SUN_MOON_HARM.title: Sun-Moon trine/sextile (harmony)

ASP_SUN_MOON_TENSE.line_meaning: Your sense of self and your emotions pull in different directions.
ASP_SUN_MOON_TENSE.text: What your mind wants and what feels comfortable don't always match, and you feel an inner tug-of-war. Write down both wishes and find ways to honor each a little; that tension then becomes a force that helps you grow.
ASP_SUN_MOON_TENSE.title: Sun-Moon square/opposition (tension)

ASP_SUN_SATURN_CONJ.line_meaning: Your core self is joined by the planet of responsibility.
ASP_SUN_SATURN_CONJ.text: You hold yourself to high standards and are deeply committed to seeing things through. When it all feels too heavy, write down what you got done today and give yourself the credit you've earned.
ASP_SUN_SATURN_CONJ.title: Sun-Saturn conjunction

ASP_SUN_SATURN_HARM.line_meaning: The planet of responsibility gives your core self a solid footing.
ASP_SUN_SATURN_HARM.text: You find stability in building things step by step over time. Consistency is your superpower, so make long-range plans and let that strength shine.
ASP_SUN_SATURN_HARM.title: Sun-Saturn trine/sextile (harmony)

ASP_SUN_SATURN_TENSE.line_meaning: Your core self and the planet of responsibility put each other to the test.
ASP_SUN_SATURN_TENSE.text: What you should do comes to mind before what you want to do, so you're quick to be hard on yourself. Lower the bar a little and let yourself enjoy small wins often; this tension then becomes the very thing that makes you steadfast.
ASP_SUN_SATURN_TENSE.title: Sun-Saturn square/opposition (tension)

ASP_SUN_VENUS_CONJ.line_meaning: Your sense of self blends with what you love.
ASP_SUN_VENUS_CONJ.text: Your tastes and your eye for beauty are a big part of who you are. When the urge to please others grows strong, make room for what you truly love as well.
ASP_SUN_VENUS_CONJ.title: Sun-Venus conjunction

ASP_SUN_VENUS_HARM.line_meaning: The Sun and Venus never form this angle.
ASP_SUN_VENUS_HARM.text: Venus never strays far from the Sun, so this aspect can't occur in a birth chart. This combination won't appear on your screen, so feel free to skip it.
ASP_SUN_VENUS_HARM.title: Sun-Venus trine/sextile (harmony)

ASP_SUN_VENUS_TENSE.line_meaning: The Sun and Venus never form this angle.
ASP_SUN_VENUS_TENSE.text: Venus never strays far from the Sun, so this aspect can't occur in a birth chart. This combination won't appear on your screen, so feel free to skip it.
ASP_SUN_VENUS_TENSE.title: Sun-Venus square/opposition (tension)

ASP_VENUS_JUPITER_CONJ.line_meaning: Love meets the planet of expansion, giving you a big, generous heart.
ASP_VENUS_JUPITER_CONJ.text: You have abundant love for people and beautiful things, and you bring warmth wherever you go. When the time or money you spend on pleasure starts creeping up, set a budget so the good times last.
ASP_VENUS_JUPITER_CONJ.title: Venus-Jupiter conjunction

ASP_VENUS_JUPITER_HARM.line_meaning: The planet of expansion helps what you love flourish.
ASP_VENUS_JUPITER_HARM.text: Good people and good times find you when you're out mixing with others. Say thank you often, and watch that warmth keep spreading.
ASP_VENUS_JUPITER_HARM.title: Venus-Jupiter trine/sextile (harmony)

ASP_VENUS_JUPITER_TENSE.line_meaning: Love meets the planet of expansion, and you want more of everything.
ASP_VENUS_JUPITER_TENSE.text: Your appetite for the good stuff can tip you into overgiving or overspending. Name what genuinely makes you happy, and you feel more satisfied with less strain.
ASP_VENUS_JUPITER_TENSE.title: Venus-Jupiter square/opposition (tension)

ASP_VENUS_MARS_CONJ.line_meaning: Desire and drive fuse here, and your passion runs hot.
ASP_VENUS_MARS_CONJ.text: When you want something, you go for it, and that confidence carries real charm. When the pull is strong, tune in to the other person's pace too, and things between you flow more easily.
ASP_VENUS_MARS_CONJ.title: Venus-Mars conjunction

ASP_VENUS_MARS_HARM.line_meaning: What you love and what you go after are naturally in sync.
ASP_VENUS_MARS_HARM.text: You ask for what you want with a light touch, yet you still make the first move when it counts. Give regular time to the things you love, and that balance brings you both joy and results.
ASP_VENUS_MARS_HARM.title: Venus-Mars trine/sextile (harmony)

ASP_VENUS_MARS_TENSE.line_meaning: Desire and drive tug in opposite directions.
ASP_VENUS_MARS_TENSE.text: Part of you wants to close the distance and part of you wants to keep the peace, and that push-pull shows up in your relationships. Say what you want kindly but clearly, and the friction becomes a bridge to understanding.
ASP_VENUS_MARS_TENSE.title: Venus-Mars square/opposition (tension)

ASP_VENUS_SATURN_CONJ.line_meaning: Love meets the planet of responsibility, so you take matters of the heart seriously.
ASP_VENUS_SATURN_CONJ.text: You choose carefully who and what you let in, and once you give your heart, you stay loyal for the long haul. When you catch yourself skimping on self-care, treat yourself to a small gift.
ASP_VENUS_SATURN_CONJ.title: Venus-Saturn conjunction

ASP_VENUS_SATURN_HARM.line_meaning: The planet of responsibility helps you keep what you love for the long run.
ASP_VENUS_SATURN_HARM.text: You value relationships and tastes that grow richer with time. Keep investing in the people and habits you mean to keep, and a deep sense of security takes root.
ASP_VENUS_SATURN_HARM.title: Venus-Saturn trine/sextile (harmony)

ASP_VENUS_SATURN_TENSE.line_meaning: Love and the planet of responsibility hold each other in a tight grip.
ASP_VENUS_SATURN_TENSE.text: You hesitate to show affection, or you wonder whether you're truly lovable. Give and receive small, everyday kindnesses, and that caution slowly ripens into a deep, steady love.
ASP_VENUS_SATURN_TENSE.title: Venus-Saturn square/opposition (tension)

CHAR_01_OTTER.choice_line: These days, when I feel lonely, I'm the one texting friends to make plans. If they're slow to answer, I keep checking my phone and get antsy.

CHAR_02_SEA_OTTER.choice_line: Even on my own rough days, I usually ask how the other person is doing and just listen. Lately, conversations often end before I've said a word about myself.

CHAR_03_SEAL.choice_line: Lately, when things get hard, I say I'm fine and pull myself together on my own. Only once it's all sorted do I mention it to someone close, briefly, like old news.

CHAR_04_BEAVER.choice_line: The more upset I am these days, the busier I keep myself, reworking my to-do list. Instead of opening up, I tend to focus on plans and things we can do together.

CHAR_05_MANDARIN_DUCK.choice_line: When I wonder how someone close to me is really feeling, I want to go see them and check. Lately, even after they say they're fine, I catch myself wanting to ask again a few days later.

CHAR_06_PENGUIN.choice_line: Lately I let little hurts slide and go along with what the other person wants, because I don't want things to turn sour. If we're comfortable together, I tell myself that's enough.

CHAR_07_HERON.choice_line: With someone new in my life, I tend to watch from a distance for a while these days. I only move closer once I've decided for myself that I can trust them.

CHAR_08_SWAN.choice_line: On the outside I act like everything's fine, but lately I'm quietly planning how to keep the relationship from falling apart. I keep my worries to myself and line up backup plans.

CHAR_09_PUFFERFISH.choice_line: These days, if someone crosses a line, I tell them on the spot that I'm not okay with it. Afterward, I sometimes worry I came across harsher than I meant to.

CHAR_10_HERMIT_CRAB.choice_line: Lately, even when I want to turn down a favor, one look at their face and I end up saying yes. I know it's eating into my time, but 'no' just won't come out.

CHAR_11_TURTLE.choice_line: When someone barges into my space these days, I quietly text less and retreat into time alone. Instead of saying it bothers me, I slip away and catch my breath.

CHAR_12_CLAM.choice_line: I've been deciding how much to show each person based on the situation. When someone asks for a favor, I first figure out how much I can give, then say yes with conditions.

CHAR_13_FUR_SEAL.choice_line: Lately, if something's on my mind, I have to say it right away or I can't relax. Sometimes I blurt it out, then replay it in my head afterward.

CHAR_14_DOLPHIN.choice_line: In conversations these days, I'm great at chiming in to keep the mood up, but I rarely say what I actually think. It's often on the way home that I remember what I wanted to say.

CHAR_15_HUMPBACK_WHALE.choice_line: I keep rehearsing what to say in my head, and lately I often miss my moment. Many days I draft a message and tweak it forever before I hit send.

CHAR_16_FROG.choice_line: Lately, I try to save important talks for when the other person's mood and timing seem right. There are a few things I've put off, still waiting for a better moment.

CHAR_17_OCTOPUS.choice_line: These days, if things get awkward with someone, I want to reach out and clear the air that same day. Even when they seem to need time to think, waiting for a reply is hard for me.

CHAR_18_JELLYFISH.choice_line: When we argue lately, I'm the first to crack a smile, lighten the mood, and move on. Whatever hurt I felt, I usually just let it go unsaid.

CHAR_19_STINGRAY.choice_line: Lately, when an argument breaks out, I step away and take time alone until I've cooled down. Sometimes it takes longer than I expect before I'm ready to talk again.

CHAR_20_STARFISH.choice_line: When things go off track with someone these days, I try to pin down what went wrong and find a fix. More than once, they just wanted comfort and I jumped straight to solutions.

CHAR_01_OTTER.grow: This is your year to notice what you need when you long for support, and to ask for exactly that. Tell people up front, in just a few words, what helps: "On days I need comfort, I'd love it if you'd just listen."
CHAR_01_OTTER.let_go: Ease up on the urge to send one more message when a reply doesn't come fast enough. Being the first to reach out once kept your relationships from going cold, but overdoing it only makes you more anxious.

CHAR_02_SEA_OTTER.grow: Next, you build the trust that it's safe to lean on someone and share your story too. In the year ahead, be the first to say how your day went at least once in every conversation.
CHAR_02_SEA_OTTER.let_go: Even on hard days, you check on how others feel and save your own story for later. Set that habit down. It once kept your relationships comfortable, but the longer you put yourself last, the fewer places you have to lean on.

CHAR_03_SEAL.grow: Your growth edge now is letting someone close see your feelings, even while they're still messy. In the year ahead, the same week something hard happens, tell one person you trust, "Here's what's been going on lately."
CHAR_03_SEAL.let_go: Stop waiting until everything's sorted to open up and talk about it like old news. Pulling yourself together alone once kept you strong, but while you do, the people around you lose their chance to help.

CHAR_04_BEAVER.grow: Now you learn to lean on people by sharing how you feel before you share your plans. In the year ahead, before deciding what to do together, make a ritual of asking each other how you've really been.
CHAR_04_BEAVER.let_go: On upset days, you grab your to-do list and keep yourself busy. Let that habit go. Focusing on the task at hand once held shaky days together, but when work fills every gap, even the time you could spend opening up, you wear yourself out alone.

CHAR_05_MANDARIN_DUCK.grow: Your next step is to trust the time you've built together, without needing to hear it in words. In the year ahead, start a small journal: each time the urge to ask rises, write down one moment you felt grateful for.
CHAR_05_MANDARIN_DUCK.let_go: Little by little, release the urge to ask again even after you've been reassured. Reaching out to check where you stand once protected your relationships, but the more often you seek reassurance, the longer the anxiety lingers.

CHAR_06_PENGUIN.grow: Now you build the confidence that saying what you want won't make a relationship crumble. In the year ahead, start small: pick the restaurant or the meeting spot, and speak up first.
CHAR_06_PENGUIN.let_go: Stop swallowing your hurt feelings out of fear of rocking the boat. Going along with others once protected the relationships you cherish, but when hurt piles up unspoken, trust starts to wear thin.

CHAR_07_HERON.grow: Your moment has come to trust people a little at a time, even before everything checks out. In the year ahead, choose one of the people you've been watching from afar and share a small worry with them first.
CHAR_07_HERON.let_go: Relax the habit of opening up only once you're completely sure someone can be trusted. Watching carefully from a distance once spared you from getting hurt, but when the vetting drags on, you miss warmth that's already right in front of you.

CHAR_08_SWAN.grow: Your next chapter is about trusting that a relationship holds steady even when you voice your worries. In the year ahead, before you make plans, tell someone close what's been weighing on you.
CHAR_08_SWAN.let_go: Release the habit of hiding your worries and quietly redrawing backup plans on your own. Keeping your balance on the inside once held your relationships steady, but the more you carry alone, the faster you wear out.

CHAR_09_PUFFERFISH.grow: You're ready to state your boundaries clearly and calmly. In the year ahead, pick one situation that keeps making you uncomfortable and have one sentence ready for the next time it happens.
CHAR_09_PUFFERFISH.let_go: Tone down the reflex to push back hard the second something feels off. Sending a signal right away once protected you, but when the words rush out too fast, they hide the very thing you meant to protect.

CHAR_10_HERMIT_CRAB.grow: Your growth now is keeping your kindness while getting clear on what's yours to handle and what isn't. In the year ahead, when someone asks a favor, don't answer on the spot. Buy yourself time with "Let me think about it and get back to you."
CHAR_10_HERMIT_CRAB.let_go: Drop the habit of swallowing your 'no' and agreeing to favors before anything else. Making room for others once kept your relationships smooth, but if it goes on, you lose the space that's truly yours.

CHAR_11_TURTLE.grow: Now you practice telling people what you're comfortable with before you pull back. In the year ahead, when something bothers you, share one thing you'd like, even in a short text.
CHAR_11_TURTLE.let_go: When something bothers you, you quietly text less and pull away. Loosen that habit. Retreating to catch your breath once kept you safe, but if the other person never learns why, they cross the same line again.

CHAR_12_CLAM.grow: Check in with how you feel first, before you start calculating, and set your boundaries from there. In the year ahead, look back on each week, jot down which get-togethers felt easy and which drained you, and let that difference shape your own ground rules.
CHAR_12_CLAM.let_go: Stop putting your own feelings last while you calculate, every single time, how much of yourself to show. Weighing things carefully once kept you safe, but when all your energy goes into the math, you lose sight of what you actually want.

CHAR_13_FUR_SEAL.grow: Now you hone what you say so it truly lands with the other person. In the year ahead, after an important conversation, ask how it came across, and make that a habit.
CHAR_13_FUR_SEAL.let_go: Loosen the need to say whatever pops into your head the instant it arrives. Speaking up first once got conversations going, but words that rush out leave you replaying them later.

CHAR_14_DOLPHIN.grow: Your next step is keeping the warm mood going while adding one sentence of what you really think. In the year ahead, start with the people closest to you, and get comfortable saying, "I actually see it a little differently."
CHAR_14_DOLPHIN.let_go: Stop hiding what you really think just to keep the mood light. Chiming in to brighten a conversation once put everyone at ease, but if it goes on, your own voice slowly fades from the room.

CHAR_15_HUMPBACK_WHALE.grow: You're ready to share your thoughts as they are, rough edges and all. In the year ahead, when there's something you want to say, say it, even briefly, before the day is out.
CHAR_15_HUMPBACK_WHALE.let_go: Loosen your hold on words you keep back until they're perfectly polished. Taking time to think deeply once kept you from saying things you'd regret, but while you polish, the moment to speak slips away.

CHAR_16_FROG.grow: This is your year to say what needs saying, even when the timing feels a bit awkward. In the year ahead, pick one conversation you've been putting off and ease into it somewhere relaxed.
CHAR_16_FROG.let_go: Let go of waiting for a better moment before you speak. Choosing the right time and place once kept conversations running smoothly, but the perfect moment arrives far less often than you'd think.

CHAR_17_OCTOPUS.grow: Now you learn to offer to make up, then trust the other person's pace and wait. In the year ahead, after an argument, share how you feel in a few words and tell them they can reply whenever they're ready.
CHAR_17_OCTOPUS.let_go: Release the pressure to patch things up the very same day. Reaching out first once mended relationships fast, but reaching out before the other person is ready makes them close off instead.

CHAR_18_JELLYFISH.grow: Trust that caring for a relationship and caring for yourself go hand in hand. In the year ahead, when something stings, jot it down in a one-line note, and bring those notes up one at a time before they pile up.
CHAR_18_JELLYFISH.let_go: Set aside the habit of letting hurt feelings drift by just to smooth over an argument. Going with the flow to soften the mood once protected your relationships, but hurt left unsaid comes flooding out in the next argument.

CHAR_19_STINGRAY.grow: Take your break, and leave the door open to come back. In the year ahead, decide in advance on the one sentence you'll say first when you return after some space.
CHAR_19_STINGRAY.let_go: Ease up on going silent and keeping your distance for ages until you've cooled off. Taking time alone to calm down once kept you from saying things you'd regret, but open-ended silence feels like a far wider gap to the other person.

CHAR_20_STARFISH.grow: Your growth now is acknowledging how someone feels before you try to fix anything. In the year ahead, before you share your own take, practice repeating back what the other person said, in their own words.
CHAR_20_STARFISH.let_go: Hold back from rushing in with solutions before you've heard how the other person feels. Working step by step toward a fix once brought people back together, but if their feelings aren't heard first, even a great solution feels out of reach.

Q1_CAREER.eoy_tease: Around this time, you may find yourself resetting the direction of your work in everyday places like meetings or work chats.
Q1_CAREER.focus_intro: You picked Work & career, so we started with the part of your chart that rules career and your public role, plus the part that covers daily work and routines. We also read the transits to your Midheaven, which points to your work direction, and to Saturn, the planet of responsibility.
Q1_CAREER.label: work and career
Q1_CAREER.quiet_line: No major transits touch your work area right now. With nothing outside pushing you, you set your own pace and choose your next goal.

Q1_FAMILY.eoy_tease: Around this time, familiar moments like check-in calls or family gatherings may lead you to rethink the distance between you and your family.
Q1_FAMILY.focus_intro: Since Family is your focus, we began with the area for home, family, and emotional roots. We also checked where your Moon, the planet of feelings and emotional security, sits and what's influencing it right now.
Q1_FAMILY.label: family
Q1_FAMILY.quiet_line: Little is moving over your home and family area at the moment. With nothing big shaking things up, you decide how close to stay and how often to check in.
